tei:div.tei:p: — 45rdoṭwāṃrkeri ri — —sna dzñakha/ ji thosporte skeṣṭha4tshedngha bhe khapā1 do sne sngodzi / rdzi’ 1dngha3 khi/ tsā bzla / ༈ sdza/ 1'bri gung chos grags sogs/(lha —༵ netorki /watram̐ ri ri —ri ri)༄7dza riwatswaḥ྾rījidzikshi pa pā / 1 rdzo྾/shā— rīrībyu ritshobhedzo— rī snyesdo protyā riri/ri (dzwahūṃ 4 ṇḍisgro/ dzeX—sna ’ri — — pa rī 3 (shā ( moza rwarmeṭwāṃriri nya/rta dzerdo7 phro snardo — byu sni/ rmelke trīnya rdzo7 jipyuthotsho4dzemoram̐ 7getre rwariri / ṇi phrotshodzāj-iltazlo shāswā (sdurdo kādzwatram̐n—ñdzapre— ḍārdo—tswa1ri~X ske ngatārnersharmyesnaḍū

tsho rdowa rsha rdo snye/dī/ pyo — /tsho la la bye / rwa/ — sdo rngo ༷tsho/ /hūṃ— sto rtso chi 4rnaX ci : tsho 5— dnghaX ri— citsho zirdo ri dnghasduX 〉 — ‘4༷ shetsho / ṭī/pyasde dzā hūṃ//spyo — ṭwāṃ zlo snye/byeri snre/ /di treoX sgo/ gidro/—rtse— rte rte —/ snyo — 4 4/sna rsha ༵ ‘ri snyetsho — rde // wa/ phu wa ༷ tsho du kyi tsho bod kyi gso ba rig pa'i gna' dpe phyogs bsgrigs dpe tshogs/ rte sde sde/ ’ skre/ snyegyu waX bhe// nti / / rdoXnghru nghru/ 4ྈ0ྈ4 ༷ dhe rdo lja༈ wa/ sgro ri/phyo/ 4/ spre spre — 7 ‘ sa 4 sa /rmā kto rdebyetram̐ ‘ ༵rdesdo riri droduci—ོ / 'a/bra/ ru’ nga smamerha/ myus kto pru’ ta〉(rte rnyekye / 4 3 khe kṇi /skre sdookā 4 /nghruskrebye/ snye/lja// wa dā sdo3 /:༵ zi sthā/ 'azi gung chos grags sogs/ / nghru/ tram̐ gyi/rdo / trom̐/ / /sdu rdo/ ༷ dzee/ rde /dzo kā martsa sngo na 'ing chen bod kyi galko rig zhib 'jug khang nasabardzi/ 4| tre waskre wa bye bod kyi gso ba rig pa'i gna' dpe phyogatshobasgrigasadape tshog4〉rtsom sgrig tshog4pa ༷ wapy-irdo —༵/ ri spra ོ༵/ / sdu/4 / / rdo wa pringhruX nt+ra khrirdo sdeX ༷ ga dribye ne / // 1ṣpe/ ci kye6kye—— byesgre hūṃ pre / / rdobyedzhabye shīo// dhe / rdo wa bye— dzispya ga mirigasadaṣpeskrustong/ / wa byelnge ram̐ 4 ji wasnadro )jipyi / nt+rohūṃ/ /rdo bye ༷—sgoo—ོwa dro niwa chi py-i tshodrori ri ske 5 ci ri ༷ —wachi ’— rde ji rdodngha chi— rdo —ge ṣe ciwa dzo bye/ snye/khro/༵sdu |/lte skre /༷/ོshaṃ gyinghruhūṃ/tī/shā| /rdo sdo ṭwāṃ shaṃ gyo rwa/— ོrdo‘dnghacaji kā rtsa ji rdokwa/
glosmo ddhapo

sngon 'gro'i gtam/bod kyi gso ba rig pa la lo ngo bzhi stong la nye ba'i lo rgyus lda na la/ de ni gna' bo'i bod kyi gso rig rmang gzhir byas thog rgya gar rgya nag ta zig la sogs pa'i gso ba rig pa'i nying bcud bsdu len byas nas grub pa zhig yin la/gzhung lugs kyi ma lag cha tshang zhing lag len gyi myong byang phun sum tshogs pa dang / mi rigs kyi khyad chos mngon par bkra ba'i gso dpyad kyi rig pa zhig yin pas na/ snga mo zhig nas 'dzam gling khyab khongs kyi gso rig smra ba rnams kyis gdeng 'jog chen po gnang mus su mchis/bod kyi gso ba rig pa la gzhung dang lag len gyi bstan bcos bgrang las 'das pa zhig yod pa ste/ de ni nang don gyi thad gso rig lo rgyus dang /rmang gzhi'i gzhung lugs/ nad thog lag len/ sman rdzas sdeb bzo/ lus khams bde srung la sogs rig tshan yongs su 'dus yod pa'i nor bu'i bang mdzod cig lags/ de la tang dang srid gzhung gi thugs 'khur dang brtsi mthong chen po'i 'og nye lor bod kyi gso ba rig pa rgyun 'dzin dang dar spel gang legs byung yod la/ gna' gzhung gang mang zhig kyang dpe skrun 'grems spel byas zin yod/ yin na yang da dung gna' dpe mang po zhig sngar bzhin 'bus zos rul gog thebs pa'am/ yang na mi'i rtsol ba'i dbang gis gtor brlag tshabs chen thebs kyi yod pas/ gang myur sgos srung skyob ma byas tshe rin thang gzhal du med pa'i gna' dpe gang mang zhig rtsa brlag rgyun chad du 'gro nyen che/de la bod kyi gso ba rig pa nyid phyogs yongs nas rgyun 'dzin dang dar 1

spel gtong rgyu'i dmigs yul bcangs nas nga tshos 2002lor mtsho sngon zhing chen bod kyi gso rig zhib 'jug khang gis gtso khrid byas pa'i ‘‘〈bod kyi gso ba rig pa'i gna' dpe phyogs bsgrigs dpe tshogs〉rtsom sgrig tshogs pa ’’sgrig 'dzugs byas pa dang / gna' dpe 'tshol sdud dang dag sgrig dang rtsom sgrig bcas kyi las sgo phye zhing dpe skrun dang 'grems spel gyi bya ba yang 'go brtsams zin yod/ dpe tshogs 'di ni snga na ma mchis pa'i rig gnas kyi las grwa chen po zhig yin la/ 'di nyid bod kyi gso ba rig pa'i gna' dpe yod do cog 'dus pa'i dpe tshogs shig tu 'gyur bar byed rgyu ni nga tsho'i bsam 'dun yin la/ de ltar byed thub pa'i yid ches kyang nga tshor yod/de ltar dpe tshogs 'di thog mar dpe skrun byed pa'i sgo dang bstun nas 'dir kho bos bya bzhag chen po 'di phyogs gang thad nas bya ba lam lhong yong ba'i bkra shis smon 'dun zhu rgyu dang / de bzhin bod kyi gso ba rig pa la lhag bsam dkar ba'i yul dang phyogs so so'i skyes bu kun nas kyang las grwa 'dir phyogs gang thad nas rgyab skyor dang rogs 'degs byed pa'i bsam 'dun zhu rgyu yin/zhes 'o tshogs chen nas/2004lo'i zla 2par/2

mtshams spyor ba'i gtam/kha ba ri bo'i bcu phrag rig gnas zhes bya ba ni bod mi rigs kyis 'jig rtenaspyi'i phan bde gzhi mar gyur pa'i blo'i rig pa mtha' dag spyi la btags pa'i ming zhig yin la/ de las gzhan rjes 'dzin gyi thabs mchog dam par gyur pa'i gangs can gso ba rig pa ni bod mi rigs rang nyid kyis srol rgyun dar spel mdzad cing 'gro ba mi'i rigs la phan pa 'ba' zhig sgrub pa'i rig pa zhig yin stabs/ ris su ma chad pa'i 'gro ba mi'i rigs la phan pa'i las don kho na sgrub pa'i rig pa zhig tu 'khums shing spyi tshogs dang dus rabs ji 'dra zhig gi nang du'ang mkho gal dang phan thogs che ba zhig yin pa ni don dngos kyi steng nas grub pa'i gnas lugs shig yin pas mi su dang su zhig gis kyang bsnyon 'ding dang khyog bshad bya bar mi nus so/ / rang re'i lo rgyus yig tshang dang da yod bstan bcos kyi dkar chag ltar na/ g.yung drung bon lugs kyi drang srong dpyad bu khri shes nas sman pa dung gi thor cog can bar dang / rje btsun g.yu thog rnying ma yon tan mgon po nas gter ston gra ba mngon shes kyi bar/ bai ro tsa na nas lo chen rin chen bzang po'i skabs/ byang zur rnam gnyis nas kong sprul yab sras/ mi dbang sde srid rin po che nas sman rtsis mkhas dbang mkhyen rab nor bu la thug pa'i drang srong mkhas grub rim byon bgrang gis mi langs pa rnams kyi sku drin las/ dpal ldan rgyud bzhi'i dgongs 'grel dang yan lag brgyad pa'i dgongs 'grel gtso byas pa'i gso rig gi bstan bcos ri bo'i gtos dang mnyam pa rang gis mjal na dad pa'i 1

spu long g.yo zhing gzhan la ngom na la rgya'i spobs pa rgyas pa 'dis bod kyi gso ba rig pa'i lo rgyus ring la gzhung man ngag gi nang don phun sum tshogs pa zhig yin pa ra sprod gsal po byas 'duga'on kyang mig sngar phyi nang gi rgyu rkyen du ma'i dbang gis rang re'i gso rig thad kyi gzhung man ngag gi gdams pa mang po zhig nyams nyes su gyur dang 'gyur mus yin pa'ang kun gyis mkhyen gsal lags pas/ da lta'i dus 'dir bdag cag tshe rig 'dzin pa rnams kyis tshong zong kho na dang yul lung bye brag pa'i khe phan nam phyogs ris can gyi lta ba sogs ring du dor nas mi rigs kyi rig gnas yid bzhin nor bu lta bu 'di la snying khong nas sha tsha dang gces spras/ de bzhin ris su med pa'i 'dzam gling gi mi'i rigs yongs la phan du re ba'i kun slong rnam dag gi sgo nas/ ri rgyal lhun po'i gtos dang mnyam pa'i bod lugs gso rig gi gzhung man ngag rnams la 'ol tshod dang rang bzo tsam ma yin par sngar las lhag pa'i ngang sngog 'don myur skyob dang 'tshol sdud legs sgrig byed rgyu bcas ni shin tu gal gnad che ba'i bgyi ba zhig red//de'i phyir mtsho sngon zhing chen bod kyi gso rig zhib 'jug khang gis ming don mtshungs pa'i sgo nas bod kyi sman rtsis rig pa rgyud 'dzin yag po zhig dang gsar btod gong spel gyi rmang gzhi brtan po zhig 'dzugs thub pa'i ched du/da lta'i dus rabs dang srid jus bzang po'i go skabs dam 'dzin ngang mi dngos nor gsum gyi stobs shugs gcig tu bsgril zhing mig rgyang ring ba'i jus gzhi dang bcas te rang re'i sman rtsis skor gyi mkho gal che ba'i gna' dpe dang bstan bcos lag tu zin to cog phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs te par du bskrun pa'i dge ba 'dis/ da lta tsam ma zad 'byung 'gyur bod kyi sman rtsis bstan pa nyid yar rgyas gong 'phel du 'gro bar bsam yul las 'das pa'i 2

nus pa thon thub cing lus can kun gyi srog 'tsho'i dpal du 'gyur bar gdon mi za bas na/ 'o skol thun mong gis rjes su yi rang zhu 'os pa'i las don gal chen zhig red ces ha cang dga' tshor dang bcas mtshams sbyor ba'i tshig tu/khu khro ru tshe rnam gyis/spyi lo 2kya02lo'i zla 11tshes 1nyin la/

dag sgrig pa'i gsal bshad/bod zal mo sgang ba zhes su grags pa 'dzam gling gi yang steng du gnas pa'i mi rigs nyid la gnam gyis sa bkab pa lta bu'i sngon byon dran dbang dam pa rnams kyi bka' drin las/ dam pa'i chos kyis gtsos pa'i bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas kyis yongs su phyug pa'i shes rig bang mdzod ni srid pa'i mthar yang nub pa med pa zhig mchis pa la sus kyang bsnyon du med do// de las gnas bcu'i ya gyal gzhan rjes 'dzin gyi thabs mchog dam par gyur pa'i bod kyi gso ba rig pa ni/ rje g.yu thog chen pos/ mi na bar gnas par 'dod pa dang na ba gso bar 'dod pa'i gang zag gis gso ba rig pa'i man ngag la bslab par bya'o zhes gsungs pa bzhin ris su ma chad pa'i 'gro ba mi'i rigs la phan pa 'ba' zhig sgrub pa'i rig pa zhig ste/ der lo rgyus kyi dus yun ha cang ring zhing gzhung lugs kyi ma lag cha tshang yin pa ma zad/ sman dpyad kyi rigs lam khyad du 'phags shing man ngag nyams myong phun sum tshogs shing gya nom pa zhig mchis stabs/ deng skabs rgyal khab phyi nang kun tu tshan rig pa mkhas can dag gis phyogs yongs nas slob sbyong dang zhib 'jug gi gom stabs mgyogs len byed bzhin pa dang / rang re'i rgyal khab nas kyang tang gi mi rigs srid jus don 'khyol dang nub rgyud gsar spel byed pa'i 'gros dang bstun nas bod kyi gso ba rig pa'i las don nyid sgo kun nas nyams pa sor chud dang ma nyams gong spel gnang ste nyams dga'i yul khams shig tu bskyal yod/ 'on kyang phyi nang gi 'gal rkyen du ma'i dbang gis rang 1

re'igaso rig thad kyi gzhung man ngag gi gdams pa gang mang nyams nyes su gyur dang 'gyur mus yin pa 'ang nga tshos mig mthong lag zin du 'khums shing /bod kyi gso rig 'di nyid gna' bo'i rig gnas shig yin pa'i ngos nas zhu na/ri rgyal lhun po'i gtos dang mnyam pa'i gzhung man ngag gi gsung rab de rnams sngar las lhag pa'i sgo nas sngog 'don myur skyob dang 'tshol sdud legs sgrig bcas byed rgyu ni thog mar bsgrub dgos pa'i rmang gzhi'i las ka gal chen zhig ste 'o skol tshe rig 'dzin pa rnams kyi phrag la rang bzhin gyis babs pa'i dus rabs kyi 'gan 'khri zhig lags/ de'i phyir nga tshos lo rgyus kyi las 'gan dang dus rabs kyi blang bya ltar mdo dbus mtho sgang zhes pa'i thun min khor yug khrod du 'phel rgyas byung ba'i gna' bo'i gso dpyad rig pa 'di'i srog dbugs rgyun bsrings byed cing / bod kyi gso dpyad rig par sbyang brtson dang ci/ba 'jug byed par spro ba brtas pa'i rnam dpyod can mang por rgyu cha mkho sprod kyi sgo 'phar yangs por phyes pa/ rang lugs kyi gzhung rkang 'dzin pa la sngar bas sman thogs thub pa/ nyam thag nad pa'i lus srog la gzir ba'i nad rigs rtsa med du 'joms par nus pa'i gzhung lugs kyi rgyab rten dang man ngag zab mo'i gdams pa chig thub kyi skor mang du btsal nas nad kyi sdug bsngal las skyob par rngo thogs pa bcas mdor na gangs can gso ba rig pa 'di nyid ming don mtshungs pa'i sgo nas rgyud 'dzin legs po zhig byed pa'i ched du/ nged cag mtsho sngon zhing chen bod kyi gso rig zhib 'jug khang gis 'brel yod ched mkhas mi sna rtsa 'dzugs dang gso ba rig pa'i gna' dpe dag sgrig gi mi sna ched bskos byas te/ lo rgyus yig cha dang / gzhung lugs bstan bcos/ man ngag lag len/ sman sbyor myong byang / sngo sman 'khrungs dpe/gnam rig skar rtsis sogs kyi dpe rgyun dkon po'i rigs gtso bor bzung thog 〈bod kyi gso ba rig pa'i gna' dpe phyogs bsgrigs dpe tshogs 〉zhes pa 2

'di rtsom sgrig byas pa yin zhing / dpe skrun thad dpe deb re re bzhin mdzad pa'i lo rgyus kyi snga phyi dang nang don la ma bltos par lag len du 'khyol gang thub byas te dpe rnying lag tu son no cog dag sgrig dang dpe skrun 'grems spel bya rgyu yin/ de la bod kyi gso rig 'dzin skyong spel gsum la thugs khur dang rgyab skyor tshad med gnangs bzhin pa'i yul shul khul lho lung dkar dgon gyi lho 'brong sprul bstan 'dzin nyi mas mkho sprod bgyis pa'i shing dpar gyi ma yig nyid gzhir byas nas bsgrigs pa'i 〈'bri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs 〉zhes bya ba 'di ni dzñobod kyi gso ba rig pa'i gna' dpe phyogs bsgrigs dpe tshogs 〉nang gses kyi deb drug cu pa yin la/ deb 'di ni 'bri gung chos kyi grags pa dang khong gi slob brgyud kyi mkhas dbang dag gis mdzad pa'i sman rtsis gyi gzhung rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa zhig yin la/ 'di'i nang mkhris pa rtsar rgyugs la sogs dus mtha'i gnyan rims kyi bcos thabs dang /rang lugs kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i 'bam nad kyi bcos sna tshogs/ rin chen grang sbyor ril nag chen mo'i sngon byung dang bzang ngan gyi brtag tshul/ phan yon/ gtong tshul sogs kyi lag len bya thabs/ slob brgyud rnams kyis nyams su blangs pa'i yid ches kyi gdeng 'khel ba'i sman sbyor sna tshogs kyi sbyor ba re re dang kha tshar sdebs lugs/ de dag gi phan nus/ gzhan go sla spyod bde ba'i rtsis kyi bstan bcos sogs mthong dkon la thun mong ma yin pa'i man ngag du mas brgyan te grub pa sha stag zhig yin stabs gangs can gyi yul gru kun tu tshad mar 'dzin pa'i gzhung legs shos zhig lags/de yang dpe tshogs 'di nyid dag sgrig dang rtsom sgrig byed pa'i rtsa 'dzin 'di lta yin te/ 1 yi ge nor ba dang dogs gzhi can rnams la ming tshig gang de'i rjes su rtags(3'di'i nang dag bcos byas yod/ 2 gzhung tshig chad 3

par 'dod pa rnams rtags ()'di'i nang du kha skong byas yod/ 2 rtsom pa po'i mchan rnams gzhung dngos kyi yig gzugs las chung tsam byas nas bkod yod/ 4 ma yig mi gsal ba'am gzhung tshig chad pa rnams la kha skong byed ma nus pa rtags 'dis mtshon par byas yod la gug rtags 〈 〉'di'i nang du ma yig gi shog grangs sam thig phreng ci tsam zhig chad yod pa gsal bshad byas yod/ 5 rgya tsha dang rgyam tsha sogs tshwa sna'i rigs rnams dag yig mkhas pa'i kha rgyan ltar te/ sog tsha dang rgya tsha zhes tshig grogs dang bsdeb na wa btags mi 'dogs shing / sog po'i tshwa dang rgya mtsho'i tshwa zhes pa'am tshwa ming rkyang pa'i skabs su wa btags 'dogs zhes pa ltar sbyar yod/lan tshwa zhes pa ni bod kyi gso ba rig pa'i dpe gzhung mang che bar bstun nas dmigs bsal du wa zur sbyar nas bkod yod/'dir nga tsho dag sgrig mi sna'i shes bya'i chu tshad dman zhing dpe rnying dag sgrig gi nyams myong zhan pa'i dbang gis ma rtogs 'gal 'khrul gyi cha gang mang yodasrid pa la rgya che klog pa po rnams kyis dgongs 'char lhugs par gnang bar bka' drin che zhu'o//mtsho sngon zhing chen bod spyi gso rig zhib 'jug khang ras/〈bodakli gso ba rig pa'i gna' dpe phyogs bsgrigs dpe tshogs〉rtsom sgrig tshogs pa /spyi lo 2rkya06lo'i zla 2pa'i tshes ranyin/

dkar chagartsom pa po ngo sprod mdor bsdus/ 1༄7/g.yu thog snying thog gi bka' srung zhang blon drag po sde dgu'i 'phrin las gnam lcags kyi 'khor lo bsgyur ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 1༄7/gso rig nor bu'i bum bzang zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 20༄7/gso byed gnyen po stong dang rtsa gnyis kyi grangs nges zhal lung mdzes rgyan zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 34༄7//rims bcos gud du bkol ba rin chen srog gi zhags pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 58༄7/khyer lnga nyi shu rtsa lnga'i spyor ba rin chen srog gi rgyab rten zhes bya bzhugs so// 66༄khya//'bam bcos che 'dzin srog skyobs zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 74ra'io//rin chen grang smyor ril nag gi sngon byung gleng gzhi bzhugs so//83༄khya//rin chen ril nag chen mo'i zin bris brtan g.yo'i bcud bsdus mkhas pa dga' byed bzhugs so// 86༄7/sprang spyor ril nag grangs nges brtag pa mu tig 'phreng ba bzhugs so// 95༄7//rin chen grang spyor ril nag gi kha skong sdum bu'i man ngag bzhugs so// 971

༄7/sprang spyor ril nag gi phan yon mos lngan dga' ba'i dbyar dza bzhugs so// 99༄7//rin chen ril bu'i cha lag sbyar dug gso thabs bzhugs so// 102༄khya//rin chen grang spyor ril bu'i cha lag phran bu'i sbyar dug gso thabs bzhugs so// 109༄khya//ril nag chung 'bring gi zin bris 'chi ba gshol 'debs bzhugs so//111༄khya//'thun byed ril nag gi zin bris ya nga bcud bdud rtsi'i bum pa bzhugs so// 113༄7//ril nag che 'bring chung ngu'i sbas don gsal byed nam mkha'i nor bu zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 115༄7//rin chen tsha sbyor gyi zin bris gcong nad bde ster zhes bya ba zur mkhar ba'i khud chos bzhugs so// 118༄7//kong bu'i zhal gdams 'dag spyon zur mkhar ba'i man ngag bzhugs so// 120༄7//rin chen rul bu 'thag thabs kyi zhal gdams bzhugs so// 121༄༅//sman bla longs sku gtso 'khor lnga'i sgrub thabs dngos grub kyi bang mdzod bzhugs so// 122༄khya//rin chen ril bu gtong tshul gyi zin bris zur mkhar ba'i khyad chos bzhugs so// 136༄7/gso ba rig pa'i gzhung lugs chen po dpal ldan rgyud bzhi'i dka' gnad dogs sel gyi zin bris/ 140dang po/ rtsa rgyud kyi dka' gnad dogs sel/ 141gnyis pa/ bshad rgyud kyi dka' gnad dogs sel/ 1512

gsum pa/ man ngag rgyud kyi dka' gnad dogs sel/ 172bzhi pa/ phyi rgyud kyi dka' gnad dogs sel/ 184༄7//gso ba rig pa'i man ngag kun gyi gtses bsdus phan bde'i snying po zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 196dang po/ thang sbyor sde tshan/ 197gnyis pa/ phye ma'i sde/ 198gsum pa/ ril bu'i sde/ 225bzhi pa/ thal sman gyi sde/ 229lnga pa/ sbyongs byed kyi sde/ 231drug pa/ byug lums kyi sde/ 235bdun pa/ nyer mkho'i lag len/ 240༄7/chung nad ce sprung mgo yi bcos zab mo bzhugs lags so// 258༄7//dmu chu'i bcos thabs gsang ba sbyabs 'dren zhes bya ba bzhugs so//261༄7//dmu chu'i bcos myong grub ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 267༄༅/gnyan rims mkhris pa rtsar rgyugs la sogs pa'i bcos tshul bsdus pa zhal lung bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 271dang po/ mkhris pa rtsar rgyugs kyi bcos thabs 272gnyis pa/ klad gzer bcos thabs 276gsum pa/ gag pa'i bcos thabs 277bzhi pa/ 'dzum bu ltag dgye'i bcos thabs 278lnga pa/ gzer thung bcos thabs 278drug pa/ bshal rims bcos thabs 281bdun pa/ lhog pa'i bcos thabs 2833

1rtsom pa po ngo sprod mdor bsdus/'bri lugs zhes pa ni 'bri gung gdan rabs nyer gsum pa 'bri gung chos grags mchog gis dus rabs bcu bdun pa'i nang gsar du gtod pa'i gso rig gi srol ka thun mong ma yin pa zhig yin la/ 'di ni byang zur lugs gnyis zhes nyi zla ltar grags pa'i srol lugs chen po gnyis las gtso bo zur lugs kyi sku mched dag gi gsung gi bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun ngoms par bzhes pa las byung ba'i zur lugs kyi bye brag zhig kyang yin/'dir 'bri gong sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs zhes pa ni 'bri gung chos grags mchog dang khong gi dngos slob dkon mchog 'gro phan dbang po 'am tshe dbang brtan pa/ de'i slob ma dpon tshang ye shes/ de'i slob ma sgar 'og karma bstan 'phel/ de nas lha rje rin chen dbang ngam tshe ring dbang / si tu chos kyi 'byung gnas/ karma rin chen dbang rgyal lam bstan 'dzin rab rgyas/lha mo skyabs/ 'brong pa phun tshe sogs dad cing brtson 'grus dang ldan pa'i slob brgyud kyi mkhas dbang dag gis mdzad pa'i sman rtsis kyi gzhung rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa zhig yin/ mdzad pa po re re'i lo rgyus zhib tu ma brjod par 'bri gung chos grags kyis mtshon mi sna re gnyis mtshams sbyor bar bya ste/'bri gung chos grags/'bri gung chos grags zhes pa ni bod kyi gdung chen bzhi las 'bri gung skyur ra'i rigs kyi yab chos rgyal phun tshogs dang yum a phyi g.yang khug gnyis

2 ༄7//'bri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/ kyi rigs sras bzhi'i chung shos la rab byung bcu pa'i shing lug (spyi lo1595)lor sku 'khrungs zhing 'bri gung gdan rabs nyer gsum pa yin/ mtshan gzhan la dkon mchog ratna dang gnas lnga smra ba'i rdo rje 'dzin pa don gyi sman pa chos kyi grags pa 'phrin las rnam par rgyal ba dbang po'i sde/ dharma kirti/rig 'dzin chos grags sogs kyang zhu/sku na chung dus nas mkhas grub gnyis ldan gyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen du ma'i drung du mdo sngags gtsos pa'i gzhung lugs rgya mtshor gsan bzhes mdzad pa dang / lhag par bka' rnying gi bla ma dam pa khyad du 'phags pa rnams dang yang sgos su slob dpon rnam bcom phun tshogs zhes par mnyes pa gsum gyi sgo nas zhabs la gtugs nas gsan sbyongs zab bzhes gnang bas ring min mkhas grub gnyis ldan gyi go 'phang la mnga' brnyes/ gso rig gi thad la slob dpon tshe yi rig byed 'dzin pa gu ṇa kā ra'i mtshan can bsten nas dpal ldan rgyud bzhi gtsor gyur gyi gso rig gzhung mang sbyangs shing de dag las rim bzhin sman dpyad lag len skor la thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos can mang por nges pa rnyed de 'bri lugs zhes pa'i srol ka thog mar btod/skabs der rgyal ba lnga pa mchog gis 'bri gung chos grags las bka' rnying gi gdams pa khag gcig gsan bzhes gnang bar brten rin chen sna lnga las grub pa'i sman bzo'i yo byad ngo mtshar can kha shas 'bul gnang mdzad par grags/ gzhan yang 'bri gung chos grags rin po che gong ma shun tsi zhes pa'i dbu bla gnang bar gdan zhus ltar rgya nag tu snga phyi thengs gsum phebs dgos byung ba bcas la brten 'bri gung chos grags kyi mtshan snyan gang sar shin tu che bar gyur/ khyad par 'bri gung rtse zhol khul du sman slob 'dzin grwa 'dzugs gnyer mdzad pa'i lo rgyus yod la brgyud 'dzin gyi zhal slob kyang phul du phyin pa sman rtsis gnyis kar mkhas pa dkon mchog lhun grub dang / dkon mchog

༄7//rtsom pa po ngo sprod mdor bsdus/ 3'gro phan dbang po'am tshe dbang brtan pa/ lho 'phrin las rnam rgyal zhes khams kyi lho dgon pa'i lha rje sogs kyis 'bri lugs rang gi khyad chos brgyud 'dzin dang / 'phel rgyas ches cher btang nas gzhung bshad lag len mtha' dag nyams pa med par 'gro ba'i spyi nor du spel bar mdzad/ brtsams chos su 〈〈rgyud bzhi dka' mchan 〉〉dang / 〈〈rin chen phyag lenata〉 bshad rgyud rkyang sel skor la sde srid sangs rgyas rgya bka' 'dri gnang ba'i lan 〈〈dka' gnad dogs selata〉 'bri lugs kyi khyad chos rmad du byung ba'i 〈〈'bam bcos tshe 'dzin srog skyobasata〉 rin chen ril nag chen mo'i zhal shes phyag len sogs ngo mtshar khyad du 'phags pa'i sman bcos nyams myong rnams phyi rabs nad pa'i don du 'jog gnang mdzad/ dgung grangs re gsum sa phag (spyi lo1659)lor sku 'das/ rje 'di nas bzung 'bri gung gdan sar skye sprul brtsad gcod zhu srol dar zhing khong ni chung tshang sku phreng dang po yin/dkon mchog 'gro phan dbang po/dkon mchog 'gro phan dbang po'am tshe dbang brtan pa zhes pa ni dbu ru'i mtshams gzhu stod ces pa'i sa char bod rab byung bcu gcig pa'i lcags lug (spyi lo1621)lor sku 'khrungs/ sku gzhon nu'i skabs nas kun rjes tha snyad kyis mtshon pa'i rgya che ba shes bya spyi'i sgro 'dogs gcod phyir dge ba'i bshes gnyen spyi dang yang sgos gso ba rig pa slob par 'bri gung pa gsang sngags kyi rig pa 'dzin pa chos kyi grags pa phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba dbang po'i sde zhes mtshan don dang ldan pa de'i zhabs pad yun ring du bsten nas rmad du byung ba'i mdzad pa bskyangs/dgung lo sum cu so gcig la son skabs 'bri gung chos grags dgongs pa rdzogs nas lo gnyis 'das pa 'phar ba zhes pa lcags mo glang la slob dpon

4 ༄7spyo'abri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/dgongs rdzogs la rjes dran zhu ba dang / mthong brgyud phyag len rnams mi nyams gong 'phel gyis 'gro phan rgya che yong ched 〈〈gces bsdus phan bde'i snying po'am 'bri gung gces bsdus 〉〉su grags pa'i sman dpe gsar rtsom mdzad/ de ni slob dpon gyi gsung rgyun rnams dang mkhas grub o rgyan pa'i 〈〈dngul chu grub pa'i bstan bcos〉〉 brang ti'i 〈〈gser bre dngul bre〉〉gtsang stod dar ma mgon po'i 〈〈zin tig yang tig〉〉 zur mkhar chos rje mnyam nyid rdo rje'i 〈〈bye ba ring bsrel 〉〉sogs dang / tha na skabs de'i sman pa mkhas pa kha shas kyi sman sbyor zab pa sna re yan chad dngos dang brgyud pa'i sgo nas 'bad pa du mas don gnyer mdzad pa dang / rang gi nyams su blangs pas yid ches kyi gdeng 'khel ba rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdebs nas brtsams par gsal/ gzhan 〈〈gnyan rims mkhris pa rtsar rgyugs kyi bcos tshul mdor bsdus zhal lung bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun 〉〉dang / 〈〈rlung nad lce spyang mgo yi bcos zab mo〉〉 〈〈'bam bcos man ngag khyad par can〉〉 〈〈'bam bcos tshe 'dzin srog skyobs kyi lhan thabs gso tshul gsum ldan〉〉 〈〈'bam bcos zab nyung don 'dril snying dang 'dra ba〉〉 〈〈phan bde'i snying po'i yan lag 'bam bcos gces pa'i gnad bsdus〉〉 〈〈gcong chen dmu chu gso ba'i gdam ngag〉〉 〈〈rgyu rgan gyi bcos 'phrul gyi them tshangs 〉〉sogs tshad ldan gyi sman gzhung mang po zhig brtsams gnang mdzad/sku tshe ji tsam la bzhugs pa gsal po ma shes rung / rgyu rgan gyi bcos 'phrul gyi them tshangs zhes pa'i mjug byang du/ rang lo re gcig pa rab myos zhes pa lcags pho rta lo'i hor zla lnga pa'i tshes kyi nyin gung gi thun mtshams su bris zhes gsal bas sku tshe cung ring tsam bzhugs pa 'dra/ slob ma'i gtso bo dpon tshang ye shes sogs byung nas rgyun ma chad par 'gro don bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mdzad pa bzang pos dus 'da' ba byung ngo //

1༄7//g.yu thog snying thig gi bka' srung zhang blon drag po sde dgu'i 'phrin las gnam lcags kyi 'khor lo bsgrur ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so//g.yu thog snying thig gi bka' bsrung zhang blon drag po sde dgu'i 'phrin las gnam lcags kyi 'khor lo zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo// gang sku bee ḍūr lhun po ltar brjid mtshan dpe'i dri bas kun nas 'khyud// gang gsungs yan lag drug cu'i dbyangs ldan drang nges chos kyi dga' ston 'gyed// gang thugs zab gsal spros bral mkhyen brtse'i rol pa kun nas brjid// gang gi skyabs gcig 'gro ba'i bla ma rgyal ba mthing mdog de la 'dud//'dir dbang thob cing dam tshig la gnas pa'i sngags pa gso rig 'dzin cing g.yu thog snying thig la mos pa dag gis bka' bsrung zhang blon drag po sde dgu'i 'phrin las kyi rim pa la 'jug pa ni/ yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su bris sku'i mdun du gtor ma sman rag zan ling tshogs dang bcas pa sogs dgos pa'i yo byad ma tshang ba med pa byas la skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ hūṃ/rigs 'dus bla ma gu ṇa sman gyi bla// gso rig dam chos nyon mongs gdung ba sel// sman gyi drang srong 'phags mchog 'dus pa'i gtso// dkon mchos/ gsum la rtag par —skyabs su mchi/ lan gsum/ sems bskyed pa ni/ ho/bdag gis dus 'di nas ni byang chub bar// 'gro ba'i nyes gsum nyon mongs bsgral ba'i phyir// byang chub mchog rab smon 'jug byang chub sems// kun

2 〉〉khibri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/nas mi btang brten par skyed par bgyis// lan gsum/ oṃ badzra a mri tas bsangs/ su bha wa (was1sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bdag gzhan gzung ba dang 'dzin pas bsdus pa'i chos dang chos can thams cad 'od gsal stong pa chen po 'jam ('byams1klas pa'i ngang las rang rig hūṃ/ hrīḥyig dmar po me dpung 'bar ba lta bur gyur pa'i ngang las sna tshogs pad ma dang nyi ma bdud bzhi'i gdan la rang rig hūṃ/ hrīhrīḥde bab pa yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid snang ba'i cha dpa' bo rta mgrin sku mdog dmar zhing gzi brjid 'bar ba zhal mche ba gtsigs shing spyan gsum sdang mig nyi ma ltar 'bar ba/smin ma dang sma ra ag tshom me ltar mched cing 'bar ba/ spyi gtsug tu rta mgo ljang khur rngog ma le brgan dbang skad 'tsher ba/ phyag g.yas rdo rje gri gug nam mkhar 'phyar zhing g.yon thod pa bdud bzhi'i khrag dang zhag gis bkang ba thugs kar 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ dpal dang dur khrod kyi chas thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs dor stabs su bsgyings pa'i pang du stong pa'i mdangs yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo rtsa zhal khro chags rna ltag g.yas su phag zhal nag po khro zhing ngur sgra 'byin pa/ phyag g.yas gri gug gdengs shing g.yon thod khrag yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud pa gcer mo/ skra grol ba/ thod pa'i phreng bas brgyan pa/ yab yum ye shes kyi me 'od 'bar zhing 'khrugs pa'i klong na gnas pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ gis mtshan par gyur/ oṃ badzra kro dha ha ya skṛ ba hūṃ/ phaṭa/ ces bzla ba bdag bskyed do// bgegs gtor spyi 'gro ltar byin gyis rlabs shing btang la bka' bsgo ba ni/ rol mo drag po dang bcas pa/ hūṃ/ hrīḥ nga ni dbang gi khro bo che// rta mgrin rgyal po bgegs kyi gshed// gdams sngags (ngag1las la mi dbang ba'i// bgegs dang log 'dren dam sri rnams// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di 'khyer la// gang 'dod gnas su da dengs shig/ gal te

༄7/zhang blon sde dgu'i 'phrin las gnam lcags kyi 'khor lo bsgyur ba/ 3mi 'gro 'dug gyur na// dbang chen khros pa'i pho nya yis// bgegs kyi lus sems brlag par byed// de bas dengs shig dga' bar byos// oṃ badzra kro dha ha ya skṛ wa karma ka ra sarba bhu ta u tsa ta ya hūṃ/ phaṭa/mtshams bcad pa ni/ e ma nga ni rang byung ba// ma skyes skye med dbang gi lha// thugs srog hrīḥyi spro bsdu las// khro pho khro mo khro chung gi/ nam mkha' sa gzhi bar snang khengs// kun kyang mi zad mtshon cha 'phen// gri gug rdo rje rin po che// pad ma rgya gram ral gri sogs// sna tshogs mtshon cha'i gur khang sra// ye shes me dpung kun nas 'bar// bgegs kyi sbyor ba mtshams chod cig/ hrīḥ ma rang rig (rigs3gdod nas gzugs 'dzin bral// nga dang bgegs kyi rtogs pa spangs// thams cad mnyam nyid rang sems klong // de la bgegs kyis ji ltar 'tshe// chos sku ye 'tshems gdod nas grub// a la la hoḥces brjod sman rag mchod pa rnams bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las thod pa rab tu brjid pa rnams kyi nang du hūṃ las mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog bdug spos snang gsal dri chab zhal zas kyis ltams (gtams3pa dang bdud rtsi sman gyi rgya mtsho rtsa brgyad yan lag stong du sbyar ba'i ra sa ya na rigs lnga'i rang bzhin can dang / dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i snying khrag rgyu rkyen sbyar ba'i rakta'i rgya mtsho chen po/ dmar mo gi ji de wa rakta gsang ba'i dam rdzas kyi bcud dang ldan pa dang / gtor ma sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga'i rang bzhin 'dod yon dam rdzos rmad du byung ba'i mchod rdzas thams cad kyang ye shes kyi rol pa chen po'i rang rtsal gyi rnam pa las byung ba nyid du gyur/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ nas sha pta'i bar dang / pañtsa a mṛ ta ma hā rakta ma hā ba liddha oṃ āḥhūṃ hriḥthā/ces gsum gyis byin rlabs/ bdun bskyed pa ni/ oṃ shu bya bsangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi mdun du e las drag po chos kyi dbyings mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i dbus su pad nyi dgra bgegs

4 sa༅/khabri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/pho mo bsnol ba'i gdan la ma hā ka la gnod sbyin chen po zhang blon rdo rje bdud 'dul sku mdog mthing nag rab khros 'jigs rung rngam pa'i lang tsho can/phyag g.yas nor bus yu ba byas pa'i gri gug nam mkhar 'phyar zhing g.yon thod rlon skra dang bcas pa'i nang du dgra bgegs kyi tsittas gang ba thugs kar bsnams pa/ dar nag gi 'jo ('jol1ber gsol ba mi mgo skam rlon gyis brgyan cing / tsan dan gyi bde chen sked la 'chang ba/ myur mgyogs kyi rtsal ldan rta nag rting dkar rlung gi shugs can la bzhon pa/ de dag gi mdun du sngags bsrung e ka tsa ti mthing nag khros pa spyan gsum mche gtsigs khro mo'i cha lugs can/ g.yas gri gug dang g.yon thod khrag thogs pa dre'u gwa dmar la bcibs pa'i snga shar mtshon drub dang phyi shar nad rkyal btags pa/ spyi bor zla tshes dang lte bar nyi mas brgyan pa/ ma mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor cing me rlung dmar nag 'tshub ma'i nang du bzhugs pa/ g.yas su khyab 'jug chen po ra hū la dud kha lus stod khro bo dbu dgu bya rog gi zhal can dang bcas pa sku smad dug sbrul du 'khyil ba/ g.yas sbrul zhags dang g.yon rwa yi mda' gzhu thogs pa 'jigs rung mig stong 'bar ba chu srin mgo dgu la bzhon pa/ sde brgyad bran du 'khol ba/ sprin nag gi klong na gnas pa/ rgyab tu mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo ce spyang rab tu khros pa'i gdong can khrag ral sprug pas/ dgra bgegs la nad yams kyi skal pa 'beb pa/ gcer mo nu ma 'phyang ba/ phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis gri gug dang dgra zor/ g.yon gnyis thod khrag dang rgyu zhags mi mgo 'phyar zhing dur bya mgo dgu la bzhon pa dur khrod yongs kyi bdag mor gyur/ g.yon du gnod sbyin bshan pa dmar po khrag gi mdog can stag gdong rab tu khros pa/ phyag g.yas zangs gri 'bar bas dgra srog gcod cing g.yon dgra snying dang rgyu ma dron mo thogs pa/ mi snying gi phreng bas lus brgyan pa/ g.yu 'brug rngam pa la bzhon pa/ rang 'dra'i sprul pa grangs med

༄7/zhang blon sde dgu'i 'phrin las gnam lcags kyi 'khor lo bsgyur ba/ 5pas bskor ba stong gsum gyi bdag por gyur/ mdun g.yas kyi mtshams su dam can srog gi spu gri mthing nag rab tu khro zhing 'jigs pa'i gzugs can srin po'i zhal rngam brjid 'bar zhing g.yo ba/ g.yas lcags kyu dang spu gri/g.yon thod pa dam nyams pa'i glo snying gis gang ba thogs pa/ dar nag gi 'jol ber gsol zhing mi mgo'i phreng bas brgyan pa/ seng chen kha gdangs khros pa la bzhon nas skye 'gro yongs kyi srog gi bdag po byed pa/ g.yas rgyab kyi mtshams su srin po dgra dur 'jigs byed dmar nag khro gtum rab 'jigs zhal bgrad pa'i yas kyi mche ba brang gi lhon sna dang / mas kyi mche ba dpral dbyings su gzings (gzengs1pa/ mi ro chom chom du za ba'i spyi bor spyang mo kha gdangs pas nga ro sgrog pa/ g.yas ral gri nam mkhar 'phyar zhing g.yon rtse gsum dang rgyu zhags thogs pa/ mi lpags rlon pa gyon nas ro langs mgo dgu la bzhon pa/ keng rus grangs mod pas bskor zhing / phyogs bcu'i grogs kyi gshed ma chen po byed pa/ rgyab g.yon gyi mtshams su bdud mo shanti ro zan ma dud kha rab tu khros shing mi sdug 'jigs su rung ba bya rgod kyi gdong pa can mche gtsigs spyan dmar khrag gi ral pa sprug cing nu ma 'phyang ba/phyag g.yas rgyu zhags dang dgra sta 'phyar zhing / g.yon tsitta bsnams nas lcags spyang mgo dgu la bzhon pa/ dgra bgegs ma lus skad cig la bsgrol ba/g.yon mdun gyi mtshams su srog bdag hab se dug ha la'i mdog ltar gnag pa rab khros 'jigs rung zhal gcig pa/ spyi bor khra'i mgo bor cher rgod pa/phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis mdung dang dug rkyal/ 'og ma gnyis mi mgo rlon pa dang phur pa thogs nas dred mo mgo dgu la bzhon pa/ dam nyams thams cad kyi gshed mar gyur/ de thams cad kyang nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi 'od ltar 'bar ba/ khro gtum rngam 'jigs ma rungs pa/ snying rje med cing gsod la dga' ba/ mi'i sha khrag la dga' zhing gsur chen gyi dri tshor ba tsam gyis rkan sdeb

6 ༄7khibri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/cing bzod rlag (glags3med pa skad cig re re la'ang sprul pa dang / yang sprul/ nying sprul pho nya nyi zer gyi rdul gyi grangs las 'das pa phyogs bcur 'gyed nus pa/ khams gsum srid gsum thams cad nyul zhing legs nyes kyi stangs 'dzin dam tshig gis rjes gcod/ bstan dgra gdug pa thams cad thal ba'i rdul du brlog par byed cing rnal 'byor sgrub pa po yi bka' nyan gsung sdod ci bcol las kyi pho nya thogs rdug turdugs1med par gyur/ bdag nyid yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i sa bon dang mdun bskyed gtso 'khor rnams kyi gnas gsum nas 'a di tshor 'phros pas rang rang gi gnas nas sngon gyi dam tshig rjes su dran pa'i dbang skad cig la glog 'khyud pa ltar gshegs shing spyan drangs par gyur pa bsam la gsur chen gyi dud pa btang / rol mo dang bcas gdung ba'i dbyangs kyis spyan drangs pa ni/ hūṃ hūṃ/ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis// tshur gshegs bka' bsrung spyan 'dren no// stobs ldan sde dgu 'khor dang bcas// mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥ hūṃ/ dur khrod rab 'jigs gzhal yas 'dir// sha khrag rgya mtsho 'khyil ba'i klong // bstan bshig ma rung bsgral ba'i steng // bka' srung 'khor bcas bzhugs su gsol// sa ma ya st+waṃ/ hūṃ/ sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba'i mthu rtsal can// 'jig rten 'das kyang 'khor ba'i cha lugs 'dzin// dus la mi 'da' dam nyams snying 'byin pa// don dam chos skyong rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod// a ti su hoḥ hūṃ/ zhing bcu bsgral ba'i khrag rnams mtsho chen 'khyil// dbang po rnam lnga'i me tog bcal du bkram//gsur chen bdug spos dud pa sprin ltar gtibs// zhu chen snang gsal mar me nyi bas gsal// rdo rje dri chus byugs pa'i rdzing bus mdzes// don snying sha rus zhal zas ri ltar spungs// thod ta rkang gling rol mo 'brug ltar sgrog/ rang rang mthun pa'i dam rdzas ma tshang med// sman rag gtor tshogs spyan gzigs

༄7/zhang blon sde dgu'i 'phrin las gnam lcags kyi 'khor lo bsgyur ba/ 7longs spyod rnams// gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya bde ba'i mchog/ bka' bsrung drag po 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// mngon spyod drag po'i 'phrin las myur du sgrubs// rang rang rtsa sngags sham bu ru/ ma hā gu ru/ mum lam/ ma hā ka la/e ka tsa ti/ ke ta ke ta/ ḍakki ni/ yakka tsitta/ badzra sa du (twa3 sa ma ya/rakṣa ra dza dunti tsitta kā la sha tribam rbad bhyo/ dharma sa pa riwā ra/ bhu mi pra ti arghaṃ nas shapta'i bar dang / ru pa nas sa ma ye hūṃ gi bar/ ma hā sarba pañtsa sogs bdud rtsi ma hā rakta ma hā ba ling ta/ dgra bo'i ma hā mam sa rakta ka ni nti/ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba sha hūṃ i dam grorna swā hā/ sarba sdu tsa bodhi tsitta gha na gu ye heḥde nas khyad par gyi mchod pa ni brub khung du dgra bo gsal btab la/dbyangs kyi nga ros 'di skad do// hūṃ/ dam nyams dgra bo ma rungs las ngan 'di// gzugs phung mchod par 'bul gyis bzhes su gsol// phyi yi dbang po rnam lnga mchod par bzhes// nang gi don snying rnam lnga mchod par bzhes//gsang ba'i bla tshe srog dbugs mchod par bzhes// klad rus rkang dang khong khrag mchod par bzhes// ri rab skur bzhengs gnam sa'i zhal phyes la//gangs dkar mche gtsigs glog dmarā ljags khyongs shig/ stong gsum mid par dgra bgegs ma lus btab// 'dod chags khrag la lcibs cib skyo'ajib 'jib3dgyes par rol// zhe sdang rus la khrum khrum dgyes par rol// gti mug sha la chem chem dgyes par rol// zhal dang mgul du btab bo kha ram khā hi/ rings par bzhes shig rol zhig khā hi/ gnod sbyin rdo rje bdud 'dul zhal la kha ram khā hi/ rings par bzhes shig rol zhig khā hi/ ma gcig e ka tsa ti'i zhal la kha ram khā hi/ gza' bdud ra hu la'i zhal la kha ram khā hi/mkha' 'gro lce spyang mchu dmar zhal la kha ram khā nyi/ gnod sbyin bshan pa dmar nag zhal la kha ram khā hi/ dam can srog gi spu gri'i zhal la kha ram khā hi/

8 ༄7//'bri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/srin po ro langs 'jigs byed zhal la kha ram khā hi/ bdud mo ro zan nag mo'i zhal la kha ram khā hi/ las mkhan hab se chen mo'i zhal la kha ram khā hi/lo dang zla bar ma bzhag myur du sod// zhag dang za mar ma 'gyangs myur du sod// 'go ba'i lha lnga skyobs tuskyob1 pa'i sman lnga phrol// za 'dre shi gshed gnod pa'i bdud dang sprod// dam nyams pha tshan nang dme shi 'dzings thongs//ngu 'bod rnam 'debs brang chen brdung du chug/ glo bur rims nad drag po char ltar phobs// snying du sdug pa'i chung ma mal du sod// yid la brtse ba'i bu chung pang nas phrogs// brtsegs pa'i mkhar bshig bsags pa'i nor rdzas gtor// btab pa'i lo ma 'bru than sad ser thong (thongs1/ / za ba'i zas la mu ge'i skal pa khyer// mdza' ba'i gnyen phrol tuphrogasakyelha yi dmu thag chod//rlung mkhris bad kan 'du ba khong nas dkrugs// khong khrag thang la skyugs cing 'chi ru chug/ smyo 'bog brgyal dang mdzes 'bras gag lhog thongs// brgyad cu rtsa gcig ltas ngan char ltar phobs// sum brgya drug cu'i ye 'drog ma lus thongs// bdun brgya nyi shu'i glo bur stabs nyes thongs// rnam brgyad dus min 'chi bas dam nyams sod// stong phrag brgyad cu'i bgegs kyi pho brang thob// gnam gyi 'ju thag steng nas myur du chod// sa yi rten phur 'og tu drungs nas phyungs// kha lce bsod nams za thang mtha' nas bsdus// rgan rims sdong rgan 'gyel ltar yas nas sod// gzhon rims me tog skam ltar mas nas sod// dar ma dgra la phob bzhin bar du sod// pho rgyud me la chu bzhin 'chi ru chug/ mo rabs rtsa (rtswa1la zor bzhin 'chi ru chug/ ban bon sgo nga brdabs bzhin 'chi ru chug/ shi rgab nags la me bzhin 'ched (mched1du bcug/ gson rgab rtsa (rtswa3rul shing ltar 'phel ma 'jug/ pha ma pha spun zhang tsha so sor sod// bu dang tsha bo yang tsha'i rigs rgyud bskums// bdun brgyud rtsad chod thal ba rlung la bskur// sngon gyi rgyal ba rigs 'dus bka'

༄7/zhang blon sde dgu'i 'phrin las gnam lcags kyi 'khor lo bsgyur ba/ 9ma bcag/ phyi rabs sngags 'chang dam ldan bstan pa srungs// da lta rig 'dzin bdag gi ngag ma dkral// thugs dam zhal bzhes gnyen po dran mdzod la// bcol ba'i 'phrin las myur du grub par mdzod// ces btab de nas bstod bsnyen sgrub// rbod rbad bsad pa'i las kha bsgyur// bskul zhing dam la gnas par bya// gdung ba'i yid dang snyan pa'i dbyangs// rol mor bcas la 'di skad do// hūṃ/ chos kyi dbyings nas 'gags med skur bstan pa// rdo rje bdud 'dul gnod sbyin chen po'i sku// 'jigs rung mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis brjid// nor bu gri gug thod pa dgra snying rnams//dar nag ber gsol mi mgo'i phreng bas brgyan// tsan dan beng gtsugs rta nag rting dkar bcibs// bstan pa gnyer srungs bka' yi bya ra mdzod//chos skyong yongs kyi rje la phyag 'tshal bstod//bhyo/ ma gcig dpal ldan e ka tsa ti ma// mthing nag rab khros spyan gsum mche bzhi gtsigs// khro mo'i chas rdzogs phyag gnyis gri thod 'dzin//dre'u bzhon zhing mtshon drub nad rkyal btags// snyan g.yas seng chen g.yon pa sbrul nag 'phyo// spyi bor zla tshes lte bar nyi mas brgyan// me rlung 'tshub ma'i dbus na dgra bgegs sgrol// dam ldan bu bzhin skyongs la phyag 'tshal bstod//hūṃ/ bstan bsrung khyab 'jug chen po rā hu la// dud kha rab khros sku smad sbrul mjug 'khyil// dbu dgu'i gtsug na bya rog mgo yis brgyan//g.yon pa sbrul zhags rwa yi mda' gzhu 'dzin// mgo lus mig gang sprin bzhon kun tu nyul// sde brgyad bran khol mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul bdag/ dam ldan skyong zhing dam nyams srog rtsa gcod// drag po'i gtso bo khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod//hūṃ/ gnas dang yul gyi sha za mkha' 'gro'i gtso// rab 'jigs dmar mo lce spyang mgo dgu ma// khrag ral sprugs pas stong gsum nad kyis 'gengs//

10 ༄7khabri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/gcer bu brgyan turgyan3med nu ma thur du 'phyangs/ phyag bzhi dang po gri gug thod khrag gdengs// 'og gnyis dgra zor rgyu zhags mi mgo 'phyar// dur bya mgo dgu (dgur3bzhon nas dur khrod nyul// dam nyams rtsad gcod gtso mor phyag 'tshal bstod// hūṃ/ gnod sbyin bshan dmar dam nyams srog gcod gtso// mtshal mdog stag gdong zangs gri dgra snying gdengs// rgyu ma za zhing snying phreng ga shar gyon// g.yu 'brug bzhon nas skad cig stongo khams bskor// rang 'dra'i sprul pa dpag med phyogs bcur 'gyed// nyin bzhin dregs pa pho rgyud bran du 'khol// mtshan bzhin mo rgyud thams cad dbang du sdud// bka' 'das gshed ma khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod//hūṃ/ bka' bsrung dam can srog gi spu gri ni// mthing nag rab khros 'jigs rung rngam pa'i zhal// spyan dmar smin ma skra ser gyen du 'bar//lcags kyu spu gri dgra bo'i glo snying bsnams// dar nag ber gsol mi mgo'i phreng bas brgyan// seng ge bzhon nas stong khams kun tu nyul// sprul pa yang sprul dgra srog chu bzhin 'thung // bzlog med 'gras phung nag por phyag 'tshal bstod//rghaṃ/ srin po'i rgyal po dgra dur 'jigs byed ni// dmar nag rab 'jigs khro gtum srin po'i zhal// mche ba brang slebs mi ro zhal du gsol//spyi bor spyang mo kha gdangs nga ro sgrog/ ral gri rtse gsum rgyu zhags nam mkhar 'phyar// mi lpags gyon nas ro langs mgo dgu (dgur3bzhon// 'khor du keng rus gar byed rgod pas bskor// dam nyams rtsad gcod gtso la phyag 'tshal bstod//hūṃ/ shanti ro zan bdud mo bya rgod mgo// dud mdog mche gtsigs khrag ral phyogs bcur sprug/ mi gdug nu ma brang gi ngos la 'chang // gcer bu mi

༄7/zhang blon sde dgu'i 'phrin las gnam lcags kyi 'khor lo bsgyur ba/ 11lpags snying phreng ga shar gyon// g.yas g.yon rgyu zhags dgra sta dgra snying 'phyar// spyang mo mgo dgu (dgur3bzhon nas stong gsum nyul// skad cig re la dgra srog 'bum 'bum gcod// rnal 'byor srung ma'i gtso mo khyod la bstod//hūṃ/ rgyal ba'i bstan bsrung las mkhan dgra bo'i gshed// srog bdag hab se ha la nag po'i mdog/ rab 'jigs khro zhal gtsug na khra mgo rgod//mche gtsigs dug rlangs na bun dgra bo gsod// phyag bzhi dang po mdung dar dug rkyal bsnams// 'og ma phur bu dam nyams mgo rlon za// dred mo mgo dgu (dgur1chibs nas stong khams nyul// rnal 'byor grogs mdzad dgra gshed phyag tshal bstod//hūṃ/ kun 'dus rgyal ba bla ma'i spyan snga ru// khas blangs dam bcas srog gi snying po phul// bsgrub pa'i sku dgra bsgral ba'i mna' phul ba// dam can bka' bsrungs sde dgu 'khor dang bcas// sngon gyi dam tshig gnyen (gnyan1po dran mdzod la// rang rang mthun pa'i dam rdzas mchod pa bzhes//bos pa'i dus su ma thogs myur du byon// rbad che sngags pa'i las rnams myur du bsgrubs// zhes bstod/bsnyen pa bya ba ni/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyi thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor re re'i dbus su/ gtso bo la hūṃ/ e ka tsa ti la mam/ gza' la ram̐/ce spyang ma la hrī/ bshan dmar la kṣa/ dam can la tri/ srin po la ra/bdud mo la dun/ srog bdag la sham rnams kyi mthar rang rang gi srog sngags kyis bskor ba sngags dang sa bon thams cad rang rang gi mdog mtshungs su gsal ba/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od 'phros zhang blon gyi thugs ka'i srog snying la phog pas thugs rgyud bskul/ zhang blon gyi thugs srog las 'od 'phros 'khor rnams kyi srog snying la phog pas rgyud bskul

12 〉〉//'bri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/'khor thams cad bdag gi dbang du 'dus shing bka' nyan par gyur par bsam/ oṃ ma hā kā la yakṣa tsitta hūṃ phaṭa/ ratna sidha hūṃ/ zhang blon gyi'o// oṃ e ka tsa ti ma ma ru lu ru lu paṃ hūṃ skyo/ mamo'i 'o// oṃ ke ta ke ta swā hā/ rā hu la sa ma hūṃ/khyab mjug gi'o ḍakki ni tsitta rakta sa hring hring dzaḥcespyang ma'o// yakṣa tsitta ma hā ru tra mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ bshan dmar gyi'o// badzra sā dhū sa ma ya a mu ka ma ra ya phroṃ phaṭa/dam can gyi'o// rakṣa rakta rādza sa ma ya dgra bo'i srog la hur thum dzaḥ srin po'i 'o//dunti tsitta kā la dgra bo thum ril ma ra ya rbad/ ro zan ma'i 'o/ tri sham rbad bhyo ging ka ra dgra bo'i srog la hab hab/ las mkhan hab se'i 'o// de ltar gtso bo la 'bum tsho gsum/ gzhan rnams la re re ni bsnyen pa'o//bsgrub pa ni gzhung du/ sgrub dus dben pa'i gnas mchog tu// sku rten dar nag ma nyams la// dri khrag tshon sbyar rang rang gi/ sku gzugs bris pa'i phyar dar ni// rab gnas mnga' gsol byas pa bkram// gsung rten thod rnga mi rkang dung // gsang ba'i rnga sogs rol mo bsags// thugs rten gri rgod gsang ba'i snying // rtsa gsum ma nyams nang nyid du// mthing shog dag la gser dngul gyis// srog sngags bris la gzhugs (gzhug3 byas nas// ma nyams sgro sgron mda' dar la// dar nag gtum (btumasakal gdags par bya// bla rdo pha wang (bongakalong bu la// gser gyis hūṃ tri bris pa dang // dngul gyi mo khab zab skud bcas// srog sngags bris pa dar snas btums// ga 'ur bcug la ma phral bcang // 'di yis mi 'bral grib ltar 'grog/ gzhan yang rta nag g.yag nag dang // khyi nag bya nag ra lug nag/ gson po'i rten 'dzug ma grub na// gsob dbul yang na bris pa'ang rung // smyugs (smyug1tshags dar snas brgyan pa gzhug/ rta gtor rten gtor thun gtor dang //mchod rdzas ci 'byor bshams par bya// zhes pa'i bar tshogs par bshams la/rang gi thugs srog gi 'od kyis dam can 'khor bcas kyi srog snying drangs nas

༄7/zhang blon sde dgu'i 'phrin las gnam lcags kyi 'khor lo bsgyur ba/ 13rang gi thugs srog la bsdus pas dbang du 'dus par bsam la/ de yang gzhung du sngags rnams dril la bzlas par bya/ grangs tshad 'bum phrag gsum yin no// zhes gsungs pas/ oṃ ma hā ka la yakṣa badzra tsitta e ka tsa ti ma ma ru lu mam ke ta ke ta rā hu la/ ḍākki ni tsitta rakta/ yakṣa tsitta ma hā ru tra/ badzra sa dha sa ma ya/ rakṣa rakta rā dzā/ dunti tsitta kā la tri sham/ rbad bhyo ging ka ra hab hab sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥ hring hring / ces 'bum phrag gsum bzla'o// gtor 'bul la hring phyi ma'i mthar e dam ba liddha sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta ma hā rakta la kha ram khā hi/ dbang bskur la hring mthar a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ 'bod pa la ni sgrub sngags de nyid rang ngo // rbad pa la dzaḥhring bzhi po re re dor nas ma ya hring mthar rbad rbad bhyo bhyo yā/ bsad pa la ya'i mthar/ dgra bgegs che ge mo rā ya rbad sod hūṃ phaṭa/ ces so// bsrung ba la hring mthar bdag gam yon bdag la bsrung shig rakṣa sā hā/ bzlog pa la hring mthar gang bzlog par 'dod pa che ge mo mā ra ya hūṃ bhyo bzlog bsgyur/ ces so// thun 'jug rnams su dam can sde dgu'i gdangs bskang gdug pa tshar gcod nor bu 'od 'bar la 'bad do// de ltar bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi rtags rnams dang / las sbyor sgrub pa'i bca' gzhi dang dmigs pa sngags la sogs pa ni byin rlabs bla sgrub kyi mchod bstod bskul gsum spu gri dug ngar zhes pa'i nang du zhal gsal gsungs pa la slob dpon dgyes pa'i gsung gi gsang ba las rtogs par byos shigamathar bstan ma bskyang ba ni gtor ma la rakta bran/ dgug dbye bya slar me mar bltams/ sman raka sgron byin gyis brlab cing dngos la bskul ba ni/oṃ ka dag klong bzhugs kun 'dus rgyal ba'i tshogs/ āḥthugs rjes longs sprul gang 'dul skur bzhengs shigahūṃ/ thugs dam gnad nas bskul lo 'gro don mdzod// hrīḥdus la

14 ༄7khibri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/babs so log rtogs dgra bgegs sgrol// hūṃ/ bhyo/ dbus nas rdo rje bdud 'dul bzhengs// gnod sbyin kun gyi ded dpon bskul// rta nag rlung gshog myur du skyod// gri gug 'bar bas dgra srog gcod// gnod sbyin dmag tshogs dgra la phobs// steng gi mi rabs rtsad nas chod// 'og gi nor phyugs rlung la bskur// dus la bab bo sa ma ya/ bhyoḥshar nas e ka tsi ti bzhengs/ma mo kun gyi sde dpon bskul// dre'u rta rlung gshog myur du skyod// nad rkyal dgra bo'i yul du phobs// ma mo'i dmag tshogs dgra srog gcod// steng gi mi rabs rtsad nas chod// 'og gi nor phyugs rlung la bskur// dus la bab bo sa ma ya//hūṃ/ bhyo/ lho nas gza' bdud chen po bzhengs// sde brgyad kun gyi sde dpon bskul// sprin nag rlung gshog myur du skyod// sprul zhags rwa mda' dgra la rgyabatubargyab3/ / gza' yi dmag tshogs dgra la phobs// steng gi mi rabs rtsad nas chod// 'og gi nor phyugs rlung la bskur// dus la bab bo sa ma ya/hūṃ/ bhyo/ nub nas ce spyang mchu dmar bzhengs// khro mo kun gyi sde dpon bskul// dur bya rlung gshog myur du skyod// dgra zor rgyu zhags dgra srog gcod// khro mo'i dmag tshogs dgra la phobs// steng gi mi rabs rtsad nas chod// 'og gi nor phyugs rlung la bskur// dus la bab bo sa ma ya//hūṃ/ bhyo/ byang nas gnod sbyin bshan pa dmar po bzhengs// bshan pa kun gyi sde dpon bskul// g.yu 'brug rlung gshog myur du skyod// zangs gri dmar pos dgra srog gcod// bshan pa'i dmag tshogs dgra la phobs// steng gi mi rabs rtsad nas chod// 'og gi nor phyugs rlung la bskur// dus la bab bo sa ma ya//hūṃ/ bhyo/ shar lho srog gi spu gri bzhengs// dam can kun gyi sde dpon

༄7/zhang blon sde dgu'i 'azin las gnam lcags kyi 'khor lo bsgyur ba/ 15bskul// seng chen rlung gshog myur du skyod// lcags kyu spu gri dgra la rgyabatubargyab3/ / dam can dmag tshogs dgra la phobs// steng gi mi rabs rtsad nas chod// 'og gi nor phyugs rlung la bskur// dus la bab bo sa ma ya//hūṃ/ bhyo/ lho nub dgra dur 'jigs byed bzhengs// srin po kun gyi sde dpon bskul// ro langs rlung gshog myur du skyod// ral gri rtse gsum dgra snying chod// srin po'i dmag tshogs dgra la phobs// steng gi mi rabs rtsad nas chod// 'og gi nor phyugs rlung la bskur// dus la bab bo sa ma ya//hūṃ/ bhyo/ nub byang shanti ro zan bzhengs// bdud mo kun gyi sde dpon bskul// spyang mo rlung gshog myur du skyod// dgra sta rgyu zhags dgra srog gcod//bdud kyi dmag tshogs dgra la phobs// steng gi mi rabs rtsad nas chod//'og gi nor phyugs rlung la bskur// dus la bab bo sa ma ya//hūṃ/ bhyo/ byang shar srog bdag hab se bzhengs// las mkhan kun gyi sde dpon bskul// dred mo rlung gshog myur du skyod// dug rkyal phur bu dgra la thobs// las mkhan dmag tshogs dgra la phobs// steng gi mi rabs rtsad nas chod// 'og gi nor phyugs rlung la bskur// dus la bab bo sa ma ya//hūṃ/ bhyo/ 'jig rten mi bsrun dregs pa'i tshogs// dpal chen 'bar ba'i bka' byung gi/ rang rang dmag dpung go mtshon bskyed// thog rgod lta bur myur du rgyug/ gnod sbyin zhe sdang che ba'i tshogs// dam nyams yul khams thal bar brlog/ ma mo phrag dog che ba'i tshogs// nad rkyal dgra la char ltar phobs// gza' bdud nga rgyal che ba'i tshogs// dug lnga dgra bo'i snying la rgyab(brgyab3/ / mkha' 'gro phrag dog che ba'i tshogs// mi rung sna tshogs dgra la thongs// bshan pa srog la brngam pa rnams// dam nyams srog dbugs da lta chod// dam can dam nyams gshed ma'i tshogs// snying khrag dron mo myur du 'thungs// srin po sha khrag dga' ba'i tshogs// dam nyams sha

16 ༄7khibri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/khrag rus la rol// bdud mo ro la za byed rnams// dam nyams zas su da zo zhig/ srog bdag khrag la skems byed rnams// dam nyams khong khrag da 'thungs zhig/ sde brgyad dbugs la brngam pa rnams// dam nyams srog dbugs da 'goms shig/ bsrung ma dam la gnas pa rnams// dam nyams phung bar da gyis shig/ bka' bsrung bka' bzhin sgrub pa rnams// bka' 'das brlag par da gyis shig/ chos skyong chos byed skyong ba rnams// chos snub dam nyams da sgrol zhig/ phyogs skyong bcu yi zhing bdag rnams// phyogs bcu'i dgra bgegs da sod cig/ bos so bos so snyan ma sra// bskul lo bskul lo bang ma bul// rbad do rbad do mthu ma chung // rten no rten no gzhung ma ngan// rgyug cig rgyug cig dmag tshogs rnams// thul cig thul cig dgra dang bgegs// sod cig sod cig dam nyams 'di// choms shig choms shig sdig can 'di// zo zhig 'thung zhig sha dang khrag/ 'khyer cig gtor cig dgra bo'i nor// bshig cig 'gyel zhig dgra bo'i khyim// bsad rtags don snying 'khyer las shog/ lo dang zla bar ma 'gyangs shig/ zhag dang za mar ma 'gyangs shig/ dam nyams dgra bo 'khor bcas kyi// bsrung skyobs dpung mgon byed pa rnams// de nyid thal ba'i rdul du brlog/ bsrung ba'i gur khang da lta bshig/ 'go ba'i lha lnga bdud du phobs// tshe srog dwangs ma hub kyis thobs// bsod rnams za thang rlung la phyor// tshe srog da lta chod la shog/gal te las 'di mi sgrub na// 'jig rten dregs pa thams cad kyi// srog rtsa bdag gi lag tu yod// khyod rnams phung bar gdon mi za// de bas myur du las gyis shig/ ces brjod phud dang rakta sbreng /hūṃ/ dregs pa'i dmag tshogs nye re re// go mtshon ru mtshon zengs se zengs// nam mkha' bya nag thibs se thibs// sa gzhi khyi nag ngu ru ru//rlung nag 'tshub dmar 'khyil le le/ bar snang me stag tshubs se tshubs//

༄7/zhang blon sde dgu'i 'phrin las gnam lcags kyi 'khor lo bsgyur ba/ 17sbrul nag zhags pa na ra ra// thun gyi ser ba sha ra ra// khrag gi char pa si li li// nad kyi na bun thibs se thibs// thog gi bu yug chi li li// rgyab turgyob1dang sod sgra di ri ri// dam nyams ngu 'bod lhangs se lhangs// khrag gi rgya mtsho khol lo lo// sha yi ri bo zangs se zangs// rus pa'i gram khrod khra la la// mi snyan nga ro tsi re re// gcan gzan tshogs rnams zhung se zhung // ba dan nam mkhar 'phyar ra ra// mtshon rtsi dgra la lta la la// gnam lcags 'khor lo sgor ro ro// sha khrag zan la rubs se rub// tshangs dang brgya byin yin 'gyur yang // rdul phran bzhin du brlag nus na// dgra dang bgegs la smos ci dgos// bka' bsrung 'jig rten dregs pa'i tshogs// gum gum chum chum las la 'dus// kun 'dus rgyal ba'i bstan bshig 'di// rings par khug la myur du sgrol// las kyi gshin rje'i khram la thob// 'chi bdag sgo bro brdung du chug/ dus la bab po sa ma ya// zhes brjod gtor ma dgra phyogs 'phang //g.yab mo sdeb cing 'o dod 'bod// dam nyams rdul du brlag par bsam//bstan pa'i spyi dgra dang rang gi phyogs la bab na ma gtogs mi bskul zer ro//zhes bskul zhing gtor ma dgra phyogs su 'phang ngam thebs 'og tu 'bul/rjes su yig brgya nongs pa bshag dam can rnams bris/ sku la rten bzhugs rab gnas bya/ shis brjod bsngo smon gyi rgyas btab/ dus rtag tu dam rdzas mi la mi bstan tshogs gtor dang bsnyen pa rgyun mi bcad/ sngar 'gras kyi mi dang snying mi bsre/ dam tshig nyams dang gtam mi smra/ ro dang mdze can yug grib 'dzem/ bya nag khyi nag la brdegs pa gsod pa spang / zla re'i dgu gtor la brtson pa bya/ slob dpon la gus shing mched lcam la dud pa dang /dam can la the tshom med pa'i yid ches skyed pa rnams thun mongs tumong3ma yin pa'i dam tshig yin pas bsrung ba gal che ba yin no//smras pa/ sman gyi bla ma sangs rgyas gu ṇa'i zhabs// bdag snying pad

18 ༄7//'bri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/mar sngon nas bzhugs pa'i mthus// gso rig gzhung lugs snying thig bsrung mar bcas// ma 'bad ngang gis rtogs pa'i yid rab dang // deng sang sman par khas che tu'achekarloms (rlomakapa rnams// bla bsgrub rim gnyis nyams dang mi ldan pas// rang gzhan mchog don sgrub pa'i rtsa ba chad// dam can srung ma'i mthu rtsal ma bsgrubs pas// zhe gnag dgra la dug mtshon sbyor ba rtsom// rgya bod mkhas pa'i gzhung lugs ma sbyangs par// man ngag dam dum tsam gyis rang gzhan bslu// brtan g.yo'i sman bcud ro nus ma rtogs par//ldam ldum 'ga' zhig tshod ma lta bur bsdud// dpyad kyi lag len gang la'ang blo rmongs pas// rā (rwaka'ajib par bu lcags sregs (sreg3tsam la re// cha dpyad rnam dpyod ldan pa ma mthong bas// btsag (gtsag3bu'i mig thur tsam gyis re ba gang // bcos dgos brgya dang rtsa gcig nad mang la// sman nyog bsres pa'i ming snyan spyi 'jom zhes// btags pas nad pa kun gyi srog gshed byed// 'chos mi dgos pa'i nad pa gsos pa'i tshe// kho bos byas zhes sa steng dregs (grags3pas 'gengs// bcos dgos nad la sman skyidaman3lhag log pa yis// nad pa shi tshe las dang tshe zad zer// bcos tshul sde tshan lnga la sogs pa rnams// nad cig steng du go rim ma log par// gzhung ltar mi byed gang dran gya tshom gyis// byol nyog spyad pas nad pa mi sman tshe// dus ngan nad la gzhung gis mi phan zhes// dus gsum mkhyen pa rgyal ba sman gyi blas// ma 'ongs don phyir gsungs la bkur (bskur3pa 'debs// de rjes 'brangs pa'i las ngan slob mar bcas// rang gzhan thams cad dmyal bar khyu ded byed// rang nyid gcig pus nad la phan mi thogs// sman pa zla bo byung na dgra ltar 'dzin// nad ma gsos par yon la sbar snying 'thams// da lta nad par dngos su ma phan kyang // sngon chad 'di 'dra mang po phan no lo// ngo tsha gral (bral3ba'i rbad kham 'ur gyis 'gengs// gzhung la ma sbyangs nad par mi

༄7/zhang blon sde dgu'i 'phrin las gnam lcags kyi 'khor lo bsgyur ba/ 19phan zhing // yod rlom mngon pa'i nga rgyal zol gyis bslu// zla grogs kun la chags sdang phrag dog pas// tshe 'dir kun gyis smod cing rang nyid ngal// phyi ma chags sdang phrag dog las dbang gis// ngan song myong bas 'di phyi gnyis ka med// de 'dra'i sman pas nor 'dzin gzhi khengs pa// dus 'dir 'gro ba'i bsod rnams skal re dman// 'on kyang sngon gyi smon sems dag pa'i mthus// 'gro la sman pa'i 'tsho mdzad re re tsam// srid la lhag bsam dag pas mi mos gang // de phyir gso rig bsrung ma gtso 'khor gyi// 'phrin las khrigs chags bgyis pa'i dge tshogs gang // ma gyur 'gro ba'i nyes gsum nad zhi nas// sman gyi bla ma'i go 'phang thob phyir bsngo//de ltar g.yu thog snying thig gi bka' bsrung zhang blon drag po sde dgu'i 'phrin las gnam lcags kyi 'khor lo bsgyur ba zhes bya ba 'di yang / 'tsho mdzad dkon mchog rnam rgyal gyis yang yang bskul ba'i ngor/ dbur stod 'bri gung du son pa 'bru rgyal skyu ra'i rigs las/ don gyi sman pa shākya'i dge slong drang srong chos kyi grags pa zhes 'bod pas/ me spre'u dbo zla dmar po'i rdzogs pa gnyis pa'i dus tshes dge bar 'bri gung rtse ba gzhis ka sra brtan rdo rje'i gnas mchog tu sbyar ba 'dis kyang / gso ba rig pa'i gnas kyi nang gi bstan pa rab tu 'phel zhing lus can rnams nyes pa gsum gyi zug rngu bral te/sangs rgyas sman gyi bla ma'i go 'phang dam pa thob gyur cig zhang blon sde dgu la gtor ma dpal gtor gcig la/ rang 'dra chung ba brgyad dam/ zur gsum ram mo brgyad kyis bskor ba/ mtshams su mtheb kyu can dkar dmar gyis brgyan pa'o// shu rghaṃ// / /

20༄khya//gso rig nor bu'i bum bzang zhes bya ba bzhugs so//rtsa ba gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// ston 'khor phun sum tshogs pa'i skabs: slob dpon pad ma 'byung gnas dang : chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan ni: mkhan po bho snyi sa twa bcas: dge slong nam mkha'i snying po nas: rje 'bangs nyer lnga so so yi: ye shes mtsho rgyal 'di nyid kyis:yar langs phyag ni gyang 'gyel tshul: gu ru rje la 'tshal nas su: gser gyi maṇḍal steng du ni: rin chen sna tshogs tshom bu bkrams: snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis 'di ltar gsol: kye/ sangs rgyas kun 'dus pad ma 'byung gnas kyis: kho mo'i zhu ba snyan gyis gsan par zhu: thams cad mkhyen pa nyi zla rin po che: bsam yas gling bzhengs phun sum tshogs na yang : dge bcu'i khrims dar 'khrugs rtsod nad yams med: bden don (ldan3zhing ltar 'bral bar dka' ba 'di: bstan pa yun gnas gang du gnas pa ni:skye rga la sogs sdug bsngal 'byung mi 'byung : ma 'ongs 'gro kun rnams kyi don ched du: gab sbas med par gsung bar zhu: gu ru rje yis 'di ltar bka' bstsal pa: e ma nyon dang shes rab mkhar chen bza': skye ba dman te byang chub sems ma'i rigs: da lta gnas dus phun sum tshogs na yang : bdud kyi blon po'i smon lam so so yi: log par btab pas bsam yas gling chen por: dar rgud nyams pa bod 'bangs spyi la yong : rdzogs ldan dus ltar nyon mongs srab pa'i skabs: nad med tshe ring dpal 'byor

༄7gso rig nor bu'i bum bzang zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ 21ldan par 'byung : ma 'ongs dus su 'gro kun thams cad kyis: rim bzhin rim bzhin dug lnga hrag (hrags3nas 'gro: de yi rkyen gyis mi bde sna tshogs 'byung : nad kyi ming du glo bur hur thum zhes: mtshon gyi ming du du ru ka zhes bya: mu ge'i ming du thu tshur mug yams zhes: de da ga rkyen gyis chos byed sdug re bsngal: dar rgud khug po bod 'bangs dmag 'khrugs byed: stod hor smad hor chu ltar g.yo ba'i dus: bod 'bangs khams su kla klo'i 'phrul 'khor dar: dge slong khrims nyams sngags pa dam tshig 'chor: mi che bla dpon phyi 'khrugs nang 'khrugs byed: dkar po'i khrims bshig mi dge'i gser la brje: ri klung med pa (par3rkun jag khram pas gang : nga yi rjes 'jug khyi bzhin brnyas pa'i dus: bcos thabs yod kyang bcos mkhan med pa'i dus: de yi rkyen gyis chos skyong ri rab gzigs: steng nas gza' dang ma mos 'khrugs pa byed: bar du btsan dang rgyal pos nga rgyal 'khrugs: 'og tu klu gnyan sa bdag gti mug 'khrugs: de yi rkyen gyis lha srin sde brgyad kyis: sngar dus mi 'dra'i nad rims sna tshogs 'byung : gso rig mkhan pos rtsa chu mi shes shing : nad ngos mi zin bcos thabs dkon pa'i dus: mi dge bsgrubs pa'i 'bras bu 'di bzhin 'byung :grang ba'i nad ni chu ltar 'khrugs pa'i dus: tsha ba'i nad ni me ltar ches cher 'bar: tsha grang 'khrugs pa'i rlung nad sprin bzhin 'thibs: sngon du rgyu ba'i gnyan nad spyang khu dang : dug lnga'i nad kyi so sor 'byung ba dang : de yi dus su snying stobs ma chung bar: nges par bshad pas nges par snying du chongs: zhes pa de ltar gsungs nas thugs ni mi g.yo bzhugs: mtsho rgyal nyid ni ci drag snyams (snyam1nas thugs la rtags pa'i tshe: 'dar ma'i spang la sbrul ni lhung pa bzhin: yar la langs nas mgul rgyan maṇḍal gtor: kye ma kye hud dus gsum sangs rgyas mkhyen:

22 ༄7ltarabri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/'gro kun don du thams cad mkhyen pas gzigs: nad mug mtshon gyi 'jigs pa 'di nyid ni: skyobs pa'i thabs dang bcos pa'i thabs nyid ni:gang na yod pa rje yis gsung bar zhu: de ltar zhus pas: gu ru rje yi sku las 'od zer 'phros: spyan mig gza' skar shar 'dras rje 'bangs gzigs: thugs ni mi g.yo 'khor 'das wa ler mkhyen: gsung ni 'gag med tshangs pa'i dbyangs las drangs: 'di ltar bka' bstsal rdo rje'i gsung gi tshig: e ma e ma zab pa'i man ngag ni: sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs bcud snying po dang : sangs rgyas sman bla'i srog gi snying po ltar: sras bcas kun gyi byang sems 'od zer las: snying po'i bcud bsdus phan sems nor bu 'di: legs par bshad pas ma g.yengs rtse gcig nyon:nad mug mtshon gyi rtsa ba 'joms pa la: de dag bgag pa nor bu dbang rgyal ltar: rgyal khab so sor dge bcu khrims btsugs nas: mdo sngags so sor 'dul khrims ma nyams pa: bod 'bangs spyi yis yig drug 'ur 'don bya: sngags pa nus ldan 'gong po ar du gtad: 'dul 'dzin rnams kyis 'khrus mchog rab gnas bya: jo dar rlung dar lha srin dam sgrags byed: gso rig mkhas pas byang chub sems bskyed nas: phan sems dbang gis rtsi sman sna tshogs bsdud: nad bdag so so ngos 'dzin ma nor bar: chu la blta ba me long nang bstan 'dra: rtsa la brtag pa skyu ru lag bzhag bzhin: man ngag gab sbas can ni zur du gsal: dug lnga'i dbang gis rlung mkhris bad kan dang : mdze rigs glog tulhog1'bras tsha grang sna tshogs 'thab: nad rigs mi 'dra sna tshogs 'byung ba las: nad pa so sor chu khams sa khams dang : me khams rlung khams 'byung gzhi'i khams so sor: shas su che ba'i nad gzhi gcig pa la: gso bya gso byed so sor yod bzhin du: sman ni so sor gtong bar ma shes na: bsod nams

44 ༄7khabri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/bdun pa/ khrag tshad sel ba'i sngo sbyor bdun pa/ mkhris tshad sel ba'i sngo sbyor bdun pa/ chu ser sel ba'i sngo sbyor bdun pa/ snying tshad sel ba'i sngo sbyor bdun pa/ glo tshad sel ba'i sngo sbyor bdun pa/ mchin tshad sel ba'i sngo sbyor bdun pa/ mtsher tshad sel ba'i sngo bdun pa/ mkhal tshad sel ba'i sngo sbyor bdun pa/ pho tshad sel ba'i sngo sbyor bdun pa/ rgyu tshad sel ba'i sngo sbyor bdun pa/ sha tshad sel ba'i sngo sbyor bdun pa/ rtsa tshad sel ba'i sngo sbyor bdun pa/ rus tshad sel ba'i sngo sbyor bdun pa bcas khyon nyi shu rtsa bdun/grang sel dbyi mong bzhi ba la kha bsgyur gsum re bsnan pa'i me drod bskyed pa'i sngo sbyor bdun pa/ rtsam pa 'ju ba'i sngo sbyor bdun pa/ sngo ngad 'ju ba'i sngo sbyor bdun pa/ skran 'dril bshig pa'i sngo sbyor bdun pa/ rdo skran bshig pa'i sngo sbyor bdun pa/ mngal skran bshig pa'i sngo sbyor bdun pa/ dmu rdzings (rdzing3skem pa'i sngo sbyor bdun pa/ skya rbab 'joms pa'i sngo sbyor bdun pa/glo nad sel ba'i sngo sbyor bdun pa/ mchin nad sel ba'i sngo sbyor bdun pa/grang rnag gcod pa'i sngo sbyor bdun pa ste bcu gsum/ kun 'dus kyi sbyor ba gcig bcas khyon zhe gnyis rnams bsgril bas zhi byed kyi sman sbyor bzhi brgya dang brgyad/ 'di'i rin po che'i sbyor ba'i skabs/ skye rgyun gcod pa dang /log gnon brgyad rnams zhi byed kyi gras su mi 'dren pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ skye rgyun gcod pa ni 'phros don lta bu las phan byed kyi nad zhi byed ma yin la/log gnon ni 'di skabs bgrangs na log gnon rnams kyang rin po che'i sbyor bar 'gyur ba lta bu zhig tu song bas 'di la rin po che'i sbyor sde rnams kyi gtso bo dngul chu rang med pa dang / bshal dang skyugs kyi skabs su'ang log gnon rnams bgrangs na mu med la song bas mi 'dren pa'i rgyu mtshan de ltar yin nam bsam/sbyong byed la a ru/ dan rog shī khaṇḍa/ dur byid bcas pa'i ded

༄7/gso byed gnyen po stong dang rtsa gnyis kyi grangs nges zhal lung mdzes rgyan/ 45dpon bzhi ril bur bsgril ba la nang gses kha bsgyur gyi sgo nas/ snying nad sbyong byed tsaṇḍan skyotsardonakyesogs bsdebs pa/ glo sbyong tsha la sogs bsdebs pa/mchin sbyong gur gum sogs bsdebs pa/ mtsher sbyong ya pakṣa ra sogs bsdebs pa/ mkhal sbyong lcam pa sogs bsdebs pa/ don nad sbyong ba'i sbyong byed lnga/ pho sbyong ma nu sogs bsdebs pa/ mkhris sbyong tig ta sogs bsdebs pa/ rgyu long sbyong snya lo sogs bsdebs pa ste snod nad sbyong byed gsum/ byang ba sogs rtsa nad sbyong byed/ dbyi mong sogasamago skyon rtsa nad sbyong / li ga dur sogs stod sbyong / rgya tsha sogs smad sbyong / se rgod sogs pags sbyong /lug mig sogs mgo sbyong / a ba sogs mig sbyong / ga bur sogs tshad sbyong /pi pi ling sogs grang sbyong / 'bras gsum sogs tsha grang 'dres pa'i spyong /spos dkar sogs chu ser sbyong / khyung sder sogs dug sbyong / bse yab sogs bad kan smug po'i sbyong / dbyi mong sogs skran sbyong / gla gor zho sha sogs dmu chu'i sbyong / nim pa sogs skyug sbyong / zar ma sogs pho long sbos nad kyi sbyong / dzā ti sogs rgyu khrol gyi sbyong / byi tang ga sogs srin gyi sbyong /gur gum sogs dreg sbyong / ru rta sogs 'bras spyong / a sho gaddha sogs bu snod nad sbyong ste nad kha 'thor nyi shu rtsa gnyis kyi sbyong bcas kha bsgyur sum cu dang / sgos sbyong la thar nu lnga pa 'khrugs rims rgyas pa'i tshad pa sbyong byed/thar nu gsum pa gag lhog rgyu gzer sbyong byed/ dur byid bzhi pa bad smug sbyong byed/ khron bu gsum pa mkhris nad sbyong byed/ dur byid lnga pa glang thabs sbos pa sbyong byed/ shrī khaṇḍa lnga pa skran nad sbyong byed/ dur byid bzhi ba skya rbab sbyong byed/ dan da bcu gsum dmu chu sbyong byed/ a ru bdun pa dug nad sbyong byed/ pho mchin rims nad sbyong byed lcum rtsa drug pa/ dreg grum rnyogs tshad sbyong byed a ru drug pa ste bcu gsum rnams ril bur byas pa'i drag bshal bzhi bcu zhe gsum/ 'jam po la thar nu/ dur byid/ a ru ra/ lcum

46 〉〉khabri gungasnan rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/rtsa/ sngon bu/ khron bu/ shrīkhaṇḍa/ dan rog dan khra/ dong ga rnams ba chur gdusapa'i khaṇḍa la tsaṇḍan (tsandad3 sogs gong bzhin kha bsgyur sbyar ba'i 'jam po sum cu/ mi rus btsa' ma bsdebs pa'i nad sbyong ba/ ba spru bsdebs pa'i sbrum ma mi 'chor ba/ chu ma rdzibasdebs pa'i skyug pa/ dngul chu sogs bsdebs pa'i myur du 'bigs pa/ myang rtsi spras bsdebs pa'i mi 'byams pa/ dri chu chu rug bsdebs pa'i chu mi gnod pa/ nyi dga'i 'bras bu bsdebs pa'i kha mi skom pa ste bdun bcas/ 'jam bshal so bdun/skyugs la gtso bo ri sho spyang tsher/ dur byid/ shu dag rgyam tsha/ pi pi dzeling drug po la/ kha 'dzin bca' sga bsdebs pa'i ma zhu ba/ po so cha bsdebs pa'i rlung ldan/ gser phud bsdebs pa'i mkhris ldan/ dbyi mong bsdebs pa'i skran/ dong dkar bsdebs pa'i dug 'bri ta sa 'dzin bsdebs pa'i byang khog rnag khrag shing mngar bsdebs pa'i glo nad rnams 'dren byed ril bu dril bu'i drag po bdun dang / khu bar bsdebs pa'i 'jam po bdun te bcu bzhi/ sna sman la 'gron thal drug pa bong dkar sogs bsdebs pa 'i drag sbyor dang / cung zad 'jam pa/ 'bri ta sa 'dzin lnga pa/ shin tu 'jam pa gur gum sogs sbyar ba'i mgo rlung sogs 'joms byed/ la phug sbyar ba'i rna ba mgo nad sel byed/ rta sbangs sbyar ba'i so srin sel byed/ zhun mar sbyar ba'i nam tshong yan chad kyi rlung sel byed de sna sman bdun/ 'jam rtsi la sle 'jam/ bkru 'jam/ bkru ma slen te rtsa ba'i sbyor ba gsum/ shing kun kha ru tsha bsdebs pa'i rlung rkyang sel byed/ sga pi pi ling bsdebs pa'i bad ldan sel byed/ sle tres kyi lce bsdebs pa'i mkhris ldan sel byed/ rgya tsha bsdebs pa'i skran sel byed/ byi tang ga bsdebs pa'i srin sel byed/ ru rta bsdebs pa'i pho long sbos pa sel byed de drug bcas 'jam rtsi la

༄7gso byed gnyen po stong dang rtsaganyis kyi grangs nges zhal lung mdzes rgyan/ 47dgu/ ni ru ha la sbyor ba bar mar dur byid sogs la mkhris pa bsnanapa'i mtshon phog sel byed/ dbyi mong bsnan pa'i glangakhathabs sel byed/ rdzum rtsa bsnan pa'i smad tshad sel byed/ ug chos bsdebs pa'i lto sbos sel byed/sgog skya bsnan pa'i srin sel byed/ pi ling bsnan pa'i grang ba sel byed de drugade thams cad la re lcag bsnan pa'i rnon po drug a ru ra dang seng phrom btsod sogs bsnan pa'i 'jam po gcig sde bcu gsum/rtsa sbyong la zhi sbyong ma gsungs shing / byang ba bdun pa dang rgya ru dgu pa ste drag sbyong gnyis bcas sbyong byed kun bsdoms pas brgyad dang nyer lnga 'grig cing / 'on kyang sgos bshal bcu gsum po drag por 'dren pa dgos gzhi sman rang gi ngo bo drag po rang la gtong dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan med kyang spyir 'jam pa dang drag po'i khya da par gzhung rang nas/ cha mnyam zhib btags ril bur bsgril ba yis// rno la drag ste stobasaholdan nad kun 'joms// zhes dang / sna ma tshigs (tshig3pa'i khaṇḍa rno la 'jam// zhes pas sman gyi ngo bos dbye ba ma phye bar/ ril bu byas pa la drag po dang / khaṇḍar byas pa la 'jam pa'i tha snyad du bzhag pa 'di'i sgos bshal bcu gsum por tshig sbyor stabs kyis thams cad ril bu zhes dngos su ma thebs kyang don gyis ril bur bshad de/ rgya tsha bu ram sbyar ba'i ril bu yis// khrag mkhris ma zhu glang thabs sbos pa sel// zhes dang / rgya tsha bu ram ril bus skun nad sbyong //ril bus 'or dang dmu chu sbyong bar byed// ces dang / 'gron thal gla rtsi'i ril bus sha dug sbyong // zhes sogs bshad pas/ drag bshal la bsdus pa'i rgyu mtshan de ltar yin nam bsam/dpyad la dugs kyi skabs bsil dugs la 'grams 'khrugs tsha gzer sel ba'i skar chu'i dugs/ mig la mtshon phog dang btsan skrangs la chu grang

48 〉〉khabri gungasan rtsisaphyogs bsgrigs/ grod gtum gyi dugs/ sha dug gre 'gags sel ba'i bong dkar gangs chur bcas pa'i drod dugs/ rgyu gzer sel ba'i bong dkar zhu mkhan chu'i dugs/khrag mkhris tsha glang sel ba'i chu rdo grang mo'i dugs/ tshad gzer sel ba'i byang lcags kyi dugs dang / tshan zho'i dugs/ sna khrag ma chod na skar chu 'dag nag gi durgas/ so'i khrag tshad rlung skrangs sel ba'i 'dag dugag dreg nad tsha brab la sle tres ba lci bsres pa'i dugs te bsil dugs bcu/ drod dugs la/ ma zhu glang thabs la tshwa bsros kyi dugs/ mtshon khrag 'khyags pa la chu rdo /mchin khrag 'khyags pa lagrog zhing yos tsha na/ mkhal ma grang gzer la sbangs skam/ bu btsas sogs la byi sa chang bran/ smug po 'thab pa la a bo sogs sbang bcos/ ma zhu grang skran la phug ron brun/ grang glang la so phag srin glang la spru ma'i rtsa lo/ gzhang srin la phur mong rta sbangs/ gzhang lug la snum kong / rlung gzer la phying ba snum ldan/ mkhal rked grang ba la g.yi yi spyang spu dugs/ snod kyi grang ba la lag mthil/ tshigs sul chu ser la shag ma chang bran nam/ yang na sbang skam grog zhing / chu 'gags la 'ba' cha bya brun/stongs tshad rlung gzer la 'khar gong srin can dang rus rnying chang bran/ yan lag chu ser la lug ril chang bran rnams bsros pa'i dugs te tsha dugs bco brgyad de bsdoms pas nyi shu brgyad/ lums la spyi mthun las grub chu tshan/ bdud rtsi lnga'i lums/ mi rus batre' ma'i lums/ 'khan bul phabs sbyar gyi chu lums dang bcas te bzhi/tsha sel 'bru sna'i lums/ kyi lcosogs kyi lums/ rtsa byer la me tog sna tshogs kyi lums/ rtsa dkar sogs la gla ril chang btsos/ rtsa 'grams skrangs rengs la 'khan pa sogs dri chur btsos pa/ tshad pa rnyogs byer la mtshan dang sro lo/mdze dug la ra ril gla chu/ dbyig dug 'a mchod rten na bza' sogs kyi lums te tsha sel gyi lums bcu gnyis/ grang sel rnag 'gugs sbang skam

༄7/gso byed gnyen po stong dang rtsa gnyis kyi grangs nges zhal lung mdzes rgyan/ 49sogs/ mde 'byin ra ril sogs/ chu lhog ra dug sogs/ yan lag chu ser la rta rkyang bong bu'i slo/ rmen 'bras la phug ron ril ma/ 'bras 'dul mi rkang sogs/ rdo skran la spyang tsher sogs/ rus trem tshabs nad la mi rus sogs / rlung 'phyos smyo 'bog la snying sna/ rims gzhug la khru gang 'og sa/rus tshigs gzer bar rus sna chang btsos/ rlung skrangs la 'ba' cha chang btsos rnams kyi bcing lums te grang sel bcu gnyis bcas bsdoms pas nyer bzhi/byug pa la/ gnyid med la 'bru mar/ blo mi gsal bar zhun mar/ smyo 'bogs brgyal nad la lo mar/ chu ser za 'phrug la rta rkyang bong tshil/mkhal nyams sogs la da byid sram tshil/ shig sro mang bar sha tshil/ khyi rmar khyi tshil/ glang shur phag tshil mu nag 'brum shul ra tshil 'bri mog shu ba rma rgan la tsardon mar khu/ mig 'grib la bya rgod phag tshil/ yang na 'bri mar go snyod/ rlung nad rus zhugs la bca' sga 'bru mar/ gnyid med la gla rtsi mar dkar/ lhog pa la mu zi ra dug sogs kyi lde gu shu bar mu zi sogs kyi lde gu/rnag 'dren la byi brun gser rdo nu zho/ 'bras la srad dkar rta bong 'o ma/dreg nad la til phyur khu/ skrangs sel la shu dag brgyad pa/ khye ma pags nad la dud sbyor bzhi pa/ ngo khab la yungs kar bzhi pa/ dug nad la 'om bu a ru/me dbal la tsandan sogs/ rngul 'byams sogs la skyu ru utpal/ za 'phrug la dud pa ru rta sogs/ bas ldag la sbrul nag pags bsregs sogs/ za 'phrug la sngon bu srub ka zho sbyar te byug pa nyer brgyad bcas khyon 'jam dpyad brgyad cu tham pa/dpyad tsub mo gtar ga la gnya' rengs 'gyur dka' la ltag rtsa/ bad mkhris mgo nad sogs la mtshog gsang dbye zhing gser mdung dang dngul mdung / mig dmar zhing ling tog yang yang 'byung bar mig rtsa/ sna la sna rtse/

50 ༄7/'bri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/rna ba'i nad la rna rtsa/ snying nad skom dad smra dka' ba la lce rtsa/ so mig rna ba 'grams pa'i nad la ltag ral/ so nad so rtsa dang rtse chung dang dpung rtsa/ glo lu snying tshad sogs la thong rtsa/ stod gzer sogs la dpung rtsa/ glo tshadatshosogs la drug 'go dang sgang rtsa/ don snod thun mong la snod ka glo snying khrag rgyas la glo snying 'dom rtsa/ mig ser lus lci dang ga 'gag pa la mkhris rtsa gsha' rengs dang phran bu/ mchin mtsher mchin dri 'grams 'khrugs gzer smug po'i tsha skran rnams la ru thung / skad 'gags lu bar sgang rtsa/ ro stod pho mchin gyi nad la glo mchin 'dom rtsa/ khrag mkhris kyi nad la mchin mkhris 'dom rtsa/ pho mchin khrag nad la rgyab rtsa drug 'dus/ rgyu long mtshon phog la rtsa chen/ gzhung rengs ltag dgye sogs la sgab rtsa/ mtsher ba snad 'grams sogs la rta mthur/ mkhal 'grams sogs la byin gzhug smad du mtshon phog pa dang chu 'gags pa sogs la long rtsa/ rgyu mar khrag babs sogs la rgyu rtsa/ rkang mthil bol skrangs sogs chu ser gyi nad la gdong rtsa dang bol gong gtar ba ste gdab dmigs nyer bdun/ bye brag stod nad rtse chung dang sgang rtsa/smad nad la long rtsa dang byin gzhug bar nad la snod ka ru thung / ro stod kyi nad la sgang rtsa dang drug 'go nu 'jing brang nad la snod ka ru thung / snying tshad la snod ka lce rtsa thong rtsa/ glo tshad la drug mgo sgang rtsa skyor gong / glo snying gnyis 'dom pa'i nad la rtse chung 'dom rtsa/ mchin tshad la ru thung dang sgang rtsa/ mtsher tshad la rta mthur dang srin lag rgyab rtsa/ pho tshad la pho ba'i rwa dang drug 'dus/ mkhris tshad la gsha' rings phran bu gser mdung rnams/mkhal tshad la byin gzhug dang pho mtshan 'gram rtsa/ rgyu long la long rtsa dang /dku 'grams la byin kyog sha tshad la glo mchin gyi rtsa/ rus tshad la mkhal rtsa/pags tshad la chu ser la mchin mkhris kyi rtsa/ zug che bar glo rtsa dang / bying 'thibs la ru thung / dang ga 'gags na bad mkhris kyi rtsa/ nad dmigs

༄7/gso byed gnyen po stong dang rtsa gnyis kyi grangs nges zhal lung mdzes rgyan/ 51gang nye gang rgyas la gtar ba rnams te bye brag gi dmig/sa nyi shu / cho ba sto bas can la rtse chung sogs yas babs su sa/tar ba / tshabs che'i nad la rtsa phran smu nga tsape gtar ba las rtsa chen gtar ba/ bsngags pa sogs ma/dor bsdus gsum ste bsdoms pas gtar ba lnga bcu/bsreg pa la an stong tshigs pa dang po rlung gi gsang / gnyis pa mkhris pa/ gsum pa bad kan/ bzhi ba glo ma/ lnga ba glo bu/ drug pa srog rtsa/bdun pa snying / brgyad pa mchin dri/ dgu ba mchin pa/ bcu ba mkhris pa/bcu gcig mtsher ba/ bcu gnyis pho ba/ bcu gsum pa bsam se bcu bzhi pa mkhal ma/ bco lnga pa don snod spyi/ bcu drug long / bcu bdun rgyu ma/bco brgyad pa lhang ba/ bcu dgu pa khu ba/ nyi shu pa thur sel rlung sgo'i gsang ste rgyab gsang nyi shu/ mdun gyi me dmigs ske stong tsa ra khung srog rtsa snying 'dom gyi rtsa/ nu dkyil brang gzhung dkar nag gi mtshams snying gsang / lhon gsang / skran gsang / me mnyam gyi gsang / long gi ther gsang / long gi phugs gsang / rgyu stod gsang / rgyu smad gsang / lhang gsang ste mdun gsang bcu/ rlung gis mgo 'khor sogs la sdud sgo spyi gtsug mtshog ma ste 'dus so gsum/ smyo lab sogs la ltag pa'i spu 'khyil/ rlung rims sogs la ma mchu'i 'og lkog nad sogs la phyi long gi steng gi chu ba'i bar/ rims nad ngu lab sogs la lag mkhrig chu ba'i bar/ pho mtshan mi ldang ba sogs la nang long thad drang gi chu ba'i bar/ rkang bshal sogs la brla'i phyi sul/bud med bu btsas skrangs par ol 'dzum/ ltag rengs sogs la rkang mtheb spu 'khyil/ mig tshag sogs la rting ba'i dreg mtshams/ rgyu long pho glang nang long 'phar rtsa/ dngangs skyigs skyugs pa la ske stong / mchu nad la srin lag gnyis kyi tshigs mgo/ so nad la gang na'i phyogs kyi rna drung dang srin lag gi rtse/ sna khrag ma chod na dbugs kyis gar sleb kyi dpung mgo ste mdzub tshugs

54 〉〉khibri gungasnan rtsisaphyogs bsgrigs/dus min du zos pa rnams dril bas bco brgyad bcas khyon brgya dang zhe bzhi/spyod lam rgyun spyod la tshe rkyang ba'i thabs spyir bshad pa ni/ sman mchog dpung ba g.yon par bcang ba/ rin po che spyi bor gdags pa/ grub pa'i gsang sngags mgul la gdags pa/ nad slong gi rkyen gnyis spang ba/ lus ngag yid kyis nyes pa spang ba gsum/ mig rna ba/ sna/ lce/ lus kyi dbang bo lnga mnar ba sogs ma lhung ba bcas bcu gnyis/ bye brag 'gro 'dug gi spyod lam la/ the tshom gyi gru/ mi bsrun pa'i bzhon pa/ gsod sa/ chu chen/me phung / dbyar gad steng / dgun shing rtse/ sdod na sa brtag 'gro na la ma brtag mtshan mo dbyug thogs grogs ldan du bya ba bcas bcu/ gnyid kyi spyod lam la mtshan mo gnyid log pa/ ma log na sang phyed log pa/ ra ro sogs nyin par kyang gnyid log pa/ gzhan du nyid gnyid spang pa bcas bzhi/nyal po'i spang blang la nyal po skye gnas mi mthun pa sogs la spang ba/ dgun dus bkag pa med pa ston dus zhag gnyis/ dbyar sos zla phyed kyi bar du ma gtogs gzhan du spang ba bcas gsum/ byug pa'i spang blang la/ rtag tu bsku byug byed pa/ stobs ldan gyi snum za ba/ dril phyis bya ba bcas gsum/ khrus kyi spang blang la chu grang gis khrus bya ba/ chu dron gyis mgo 'khru ba spang ba bcas gnyis/ mig sman gyi spang blang la glo bur nad lnga'i dgra la skyel ma bsten pa gcig bcas tshe rkyang gi spyod pa so drug mi chos spyod pa kun gyi gzhi yin pas chad don batren par bya zhing rang gi mdo don bsdam pa/ ngan las chad kyang bzlog cing bzang las bshol yang brtsam pa/ gzhig pa sngon la btang zhing phyis kyi legs 'phen bca' ba/ zer dgu bden par mi 'dzin par legs par dpyad la 'dzin pa/ smra dgu bsam la smra zhing rang gi mdo don bsdam pa/

100 ༄༅|'bri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/grang las// gyur pa'i nad rigs zug ju thams cad la// thogs med bya ba ril nag ma lags sam// nad med zhig gis rgyun du bsten pa na// rdo rje'i sku 'grub sde brgyad bsrung ba'i mchog/ thog ser mtshon kyang 'jigs med bsod nams grub// dgos su sbyor ngan gnyen po sna re yis// 'joms shing thams cad bsdoms na mchog tu bsngags//da ni so sor dbye ste bstan pa ni// dbyig dug gnyen por dngul chu gser dngul dang // zangs lcags lhang tsher rnams ni mchog tu bshad// nyi zla'i 'od la dugs pa'i dug rigs rnams// bco lnga'i zla 'od bdug pa'i lcags rtsis bsrungs// rin chen nyi ma'i zer gyi rlangs dug rnams// pha lam la sogs rin chen rnams kyis bsrungs// rdo dug rnams la sbal rgyab la sogs bsngags// don snod gang bab kha 'dzin bzang po drug/ sngo sbyor dug med gsum dang dkar ser rnams// gang chung sug smel la sogs gnyen po mchog/'brudug yungs dkar dpal sgang pad kha nyung son yin// sha dug gnyen po gzi mdangs med pa dang // byi'u la phug nyid ni mchog yin no// shing dug reg dug sogs la tsan dan no// ra dug gnyen por spyi bor chig skyes yin//mkha' lding dug la rma bya'i sgro gzhob yin// gzugs mo byi dor tuthur3rnams ni mchog yin no// spu dug stag gi sma ra sbugs tusbubs3gcig yin// klad dug klad srin sogs la bu mo yi// spyi bo mchan 'og spu yis skyob par nus//mchin dug bu mo stag lo'i mchin pas 'joms// sbal pa o rog la sogs sha sbyor gyis// dug rigs gri sha sogs kyis 'joms par byed// skad cig hur thum bse zho'i sbyar dug de// phya tshan gsum gyis rtsad nas 'joms par byed//krig (gri3dug mu zi ser pos 'joms par byed// se 'bru'i khu bas me drod gso bar byed// de ltar rags rim bsdus nas bstan pa de// zhib rgyas phan yon bgrangs kyis mi lang mod// rang rang sman gyis nad rnams 'joms pa'i
