102༄//rin chen ril bu'i cha lag sbyar dug gso thabs bzhugs so//gangs can lha lam yangs pa'i mngon mtho la// mnyam nyid nyi ma'i 'od zer kun nas shar// zug sel tsha zer 'od stong 'gyed mkhas pa// dharmā (dharma3swā (swātudharma kisni'ika3mi brgyud bcas rgyal gyur cig/ rin chen ril bu blas dpon bzhag pa'i tshe// dgra byung blon pos bya gtong byung ba'i tshe//dgra rigs gang yin brtag pa shin tu gces// 'di la rin po che dang rdo rtsi sha/sngo las sbyar te rgyu ni de lnga'o// rin chen rdo las sbyar ba grang bar 'gyur// pho bar bab cing bad kan skye bar byed// rtsi sha sngo rnams tshar 'gyur mchin mkhris 'bab// khrag mkhris skyed cing ldan 'dus pho mchin 'bab// tsha grang 'du ba 'khrug cing mi snyoms 'gyur// dang po dug rigs spyi rtags ma zhu 'dra//ro stod mchin kha na zhing rtsa khrid 'khyug/ sha mdog mthing 'dra skam zhing kol bur na// shed snyil gnyid mi snyoms shing rus kun na// rna 'on mig mi gsal zhing lce dig pa// so 'ga' sen mo'i kha dog nag por 'gyur// mgo 'khor sgal tshigs kha bye btsir na phan// sa bon dkar dmar 'dzag cing chags pa 'chor// brjed ngas myos dang snying mi dga' ba 'ongs// mdor na lus zungs bdun po kun khyab pas// rlung mkhris bad kan tsha grang rtags kun ston//gnyis pa brtag thabs phyi nang gsang gsum las// phyi rtags rtsa rgyud phra spun mngon mi thub// chu mdog nag nyog ku ya bal 'dab 'dra// zangs la byugs na g.ya' chags nag por 'gro// lto stong mchil ma chur blugs gting du

104 ༄7khibri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/ba na// mid pa mi bde rin chen sbyar dug rtags// rdo sbyor pho ba sra 'dril kha gdong sbos// rtsi sbyor chu nag lce mchu 'gags tugs1shing skom// gzhogs phyed na zhing gang na sha yang skams// lus po sbrid 'khyug be ra ldang bar 'gyur//sha sbyor mid pa ldeb cing khol bur na// skyug bro mig dmar khrag 'khru sha za 'dod// sngo sbyor yan lag na zhing kha mtshul skrangs// rma shu med na sngo sbyor yin par nges// gab pa yul gyi brtag thabs bstan pa ni// snying la babs pas lce ldib shes pa 'phyo// mchin par babs pas mig zhu mchin dri gzer// mcher par bab pas chu 'gag (mchu gas3sbo 'khrog rdzing // mkhal babs rna 'on chu sri mkhal rked na// snod du babs pas sgregs skyugs tsha 'gyur 'khru// sha la babs pas sngo skam 'gul 'phrig tsha// rtsa la babs pas sprid 'khyug kun tu byer// rus la babs pas rus pa khol bur na// rgyus par babs pas yan lag zha rengs 'khyog/ khrag la babs pas khrag gzer rtsa rnams rgyas// tshad par babs pas rtsa chus tshad rtags ston// grang bar babs pas rtsa dal chu sngo la// zas mi 'ju zhing sbos 'khrog la sogs so// gsang rtags nyal po rta bong (bang1khrag tshod dang // nya dang phag sha rul pa zos pa dang // bra'o res bal zos pas nad ldang na// sbyar dug yin par thag chod nges pa'o// phyi nang gsang rtags gsal bar tshang ba dang // dug gsar ma rnying bcos log ma song ba// 'tsho ba'i phyir na mkhas pas bcos par bya// dug rnying sman log sha skams mur gong brdib// skyugs skam dang kha 'gag la sen bkrag shor//dmu chur 'gyur dang skran du 'gyur ba dang // phyi nang gsang rtags mi gsal bying po dang // rtsa rgyud phra spun 'dar la grangs su sdod// yang na rgyud 'gyur yang na ma tshang ngam// nad med dal ba'i rtsa byung chu rtags de// snag tsha chad 'dra ku ya long long 'ong // de 'dra byung na mi de 'chi bar nges// mkhas pas kha dmar gdags la spang bar bya//

༄7/rin chen ril bu'i cha lag sbyar dug gso thabs bzhugs so/ 105da ni 'tsho nges bcos pa'i thabs bstan pa// bsdu gsad spyong ba rjes gcod bzhi ru 'dus// dang por sdud thang yung ba g.yag khrag dang // re ral 'om bu sbyar ba'i thang gis bsdu// yang na de ba lug ru'i thang gis bsdu// yang na phag khrag yungs dkar dbang lag dang // klad pa sbyar ba'i thang gis bsdu ba'am// yang na 'om bu skyer ba par pa ta// garga skyogaṅgā3chung dang hong len yu gu shing // khur mang se rgod tsher sngon chu srin sder// brag skya ha'o spang rtsi do bo dang // ber skyes re ral sbyar ba'i thang gis bsdu// yang na mon yul skyes pa'i su mi sman// bzang po'i chig thang gis kyang bsdu bar nus// 'dus rtags lus lci sgyid skyur dang kha 'gags// lce skams pho ba lci la tsha rum byed//de ltar byung na dug cher 'dus pa yin// 'dus rtags ma gsal bar du thang la 'bad// gnyis pa bsad pa'i thabs la 'di lta ste// nad pa zungs bzang ba la 'om bu dang // re ral spang rtsi do bo yu gu shing // hong len tig ta rnams ni cha bskyed la// bong ba dkar po spang rgyan gaṅga (gaṅgā1chung // brag zhun gang bas snod kyi kha 'dzin la// bzang drug sdebs la grang sbyor ril bu bsre//se 'bru chu skol grang pas dus drug dbul// zungs ngan me drod chung la tsha la dang // brag zhun a ru ze tsha pi pi ling // rma bya'i sha dang mi ra'i mkhris pa dang // phya tshan gsum dang gla rtsi bzang po drug/ bong nga dkar po ber skyes re ral dang // chos sman dpa' bo dkar dang khyung sder tshal(mtshal1/ / yung ba skyer pa rnam par yu gu shing // so ma ra dza ga pur tsan dan shing // ghi wang ka ra grang sbyor ril bu bsres// phye ma brag zhun khu bas dus drug 'bul// gsod nas tsha ba chogs pa'i rtags byung tshe// tshad ro dug rnams thur du sbyong ba ni//bse ru dkar po a ru mchu snyung dang // dan rog dur byid rin chen ril bu sbyar// lcag gis phul bas nad ro thur du sbyong // yang na a ru mchu snyung dan rog dang // lce zhur rin chen ril bu sbyar bas sbyong // yang na a ru mchu ring

106 ༄༅spyo'abri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/lcum rtsa dang // rin chen ril bu sbyar bas sbyong bar 'gyur// lag len lto sbyong lta bur bya bar gces// gal te nad pa zungs zad shed ngan na// sdud thang btang la bsad sbyong sbrags pa ni// bong ba dkar po skyer pa ghi wang dang //tsan dan gnyis dang bzang drug bse ru dkar// dan rog a ru mchu snyung durabyid dang // lce zhur lcum rtsa rin chen ril bu sbyar// dri chu gangs chu cha gsum bsres la btang // lag len lto sbyong lta bur byas la spyad// 'byams na iṇḍa (ind+ra3da trig tha ram dang // mon cha ra dang bya rkang ka ped dang // rgya lkag skyoskagasakye myag sbyar chu skol phul btang mchod (chod1/ / de nas rjes gcod rin chen ril bu la// se 'bru lnga pa sbyar ba chang zhim gyis// phul la nyin mtshan dus bsten lus zungs gso// mjug sdud rin chen ril bu dom mkhris dang // gur gum sbyar la chus phul rtsa kha bsdams// de ltar bcos thabs zab mos gsos par 'gyur// dbyig dug dag la mngar bag kha zas spangs// rdo la snum spang sha la sha rul spangs// rtsi la gtar kha spang byar 'dir bshad do//phran bu dug gi sbyor ba bshig pa ni// dug nad grang bar gyur na zangs thal dang // 'gron thal sog thal gangs thigs bul tog dang // tsha la khur mang dom mkhris brag zhun dang // a ru yung ba dri chen ka ra dang // mi rus btsa' ma rin chen ril bu sbyar// btang ba'i rjes la nad ro bshal gyis sbyangs// dug nad skran du 'dril na rgya tsha dang // tsha ba gsum bsres 'gron thal rin chen ril bu sbyar// btang rjes skran ro bshal gyis sbyang bar bya// dug nadaskya rbab skrangs na srad dkar dang // a ru dur byid pi ling spos dkar dang // rin chen ril bu sbyar bas sbyang bar bya// dug nad khol bur bab cing tsha ba'i nad// shas che ba la gtso bo drug gis dug(bdug3/ grang shas che na tsha ba gsum gyis dug(bdug3/ yan lag rengs na ram pa'i thang gis 'gugs//

༄7/rin chen ril bu'i cha lag sbyar dug gso thabs bzhugs so/ 107gnya' rengs gser sha'i thang dang nya shas bdug/ chu 'gag gla rtsi gze ma'i thang gis sel// khol bur gzer na ma nu bzhi thang mchog/ snying 'phyo stabs (stab3seng chang sbyar khu ba la// dzā ti btab la btang bas 'joms par byedaspyoglo lu bu ram mar rnying ting khrol btang // mkhal gzer dugs bya pi pi ling thang btang // sbos la ru rta rgyam tsha shing tshwa (tsha3btang // khol bur skrangs na rta'i phya tshan dang // skyer pa'i thang gis sbo 'khrog gzhom par nus// 'brum pas lus khyab tsan dan mar khu byugs// ro stod na na rdo ba 'khur zhing 'phangs// rked pa mi bde ba la sa phad bskur// ro smad mi bde rta bzhon 'dur zhing rgyugs// me yis mi zhu se 'bru bzhi pa btang // ngan khrag nad la khol bu'i rtsa re gtar// gzhan yang kha la rma dang rgyu skam la// skrad (krad3rnying thal ba a ba ra (rwa3gzhob btang // shug pa'i lo mas dugs bya rgyu gzer sel// smyo na 'bras bu gsum po chang sbangs btang // 'di kun rin chen ril bur sbyar ba gces// dug nad mjug 'khyogs bcos nyes gdon chen dang //sa bdag klus gnod mdze la 'gyur ba la// 'bras bu gsum dang star bu bzang po drug/ tsha ba gsum dang tsan dan dkar dmar gnyis// chu ser sman gsum skyer shun tsan dan mar khu// khro gnyer 'dre 'jigs mi'i rkang mar dang // re ral mtshe dang brag zhun ra mnye dang // ldong ros nye shing yungs dkar dom mkhris dung // mu men byu ru g.yu dang 'gron bu dang // cong zhi phag rgod mche bar bcas pa rnams// rin chen ril bur sbyar la chus phul btang // rgyun ring bsten pas shu pags brje bar 'gyur// rjes su mdze ro bshal du sbyar ba ni// bar shog (gshog1ma bton byang pa rgya tsha dang // sdig srin mtshal dang gur gum ha shig dang // pi ling lcam 'bru shing mngar tsha la dang // da mtshur rin chen ril bu sbyar la btang // lag len rtsa sbyong ji bzhin bya bar gces// 'di ltar dug sbyar gso thabs zab mo 'di// rgyud

108 〉〉khibri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/bzhi'i yan lag brgyad pa'i dgongs pa blangs// bla ma'i man ngag gdams pas legs brgyan te// lus can gso phyir phan sems blo yis bkod//'dir smras pa/ rnam dag gso dpyad mkhyen pa'i sman pa mchog/dgongs don bcud 'dzin mang rabs byung ba rnams// deng dus nub ri'i khri la 'khod par gyur// rgyud dang mon ngag sdebs pa'i dgongs pa la// mkha' 'gro'i gsang tshig dam pa'i phras btab ste// lus can nad las grol phyir 'di na shar// 'di 'dra'i gdams pa zab mo med srid na// deng sang dus 'dir bshes gnyen mi chen sogs// 'gro ba'i sum gnyis dug gis 'chi bar nges//de 'dra'i dus su gdams pa 'di las ci// rgyud dang bstan bcos man ngag gis dben kyang // rang 'dod khur gyis lci zhing khrel med pa'i// phub 'khur kun slong mtshon cha rab bzung ba// srog bdag sman pa'i lag tu sho ra re// kye ma sbyor ngan dug gi dmag tshogs rab mang la// ril nag gnyen po'i dmag mi dpa' bo yi// kha bsgyur 'di yi mtshon cha rab brdeg pas// sbyor ngan dpung tshogs gzhom pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ces pa rin chen grang sbyor ril bu'i cha lag sbyor ngan gso ba'i man ngag dam pa 'di yang zur mkhar ba dharmā tudhangam3swā mi'i slob brgyud dam pa kong sman dkon chog (mchog1 rgyal mtshan gyi drin las byung ba yin/ gzhan pa 'ga' zhig rang 'dod dang sdig ltung bral ba'i phub khur te/ sman dpyad log pa'i mtshon cha bzung zhing / nga rgyal dang kun slong gi zhags pa thogs te lus can gyi srog bdag dbugs za ba'o// sman par khas len pa de ltar min kyang /sman dpyad yan lag brgyad pa'i dgongs pa blangs zhing / dpal mnyam nyid badzra sogs kyi gsung gi man ngag dam pa legs par mang du thos pa'i nges pa don gyi sman pa dge slong dharmā kirtis (dharma kitī1'ba' rong gi sgar du bris pa maṅgā lam// / /

109༄//rin chen grang smyor ril bu'i sbyar cha lag phran bu'i sbyar dug gso thabs bzhugs so//sman bla'i tshogs la gus btud nas// lus can rkang bzhi'i tshogs rnams kyis// sngo sa rdo chu shing la sogs// dug rigs zos pas na gyur na//sman dpyad gzhan rnams ma byas pa'i// snga rol gdams pa 'di bya'o// phag khrag de ba lug ru dang // yungs dkar dbang lag sbyar ba'am// yang na re ral 'om bu dang // yung ba phag khrag skyer shun rnams// sbyar ba'i thang gis bsdus byas la// sbyang thabs a ru mchu snyung dang // dan rog dur byid bse ru dkar// grang sbyor ril rdog bco lnga rnams// sbyar ba'i phye mas legs btang bas// dug rigs nad rnams sbyang bar byed// sbyangs rjes rin chen ril bu btang // des ni dug nad 'tsho bar 'gyur// yang na dan rog dur byid shri (shrī3khaṇḍa// spos dkar thal rdor so ma ra tsas sbyong // sbyang rjes rin chen ril bu cung zad bsten// 'dis ni rkyang dug ma lus 'joms par byed// sngo sogs dug chung rnams la bsdu mi dgos// sbyangs pas chog cing sa rdo chu dug rnams// cung zad bsdus te sbyang na legs pa yin// shin tu nad tshabs che ba na// sman btang bshal sbyong khrag yang gtar// yang na ra dug zos pa ngos zin na// bul tog a ru mchu snyung dang // yungs (yung3ba sbyar ba'i phye ma la//oṃ krug a hri a hri kha// zhes pa ci mang btab byas la// chus phul btang bas 'joms par 'gyur// kun la rin chen ril bu sbyar// dug chung rnams la ser mtshur gyi// khu ba blud pas grol bar 'gyur// 'di rnams mi nor khyad

110 ༄7//'bri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/par med// mi yis btsan dug zos pa na// thog mar mi khyi gang rung gi/ phya tshan dri chur sbyar ba la// ri sho spyang tsher shu dag dang // rgyam tsha so 'cha' sbyar ba btang // phub steng bzhag la drag tu bskor// skyugs 'byung de nas phag khrag dang // yung ba re ral 'om bu rnams// sbyar ba'i thang gis bsdu byas la//bsad sbyong sbrags pa'i gdams pa 'di// bse ru dkar po dan rog dang //a ru mchu snyung dur byid dang // skyer shun ghi wang tsan dan gnyis// rin chen ril bu sbyar la btang // des sbyong sbyang rjes rin po che'i// ril bu zhag bdun bar du bsten// des ni nad las grol bar nges// 'di mi shes pa'i sman pa 'gas// btsan dug rtsar byer rgyas pa ltar// bong nga dkar ser dmar la sogs// sbyar dug gsod pa'i sman sbyor byed// des ni grogs byed rtsar ded na// srog rtsar zhugs te 'chi bar 'gyur// kha gcig khrag gtar phan ces smra//des ni rtsa la byer te 'chi// kha cig mar khus bsdud ces brjod// des kyang mkhris pa bskyed pa las// btsan dug rgyas la phan mi 'gyur// 'di 'dra'i gdams pa zab mo 'di// grang sbyor ril nag cha lag tu// dge slong dharmā kirtis (dharma kirnyis3sbyar bkra shis// / /

112 〉〉ku'abri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/tshul bzhin byas pa yi// 'bigs byed dngul chu rgyal po chen po dang // blon po gser dngul zangs lcags lhang tsher lnga lnga sogs gang 'thad re// ghan dha ka mu zi yi dmag dpon mchog/ bzang drug 'bangs la rma bya'i nor// gzi mdangs med pa'i dmag dpung gi/ kastu ra yi ma tshon cha bzung // a ru gser mdog phub tu khur// yungs dkar 'bru yi rta la bzhon// se 'bru'i khu bas 'dam 'thag bya// ril bu sran skam tshad ltar bya// bsten thabs dam tshig sngar dang 'dra// de ltar sman sna bco brgyad po// ril nag chung ngu'i sbyor ba ste// nad rnams kun la slebs pas chog/ phan yon che 'bring lta bu ste// de ltar ril nag 'bring po dang // chung ngu'i sbyor ba'i gdams pa 'di// dharmā (dharma1swā mi las brgyud pa'i// bka' lung chu bo ma nyams pa// gang gi kong sman dkon mchog rgyal mtshan drin las legs byung ba// shākya'i dge slong ming 'dzin pa// dharmā (dharmakakirti zhes bya bas// phyi rabs don du bkod pa 'di// dge bas 'gro kun nad bral nas// beeḍūrya can sangs rgyas kyi// go 'phang mchog de 'grub gyur cig/ maṅgā lam// / /

113 ༄khya//'thun byed ril nag gi zin bris yang bcud bdud rtsi'i bum pa bzhugs so// rgyal dang rgyal sras 'phags dang skyes bu'i tshogs// gnang rigs rjes sbyangs las la goms pa yi// skye 'gro'i lus sems phan bde skyed byed pa//gzhung gdams sman par bcas la gus phyag 'tshal// de las 'ongs pa'i gdams pa'i nying khu rnams// ma nyams bum pa 'dzin pa gu ṇa yon tan mgon po yi// bcud 'dzin dharmā (dharma3zur mkhar ba a bo chos rje su (swā3mi 'gyed mkhas de'i// 'gro la phan pa'i gdams pa srog gi 'thud// 'thun byed ril bu zhes bya'i sbyor ba zhig/ 'byor ldan rang gi bsod nams las grub cing // dbul 'phongs brtse bas skyongs pa'i sbyor ba 'di// kha zas ma zhu gcong nad dug gi sde// zug rngu sel byed lhag bsam blo yis bkod// rgyal po blon 'bangs gshegs shul gyi// me dang du ba ldan pa'i steng // gser mdog lcags rtsi gang mang dang // char nyung khaṇḍa de dang mtshungs// bzang drug dom mkhris bong ba dkar// tsha la so ma ra dza dang // ma zhu hong len pri yang ku// tig ta ru rta me ru rtse// gser gyi me tog sngo leb spu// khur mang utpal se 'bru dang // tsan dan dkar dmar pi pi ling // mi yi sog thal da li (lis3dang // na ga ti li ga dur dang bse ru rnams// se 'bru'i khu bas 'dam 'thag bya// kha dog beeḍūrya lta bu// thon tshe ril bu sran ma tsam// dril la skam zhing ril bcags bya// ga bur chu yi na bza' gsol// de ltar ril bu'i phan yon ni// rlung mkhris bad kan tsha grang nad// gyur pa'i nad rigs thams cad 'joms// sbyar dug

114 ༄༅khabri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/dug rigs thams cad 'joms// nad med kun gyis bsten pa na// bcud len mchog tu 'di 'gyur ro// nangs ma re re bsten pa na// rdo rje'i sku yang 'di yis 'grub/ 'di la sman sna sum cu bzhi// grangs ldan 'di la bcos lhad dang // rang bzo ma byed tshegs chung zhing // don che'i gdams pa 'di lta bu// dkon mod rgyal khams yongs la dris// e shes sman pa kun dang bsdur//thams cad dag la 'di med pas// shes ldan dgongs na mkhas khyad 'don//mi shes spob bzang mgo bo 'khor// sems can bslu ba'i rjes su ma 'brang zhig/ ces pa'i 'thun byed ril nag sbyor ba 'di// rang gi slob mar gyur pa rgyal mtshan gyis// khungs thub lung la brten pa las byung zhing // shākya'i dge slong dharma'i kirti tukirnyi1yis// phan sems blos sbyar 'gro kun dug lnga yi//nad las grol te rdzogs sangs rgyas thob shog/ maṅgā lam// //

115༄//ril nag che 'bring chung ngu'i sbas don gsal byed nam mkha'i nor bu zhes bya bzhugs so//gang zhig rdul bral khyod sku go 'byed mdog/ sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan gyi dpal 'chang zhing // longs spyod brgyad cu'i dbang chen mdangs bkra ba//thub chen sman gyi sangs rgyas khyod phyag 'tshal// lung dang rig (rigs3smra dpa' bo'i mtshan can dang // bstan pa'i gsal mdzad yon tan mgon po mchog zung 'jug don mkhas mnyam nyid badzra sogs// brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la gus pas 'dud// sngon chad bod 'dir ha cang ma grags kyang //dharmā khudmarma3su (sā3mi'i legs bshad las byung ba// grang sbyor rin chen ril bu'i gdams pa zhig 'dir spro skal ldan tshogs rnams dad pas nyon// sa bdag bcud bsdus tsha bas g.ya' 'phyi zhing // kṣa ra rnam lngas legs bkru gtso bo'i phyir// za byed khams lnga 'ching byed lcags brgyad kyis// btso zhing dgra sprad sra mkhregs ldan pa dang // gser dngul zangs lcags a bhra ka bsregs thal// lcags mdog gnyis dang badzra hi ra dang // khyung skyugs man (mekashel pad ma rā ka dang // iṇḍa skyo.ind+ra3ni la nal dang g.yu spos shel//sbug dang mu tig dung dang mu men dang // byu ru nya phyis sbal rgyab gangs kyi thigs// man rdzi (mañdzi3ra dang dkar po chig thub dang // khab len cong zhi lcags rdo mdung rtse dmar// mtshal dkar ze tsha 'gron thal bzang po drug/gla rtsi dom mkhris ma gi ta dang ni// sngo leb spu dang ha ri ta ka dang // dug med

116 ༄7khibri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/gsum dang dpa' bo dkar po dang // dpa' rgod su mi glang chen chig thub dang // las mkhan gser gyi rgyal mtshan khaṇḍa dang // gang chung g.yu rgyan ma dang be ljang dang // rtse ro mu ra sgrodha dku pa dang // mu men ga sha canapadang ko tra ba// spang rgyan dkar dang dung gi thag pa can// yungs kar cho lo dpal gang khyor ba re// sman mchog sdong po tsan dan dkar dmar dang // a ka ru nag shing gsum bar shun dang // stabs (stab1seng srad dkar mdong (mdongs3dang byi thur dang // sma ra spyi mchan spu dang ka le dza// nya sha sha chen sha tshil phya tshan gsum// sa bcud rnams ni gzhung sman brgyad cu gsum// kha skong brag khyung spru par rdo spang uta// rtag te phur ldog gser tig stong stang dang // spri shug sbyar te zhib btags pi zhus g.yo// 'dam bur btags la zhag bdun bar du 'thag/ dul tshe sran phos tsam dril grib mar skams// rab tu gnas la nyi gnam ma mthong bya// bsten thabs phan yon logs su bkod der ltos//'bring sbyor 'bigs byed gser dngul zangs dang lcags// a bhra g.yu spos byu mu mu sran bla// bong ba dkar dmar su mi dom gyi rtsi// cu gur li dzā sug ka go yungs mdongs// lcags rtsi a ru dpa' bo ser bo dang // mchin pa rnams sbyar dril thabs gong bzhin bya// chung sbyor rgyal po dang ni blon po lnga// dmag dpon ser dang 'bangs drug nor legs po// gzims (gzi3 mdangs dmag gis kastu'i mtshon cha thogs// a phub 'khur te yung gi rta la bzhon//'thag thabs grib skams gong ltar bya// zhib pa slob dpon mkhas pa'i ngag la yod// de min 'di la bya thabs zad de 'chi// 'ol tshod byas na cis kyang 'di mi 'byung // phan yon la sogs gang dgos logs su yod// 'di ni ma tshang med bsdus zhib bkod pa// kyai ma// dharmā swā mi gangs kyi ri bo las// 'ongs pa'i yan lag brgyad ldan man ngag chu// kong sman dkon rgyan 'bab stegs yid bzang por// legs bskrun de las yongs rdzogs rgyun bab ste// bdag

blo'i bum bzang yongs su gang ba'i mthus// sbyor sde mchog 'di phan bsam blo yis sbyar// dge bas 'gro kun thams cad mkhyen thob shog/ ces pa'i rin chen grang sbyor ril bu'i sbyor thabs 'di yang / gso rig gi gnas la cung zad goms par bgyis pa'i dge slong dharmā (dharma3kirtis kyikitīs1khrom stod kyi sgar du sbyar ba'o// marga lo bha wantu// dge bar gyur cig/ / /

118༄//rin chen tsha smyor gyi zin bris gcong nad bde ster zhes bya ba zur mkhar ba'i khrad chos bzhugs so//rigs rus snying rje lhag bsam rmad byung thugs bskyed chu gter las//brtson pa chen po 'bar bas drod bskyed gnas lnga'i rlabs chen g.yos// chos nyid mkha' la sku gsung thugs kyi chu 'dzin ci yang 'khrigs// brgyad khri bzhi stong chos kyi char rgyun snod ldan 'byor pa rgyas// rgyal bas lung bstan 'phags pa'i yul du rta dbyangs bod yul 'dir// smon lam dbang gis khu li ri (re3thang g.yu thog mgon zhes grags// slar yang rnam 'dren gnas lnga'i paṇa chen dharmā (dharma3swā mi zhes// dag pa rab 'byams gang na bzhugs kyang sgo gsum gus pas mchod// sngon bsags bsod nams mthu las grub pa'i lus// dal 'byor shin tu rnyed dka' rnyed pa 'di// gcong nad sde bzhis stong log 'gro mthong nas// rgyu gnyis las kyi sdug bsngal bsgral phyir du// rin chen tsha sbyor zin bris 'di na bgyi// dang po 'bigs byed btsun mo gnyis// zho re lcags snod du bzhu la// dbyer med gyur tshe rdo steng byo// dngul skam lta bur song ba de// gang du dgos par longs spyad do// gser dngul zangs lcags rnam pa bzhi// sbrang gshog dkar gong gis bcad la// snying po gnyen por ldan pa de//bzhi ka kong bur sol mes bsregs// rtags ldan chus g.yengs dor ba las//rin chen ka la'i mdog can 'grub// 'khor gyi sman rnams 'di lta ste// gu gul dkar nag so ma ra// thal rdor khro gnyer sga skya dang // drod sman hril

༄7/rin chen tsha sbyor gyi zin bris gcong nad bde ster/ 119'jong tsi tra ka/ re skon seng ldeng khan ṭa (khaṇḍakyedang // dbyi mong srub ka lce tsha ba// da lis 'gron thal bzang po drug/ sman chen a ru gla rtsi rnam sa //zhib btags lo brgyad chus sbyangs la// 'dam 'thag yun ring byas pa de//ril bu sran ma tsam du dril// lnga bdun dgu sogs rim pa bzhin// chu bskol gyis sam su ras dbul// de ltar sman sna sum cu'o// tshad ldan sbyar ba'i phan yon ni// dmu chu 'or dang skya rbab dang // mdze 'bras grum bu dkar nag khra//gag lhog gnyan rigs grang srin dang // za khu 'thengs skrangs zha 'khums las// gyur pa'i nad rigs thams cad dang // khyad par grang ba'i nad la bsngags// / /

120༄khya//kong bu'i zhal gdams 'dag spyon zur mkhar ba'i man ngag bzhugs so// gser dngul zangs lcags lhang tsher rnams// bsreg snod kong bu bzo thabs ni// kham (khams1pa bzang po cha bzhi la// bye ma zhib mo cha gcig ste//kong bu che chung skabs sbyar bzos// skam la nang du gser dngul dang //zangs lcags lhang tsher la sogs pa// lde gu byas la mi nor ba'i// rtags ldan kong bu so sor gzhug/ kha yang sa sbyor 'dis bcad la// sbyar mtshams dam sbyar phyi logs su// kam (khams3pa tsha dang rta sbangs dang // sol ba bye ma bsres pa yis// 'dag pas byugs la bskam nas ni// gzhung du bshad ltar yun ring bsreg/ 'tshig tshad dngul skam nag 'dul 'dra na legs pa'i tshad yin la/ gser dngul zangs lcags lhang tsher sogs gang yin yang 'dra/ rang gi kha dog mi 'gyur/ de la slar yang gal te rin chen ma 'tshig na// sngar gyi gnyen po rnams kyi steng // zhwa (zha3nag ldong ros ra 'o la// skyo sbyar gong ltar kong bur gzhug/ mer bzhag sbud pas drag tu bskul// des ni mi 'tshig mi srid la// 'tshig nas gzhung bzhin bkrus pa las// rin chen kha dog sngo sangs la// ljid ni sngar dang mnyam par sdod// zhes pa'i zhal gdams yig chung 'di// gzhung du ma bstan log tu gab// yun du gsang zhing sbas nas kyang // dgos dus spyod pa mkhas pa'i khyad// yin phyir dharmā kirtis (dharma kintis3sbyar// / /

121༄cu//rin chenadzeel bu 'thag thabs kyi zhal gdams bzhugs so//rin chen ril bu 'thag thabs ni/ thog mar sman rnams gang sra nas rim gyis brdungs te zhib tu song tshe dar seng zhib po la btsags te thams cad dul ba dang phyogs gcig tu skam btags nyin gcig bya/ de nas 'dam btags bya ba'i tshul ni dngul chu dul ma mu zi ser po dang mnyam du rdo gzhong drod ma yal bar snga dro gcig skam btags bya/ de nas star bu'i chus bran te snga dro gcig 'dam btags bya/ de nas de'i steng du rin po che rnams dang gser sogs lnga po blug la 'dam btags rgyang tsam bya/ de'i steng du bzang drug dang rdo rnams dang ra skyirwa3sgro spu rnams blugs la rgyang trem 'dam btags bya/ de nas sngo shing khaṇḍa 'bru bun (brun3sogs sman thams cad blugs la rgyang tsam 'dam btags bya/ de steng lcags rtsi'i a ru ra blugs la se 'bru'i khu bas bran te nyin zhag bdun gyi ring la rdo gzhong drod ma —yal bar 'dam btags bya zhing badzra bzla/ 'di'i ring la sman bla longs sku'i bsgrub pa bya zhing dgong re bzhin tshogs 'khor bya/ bshags pa la 'bad/ dam tshig gtsang ba gal che/ ril bu grib skam thon nas sman bla'i snying po ci mang gis rab gnas bya zhing / rab gnas gzhan yang tshul bzhin bya ba gnad kyi man ngag gal che ba yin no// maṅgā lam// / /

122༄༅//sman bla longs sku gtso 'khor lnga'i sgrub thabs dngos grub kyi bang mdzod bzhugs so//gang zhig lha lam sgribs bral gsal mdangs can// thun mtshams li khri'i bla gos bgos bzhin du// rmongs 'khrul log pa'i lam nas brten mkhas pa// sangs rgyas sman gyi lha la spyi bos mchod// khyod gsung dam chos bdud rtsi ro brgya pa// pa sangs slob mas ma 'thung bdud rtsi'i bcud// bcud 'chang dharmā (dharma1su (swā3mi'i mtshan nas brgyudaka brgyud pa'i bla ma mchog rnams rgyal gyur cig/ dkyil 'khor lus rdzogs g.yu thog mgon po sogs// dam chos bsil zer 'gyed pa'i mgon de kun// deng dus nub ri'i khri la gzim gyur nas// lo mang lon zhing 'di lugs gso byed kyang // de tshe dam chos a ti rdzogs pa che'i// nyams len sman dpyad zung 'brel gnas mchis kyang //da dus chu shing rul ba lta bu yi// sman pa mang po'i nyams len rgyang bsrings te//lag len 'khyog pos lus can bslus mthong nas// de dag ma bzod dang ba'i blo gros kyis// rnam dpyod spobs pa'i shing rtas myur drangs nas// bla ma longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur bsgrubs pa// yi ge'i lam du 'khod kyis shes ldan tshogs// mos blo'i spobs pa bskyed la 'di longs shig/'dir 'jug pa'i gang zag gis gnas dben par rdul len sogs kyis pad ma 'dab ma bzhi pa lte ba mu khyud dang bcas pa bris pa'i mthar mchod pa ci 'byor bshams/ dkar gtor sman dang 'bru snas brgyan pa dang / zhang

༄7/sman bla longs sku gtso 'khor lnga'i sgrub thabs dngos grub kyi bang mdzod/ 123blon sogs sman bsrung rnams la gtor ma zur gsum sha khrag gis brgyan pa bshams/ rdo rje dril bu ḍa ma ru dang nang mchod kyang nyer bzlog bya/ tshogs kyi yo byed (byad3rnams 'du byas la/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi sngon du 'gro bas/ su bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla'i gdan la rang nyid sangs rgyas sman gyi bla sku mdog bai ḍūrya ltar 'tsher ba/ mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan dpal mnga' ba/ phyag g.yas pa sa non dang g.yon mnyam bzhag mdzad pa/ chos gos gsum dang ldan pa zhabs rdo rje'i dkyil dkrungagis bzhugs pa'i mdun du pad ma 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte bar paṃ las pad ma dkar po dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba'i gdan las dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad yongs su 'dus pa'i ngo bo sangs rgyas sman gyi bla bee ḍūrya 'od kyi rgyal po sku mdog nam mkha' g.ya' dag pa lta bu utpal ltar dkyus ring ba'i spyan zur 'gro ba'i 'dul bya la phyogs bcur gzigs pa/mthon ka'i dbu sku spyi bor bcings pa'i phyed sil bur rgyab tu phyogs pa/ thor lcog tucog3gi rtse mor nor bu rin po che dang g.yas g.yon du nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor gyis spras pas 'gro ba thams cad kyi dbul phongs ('phongs1dang tsha grang gi nad las skyob pa/ rin po che sna tshogs dbur brgyan pa mi skyod pa gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs lngasu spras pa/ phyag g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgyas 'dab ma dang bcas pa'i a ru ra rnam par rgyal ba dang / g.yon mnyam bzhag gis sman gyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i lhung bzed bsnams pa/ dar dkar po dang dmar po'i stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs 'chang ba rin po ches brgyan pa/zhabs rdo rje'i dkyil mo dkrung gis bzhugs pa/ sku mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan pa/ gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu dang ldan zhing thugs ting nge 'dzin brgya phrag du ma la snyoms par bzhugs pa/ de la gso rig brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyis bskor nas bzhugs pa/ mdun gyi 'dab ma la sman gyi lha mo

124 ༄7khabri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/dkar mo phyag gnyis rin po che pi wang bsgyur ba/ g.yas su lha mo ser mo gnyis bya rgod kyi rkang gling bsgyur ba/ rgyab tu lha mo dmar mo phyag gnyis mi rkang gi gling bu 'bud pa/ g.yon du lha mo ljang gu phyag gnyis dngul dkar gyi me long 'dzin pa/ bzhi ka'ang bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod can dbu skra sil bur grol ba/ me tog dang dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ zhabs phyed dkyil gyis bcom ldan 'das la 'dud pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa/ mu khyud la sman gyi srung ma zhang blon chen po dang / drang srong lha klu gza' skar rgyal po btsan bdud gang gis tshogs til gyi gang bu ltar gang ba rnams gtso bo'i phyogs su thal mo sbyar te 'khod pa/ dbus kyi gtso 'khor lnga'i gnas gsum dang dred kyi yi ge gsum dang dred byed rnams kyi snying gar rang rang sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas ye shes pa rang bzhin chos kyi dbyings nas spyan drangs te rang gi dam tshig pa dang dbyer med du gyur/ 'jig rten pa rnams kyang phyogs thams cad nas gus te so so'i rten la thims par gyur/ dza hūṃ bam sdod/ sa ma dzaḥtaṣṭha ldan/ bde chen dbus kyi bcom ldan 'das la mi skyod pa dang lha mo bzhi la sangs rgyas sman gyi bla re res dbu brgyan/ 'jig rten pa thams cad la rdo rje rtse dgu pa re res sa btab par mos te/ rma sarba ta thā ga ta oṃ rgyu sra ti tstsha swā hā/ de bzhin/ sa rgyam puṣpe rdu rde sa oke gadhe nee wi rgya shasta zhes sbyar bas mchod/ gtor ma bsang sbyangs/ a ka ro gsum gyis byin gyis rlobs la rtsa sngags mjug tu e dam ba liddha kha kha khyi khyi gsum/gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po 'di sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sman gyi bla bee ḍūrya 'od kyi rgyal po 'khor rigs bzhi'i lha mo sman gyi bsrung ma mched bzhi dang bcas pa ma lus pa la 'bul/ bzhes nas bdag dang sems can thams cad gnas skabs su rlung mkhris bad kan 'dus pa'i nad tsha grang gi zug rngu thams cad zhi ba dang mthar thug sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che

༄7/sman bla longs sku gtso 'khor lnga'i sgrub thabs dngos grub kyi bang mdzod/ 125thob par mdzad du gsol/ zhes dang 'jig rten pa rnams la oṃ lo ka pā la sa pa ri wa ra i dam ba lidhwa kha kha khyi khyi/ gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho 'di zhang blon chen po drang srong lha klu gza' skar rgyal po bdud btsan ging shan (bshan1pho nya bka' sdod dregs pa'i tshogs bsrung ma 'khor dang bcas pa gtor ma 'dis tshim zhing dgyes par bzhes la/ ru nga dang phrag dog ko long gdug sems zhi ste zhi ba dul ba byang chub kyi sems dang ldan pas bdag gi gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi bar chad dang mi mthun pa'i phyogs ris ngan pa thams cad zhi bar mdzod cig legs pa brgyad dang sprod cig nyes pa stong dang byol nas bsam pa'i don bsgrub/ bdag gi tshe dang bsod nams snyan grags mnga' thang longs spyod dpal dang 'byor ba thams cad zla ba yar gyi ngo'am dbyar dus kyi mtsho ltar yar gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzod/ ces brjod/de nas bstod pa ni/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas 'di skad do// chos dbyings rnam dag 'dus ma byas yin yang // sprul pa'i cho 'phrul snang brnyan sman gyi bla// dus gsum bde gshegs kun gyi ngo bo nyid// bee ḍūrya yi 'od la phyag 'tshal lo// sku mdog sngon po nam mkha' sgrib bral ltar// mtshan dpe'i dpal 'bar dar dang rin chen brgyan// skra mchog bung ba phyed bcing rgyab tu grol// phyag gnyis mchog sbyin mnyam bzhag mdzad phyag 'tshal// khyod gsung mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo yis// dbyangs kyi nga ro drug cu'i bye brag las// drang nges chos kun lhug par rab bstan nas// 'gro ba'i zug sel skyabs mchog la phyag 'tshal// thugs kyi gsang ba dpag yas zab gsal che// rgya mtsho che ltar jigating mtha' rnyogs pa med// mi zad ting 'dzin du ma dbang bsgyur pa'i//nges don ston mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// khyod gsung dam chos bdud rtsi'i rgyun bzang pos// gang gi blo gros bum pa legs bkang nas// thar 'dod

126 ༄7khabri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/yongs la legs lam ston mdzad pa// brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod// phyogs bzhi rigs bzhi'i sman bsrung lha mo bzhi// dkar ser dmar ljang rin chen dar gyis mdzes// rang rang rtags kyi phyag mtshan dang bcas te// gtso la 'dud tshul bzhugs la phyal (phyag3'tshal bstod// phyi rol nang blon drang srong gza' skar dang // lha klu rgyal btsan ging bdud dregs byed tshogs// bcom ldan 'das la 'dud tshul thal sbyor gzhug/ sman gyi bsrung ma dregs byed tshogs la bstod// ces bstod/bzlas pa bya ba ni/ rang gi thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su/hūṃ gi mthar rtsa sngags kyis bskor ba/ mdun bskyed kyis bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs tsitta dmar po pad ma rā ga'i mdog lta bur zur drug po de dag 'od zer re re'i sna la thub pa drug 'phros pas/ 'gro ba rigs drug gi zug ju ma rig pa'i tshogs sel ba de'i dbus rtsa ti la ka shel gyi sbu gu can shel dkar gyi ka ba btsugs pa lta bu la 'od zer brgya phrag du ma 'phros pas zhi ba dang khro bo dam pa rigs brgya 'phros pa de'i rtsa sbubs su pad ma dang zla ba'i gdan la rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa bsgrengs thabs su gnas pa'i yar gyi rwa lnga la rigs lnga yab yum mnyam sbyor du bzhugs shing / mar gyi rwa lnga la khrag 'thung rigs lnga yab yum 'khril skyo'akhrig3sbyor du bzhugs pa/ rdo rje'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su hūṃ sngon po bai ḍūrya lta bu'i mthar rtsa sngags kyis bskor bar 'gyur pa dang / lha mo bzhi'i thugs kar zla ba'i gdan re re'i dbus su mdun nas g.yas skor du ha ri ni sa dang / 'jig rten pa rnams kyi snying gar rang rang gi sa bon gyi mtshan par gyur par dmigs te/ rma na mo bha ga wa te lha ṣa dzño gu ru bee ḍūrya pra bha rā dzā ya/ ta tha (thā3ga ta tuyā1ya/ a ra ha ste samyaklam budha (buddhā3ya/ ta rya thā/ oṃ lha ṣa byo lha ṣa dzño ma hā lha ṣa byo/ bhi ṣa byo rā dzā ya sa murga te ha ri ni sa ma hā sarba sidhi pha la ho/ zhes ci mang bzlas par bya'o//

༄7/sman bla longs sku gtso 'khor lnga'i sgrub thabs dngos grub kyi bang mdzod/ 127skabs skabs su bzlas pas skyo na/ brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ dpag yas bsod nams tshogs gnyis las 'khrungs shing //mtshan dpe'i dpal 'bar bee ḍūrya yi mdog/ mchod jimachog3sbyin mnyam bzhag phyag rgyas 'gro la skyobs// sangs rgyas sman gyi lha la gsol ba 'debs//des gsung chos kun sdud dang zhu ba dang // legs par ston sogs chos kyi mdzod 'dzin pa// yid las skyes dang rig pa'i ye shes mtshan// drang srong rnam gnyis zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// rgyun shes nabs so skyes dang thang lha 'bar// rkang gnyis skyobs dang 'gro skyongs me bzhin 'jug/ lugs lag rgya skegs sna dang zla ba'i mchog/ lan tshwa'i mchog gi zhabs la gsol ba 'debs//dpal ldan 'phreng ba dpal ldan phun tshogs dang // bshol 'gro skyes dang nyi ma'i snying po dang // zla ba'i 'od zer dge slong kun dga' bo// 'tsho byed gzhon nu'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// klu sgrub snying po dpal ldan dga' ba'i mtshan// zla ba mngon dga' bee ro tsa na dang // khri srong lde'u btsan grwa pa mngon shes can// dbus pa dar grags zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// klu sgrub snying po dpal ldan dga' ba'i mtshan// dge slong dkon skyabs g.yu thog yon tan mgon// ye shes zung dang 'bo se kun tu dga'// 'dzam gling mgon dang dwags po tsaṇḍa pa// 'tsho mdzad rgyal po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// tshwa lung pa dang g.yu thog mgon po dang // ban mo ga ga gzhon nu ye shes zhabs// be sras brang ti 'jam dpal rgyal mtshan dang // g.yu thog nyi ma'i mgon la gsol ba 'debs// gzi brjid 'bum dang rdza ston bum pa dang // zhang ston zhig po lha rje dge ba 'bum// sman mo che dang ratna'i mtshan can dang // brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs// g.yu thog mgon khyod slar yang byang phyogs 'dir// dge slong tshul bzung thos bsam sgron me sbyar// 'gro ba kun gyi skyabs gcig thugs rje can// mnyam nyid rdo rje'i

128 ༄7//'bri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// khyod gsung chos mdzod 'dzin pa'i thugs sras bzhin// de las 'ongs pa'i slob rgyud bende'i 'phreng // ma chad ma nyams legs ston gser gyi zam// brgyud 'dzin sman pa'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo//lha mo mched bzhi nor sbyin zhang blon sogs// gso rig rgyud dang sman gyi bsrung ma'i tshogs// ye shes 'jig rten tshul 'dzin sprul 'khor bcas//bka' bsrung dregs byed tshogs la gsol ba 'debs// de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i byin rlabs kyis// bdag gi skye ba tshe rabs thams cad du// gso dpyad rig pa'i gnas la mkhas pa dang // drang srong brgyud pa zin par byin gyis rlobs// nad pas sman pa thos sam mthong ba'i tshe// sman gyi nags su slebs pa ji bzhin du// rlung mkhris bad kan 'dus pa tsha grang nad// rang rang shugs kyis grol bar byin gyis rlobs// sman pas nad par brtag dpyad byas pa'i tshe// drang srong 'khor bcas thugs rje'i cho 'phrul gyis// mngon shes gzhan rig me long 'phyis pa bzhin// nad kyi mtshan nyid mthong bar byin gyis rlobs// sman pas kha dmar gdags tshe g.yu 'brug gi/ skad la rma bya spro ltar nad pa bde// sman gyi dri la sbrul gyi ma ki (gi3ta'i// dri la bros ltar nad kyi grong khyer tshogs// skad cig nyid la 'joms par byin gyis rlobs// tsha bsil sbyor ba bsil drod rtar bskyon nas// nad pa'i ljags kyi dbang po dang 'phrad tshe// ro drug nus brgyad yon tan stobs 'phel te// nad kyi dgra dpung gzhom par byin gyis rlobs// mgul mgrin pho bar slebs tshe pho drod kyis// zhu rjes mngar skyur tsha ba'i tshul byung bas// rlung mkhris bad kan 'phel zad 'khrugs la sogs// nad kyi g.yul ngo bzlog par byin gyis rlobs//sman rnams zhu rjes nad rjes gcod pa dang // lus zungs stobs 'phel tshe yi bar chad zhi// bsam pa'i don kun chos bzhin 'grub pa dang // 'jigs med rdo rje'i lus mchog thob gyur cig/ sems can thams cad ngan song

༄7/sman bla longs sku gtso 'khor lnga'i sgrub thabs dngos grub kyi bang mdzod/ 129gsum sogs kyi// sdug bsngal me rlabs zhi nas chos 'grub ste// thos bsam bsgom pa'i bya ba la sbyangs nas// sman pa'i rgyal po'i go 'phang thob gyur te//sangs rgyas sman gyi bla ma'i thugs rje dang // drang srong rig pa'i lha dbang mthu rtsal dang // chos dbyings rnam par dag pa'i bden tshig gis// smon lam myur du 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ ces gsol ba 'debs smon lam bya/bzlas pa la 'bad do//de nas tshogs kyi yo byad de rnams bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las thod pa'i sgye so gsum gyi steng du ka pa la phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du hūṃ oṃ tram̐ i khaṃ las dri chen dri chu rakta byang sems klad pa rnams sa bon gyis mtshan pa'i steng du hūṃ lī māṃ ṭwāṃ tī la mi dang ba glang khyi dang glang po che dang mdzo ra rnams kyi sha rang rang gi sa bon gyi mtshan pa zla ba'i kha chod yi ge gsum gyis rgyan (brgyan3btab pa rlung g.yos me spar thod pa dros rdzas 'khol ba'i rlangs pa yi ge gsum la phog de las 'phros phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs rje'i 'od zer rnam par bsdus pa'i yi ge gsum la thim zhing zla ba'i kha cod yi ge gsum dang bcas pa 'od du zhu rdzas so so sa bon dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ho ho hrīḥzhes lan gsum brjod/ tshogs phud gtor ma gnyis la bran/ hūṃ/ hūṃ/ chos dbyings rnam dag bden don pho brang nas// sman bla longs spyod rdzogs sku gshegs su gsol// sman zhal bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po yi// ga na (ṇa3tsa kra'i longs spyod mchod 'bul gyis// bzhes nas dbang dang dngos grub bstsal du gsol// sman zhal sogs rkang pa 'og mar rigs 'gre la/ ka dag 'gyur med lhun grub pho brang nas// yid skyes rig pa'i ye shes gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// sman zhal bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po yi// ga ṇa tsa kra'i longs spyod mchod 'bul gyis// bzhes nas

130 〉〉/khabri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/dbang dang dngos grub stsal du gsol// bden don mi 'gyur 'og min gzhal yas nas// rgyun shes la sogs rtsa brgyud bla ma la// sman zhal bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po yi// ga ṇa rtsa khutsa3kra'i longs spyod mchod 'bul gyis// bzhes nas dbang dang dngos grub bstsal du gsol// bden gnyis mtha' bral zung 'jug khang bzang nas// mkhas grub g.yu thog yon tan mgon po la// sman zhal bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po yi// ga ṇa tsa kra'i longs spyod mchod 'bul gyis// bzhes nas dbang dang dngos grub bstsal du gsol// klong chen rig pa rang grol pho brang nas// rdzogs chen rnal 'byor mnyam nyid badzra la// sman zhal bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po yi// ga ṇa tsa kra'i longs spyod mchod 'bul gyis// bzhes nas dbang dang dngos grub bstsal du gsol// gar bzhugs lta na sdug gi grong khyer nas// sman bsrung rigs bzhi'i lha mo mched bzhi la//sman zhal bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po yi// ga na (ṇa3tsa kra'i longs spyod mchod 'bul gyis// bzhes nas dbang dang dngos grub bstsal du gsol// phyogs bcu'i nam mkha' yangs pa'i dkyil 'khor nas// zhang blon la sogs dregs byed 'khor bcas la// sman zhal bdud tsi'i rgya mtsho chen po yi// ga ṇa tsa kra'i longs spyod mchod 'bul gyis// bzhes nas dbang dang dngos grub bstsal du gsol// zhes dang bskang ba ni/ hūṃ/ sman gyi grong khyer gzhal yas chen po 'dir// phyi nang mchod sprin rgya mtshor bskyil ba dang // ye shes tshogs kyi 'khor lo dpag med kyis// budha (burnya3bde bar gshegs pa'i thugs dam dang // sman phud rin chen dar dang ja khur dang // kun tu bzang po mchod pa'i bye brag gis// brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi thugs dam dang // tsha grang nad sel bzang drug sman la sogs// ro nus ldan pa'i sman sna mang po dang //dbang po sna lnga rin chen zas nor gyis// sman bsrung lha mo mchod bzhes thugs dam dang // sha khrag rus pa nang khrol rnam pa lnga// don snying klad pa

༄7/sman bla longs spu gtso 'khor lnga'i sgrub thabs dngos grub kyi bang mdzod/ 131rkang dang khu ba dang // ba lang sha khrag rgyan ldan gtor chen gyis// zhang blon la sogs dregs tshogs thugs dam dang // bskangs gyur dngos grub dam pa dus 'dir stsol// bshags pa bya ba ni/ bdag cag ma rig du ma'i dbang gyur pas// sku gsung thugs dang rtsa ba slob dpon gyi// dam tshig nyams shing dus su ma bshags pa// 'gal 'khrul log par gyur pa ci mchis pa rtsa 'grel rgyud gzhung ma thos ma bkang dang // dam ldan bla ma ma bsten kun chos dang // mkhas grub slob dpon ma bsten rang bzo 'gyur// man ngag lag len 'phyugs shing nor ba dang // rgyal ba'i dgongs pa ma rtog 'khrul par spyad// de sogs bka' 'grel gzhung dang ci 'gal ba// chos bdag sangs rgyas drung du tho tumatholakalo bshags// mkhyen ldan khyod kyis ci yang bzod par rigs// rlung mkhris bad kan 'dus pa tsha grang nad// rang rang gnyen po'i sman rnams nor ba dang // ro nus zhu rjes log par rtogs pa dang // kha cig sbyor sdebs chad lhag 'khrul ba dang // rang gis phan sems mos blo cher bskyed nas// nad kyi gnyen por sman rnams legs byin yang // sngon las dbang gis de dag srog dor tshe// bdag la blo gtad byas kyang ma skyobs pa'i//nyes sdig rmongs pa'i 'khrul pa ci mchis dang // sman 'ga'i ngo bo ma rtogs nor ba sogs// 'khrul bcas nong (nongs3 pa bdag gi mchis pa kun//sman bsrung lha mo bzhi la tho (mthol3 lo ba༅/gas// bzod par bzhes la dngos grub bstsal du gsol// gdam pa'i man ngag zab khyad ldan pa 'ga'//chig rgyud yin yang de las 'gal ba dang // dam med 'ga' la man ngag bstan pa dang // chom rkun zog po dam log 'ga' zhig la// man ngag sbas kyang 'ga' zhig shor srid cing // thabs kyis brku dang gzhog slong byed pa dang // slob dpon gsang shing rang che 'byin pa dang // don med khyad gsod byed pa'i bdud sprul 'ga'// slob mar brdzus la gdams pa bstan pa sogs//

132 ༄༅khabri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/rang blo 'khrul pa tshad mar bzung byas pa'i// zhang blon dregs byed tshogs dang 'gal ba kun// mthol shing bshags so bzod par bzhes nas kyang //bdag gi bar chad phyogs kun zhi ba dang // bsam don chos bzhin 'grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod// ces dang yi ge brgya pa 'don/de nas tshogs la ci dgar longs spyod pa'i lhag ma bsdus la bran te/ oṃ a ka ro gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs la/ bde gshegs chos srung zhang blon dregs pa'i tshogs// pho nya 'bum phrag khro bo bran g.yog dang // bka' sdod sde brgyad 'byung po lhag ma'i bdag/ ma lus 'khor bcas 'dir gshegs gtor ma longs// bcol ba'i las grub chos kyi bya ra mdzod// bar chad rkyen dang mtha' yi dmag dpung bzlog/ 'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis 'grub par mdzod// ces lhag ma gtsang par 'bul lo//de nas thugs dam bskul ba ni/ hūṃ/ rang bzhin dag pa chos dbyings pho brang nas// budha tuburnya1rigs kyi sangs rgyas thugs dam bskul// phyogs bzhi pad ma 'dab bzhi'i gdan steng nas// sman srung lha mo mched bzhis nam mkha' stong la dbang bsgyur pho brang nas/ zhang blon dregs byed tshogs kyi mchod sbyin gtor ma dgyes bzhin gsol nas kyang / bdag gi las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod/ ces bskul/ chad mdo ni/ bhyo/ sngon tshe gnas mchog sman gyi nags tshal du// ston pa sangs rgyas sman gyi bla chen pos// gso rig rgyud rgyal mang du gsungs pa'i tshe// zhang blon la sogs dregs byed 'khor bcas kyis// rang rang mthu rtsal che bar bstan nas kyang // khas blangs dam bcas ji bzhin de dgongs la// 'dir gshegs dam chos bdud rtsi'i gtor ma longs// rnal 'byor bcol ba'i 'phrin las 'grub par mdzod// de 'og bar gyi bskal pa'i dbu ma la// chos rgyal chen po khri srong lde'u btsan gyis//bod 'dir gso rig rgyas par mdzad pa'i tshe// dregs pa sde brgyad mthu rtsal

༄7/sman bla longs sku gtso 'khor lnga'i sgrub thabs dngos grub kyi bang mdzod/ 133ldan rnams kyis// rang rang mthu rtsal che bar bstan nas kyang // khas blangs dam bcasatshoji bzhin de dgongs la// 'dir gshegs dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i gtor ma bzhes// rnal 'byor bcol ba'i 'phrin las 'grub par mdzod// de 'og da lta bskal pa'i tha ma la// bdag sogs gso rig brgyud pa 'dzin rnams kyis// bka' 'grel man ngag nyams su blangs pa'i tshe// sman bsrungs lha mo dregs byed tshogs rnams kyis// rang rang mthu rtsal che bar bstan nas kyang // khas blangs dam bcas ji bzhin de 'gongs (dgongs3la// 'dir gshegs dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i gtor ma longs// rnal 'byor bcol ba'i 'phrin las 'grub par mdzod//de nas brtan ma brkyangs pa ni/ gong gi dmar gtor phyir brdegs la chab bran la/ bhyo/ sman gyi bsrung ma lha mo mched bzhi dang // zhang blon chen mo rdo rje bdud 'dul dang // lha klu btsan bdud ging bshan gza' skar tshogs// bstan ma bcu gnyis yang skyongs 'khor bcas pa// 'dir byon sngon gyi dam tshig nyer dgongs te// sha khrag rgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la//bar chad rkyen dang mi mthun gnod pa'i tshogs// mtha' yi dmag dpung g.yul ngo bzlog pa dang // bsam don 'bad med chos bzhin 'grub par mdzod// ces gtor ma gtsang bar 'bul lo//de nas oṃ sarba ta tha ga ta arghaṃ pra ti tstsha swā hā yis mchod la/ sman gyi bla ma'i thugs rje'i gter// sman bsrung rigs kyi lha mo bzhi// zhang blon la sogs dregs pa'i tshogs// 'khor dang bcas par bstod par bgyi// bdag gi legs byas dge ba 'dis mtshon te// nad rigs mi mthun phyogs kun rab zhi ste// bsam pa'i don kun 'bad med 'grub pa dang // gtso bo khyod bzhin byang chub reg gyur cig/ ces bstod cing smon lam btab bo// oṃ khyod kyis tsho sems can don kun mdzod// rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub bstsol lo//

134 ༄7/khabri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang // slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol// oṃ badzra muḥye shes pa rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang nyid la thim zhing / 'jig rten pa rnams kyang rang rang gi gnas su gshegs gyur par mos te/ bkra shis dang smon lam rgyas bsdus skabs dang sbyar bar bya'o//'dir smras pa/ blo gros lang tsho dar ba'i bshes 'chang ma// rnam dag thos pa mchog gi rgyan gyis mdzes// rnam dpyod shes rab mchog gis lta byed mkhan// gdung sel ston pa mchog khyod dgyes phyir 'bul// sngon chad bod 'dir grags par ma gyur pa'i// rig gnas gsar bu ba zhig 'di min phyir//shes ldan kun gyi dgongs brgyan 'di las med// de dus gso mdzad sman pa phal cher gyis// rnam grangs lag len long ba'i kha zas bzhin// rang nyid 'tsho tsam de las gzhan pa yi// gdung sel byang chub bsgrub pa'i thabs 'di kun// long bas g.yang sar lam sna byas srid na// rang phung gzhan la mi phan de dang mtshungs// de phyir sman dpyad bla bsgrub mchog 'di ni// kho bos go slar phye ba 'di yin no// bdag gis gso dpyad slob dpon ma bsten zhing //lag len dag kyang mkhas par ma sbyangs kyang // yan lag brgyad dang rgyud bzhi la sogs pa// cung zad bltas pa'i don 'ga' khong du chud// sngon dus smon lam bzang pos mthu btsan pas// sbyor ba chen po 'ga' zhig dpyis phyin rtogs// de phyir lhag bsam dag pas 'di bskrun no// sman bla longs sku'i bsgrub thabs 'di// rin chen ril nag rab gnas kyi// dus su bsgrub pa 'di byas na/ nga chog/ ril nag che chung gang byed kyang // sbyor tsha bsgrub pa 'di bya zhing // tshogs 'khor rtag tu gtong ba gces// mkhas pa kun gyi mgul rgyan 'di// shes ldan rnams kyi thugs la zhog/ ces pa bla ma longs sku'i bsgrubs thabs 'di yang rin chen grangs sbyor ril nag che 'bring chung
