༄7/rin chen ril bu gtong tshul gyi zin bris zur mkhar ba'i khyad chos/ 137'joms pa'i bdud rtsi yin// mda' dug rin chen khar bzung 'jib// lo brgyad chur gdus khu ba btung // tshabs chen bzhi mnyam khong du gtang // na tshod sbyar ba'i rta pho bskyon// sha dug rin chen chang gis dbul// tshabs chen lan tshwa gdus khus dbul// yang na nyung skam gdus khus dbul// 'chi bdag gre 'gags 'joms par byed// sgong dug rin chen sram shas dbul//yang na mthing shun khu bas dbul// sgong dug glo skam gyur pa sel// spu dug rin chen khrag dron dbul// yang na dom gyi tshil bus dbul// rtsar bab rmar gyur sel bar byed// g.ya' dug tsha la btul ma dang // mu zi gser 'dra'i khu bas dbul// yang na zwa dkar khu bas dbul// sdud dang gsod pa'i gdams pa yin// dug gis shi ba'i mchin dug la// rin chen nya bam za khus dbul// de rjes nad lhag bshal gyis ded// gyur pa'i dug la rin chen ni//gang gnod zas kyi khu bas dbul// gzhan yang rgyu dang mi rgyu ba'i// dug rigs gang dang gang yin yang // rgyud nas bshad pa'i sman rnams dang //rin chen bsdebs pas ma lus 'joms// de bzhin tsha ba'i nad la bsil//grang ba'i nad la drod du 'gyur// bsil sman bsdebs pas tshad nad 'joms//drod sman dang sdebs grang nad sel// drod bcud dang sdebs rlung nad gso//sbyor ba gang dang bsdeb gyur kyang // de yi nus pa brgya 'gyur skye// gsum pa 'di yi phan yon phyi rgyud las// thang phye ril bu lde gu sman mar sogs// yang yang bsten pas sman 'dred nad ma thon// zhi byed kun gyi log gnon rin po che// khrag mkhris bad rlung bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad// mgo dang byang khog yan lag rma rnams dang // dmu 'or mdze 'bras gag lhog gnyan nad dang // klu gnyan rgyal po la sogs 'byung po'i gdon// rin po che yis mi sel gang yang med// nad gzhi med pa'i mi la bcud len 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa dang man ngag tu// khu byug byung na chu skyar 'ong // bshal skyug byung na rang rtags

138 ༄7//'bri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/bstan// rkun ma byung na blon po sgrogs// de gsum byung na so pa bskyar//zhes dang gzhan yang ji skad du// rin chen khong par yod dus sbyor ngan dug/me yod du ba lta bur gla rtsi'i sgrogs// nang du srog 'tsho yod pas bshal skyugs byed// des na sbyor ngan dpung gis ga la tshugs// zas skom bza' btung gang la dug yod na// khong slebs 'phral du gla rtsi'i sgrogs pa dang // de ma thag tu 'khru skyugs 'byung bas na// myur du rin chen gtong ba gal che zhing //de yis sbyor ngan dug gi dpung tshogs la// ba mor nyi shar ji bzhin nges par 'joms// zhes gsungs rin chen la sbyar dbyig gi dug/ srog chags la sbyar sha yi dug/ 'dab chags la sbyar sgong tusgo3nga'i dug/ rdzas kyi sbyor ba man ngag dug/ mkhris pa la sbyar rtsi yi dug/ gyur pa la sogs mi 'phrod dug/ khyi dug la sogs rgyu ba'i dug/ btsan dug la sogs mi rgyu'i dug/ dug rigs kun la slebs chog yin// bad rlung las gyur grang ba'i nad// khrag mkhris las gyur tsha ba'i nad// phyi rkyen las gyur glo bur nad// gza' klu la sogs 'byung po'i gdon// 'bras sogs lhan skyes rma rnams te// stong dang nyis brgya'i nad rnams sel// lus stobs lang tsho'i tshad dang bstun// sman rta rang rang gnyen pos shes// gzhan yang yon tan brjod mi langs(lang3/ /rgas pa'i tshe bsrings dar la 'jog/ gzhon nu'i stobs bskyed bcud len 'gyur// dbang dang lo brgya thub par gsungs// des na bcud len sman gyi mchog/ o rgyan pa dang chos kyi rje// dam pa rnams las rim par brgyud//rgyun ma chad pa'i rin chen phab// da lta bdag gi bar du brgyud// de yi sbyor ba tshul bzhin sbyar// sman sna bcu phrag bcu dang gsum// dgos 'dod 'byung ba nor bu'i grangs// kun la med pa'i khyad nor yin// kha tsho mang la dgos pa ci// bden brdzun nyams su longs dang gsal// sbyor ba 'di yis 'gro ba'i nad// yongs grub la sogs rgyun bcom nas// gzhan dbang nad

༄khya/rin chen ril bu gtong tshul gyi zin bris zur mkhar ba'i khyad chos/ 139las thar gyur te// mtshan dpes spras pa'i sku thob shog/ rin chen lus la yod dus ni// me nyis gdungs pa'i rngul ches dang // lan tshwa ches pa'i zas skom dang // zwa tshod star bu chu rkang dang // chu skyur chang skyur kham bu dang //ku shu zho dar ras pa dang // mtshur sogs skyur ches bza' btung 'dzem//gdon can grib can chags spyod spangs// dam tshig 'di rnams las 'das te//rin chen log te sbos pa dang // mgo na skyug long ldang ba dang // sram brun mar dkar sbyar byas la// mgo dang lto bar sku mnye bya// me nyis bsro zhing yang yang bskyar// des ni de dag zhi bar 'gyur// 'di yang dharmā kirtis (dharma kitīsakaso// / /

140༄7//gso ba rig pa'i gzhung lugs chen po dpal ldan rgyud bzhi'i dka' gnad dogs sel gyi zin bris/oṃ su ste sidhi/mkhyen ldan nyin byed 'od brgya'i snang ba yis//gang blo'i ma rig mun sel dpal ster ba'i//mngon mtho'i mgon zhabs spyi bos blangs nas ni//legs bshad brjed byang zin bris 'di na bris//de yang bdag cag gi slob dpon mtshan nas smos pa dkon mchog 'gro phanadabang po zhes bya bas gso ba rig pa'i rgyud bzhi'i lung thar (mthar3chags dka' gnad la dogs sel gyi go don bshad sbyar dang bcas te gnang ba'i gnad 'gag rags rim gyi brjed tho'i zin bris bkod pa la/ thog mar gang dag thar pa dang mthar thug thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob par 'dod pa'i blo dang ldan pa dag gis ni 'khor ba'i bya ba snying po med pa la zhen pa spang nas shes bya rig pa'i gnas lnga la bslab par bya dgos te mdo sde'i rgyan las/ rig pa'i gnas lnga dag la mkhas par ma byas na// 'phags mchog gis kyang thams cad mkhyen nyid mi 'gyur te// de bas gzhan dag tshar bcad rjes su bzang (gzung3phyir dang / bdag nyid kun shes bya phyir de la de brtson bya// zhes gsungs pa ltar gsung rab dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa'i tshig don gnyis ka la 'khrul ba spong ba gtan tshigs rig pa'i bstan

༄/dpal ldan rgyud bzhi'i dka' gnadadogasaselagyizinabris /da wa141bcos dag gis gzhan gyi rgol ba ngan pa rnams tshar bcad cing / sa/ser 'gyur dang sku gzugs la sogs pa'i bzo rig pa dang / nad 'i ba la sogs pa'i thabs ston pa gso ba rig pa'i bstan bcos dag gis gdul byar gyur pa rnams rjes su bzung ste/ zab pa dang rgya che ba ston pa nang rig pa'i bstan bcos rnams la brten nas bdag nyid kyis yang dag pa'i don kun shes par bya ba'i ched du bslab pa dang / de bzhin du rig pa'i gnas chung ba lngar grags pa mngon brjod shes na ming la mi rmongs pa dang / sdebs sbyor shes na tshigs bcad la mi rmongs pa dang / tshigs khutshig3rgyan shes na snyan ngag la mi rmongs pa dang / zlos gar shes na skad rigs la mi rmongs pa dang / rtsis shes na bya ba'i 'jug ldog la mi rmongs pa rnams kyang bslab par bya ba'i gnas yin te/ spyod 'jug las/ rgyal sras rnams kyis mi slob pa'i// dngos de gang yang yod ma yin// de ltar gnas pa'i mkhas pa la// bsod nams mi 'gyur gang yang med// ces gsungs pa ltar ro// de ltar rig pa'i gnas che ba lnga/chung ba lnga dang bcas pa'i bcu phrag gcig las/ 'dir gso ba rig pa'i gzhung lugs chen mo dpal ldan rgyud bzhi thugs nyams su bzhes nas sems can gyi don bya'o snyam pa'i thugs bskyed rnam par dag pa dang bcas te gsan par zhu/dang po/ rtsa rgyud kyi dka' gnad dogs sel/de yang chos kyi rje zur mkhar ba legs bshad 'tshol gyis/ dang po sman gyi cha byad sman dpyad kyi rgyud bzhi 'di phyi ltar du bkar 'chad/ de la bka'i 'chad lugs phun sum tshogs pa lnga ldan/ 'di skad bdag gis thos pa'i dus gcig na/ zhes sbyar ba mkhas pa rnams la grags pa bzhin du 'chad shes

— 142 ༄7//'bri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/dgos te/ nang ltar bstan bcos yin pa dang khyad par g.yu thog pas mdzad pa yin na de ga'i dgongs gzhi dgos pa dngos shugs la gnod byed gsum dang bral ba mkhas pas mthong na ngo tsha mi dgos pa shes pa zhig dgos gsungs mod/ tshul 'di blo dman bdag lta bus bgyi ba'i gnas ma yin zhing / rang re bklag lung dka' ba'i gnad 'ga' zhig la go don gyi dogs sel dang bcas pa tsam zhig byed pa la spros pa cher mi dgos pa 'dus/ 'dir mtshan don tsam zhig zhu ba'i dbang du bgyis na/ rgya gar zhes pa ni 'ga' zhig bod kyi ri spos rgya lta bur yod pa las rgya gar gyi ri la gar ba'i tshul du yod pas de skad ces bya'o zhes btags pa'i ming du 'dod kyang / 'grel pa mes po'i zhal lung las/ 'phags pa'i yul gyi dngos ming 'dod rgyal gyi sgra yin la zhes gsungs/ bstan bcos chen po 'di'i mtshan a mṛ ta hri da ya aṅgā aṣā gu hu u pa de sha tant+ra nā ma zhes 'byung la/ 'di nyid rang cag kha ba can pa'i yul gyi ming la/ bod ces bya ba'i rgyu mtshan yang / spre'u dang brag srin gnyis las mched/ de rim gyis 'phel zhing dar pa las bod mi'u gdung drug ces grags pa dang / lha las phul byung gi 'grel bar bdag cag gi ston pa las rgyal rabs bcu gnyis kyi snga ba shākya'i rgyal po shing rta bcu pa zhes skya seng bu lnga dang dgra ngan dpung tshogs bcu gnyis g.yul bkye (bkyesakapa las srog chags khri phrag mang po shi bas yid byung ste rgyal po pa ti zhes bya ba dmag stong dang bcas te bud med kyi chas su zhugs nas ri kha ba can gyi nags gseb tu bros te gnas pa'i rigs la deng sang na yang bod ces grags so zhes mkhas pa phal cher mthun par rten la brten pa'i ming btags pa ste btags ming du bzhed la/ yang pad dkar chos 'byung du dus kyi thog mar byung ba yin pa dang /rdzogs ldan dus gsungs pa'i bde mchog gi rgyud du bod ces yul nyer bzhi'i ya gyal du bgrang pa da lta'i tsa ri ṭa yin pa'i ming spyi la'ang de ltar du grags pa

༄7/dpal ldan rgyud bzhi'i dka' gnad dogs sel gyi zin bris/ 143dang / mes po'i zhal lung du dngos ming 'dod rgyal gyi sgra yin zhes gsungs/gang ltar na'ang yul 'di'i skad du bsgyur na/ bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud ces bya ba zhes so//de yang bshad pa ni/ mṛ ta 'chi ba'i gong du dgag pa'i a thung bzhag pa'i tshig sgyur la 'chi med ces grub la/ de ni bdud rtsi'i don yin te/bdud rtsi zas su byed pa rnams la 'chi ba med ces 'chi med mdzod rtsa 'grel sogs legs sbyar gyi gzhung rnams las 'byung ba ltar don bsgyur gyi dbang du mdzad nas bdud rtsi zhes bsgyur la hri da ya ni hri nya dkrog pa'i khams las byung ba ste/ 'o ma las mar lta bur bsdus pa'i don gyis na/ ga/so ba rig pa bdud rtsi dang mtshungs pa rnams kyi yang snying po lta bur gyur pas na/ bdud rtsi snying po ste/ dpe'i sgo nas btags pa dang / aṅgā ni yan lag ste/ grangs du yod ce na/ aṣṭa ste brgyad yod ces pa'i don yin la/ gso bya'i yul lus la sogs pa yan lag brgyad yod pa bzhin du gso thabs kyi gzhung la yang yan lag brgyad du bstan pas na yan lag brgyad pa ste/ brjod bya'i sgo nas btags pa dang / gu hya ni gsang ba las sgrub pa'i snod zhabs rdol dang / kha sbub dang / dug can lta bu ste/ de 'dra ba'i skyon can gyi gang zag la bstan par mi bya ba'i don gyis gsang ba ste/ snod kyi sgo nas btags pa dang / u pa ni nye ba dang / de sha ni gdams pa ste zab mo'i gnad ma 'phyugs par bla ma brgyud pa zam mi chad pa'i gsung gi rgyun las nye bar 'ong ba zhig gi don gyis na man ngag ste ngo bo'i sgo nas btags pa dang / 'dir rgya skad la rnam dbye phyes pa'i dngos su med kyang / lo tsā bas don thob bsgyur ba gi zhes pa rnam dbye drug pa 'brel ba'i sgra yin pa dang / tant+ra ni ta nu lus dang tra ya skyob pa ste de 'dra'i don zab mo gzhung 'dir rgyun mi chad du gnas pa'i don gyis na rgyud ces pa byed las kyi sgo nas btags pa dang / nā ma ni zhes bya ba'i ming ste

da 17 ༄7//'bri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/gzhung 'di'i mtshan gsal bar byed pa'i sgra'o// zhes mes po'i zhal lung du bshad pa'i lugs yin la/ yang kho bo'i bla ma dpal 'bri gung pa dharmā gīrti'i bka' mchan du/ tshig sgyur la bdud rtsi dang 'chi med kyi don gcig ste/ ji skad du/ 'chi med bcu phyed sbyin par bya/ sogs rgyud lung mang por sasungs pa'i phyir/ bsgyur khyad tsam mo zhes mtshan byang 'di dag tshig bsgyur du bzhed pa dang / yang mtshan don bsgyur byas na/ bdud rtsi bzhi la ye shes lnga'i rtsis bsgyur bas 'khor 'das kyi snying po rnam par thar pa'i yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa/ snod min la gsang ba/ yid gdu nga ba la rgyun mi chad pa zhes bsgyur te/ 'di la bshad pa byas na mtha' yas/ so zhes gsungs pa gnyis 'gal ba ltar 'gyur ba ni/ snga ma sgra pa'i lugs yin la phyi ma gsang sngags zab mo'i bshad srol bdud rtsi rnam pa lnga dang rtsa brgyad stong sbyar 'chi med bcud chen po sogs la dgongs pas nges pa'i don gyi mthar thug ste drang nges kyi khyad par yin pa shes par bya'o zhes so// yang mtshan 'di ltar 'dogs pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ lang kar gshegs pa las/ ming du gdags par ma mdzad na// 'jig na thams cad rmongs par 'gyur// de bas rmongs pa spangs pa'i phyir//mgon pos ming du gdags pa mdzad// ces dang / mdo sder lha mo dbyangs can ma la bstod par/ 'jig rten 'di na rab tu snang ba yis// phan tshun shes shing yang dag brda sbyor ba// dbyangs can lha mo'i mthu ste bsam mi khyab//zhes pa dang / tshig rgyan me long las/ gal te sgra 'od snang ba yis// 'khor ba gsal bar ma byas na// 'jig rten gsum po mtha' dag ni// smag rum mun pa nyid du 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dngos po thams cad la sngon gyi gna' bo'i mkhan po sogs kyis 'dod rgyal dang rjes grub gang rung gi sgo nas brda dang tha snyad la brten pa'i ming re btags pas don rtogs nus pa bzhin du 'dir yang sngon gyi slob dpon rnams kyis nad dang sman gyi bye brag

༄7/dpal ldan rgyud bzhi'i dka' gnad dogs sel gyi zin bris/ 145mtha' dag dang de ston byed kyi gzhung rnams la so sor brda re sbyar ba'i rjes su 'brangs nas 'dris par byas pas don 'khrul med du shes par 'gyur ba'i ched du yin pa dang / btags pa'i dgos pa ni gzhung gi dbu zhabs mi 'khrug cing glegs bam gzhan dang mi nor bas btsal bde ba dang / ming tsam la brten nas gzhung gi brjod bya rags pa zhig rtogs nus pa'i dgos pa yod pa dang / yang skad gnyis smra ba'i dgos pa ni/ sngon gzhung gi lus mtha' dag legs sbyar gyi skad 'ba' zhig tu yod pa'i mtshon byed de chos 'di nyid rgya gar nas byung ba shes shing khungs btsun par rtogs nus pa'i ched dang / de rang cag gi skad go bde bar bsgyur bas lo tsā ba rnams kyi drin dran par bya ba dang / rgya skad gzhung du 'di tsam la brten nas legs sbyar gyi skad dang 'phags pa'i yul la bag chags 'jog pa'i ched sogs dgos pa du ma zhig ldan pa yin no// zhes so//yangadrang srong gi gnas sman gyi grong khyer lta na sdug ces bya ba la/ bye brag bshad mtsho chen mo las/ chos 'khor gnas dang yangs pa can// sa dkar can dang lha yi gnas// 'brog gnas mchod rten ri dang ni// byis pa gsod dang kau shambi// 'od ma'i tshal dang sgrar bcas dang // ser skya'i gnas kyi grong khyer du// 'di rnams su ni thub pa yi// skyes mchog lo re lo re bzhugs// nyi shu rtsa gsum gnyan (mnyan3yod du// sman gyi nags su lo bzhi bzhugs// zhes pa'i sman gyi nags 'di'i dbus su/ ri bo ngos bzhi sa rgyar dpag tshad brgya dang 'phang du tudapangs su3gsum dang ldan pa/ de'i rtse mo na sprul pa'i grong khyer lta na sdug ces bya ba thar pa chen po'i grong mchog yod par mes po'i zhal lung du bshad pa ltar slar shes par byed dgos so// yang ga bur gyi 'byung khungs la rgya gar gyi slob dpon dzi na mi tra dang drang srong gzhung skyes dang / skyes bu me lha gsum mthun par tsan dan sa mchog gi thang

146 ༄7//'bri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/chur bzhed pa dang / byang khog rgya nag mar/ tsan dan dag la rigs gsum ste// sa mchog sbrul gyi snying po dang // go ro shirsha gsum yin no// de las ga bur rigs gsum 'byung // zhes dang / bdud rtsi 'byung khungs su// sbrul gyi snying po sa mchog dang // go ro shirsha gsum po las// ga bur rigs gsum byung ba yin// zhes dang / zur mkhar chos kyi rje mnyam nyid rdo rje'i phyi ma rgyud gyi sman ngo gsal byed du/ 'byung khungs sbrul gyi snying po gcig pu yin yang /'thu dus kyi nam zla bsil drod snyoms gsum las ga bur rigs gsum 'byung ngo zhes gsungs la/ chos rje legs bshad 'tshol gyis de rnams mi 'thad pa'i phyogs sngar bzhag nas rang lugs daṇḍi'i tshig rgyan gyi phyi yul dang 'gal ba'i dpe brjod du gsungs pa ltar mdzad de/ mal yan (ma la ya na1 ga bur 'byung ba'i shing med pa'i phyir dang / ga bur ni kanur zhes pa'i shing las 'byung zhing / tsan dan las ni rnam pa thams cad du 'byung ba ma yin pa de'i phyir lugs snga ma thams cad kyi mtshang brdol bar 'gyur ba yin no zhes gsungs/ tshul 'di lta bu la bsam nas/ lha phu drung 'tsho ba bzhi dgas bdag la 'dri ba'i shog dril zhig bskur bar/ gso dpyad bka' ma la rgya gar na bka' yan lag brgyad pa dang / bod du bsgyur ba rgyud bzhi yin pas sngar gyi bshad srol rnying pa so sor bzhag dgos rgyu la zur mkhar ba legs bshad 'tshol gyis/ snga rabs pa'i yig cha thams cad khyad du bsad pa'i gso rig gi bstan pa la de las gnod pa mi 'byung zhing / mes po'i zhal lung la nang 'gal ni mang du 'dug ces sogs g.yu thog rnam thar bka' rgya ma dang pad ma rgyas pa'i dga' tshal mthong nas don ma rtogs pa'i 'chal gtam mang po'i mthar bstan bcos yan lag brgyad pa la 'grel pa zla zer ni yod mod/ rang 'grel yod pa dang bod du bsgyur ba yin na/ lo paṇa gang gis bsgyur/mkhas pa mi dgu dus mnyam byung ba e yin/ de dag so so'i mtshan la ci zer/

— ༄༅/dpalaldan rgyun tsho'i dka' gnad dogs sel gyi zin bris/ 147so so'i gso dpyad brtsams pa ji ltar yod/ deng sang stod lugs smad lugs zer ba 'di la gzhung don dang lag len sman gyi ngos 'dzin sogs la khyad par ji lta bu yod ces zer ro// lar 'di lta bu'i dri ba byed pa ni rang gi khong par mkhyen gzigs kyi cha 'di bzhin yod do zhes gzhan la gsal por ston pa yin te/ de rnams ni sngar grags shing grub zin gyi glegs bam mang du yod pa ma mthong ba'i gtam du snang bas so// de'i phyir bdag gis dris lan ma btab par btang snyoms su bzhag pa la/ kho la snyan pa chen po 'dug ste yon tan yod le ma red/ ngas dri ba byas pa la lan ma byung zhes yang yang smra'o skad/bdag la yon tan mi 'dug zer ba ni bden mod kyang / dri ba 'di 'dra la lan spros nas btab na ni de bas kyang col chung du rang 'gro ba 'dug khong rang gis gso rig chos 'byung mdor bsdus shig brtsams 'dug pa de rang lugs kyi nam ma langs par phyogs snga'i nyi ma shar ba zhig 'dug kyang / srin bu me 'khyer gyi rig pas mang thos kyi nags klung bsregs mi nus pa'i khar rang nyid kyis 'bad pa'i dgos pa yang bya rog so brtag gi bstan bcos lta bur 'gyur ram snyam/ zhes so//le'u lnga par/ lug dang g.yag rgod gcan gzan nya yi sha/ zhes bya ba la/ mes po'i zhal lung du/ skam sa'i 'bru zhes pa'i rigs las 'dir yang sha skam po lo lon nam yang na btsos pa ste/ rlon pas ni bad kan bskyed par byed la/ khyad par nya sha rlon pa ni lci bsil dang ldan pas btsos pa'i skam po kho na la dgongs pa yin no// zhes gsungs pa la/ kho bo'i bla ma'i bka' mchan du blo rgyal bas skam sa'i 'bru zhes pa'i rig pas nya sha skam po la dgongs zer ba mi rigs te/ skam sa'i 'bru zhes pa chu med pa'i skam sa'i nas la dgongs kyi des 'gre na nya de yang skam sa'i nya la dgongs kyi/ thal la/yang nya chu nang du gnas kyang sha skam po dgos pa'i rig pa sbyor na ni nas de

148 ༄7rṣabri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/yang zhing chu ma la skyes nas skam sa zhig la khyed 'dod dgos pa'i phyir rig pa de gnyis ka rnam par blun no zhes gsung pa ni mngon sum rig pa dang 'gal ba la dgongs kyi/ bad kan gyi zas su nya sha skam po ston (gtong3dgos pa mi rigs gsung ba ni ma yin no// bka' 'chan khudaka' mchan3'di khungs btsun pa'i rgyu mtshan ni dam pa de nyid kyi gsung gi dkyil 'khor dngos las/ngas rgyud bzhi'i mchan bu 'di 'debs dus snga phyi'i 'grel pa kun la brtag cing dpyad pas mes po'i zhal lung dang skyems pa tshe dbang rgyal po'i 'grel pa legs pa 'dug pa de gnyis kyi lugs su btab pa yin/ zur mkhar blo gros rgyal po de rig gnas mtha' dag la mkhas pas mes po'i zhal lung rig gnas gzhan gyi rgyas 'gebs legs pa ma gtogs gso dpyad rang gi ngos la 'tsho byed tshe dbang rgyal po mi zhan tsam 'dug skabs 'dir dpe rnying dag pa gnyis las zhes smros pa ni rje g.yu thog pa'i rgyud bzhi phyag dreg ma dang zur mkhar ba'i rgyud bzhi rnam dag ma gnyis yin pas khyed rang lha rje tshor phan thogs nges shes pa yod pas khyed kyis bshus nas gzhan la yang spel cig ces gsungs/ bdag gis gsung gi gnang ba thos pa la brten nas 'phel rgyas su ci 'gyur byed pa 'di bzhin yin zhes so// hor gyi me btsa' la 'dod lugs mi 'dra ba 'ga' zhig mchis kyang / rang lugs go snyod snum ldan zhes gsungs pas go snyod kyi 'bru chom brdungs par dzā ti dang sga skya zhad tsam bsnan te ras kyi thum bu 'bru mar tsha 'jam la dugs tshos skyochos3byas pa rlung gsang dang rtsa dkar gyi dmigs su dugs pa de yin gsungs/le'u drug par/ gnas lugs ngos 'dzin gso ba'i rtsa ba la// zhes sogs ni le'u gong ma gsum gyi don bsdus te ljon shing gi dpe'i sgo nas bstan pa'i rtsa ba sdong po yal ga lo ma me tog 'bras bu rnam grangs de'u bkram ste brtsis pa la deng sang rtsa rgyud rdel 'grem zhes grags pa yin no// zhes so//

da wa da khuokhya/dpalaldan rgyud bzhi'i dka' sand dogs sel gyi zin bris/ 149yang rje legs bshad 'tshol gyis bdag gi rgyud ba'i'i par brkos pa'i mjug tu/ yar rgyab chos kyi rgyal po'i rgyal rnga retudeka// blo gros rgyal po'i dbyug gus bskul ba'i tshe// gso rig bstan pa'i lo tog rgyas byed pa'i// mi zad chos kyi char ba 'di phab bo// zhes bkod pa la snyan ngag me long mig gis mthong ma myong ba'i blun po phrag dog can 'ga' zhig gis tshig 'di la skyon 'dug zer ba thos pas/ de lta na khyed rnams kyi snyan ngag shes par 'dug pas thog mar 'di 'dri ste/ snyan ngag gi mchog dam pa dpag bsam 'khri thing gi le'u bcu drug par/ zhal ras mdzes shing spyan yangs pa// zla ba nya dang pad tshal dag/ 'grogs pa bzhin du bde ster ba'i// rgyal ba nam zhig mthong bar 'gyur// zhes pa'i dpe zla ba nya ba dang pad tshal 'grogs pa ci srid/ de gnyis 'grogs pas bde ba ster ba ci yod/ de bzhin du zangs mkhar lo tsā bas rnam sras la bstod par/ rgyal chen rnam mang thos sras nor mang ldan// gser gyi lhun po lta bur brjid chags shing // sprin bral nyi 'od stong gi gzi 'bar ba// 'dod rgu'i char 'bebs mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod//ces pa nam mkha' sprin dang bral ba tsam du ma zad nyi 'od stong phrag gi brjid 'bar ba'i dus der 'dod rgu'i char 'bab pa de dag yin pa 'dug 'di la don ma go ba 'ga' zhig na re/ 'di rab spel gyi rgyan yin zer na/ rgyal chen rnam mang thos sras nor mang ldan/ zer ba 'di rang bzhin brjod pa'i rdzas yin/ gser gyi lhun po lta bur brjid chags shing zer ba 'di dpe rgyan gyi nang nas chos dpe yin/ sprin bral nyi 'od stong gi gzi 'bar ba zer ba 'di gzugs can gyi nang nas sngon med gzugs can yin/ 'dod rgu'i char 'bebs mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod zer ba 'di 'byung min nam srid min gyi rgyan yin/ de bzhi ga bsdoms na rab spel gyi rgyan yin mod/ des na kho bos tshigs bcad 'di yang rab spel gyi rgyan ma yin pa'i rgyu mtshan ci yin/ snyan

150 ༄7//'bri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/ngag me long gi gzhung las/ gzugs can dpe yi rnam rtog rnams// mtha' yod ma yin de yi phyir// blo ldan rnams kyi phyogs tsam bstan// zhes gzugs can la dngos su smos pa nyi shu dang dpe rgyan sum cu so gnyis smos nas shugs bstan du de gnyis la grangs dang rgyan gyi mtha' yod par ma gsungs pas/'di la khyed rnams ji skad zer/ gzhan yangs paṇḍi tas rig gter gyi mchod brjod du/ gangs ri'i khrod 'dir mkhas pa'i rgyu skar bye ba brgyas// dpal ldan grags pa'i gsung rab pad ma kha phye mod// gang blo'i nyi 'od snang bas ma khyab de srid du// gsung rab dgongs don ge sar snying po gsal ma nus//zhes pa rgyu skar ji tsam mang yang pad ma kha 'byed par nus sam/ legs par soms shig dpag bsam 'khri shing dang / zangs mkhar lo tsā ba dang sa paṇa rnams kyi tshig la skyon byung 'dug na/ des shes na ngan dgu bdag lta'i tshig la skyon byung na'ang byung zhes ldan min nam srid min nam rigs min gang rung zhig tu bzhed pa 'dra zhig byung ste/ dpag bsam 'khri shing gi tshigs bcad 'di nyid ldan min dpe rgyan dang / zangs mkhar lo tsā ba'i tshigs bcad rkang pa phyi ma gnyis ldan min gzugs can yin par mi dbang rin chen spungs pa'i me long gi rgya cher 'grel pa las gsungs shing / rig gter gyi tshigs bcad ni rkang pa dang po gnyis rigs min gyi rgyu 'bras dang / phyi ma gnyis rigs pa'i rgyu 'bras kyi rgyan yin par mngon te/ tshig rgyan me long gi le'u gnyis par/ lha gcig khyod kyi zhabs gnyis po// dmar po'i nyi gzhon la reg pa'i//rgyal po rnams kyi lag pa yi// pad ma zum pa byed pa ci// zhes bya ba la/ snar thang lo tsā ba sargyu shri'i 'grel par/ nyi mas pad ma kha zum par mi rigs pa la zum par byas pas mi rigs pa'i rgyu 'bras zhes bya'o// zhes dang / khyod kyi zhabs sen zla ba yi// 'od zer kunda dri med rnams// sa skyongs (skyong3rnams kyi lag pa yi// pad ma zum par byed la dbang // zhes bya ba la sa skyongs

༄7/dpal ldan rgyud bzhi'i dka' gnad dogs sel gyi zin bris/ 151(skyong1mtha'i rgyal phran rnams kyi lag pa spyi bor thal mo sbyar nas phyag 'tshal bas pad ma ze'u 'bru dang ldan pa zum par byed pa la dbang zhes pa rigs pa'i rgyu 'bras te zla 'od shar bas pad ma zum par byed pas so// zhes bshad pa dang chos mtshungs sam snyam mo//gnyis pa/ bshad rgyud kyi dka' gnad dogs sel/ le'u gsum par/ dbang po sgo lnga skar khung gtod pa 'dra// zhes nga la snga phyi'i 'grel pa rnams su/ mig la sogs pa'i dbang po sgo lnga ni/ skar khung ngam glo skar gtod pa dang 'dra'o// zhes gzhung tshig lhug par btang ba tsam las spros pa ma byung bas/ gzugs kyi sgo mig sgra'i sgo rna ba/ dri'i hro sna / ro'i sgo kha/ reg bya'i sgo ba spu'i bu ga yin par shes par bya'o zhes so///le'u bzhi par/ mi la che yi rtsa ni gsum yod de// gcig ni mabee lus thams cad khrab par gnas// zhes pa tshes khutshe'i rtsa1re re bzhin lus tham sa cad la khyab par gnas pa ste/ ngo bo ni/ rgyud 'di nyid du/ lus zungs khu ba'i mthar phyin mdangs mchog ste// snying la gnas cing lus kun khyab nga dang // tshe gnas gzi mdangs bkrag dang ldan par byed// ces gsungs pa de nyid jo// mes po'i zhal lung las/ thams cad mkhyen pa rang byung lta bu'i bstan bcos las/ kun tu 'khyams pa bla gnas kyi rtsa zhes bya 'di gnas ngari/'i sar gtar bsregs la sogs pa mi bya'o// zhes gsungs kyang ri bong gis cal sgrogs la seng ge kyang re zhig bros pa dang chos mtshungs la zhes gsungs pa'i bla gnas dang bla rtsa 'khyams po ma nor bar ngos 'dzin byed dgos so// gcig ni dbugs dang 'grogs nas rgyu ba ste// zhes pa las/ pa'i mgul ya zur rus pa 'bur po'i ldebs kyi blta rtsa ste/ ngo bo ni/ man ngag rgyud du/ rlung khrag

152 ༄7/khabri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/gnyis 'doms kyi 'phar ba'i snying rtsa mi/ zhes srog rlung rgyu ba'i rtsa'o// gcig ni bla dang 'dra ste 'khyams pa yin// zhes pa tshe'i rtsa phyi rol tu 'khyams pa'i don ma yin gyi bla tshe dang rten pa'i tshul du rgyu ba la dgongs nas phyi rgyud du'ang tshe srog rten du bla rtsa 'khyams po 'byung / zhes dang / deng sang lag ngar ldebs ma zur gyi rtsa la bla gnas zhes grags pa'ang don de las btags par zad do//zhes bka' (dka'1mchan du gsungs la/ 'khyams pa'i shes byed ni rnam shes kyi rten la tshe dang srog ces bya zhing / tshe srog gi rten bya zhes bya ba rtsa nang nas phyi rol tu 'khyams par byed pa'i don yin te/ rgyud phyi mar/ bla rtsa gnas na bla tshe mal du gnas// bla rtsa 'gyur ldog byed na tshe mi brtan// bla rtsa bros na bla tshe yar te 'chi// tshe chog 'chi bslus khug pa srid pa tsam// zhes gsungs pas gsal bar go nus pa yin/ zhes so//le'u lnga par/ dwangs ma len pa'i rtsa dgu mchin lam brgyud// ces bya ba la rje mnyam nyid rdo rjes kho bo'i bla ma'i gsung las 'di skad do// dri med zla zer las/ mchin pa'i rtsa la srid pa'i chu mig dgu zhes dang / gzhan las/rtsa ni srid pa'i chu mig dgu/ zhes byung ba ni zhes dang / de rnams gang zhe na/mchin pa'i gnas pho ba nas dwangs ma 'khrid pa'i rtsa gcig mchin pa'i gnas su mchin (mcher3par dwangs ma 'khrid pa'i rtsa gcig de bzhi/na du mkhris par/ glo bar/ snying du/ klad par/ mkhal ma (maraka/ bsam se'ur dwangs ma len pa'i rtsa dang dgu'o// rtsa dgu po de las sha khrag 'phel byed rtsa chen nyi shu bzhir 'gro ba yin no// zhes gsungs pa bla rta tshe dbang rgyal pos 'grel pa tshig don nyi mar rang lugs su mdzad par bka' mchan du'ang bkod kyang lung bshad gnyis ka gzhung 'di'i dgongs don du 'gyur ba ma yin te/ rtsa dgu zhes pa mang tshig dang grangs kyi dgu gang du 'chad kyang pho ba nas mchin par zug pa zhig nges par dgos pa la/ rtsa dgu po 'di las sha

༄7/dpal ldan rgyud bzhi'i dka' gnad dogs sel gyi zin bris/ 153khrag 'phel byed rtsa chen nyi shu bzhir 'gro ba yin no// zhes si srog rtsa la dgongs te/ rgyud 'di nyid du/ srog pa rtsa ni rtsa yi sdong po la// yal ga'i tshu du gyen la gyes pa yi// sha khrag 'phel byed rtsa chen nyi shu bzhi// man ngag rgyud du/ nang rtsa srog rtsa dkar nag sdong po ste// sgal pa'i nang gzhung thang shing bslang pa 'dra// de las yal ga'i rtsa phran kun tu gyes// zhes sogs rgyas par gsungs pas so// 'bum nag sogs 'grel pa snga ma rnams su zas kyi dwangs ma de pho ba nas mchin pa'i bar na dwangs ma len pa'i rtsa mig dgu yod pa der 'gro ste/ zhes 'byung ba la/ mes po'i zhal lung du de dag thams cad kyi rtogs pa la pho ba dang mchin pa gnyis dwangs ma len pa'i rtsa dgus 'brel te yod do snyam pa'am yang na gang yang dpyad ma shes gzhung tshig lhug par btang ba tsam las ma byung mod/ de gnyis kyi bar na dngos su 'brel ba'i rtsa ni rta rnga bshags (gshags1pa'i tshad tsam yang med na dgu byung ba lta ci smos/ 'on kyang gzhung gi dgongs pa ni pho ba rang gi nang ngos na rtsa sbubs shin tu phra ba dra ba ltar yod pa'i nang nas mchin pa'i rtsa ba phyogs dang gang reg pa'i rtsa mig gtso che ba'i dbang du byas pa dgu las ngang gis 'ongs pa mchin pa'i rtsa bo cher 'gro ste/ dper na mnye tuganye3ma nas lhang par chu gsog pa'am ras tshags dam por chu blugs pa ngang gis 'dzag pa'am rdza so ma chu blugs na rngul ba ltar 'gro ba la dgongs pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de ltar mnye (gnye3ma nas lhang par chu gsog pa lta bu yin na/ man ngag rgyud du/ rgyu rkyen ldang pa'i kha nyid thur bltas pa'i// ngos nyid (gnyis3chu rgyu'i rtsa yod rgyu mar 'brel//zhesagasungs pa mngon sum du snang ba bzhin du 'byung dgos kyang de ltar mi 'byung ba ni gsang sngags pa'i lugs la rtsa thig rlung gsum rnam shes kyi rten yin pas shi ba'i tshe rnam shes 'phos ma thag thams cad sdud par bshad pa dang / gso dpyad kyang phyi ma rgyud las/ mtha' nas sdud phyir 'chi rtsa bol la

154 ༄7spyo'abri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/brtag/ ces dang / zla ba'i rgyal por/ khrag dang rlung gi so 'dzin pa// 'chi ba'i tshe na rim gyis 'gag ces gsungs/ lus kyi phyi nang gi rtsa shin tu rags pa rnams ma gtogs phra ba dang shin tu phra ba rnams shi ba'i phung po la mngon du med pa ni bsdus par zad la des na pho mchin bar na dwangs ma 'gro ba'i rtsa yod pa gzhung gi dngos bstan yin pa dngos su med pa yang bsdus pa las 'os ci yod de/ man ngag rgyud du/ de las gyes pa'i don snod nang rtsa rnams//'dral tu'abralaka'abrel mang bas thag pa 'dzing pa 'dra// zhes gsungs pa rnams kyang dngos su mi snang ba bzhin no// yang gsang sngags pa'i lugs la gnas pa rtsa ba'i dbu ma ni rags pa la dgongs nas ye shes thig ler/ de ni srog pa rtsa de nyid// ces srog rtsa la bzhed cing de las yal ga'i tshul du rtsa thams cad gyes pas khyab byedatshoyin pa la dgongs te/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtshor/'di ltar dbu ma thams cad kyi// khyab byed du ni rnam par gnas// zhes gsungs/ phra ba la dgongs te rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud las/ phra ba'i phra ba yang dag mchog/ ces dang / sasbra ṭir/ mi gsal gsal ba'i rang bzhin can// cha med mchog tu phra ba ste// gzi brjid chen po 'od dang ldan// zhes dang / mkha' 'gro rgya mtshor/ phra dang reg bya mchog tu phra// gzungs dang 'dzin pa rnam par spangs// zhes tshur rol mthong ba la snang du med pa dbu ma rta rnga brgyar gshags pa'i tshad tsam gyi pad ma'i rnal ma dang 'od kyi skud pa la 'jog pa'ang de'i phyir ro// shin tu phra ba'i dbang du mdzad nas phyi na ma yin nang na min/ zhes khyab bya'i rtsa thams cad la khyab byed kyi tshul du zhugs pa ste/dper na me tog dang dri bzhin phyi nang du 'byed mi nus pa'o// des na sgom pa'i lam sbyangs nas dbu mar dag pa yang so skye'i gnas skabs su rags pa'i dbu mar dang / sa thob nas phra ba'i dbu mar dang / sangs rgyas nas gnyug ma'i dbu mar dag pa gsum shes par bya'o// zhes 'byung mod/ gso dpyad

༄7/dpal ldan rgyud bzhi'i dka' gnad dogs sel gyi zin bris/ 155du'ang / srog pa rtsa ri rtsa yi sdong po las// yal ga'i tshul du rgyan la rgyas pa yikashakhig 'phel byed rtsa chen nyi shu bzhi// don snod nang 'brel sbas pa'i rtsa chen brgyad// yan lag phyir 'brel mngon pa'i rtsa bcu drug/ de las rgyas pa'i gtar rtsa bdun cu bdun// gnyan pa'i rtsa gnad brgya dang bcu gnyis te//zhes pa rags pa dang 'dres pa'i rtsa phran brgya dang brgyad cu dgu/ de las phyi nang bar gsum brgya nyi shu// rtsa phran gsum brgya drug cur gyes pa yin// de lasartsa phran bdun brgya dag tu rgyas// zhes pa phra ba dang / de las yang phran lus la dra bar 'brel zhes pa shin tu phra ba ste/ mes po'i zhal lung du grangs kyi sgo nas stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis te/ bdun khri nyis stong dang de las kyang phal che ba bye ba phrag phyed dang bzhi gyes shing mdor na lus 'di nyid gong bu gcig ma yin par rtsa'i rang bzhin can dra ba'am dru bu 'dzing pa ltar gnas pa yin te zhes gsungs pas shin tu phra ba rnams ni tshur rol mthong ba snang du med pa yin nam snyam mo//khrad par srog 'dzin rlung ni spyi bor gnas// zhes pa dang / khrab byed rlung ni snying la gnas pa ste// zhes bya ba la mes po'i zhal lung du/ yang dgon pa'i rdo rje lus kyi sbas bshad du/ srog 'dzin snying dang / khyab byed spyi bor gnas par bshad mod kyang / rgyud sde rin po che gang gi yang khungs mi snang bas rang bzo tsam du byed do// zhes dbyug pa'i 'phred 'jog mdzad do// de ni rdo rje 'phreng ba las/ srog gi rlung ni snying gar gnas// mi bskyod bye brag rigs las skyes// 'dom na gnas pa thur sel ni// rin chen 'byung gnas bye brag skyes// stod du rgyu ba lkog mar gnas// 'od dpag med kyi rang bzhin no// mnyam gnas lte ba'i pad mar gnas// don yod grub pa'i rang bzhin no// khyab byed spyi bo'i 'khor lor gnas// rnam par snang mdzad rang bzhin no// zhes dang / sbyor drug dang chos drug sogs sngar gyi man ngag rnams su

156 ༄7khabri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/thur sel ba'i skyosa'i3rlung gsang gnas su gnas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen 'byung gnas kyi rang bzhin bde ba bskyed cing 'og sgo 'byed 'dzum dang bshang gci 'phen sdom gyi las byed/ me mnyam rlung gi rlung lte bar gnas/de bzhin gshegs pa don yod grub pa'i rang bzhin bde drod bskyed cing zas 'ju ba'i las byed/ srog 'dzin chu'i rlung snying gar gnas/ de bzhin gshegs pa mi bskyod pa'i rang bzhin srog 'dzin dbugs phyi nang rgyu ba'i las byed/ gyen rgyu'i rlung me'i rlung mgrin par gnas/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med kyi rang bzhin bza' btung mid pa dang mchil snabs 'dor ba dang smra dgod kyi las byed/ khyab byed nam mkha'i rlung spyi bo dang tshigs pa rnams su gnas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad kyi rang bzhin lus kun la khyab cing 'gro 'dug dang 'gul skyod kyi las byed do// zhes byung ba'i lung ltar yin pas rje yang dgon pa'i rang bzo ni ma yin no// lar gsang sngags kyi bshad srol rnams su rgyud sde so so'i dgongs pa rlung gi gnas tshul mi mthun mang dag shig mchis na/ gso rig phyi nang thun mong gi rig pa dang gsang sngags nang pa'i khyad chos kyi mthar thug gnyis 'gal 'du byed pa ni dka' ba'i gnas su gyur pas rig ldan byang pas mdzad pa'i mes po'i zhal lung du mi 'thad pa'i cha du ma zhig 'god par mdzad mod/ 'on kyang bla rta tshe dbang rgyal pos phyi ma rgyud kyi rnam bshad lag len gsal byed du/ bshad rgyud dang gnas bcu mi mthun pa ni gsang sngags su skyes gnas la dgongs pa dang /gso byed la byed las gtso che ba'i yul de gnas su mdzad pa'i khyad par ro zhes bshad pa ni don la gnas par sems te/ gso dpyad la'ang / skye ba len pa'i gnas skabs su ni rgyu 'di nyid du/ drug pa lte ba la brten srog rtsa chags// zhes dang / rtsa gcig bar du zug pas srog rtsa chags// zhes srog rlungagi rten byed pa la srog rtsa zhes btags pa dang / so ma rā dzar/ lte ba

༄7/dpal ldan rgyud bzhi'i dka' gnad dogs sel gyi zin bris/ 157nas chags srog 'dzin rlung // zhes dang srog 'dzin gyi las snying ga yan du byed pa gtso che ba dang / khyab byed lus kun la las byed kyang / snying ga gtso che bar rgya bod kyi gso rig gi gzhung lugs thams cad mthun pas so//le'u brgyad par/ nad rnams kun gyi rgyu ni gcig pu ste// bdag med donam rtogs pas ma rig ces// zhes bya ba la brjod par mi nus pa'i nad kyi rnam grangs de rnams kun gyi thun mong ba'i rgyu ni gcig pu nyid yin te/ rgyu'i gtso bo zhes bya ba'i don ni gcig pu de yang gang zhe na/ don dam dngos po thams cad bdag med pa'i rang bzhin can kho na yin yang / kun rdzob tu 'khrul bas slad pa la brten nas bdag tu bzung bas de'i don ma shes zhing /de ltar ma shes pas na bdag 'dzin dang lhan gcig tu skyes pa'i ma rig pa nas yongs su grub pa'i mi dge ba de nyid gcig pu yin no zhes mes po'i zhal lung las gsungs/ bka' mchan du/ ma rig pa de gang yin zhe na/ sasbra ṭar/ rnam rtog ma rig chen po ste// 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor lhung byed yin//rnam rtog de dang bral ba na// khyod ni rtog med mya ngan 'das// zhes so//rnam rtog dang 'khrul bral zhi gnas lugs rtags (rtog3ma rtags (rtog3yin te/ mdo sde las/ 'khor ba dang ni mya ngan 'das// gnyis su yod pa ma yin te// 'khor ba'i rang bzhin shes pa la// mya ngan 'das zhes brjod pa yin//zhes gsungs so// zhes pa tsam las 'god par ma mdzad la/ cung zad smos na/ sa ra has/ gang tshe yid ni mi g.yo brtan gyur na// de tshe 'khor ba'i dngos po rang grol 'gyur// zhes dang / zhi ba lhas/ rnam par rtog pa'i gdon chen po// 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor lhung byed yin// rnam par mi rtog bdag nyid che// srid pa'i 'ching las grol bar 'gyur// zhes dang / dbu ma rtsa ba'i 'grel pa tshig gsal las/ rnam par rtog pa ni sems kyi rgyu ba yin/de dang bral ba'i phyir de kho na nyid ni rnam par rtog pa yin no// zhes dang /

158 ༄7//'bri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/'jug pa las kyang / so so skye bo rnams ni rtog pas bcing // mi rtog rnal 'byor pa ni grol bar 'gyur// zhes gsungs pas gnas lugs rtogs pa de tshul bzhin ji lta bu zhig yin na chos thams cad kyi chos nyid rang bzhin skye 'gag med pas don dam pa'i gnas lugs rtogs pa yin te de ni bdag med rtogs pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i gsung rab mdo rgyud kun gyi brjod bya'i snying po de kho na nyid phyag rgya chen po rtogs pa yin no// 'o na rtogs bya ngo bo phyag rgya chen po de gang yin zhe na/ rdo rje phreng bar/ e ni stong pa nyid du gsungs// de bzhin wam ni snying rje ste// thig le de nyid sbyor las byung //des sbyor ba ni rmad byung mchog/ chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong khyab// mdor bsdus chos kyi phyag rgya 'o// zhes dang / dus kyi 'khor lo'i 'grel chen las/phyag rgya chen po ni chos thams cad rang bzhin med pa'i mtshan nyid rnam pa kun gyi mchog dang / snga ba shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sangs rgyas thams cad bskyed par mdzad pa po chos 'byung gi sgra yis kyang brjod de/ chos 'byung gang las thams cad rang bzhin med pas 'byung bar 'gyur ro// rang bzhin med pa'i chos rnams ni stobs bcu dang mi 'jigs pa la sogs pa chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong rnams so// de rnams 'byung ba ni chos 'byung ste sangs rgyas kyi zhing ngo // sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi gnas te bde ba'i skye gnas so// zhes dang / mdo ting 'dzin rgyal po las chos rnams kun gyi rang bzhin phyag rgya ste// ting 'dzin 'di ni 'dren pa dag gis bshad// ting 'dzin zhi ba 'dren las bshad pa 'dis// thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes thob par byed// ces dang / bu mo rin chen gyis zhus pa'i mdo las/ chos rnams kun gyi mtshan nyid ni// nam mkha' mnyam pa'i mtshan nyid rdo// mtshan nyid phyag rgya de 'dra ba'i// phyag rgya gang btab phyir mi ldog/ ces mdo sngags gnyis kar nges tshig dang bcas te gsal bar gsungs pa ltar

༄7/dpal ldan rgyud bzhi'i dka' gnad dogs sel gyi zin bris/ 159yin la/ des na rgyal bas chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs pa thams cad don dam pa'i chos nyid 'di ston pa'i thabs su 'bab pa la dgongs nas/ zhi ba lhas/ yan lag 'di dag thams cad ni/ thub pas shes rab zhes dang /jo bo rjes/ chos kyi phung po brgyad khri dang // bzhi stong gsungs pa gang yin pa// chos nyid 'di la zhol zhing 'bab// ces gsungs so// de ltar ma rig pa ngos bzung zhing / bdag med rtogs pa'i don cung zad bshad pa 'di ni nad kyi rgyu'i gtso bo ma rig pa yin pas tshig gsal yan lag brgyad pa rtsa 'grel du mi 'byung bas rgyud 'di nyid du gsungs pa'i dgongs don dpyis phyin par shes dgos pa'i ched du'o// zhes so//le'u bcu gsum par/ glo bur nad lnga'i dgra la skyel ma bsten// zhes gsungs pas gag pa dang lhog pa/ pho log dang nywa log dang sna khrag mang du shor ba dang lnga'o// 'di dag gi skyel ma bsten tshul ni/ kho bos rims bcos zhal lung bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun du bshad yod pas der rtogs par bya'o// zhes so//le'u bcu drug par/ sha ni sde brgyad ces pa la/ stag gzig nas byil khra'i bar rang gi rtsal dang mthus za ba'i sde tshan gcig yin pas gnyis su mi bzung ste/ yan lag brgyad par/ gcan gzan bya rnams rtsal mthus za/zhes dang / 'dir yang bya gcan rtsal mthus sha rlon za ba rnams/ zhes gsungs pas so// skyur po ni/ mes po'i zhal lung du/ zan chang dus kyis skyur por song bar bshad/ yan lag brgyad pa'i rang 'grel du/ nyung ma dang la phug gtubs pa dang sran phye sbyar te skyur por mnan te langs pa dang btsir te bcang bcang po sha stag byas te skam pa'i tshod ma bza' ba 'di lta bu'i zas ni mi dge ste mig la gnod/ rlung dang mkhris pa dang bad kan gyi nad bskyed/'ju dka' ste lci/ lus rmya zhing nyam chung bar byed de gnod do// zho dang sman

160 ༄7//'bri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/sbyar bas g.yos te zho cung zad bsrubs la sman ni dri zhim po sna bzhi po shing tsha dang / sug smel/ gadha bha dra/ nā ga ge sar 'di rnams btags te btab la dkrug cing 'thung bas na gsos so// lus brtas/ khong snum/ bcud du 'gyur te bud med la nyal phod/ stobs bskyed/ yi ga 'byed/ 'di'i nang du tsha ba gsum po na le sham dang pi pi ling / sga rnams btab na cham pa'i nad sel lo zhes 'byung / phrum gsar spri dang phyur ba la sogs pa zhes pa la mes po'i zhal lung du snga rabs pa 'ga' zhig phrum gsar ni thud yin no zhes zer ba mi 'thad de thud ni mar dang phyur ba bsres pa yin/ phrum gsar ni snod 'ga' zhig gi nang du snga dro re bzhin 'o ma dang dar ba dum re blugs te bsags pa phyogs gcig tu 'dril ba la zer ba'i phyir/ de ltar yang zla zer las/ phrum gsar spri dang rgya phrum dang // phyur ba la sogs stobs bskyed cing //zhes bya ba la phrum gsar zhes bya ba ni/ 'o ma dang dar ba las byas pa ste grags par zad do// spri ni ba la sogs pa grus (batres3ma thag pa'i 'o ma las byas pa'o// rgya phrum ni 'o ma'i btso phrum a mi cha zhes grags pa'o// phyur ba ni zho kha chu las gdus pa'i gong bu'o zhes bshad pa'i phyir dang / rgya phrum ni 'o zom la chags pa'i zo mar zhes pa dang / don gcig tu mngon no// zhes gsungs/'grel ba legs bshad rgya mtshor/ phrum gsar ni 'o ma la skyur cung zad btab ste gdus pa dang spri ni be'u skyes ma thag pa'i 'o ma gdus pa dang / phyur ba ni go sla zhing / sogs khong nas rgya phrum ste snying po bton pa'i 'o ma skyur cung zad btab ste gdus pa'i gong bu'o zhes bshad do// bshad rgyud 'dir 'grel bshad mang du byung yang 'grel pa 'di gnyis khungs btsun zhing phrum gsar dang rgya phrum gyi ngos 'dzin phyi ma yongs grags dang mthun pa yin no// sngo sga'i tsha ba mkhris tshad mgo nad sel// zhes pa'i sngo sga ni grong pas sga zer ba de'o//'di rigs g.ya' sga bye sga chu sga gsum yod pa las tshod ma'i skabs 'dir

༄7/dpal ldan rgyud bzhi'i dka' gnad dogs sel gyi zin bris/ 161g.ya' la skye ba dang bye ma la skye ba gnyis yin la/ phyi ma chu sga ni/ bka' mchan du/ srib kyi chu shag la skye ba lo ma shwa ba'i rna ba lta bu me tog ser po/ ro kha tsha yod pa ste don la lhog dug nag po sha la yu ring du grags pa rkang 'bam gyi gnyen po'i mchog tu 'gyur ba de yin no// 'o ma phal cher ro dang zhu rjes mngar// zhes pa ni smra sgo mtshon char/ phal cher zhes pa ma tshang tshig ces pas ro dang zhu rjes mngar ba kho na ma yin pa'i gzhan yang yod pa ston pa yin te/ brgyad par/ rnga mo'i 'o ma cung tsub dro// lan tshwa bro zhing drod che yang //zhes pa dang / rmig pa gcig pa'i 'o ma tsha// yan lag rlung sel skyur bcas shing // lan tshwa bro zhing rmongs par byed// ces pa la sogs pa yin par mes po'i zhal lung du bshad/ rmig pa gcig ni rta rkyang bong bu la sogs pa'i mig zlum rnams yin no// mkha' las babs pa ro mi gsal la zhim// zhes bya ba la/mkha' las babs pa dngos ni chu bo gang gā yin te/ yan lag brgyad par/mkha' las babs pa gang gā'i chu// 'tsho byed ngoms byed yi gar 'ong //tshims shing sems ni gsal byed la// sla zhing ro mi gsal la zhim// bsil zhing yang bas bdud rtsir mtshungs// zhes gsal bar gsungs la/ gang zhig char bab dri ma med// 'bras chan dngul phor nang gnas pa// ma rul mdog kyang ma 'gyur na// gang gā'i chu ste btung bar bya// zhes bar snang las babs pa'i char chu snod bzang du bzed nas 'bras chan mi rul zhing mdog mi 'gyur na gang gā'i chu dang mtshungs te yan lag brgyad ldan du bshad do// yan lag brgyad ni gong du dwangs pa ltar dang / 'jig rten bzhag pa las/ 'tsho byed ngoms byed yi gar 'ong // tshim zhing ro mi gsal la dwangs// 'thung na mgrin pa lto ba la// mi gnod pa de yan lag brgyad// ces gsungs so// nya lcibs zhes pa la zla zer du/ nya lcibs ni nyid nas skyes pa'o// zhes dang / mes po'i zhal lung du/ nya lcibs ni chu shin tu dal ba'i nang du skyes pa ba thag sngo

162 ༄7//'bri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/nal nal pos gang ba dang / zhes gsungs pa grong pas chu bal zer ba de'o//tsha ni khrag mkhris bad kan sel bar byed// ces pa ni 'dul ba las/ shin tu skyur bas tsha zhes bya'o// zhes gsungs pas chang yun lon pas dang po'i ro mngar skyur kha ba gsum yal nas zhu rjes kyi skyur ba 'ba' zhig yin gsungs so le'u bcu bdun par/ skyer pa'i me la ha ri tra sha bsreg/ ces pa la skyor lo tsā bas ha ri tra zhes pa bya ljang khu ste phyogs mthun ne tso yin no zhes gsungs/ sreg pa dang ri bong la 'dod pa'ang yod ces so//le'u nyi shu par/ cog la ma yis rtsa dang lha ba 'dzin// zhes bya ba la gnam sa'i dbang phyug sangs rgyas rgya mtshos bdag la dri ba gnang bar cog la ma dang da chu dang mtshal gyis rma 'brub skyi'adrub3glo mchin rtsa tshad sel/ zhes pa 'di gsum mtshal dang bcas pa so so'i ngos 'dzin rang lugs la ji ltar yod ces gsungs pa la/ zur mkhar ba chos rje mnyam nyid rdo rjes rgyud phyi ma'i sman ngo gsal byed bdud rtsi sgron mer/ cog la ma dang da chu dang mtshal dkar gsum ngo bo tha dad du bshad/ 'grel ba mes po'i zhal lung du cog la ma ni dngul chu dang ldong ros sogs la bcos pa'i deng sang rgya mtshal du grags pa 'di yin pa dang / da chu ze tsha bzos pa'i mjug tu 'byung bar bshad/brda sprod lnga par ni da chu zhes pa mtshal dang dngul chu gnyis ka'i ming du bshad/ skyems pa tshe dbang rgyal po'i phyi rgyud kyi rnam bshad lag len gsal byed du rgya mtshal dang cog la ma da chu gsum mtshal dkar gyi ming gi rnam grangs yin pa 'dra zhig byung / chos rgyal 'bri gung pa'i sman bla rnam rgyal 'phrin las kyis bshad rgyud kyi 'grel ba legs bshad rgya mtshor/ cog la ma ni ha shig dmar po dang // da chu rgya nag sogs nas 'byung ba'i mtshal// dngul chu'i mdog yod pa de yin par bshad// yang slob dpon dag gis zhal rgyun

༄7/dpal ldan rgyud bzhi'i dka' gnad dogs sel gyi zin bris/ 163las cog la ma dang mtshal dkar zhes pa rgya mtshal dang da chu ni dngul chu yin pa ngos bzung nas 'thad pa yin gsungs pa sogs so sor ngos 'dzin lugs mi 'dra ba mang du snang ba las rang lugs rnam bshad lag len gsal byed ltar byas na thams cad la grags che bar 'dug pas 'thad dam snyam lags zhus so//lig bu mig dang btsag yug rnams la sogs// zhes pa'i lig bu mig ni mdung rtse'o zhes brda sprod lnga par bshad pa ltar 'dod pa mang la mes po'i zhal lung du mdung rtse dkar smug gnyis chig thub dkar smug tu mdzad nas/zhes lig bu mig ni mdung rtse dang 'dra ba la de las cung yang ba de'o zhes gsungs/ bka' mchan du/ dkar khra men zhes 'byung / zla zer las/ mu tig byu ru a dzan btsag ces bya ba la/ a dzan ni lig bu mig gam dngulardo 'o zhes gsungs pas 'di la blo dang ldan pa rnams kyis slar dpyad par bya'o//btsag yug ni sa'i btsag ma yin par chu tsha na yod sa'i rdo las byung ba mdog mtshal 'dra ba'o// zhes so// li khris rul gcod ces pa la mes po'i zhal lung du/ li khri ni bal por zha nye las bzos pa'i tshon rung ba de'o zhes bshad la/bka' mchan du/ li khri ni rgya gar nas 'ong ba'i chu la chags pas chu li khrir grags pa bcos pa min pa de yin gyi deng sang bal pos 'khyer 'ong pa ni phag mo gzhu drug las/ zha nye dag las bcos pa'i rdzas/ zhes gsungs pa ltar dkar gong dang zha nye ba bla sdong (ldong3ros rnams bsres nas bzhu zhing bcos pa 'dis mi 'ong bas dbye ba phyed dgos so zhes gsungs/ 'dir rdo sman gyi skabs su bshad pas rang byung gi rdo zhig yod dgos par snang ngo // chu li khri ni rgya gar nub phyogs o rgyan gyi yul ka wo ka'i grong khyer na rang byung gi phag mo'i gsang gnas nas 'bab par bshad pas sin ṅgha ra yin pas so// ka rañdza yis pho ba'i me drod bskyed// ces pa la mes zhal du/ ka rañdza yi skad dod dngos bstan mañdza pha la zhes pa 'jam 'bras te sbrul gyi sgong skyisgo3nga lta bu dang /

164 ༄7//'bri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/ka radzi zhes pa lag skyes tesgyu don du 'jam 'bras rang yin zhes dang / 'jam 'bras dang ka rañdza gcig par gong du bshad mod/ 'o na bzlos par 'gyur ro zhe na/ gong du nus pa khyad par ba'i dbang du byas pa yin la 'dir ni smad kyi 'bras sna gsum po mnyam du mkhal nad sel ba'i dbang du byas pa'o// zhes dang / bka' mchan du/ ka rañdza dang 'jam 'bras ngo bo gcig yin pa ni 'dir ka rañdza pho ba'i me drod bskyed par bshad pa dang phyi ma'i rgyud du 'jam 'bras bsdebs pas pho ba'i me nyams gso zhes pas kyang go nus la/ yan lag brgyad pa'i rang 'grel las/ ka rañdza rnam pa gnyis dang / zhes gsungs pa yang 'jam 'bras rigs che chung gnyis 'byung ba la dgongs so// zhes dang /brang ti pa'i sde tshan lnga 'grel du/ 'jam 'bras dang ka rañdza gcig par g.yu thog pas bshad ces 'byung bas srin bu dmar leb dang sre shing gi 'bras bu dang sga dmar dang shing la ka rañdza dang 'bras bu 'jam 'bras su 'dod pa dag yod kyang rang lugs 'jam 'bras dang gcig par bzhed do// lce myang tsha yang de bzhin mig la phan// zhes bya ba la/ bka' mchan du/ rgyud 'di dang brgyad pa rtsa 'grel rnams mthun par lan tshwa'i sde kho nar bshad cing /'phags mchog klu sgrub kyis kyang / lan tshwa dro ste rlung sel bad mkhris bskyed na yang / rgyam tsha lce myang tsha ni mkhris par gnod mi byed/ ces gsungs pas g.yu thog zhabs kyis lce myang tsha rgyam tsha 'dra ba'i dmar dwangs dang / zhes gsungs pa de nyid yin gyi shing sman la 'dod pa dag ni nor ro// zhes gsungs/ mes po'i zhal lung las lce myang tsha ni zla zer las tshwa mchog ni rgyam tsha dang lce myang tsha'o// zhes lan tshwa'i sder gsungs shing lan tshwa lce myang tsha zhu rjes mngar bas mkhris pa sel zhing yang bas bad kan la phan pa dang zhese sogs bshad pas/ sman ming rgya mtshor/ lce myang tsha ni yal ga'i sde/ zhes pa dang / bdud rtsi 'byung khungs las/ lce myang tsha zhes bya ba'i sman// lho rong

༄7/dpal ldan rgyud bzhi'i dka' gnad dogs sel gyi zin bris/ 165tshad pa'i yul du skye// zhes pa'i lung gis ni khung skyokhungs3thub pa'i ris su mi snang ngo zhes gsungs so// legs bshad rgya mtshor/ lce myang tsha ni mtsho gram ('gram3la chags nas lo mang du lon pa gru bzhi shel ltar dwangs pa'o// ngaming byang tsha rgan po dang tshwa rgan no// zhes bshad/ des na tshwa dmar po shel ltar dwangs shing ro mngar shas che ba'i gru bzhi pa de la deng sang stod pa'i 'tsho byed rnams lce myang tshar yong tuyongs3grags su byed pa de nyid 'khrul med yin la/shing sman dbyibs ba le ka 'dra ba la srug ngam yod pa'i ro shin tu tsha ba lho rong nas 'ong ba de tsi tra ka 'khrul med yin pas ma nor bar shes dgos so// khyung sder dkar smug dug tshad sel bar byed// ces pa snga phyi'i 'grel pa rnams su khyung sder 'dra ba las btags shing dkar smug ni kha dog gis phye bar 'dod la/mes po'i zhal lung du/ khyung sder dkar smug ni da lta sngo'i shing gi rtse mo sor gcig tsam sder mo'i rnam par yod pa de la ngos 'dzin 'khrul ba yin min brtag par bya'o// zhes gsungs so// dpa' bo dkar po dpa' rgod de bzhin no// zhes bya ba la/ phyi ma rgyud kyi sman ngo gsal byed du/ dpa' bo la dkar po ser po gnyis te dkar po la ru se da dang dpa' rgod gnyis/ ru se da zhes bya ba rtsa ba la phug 'dra ba'i neng la sga'i khong spu 'dra ba yod/ dpa' rgod ni dbyibs dpa' bo dkar po 'dra ba la phreng ba brgyus pa ltar rdog po sbreng tshar yod do// zhes gsungs/ skyems pa tshe dbang rgyal pos gzhan snga ma dang 'dra ba la dpa' rgod la khong spu med/ ming glang chen kha chu glang chen chig thub zhes dang / dpa' bo dkar ser dpa' rgod gsum ga kha dog gi dbye ba tsam ma gtogs ro shin tu kha ba yin te ngo bo su mi sman dkar smug ser gsum yin zhes bshad do// rtsad dang rgya thub sdum stag dug nad sel// zhes bya ba la/su mi sman dkar dmar ser gsum la rtsad dang rgu thub char nyung khaṇḍa la 'dod par snga phyi'i 'grel pa phal cher mthun la/ bdag gi bla mas ni su mi sman la

166 ༄7khibri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/rigs dkar ser dmar gsum 'byung ba'i dkar po rtsad du bzhed cing dmar ser gnyis la rgu thub kyi ngos 'dzin mdzad do// mes po'i zhal lung du/rtsad ni spa—nga mtho sar lo ma go snyod 'dra ba la khrad por skye ba'i rtsad pa zer ba de'o// rgu thub ni lho mon nas 'byung la zhes pa tsam las gsal bar ma gsungs so// man ngag rgyud kyi sbyar dug gso bar yang / dpa' bo dkar ser khyung sder dkar smug gnyis// se rgod rgu thub gla rtsi re ral dang // zhes pa la 'grel ba 'dod 'jor/ rgu thub ni dpa' bo ser po'i rigags rgya bong 'dra ba ste/ glang chen chig thub ces bya'o// zhes bshad kyang / bka' mchan du/ klo mon nas byung ba'i su mi sman srug po yin/ char nyung khaṇḍa yin yang zer zhes gsungs pa ltar rgu thub kyi ngos 'dzin su mi sman la byas na mkhas pa'i dbang po legs bshad 'tshol gyi dgongs pa dang yang mthun par 'gyur ram snyam mo// dpa' bo ser pos gnyis go bcad na drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyi lugs dang 'gal bar 'gyur bas na bla rta tshe dbang rgyal po'i lugs 'di nyid ni legs par bshad pa'i cha tsam du yang ma mngon te/ bshad rgyud dang man ngag rgyud gnyis ka nas so sor gsungs pa'i phyir ro// der ma zad chos kyi rje zur mkhar ba 'tsho byed grub pas rin chen grang sbyor ril nag chen mor/ dpa' bo dkar po ser po dpa' rgod rnams zho re re/ su mi sman dmar ser gang yang rung ba zho do/ glang chen chig thub zho do zhes gsungs pa'i skabs su dpa' bo ser po gsum go gcod dgos par yang 'gyur te/dpa' bo dkar ser dpa' rgod gsum ni su mi sman dkar smug ser po gsum la khyod 'dod pa'i phyir dang / glang chen chig thub kyang dpa' ser dpa' rgod kyi ming gi rnam grangs yin par bshad gnang ba'i phyir ro// ldum stag ni bya phur leb yin te bye ba ring bsrel las/ ko byi la dang bya phur leb// ldum stag sngo leb yu can rnams// don gcig ming gi rnam grangs yin// zhes gsungs

༄7/dpal ldan rgyud bzhi'i dka' gnad dogs sel gyi zin bris/ 167so// sman rta bu ram grang rlung sel ba'i rta// ka ra khrag mkhris tsha ba sel ba'i rta// zhes dang / phyi rgyud du/ tsha sel thams cad ka ra drug 'gyur sbyar// grang sel thams cad bu ram bzhi 'gyur sbyar// zhes gsungs pa ni bu ram shing khu rnams bsil zhing khrag mkhris sel bar bshad kyang ka ra las nus pa dro zhikhu lci ba dang / de nyid lo gcig lon na nus pa drod bcud du 'gyur bas grang rlung sel ba dang / ka ra ni nus pa bsil ba'i mchog tu bshad pa las lo lon yang nus pa 'gyur tshul bshad med pa la dgongs pa 'dra yang dgongs 'grel mkhan 'ga' zhig ka ra dang bu ram dwangs snyigs kyi khyad par ma gtogs bur shing ngo bo gcig tu 'dod pa dag gis ni gzhung 'di nyid log par bkral ba tsam du ma zad/ yan lag brgyad pa rtsa 'grel dang yang 'gal ba yin te ji skad du/ de la ka ra dkar po'i shing // mngar dang bsil ba'i mchog yin la//de yi steng 'og sbub can yin// tshigs brgya pa dang kaṇḍa ra// bal yul skye sogs de las rim// cung zad tsha (tshwa3bro bska ba dang // dro bcas cung zad tsha ba skye// zhes bya ba rang 'grel du/ de las li kha ra dkar po'i shing ni ka ra da ste/ khu ba ni ro mngar la bsil/ mig rno/ rna ba gsang / sems bde bar 'gyur ro// yang bu ram shing phal pa bang sha ka zhes bya ba bu ram shing snga ma tsam du mi bzang ba zhig yod pa de'i mthu dang yon tan dang skyon ni gong ma dang 'dra mod kyi phan yon gong ma tsam du mi phod do// de la bu ram shing gi bye brag ni bu ram shing sha ta zhes bya ba gnag la sbom zhing ring ba dang / bu ram shing 'dra par pa ka zhes bya ba tshigs mang ba zhig yod pa dang bu ram shing ka ta ra zhes bya ba phra'u thung ngu zhig yod pa dang bal yul gyi bu ram shing la sogs pa 'di dag ro cung zad tsha (tshwa3bro ba dang bska ba dang zos na dro ba dang zhu ba'i rjes tsha bar 'gyur ro// bu ram shing 'di bzhi yang ming gi go rim bzhin 'og ma rnams cung zad tsam gyis ro bro ba dang mthu'i shas chung ngo // dbu ba

168 〉〉khabri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/can lcibs (lci3 bad kan bskyed// sog byed gcin ni sbyong byed yin//dkar po bad kan cher mi bskyed// bshang dang gci ba bde bar 'byin//dmar nag phal cher srin bu khrag/ rkang tshil sha dang bad kan bskyed// ces bya ba la de la bu ram gyi bye brag ni rnam pa gsum ste bu ram bskol te gdus pa'i tshe kha'i dbu ba dang dri ma ngan pa gzhams (gzhab3pa'i 'og tu dbu ba can kha spris sla mo zhig yod pa de ni 'ju dka' ste lci/ sla ba 'byar bag yin te mchin pa'i nad bskyed pa dang bshang gci sra ba ma yin te snyi bar 'gyur ro// de ltar btsos shing gdus pa las bar nas 'byung ba ni bu ram zhes bya ste de la'ang bu ram dkar po ni mtshar du bad kan du 'gyur ba ni ma yin bshang gci gnyis kyangami sri ste bde bar 'ong ngo // bu ram dmar po rtsi gnag pa ni phal cher srin 'bu dang khrag dang sha tshil bskyed bad kan bskyed de mi bzang ngo / bu ram dkar po lo gcig lon pa phan chad rnying pa zhes bya ba ni zhim ste yid du 'ong / ci la'ang phan te rlung dang mkhris pa dang bad kan gyi nad gsum ga sel te dge'o// bu ram gsar pa ni bad kan bskyed/ pho ba'i me drod med pa byed de mi dge'o// de ltar bu ram gyi khu ba gdus pa'i zhabs nas byung ba de ni li khar (kha3rar 'gyur ro// hwags dang khaṇḍa ka ra dkar// rim gyis yon tan che ba ste// ro tsa glo gcong glo brdol dang // khrag dang mkhris pa rlung sel yin// zhes bya ba la tshul 'di 'dra bar kha ra dkar po bskol zhing gdus pa las kha ra'i bye brag rnam pa gsum du 'byung ba ste rim gyis zhes bya ba dang bar nas byung ba ni li kha ra bzang por bya ba'igargyu ste hwags yin no// zhabs nas 'byung ba ni li kha ra dkar po nyid yin no// de la mthu'i bye brag ni steng ma bas bar gyi bzang / bar ba bas zhabs kyi bzang ste glo gcong dang glo brdol dang khrag dang mkhris pa'i nad dang rlung nad sel/ khong du phan te bud med la phod cing ro tsa bar 'gyur ro// a ba kha ra tsha zhing mngar bska ste yon tan

༄7/dasprol ldan rgyud bzhi'i dka' gnad dogs sel gyi zin bris/ 169de dang 'dra/ zhes bya la/ kha ra dang 'dra bar shing glang po tsher ma can gyi khu ba bskol ba las kha rar byas pa'ang li kha ra'i yon tan dang 'dra'o// kha ra dkar kun tsha dang skom// skyug bro rgyal dang mkhris pa sel// bu ram shing gdus kha ra dang // dbu ba can mchog tha ma yin// zhes bya ba la li kha ra dkar po thams cad kyi yon tan ni tsha ba dang skom pa dang skyug bro ba dang rgyal ba dang khrag dang mkhris pa'i nad 'di rnams sel 'gyur ro// de las mdor na bu ram shing las gdus te bu ram gyi dbu ba kha spris sla bar 'ong ba de lta bu ngan no// bu ram gyi shing yang rung kha ra'i shing yang rung ste de las byas pa'i kha ra dkar po ni bzang ste dge'o// zhes gsungs so// de ltar bu ram gyi khu ba gdus pa'i zhabs nas byung ba ni li kha rar 'gyur ro// tshul 'di dang 'dra bar kha ra dkar po bskol zhing gdus pa las kha ra'i bye brag rnam pa gsum du 'byung ste/ zhes bu ram gyi dwangs ma li kha ra dang kha ra dang kha ra dkar po so sor 'dra mtshungs su bshad pas 'dra ba'i phyir na dngos ma yin pa dang bu ram shing yang rung kha ra'i shing yang tha dad du gsung bas so// zla zer las kyang de la zhes bya ba ni bu ram shing de rnams kyi nang nas kha ra dkar po'i bu ram shing ni bsil ba dang dwangs shing dri ma med pa dang mngar ba'i mchog ste dam pa yin no// zhes dang / hwags zhes bya ba ni bu ram gyi dwangs ma'i sha kha ra ste gal la zhes ming du grags pa'o// khaṇḍa ni de bas kyang dwangs shing dri ma med pa'o// kha ra dkar po ni de bas kyang ches dwangs shing rnyogs pa med pas kha ra dkar po'o// zhes logs su bkar ba dang kha ra dkar po kun tsha ba snyoms/skyugs bro brgyal ba dang bad mkhris sel/ zhes bya la kha ra 'di dag dang gzhan gang dag yod pa de thams cad ni tsha ba la sogs pa sel zhing 'jam pa yin no// bu ram shing gdus pa ni kha ra dang / dbu ma can mchog tha ma yin/zhesakhya ba la bu ram shing gdus pa ni bu ram shing gi khu ba gdus pa rnams kyi

170 ༄7ku'abri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/nang nas kha ra ni mchog yin la zhes gsungs pa 'dis kyang ka ra dang bu ram shing tha dad du go nus pa yin no// des na phyi rgyud kyi rnam bshad lag len gsal byed du/ bu ram dang ka ra ni rgyu mi gcig cing ming bu ram gyi zhabs nas byung ba la li kha rar 'gyur ba ni bur dkar dang rgyal mo ka ra zhes bya ste li kha ra dang 'dra ba yin gyi dngos po ni ma yin no// ka ra dkar po'i shing las ka ra'i bye brag tu byung ba rmudang po byung ba kha spris dang 'dres pa la sha kha ra'i hwags sam gal la zhes bya'o// de'i zhabs nas byung ba khaṇḍa zhes pa dum bu'i gong bu ste dkar chung zhes bya ba gong bur dril ba de'o// de'i zhabs su chags pa shin tu dwangs ba ni ka ra dkar po ste 'dra mtshungs las btags pa bye ma ka ra dang shel ka ra zhes grags pa de'o// lo chen rin chen bzang po'i dngos slob spu hreng gi mkhas pa mi bzhi sogs yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa rtsa 'grel la bshad 'grel mdzad pa'i 'chad srol ma nyams pa'i lugs su bkod pa yin zer ba 'grel ba legs bshad rgya mtsho zhes bya bar bu ram dkar smug tsher bu dang gsum zhes dang / ka ra shel dang bye ma 'dam ka ra ste rigs gsum mo zhes bshad 'dug pa ni shin tu 'thad par sems so// zhes so//le'u nyer drug par/ span pa mkhas pa'i stegs la 'dzegs pa dang //zhes pa la/ bka' bochan gyi 'bru gnyer ba sman pa mkhas pa sbyangs pa'i go 'phang gi stegs la 'dzegs pa ste/ yon tan gyis mngon par mtho ba dang /zhes dang / mes po'i zhal lung las/ sman pa gang zhig mkhas pa'i stegs lta bu blo gros dang sbyangs pa dang snyan grags dang kun gyis bkur ba dang bzhi la 'dzegs pa'i rig pa'i gnas lnga spyi dang khyad par gso ba rig pa'i mngon pa mtho ba dang / zhes dang 'grel ba snga ma dag las/ rkang stegs su bkral ba la stegs yin na rkang pa'i stegs yin pas ma khyab ste/ yon tan gyi mngon par mtho ba lta bu'i yon tan gyi stegs yin la de nyid rkang pa'i stegs su mi rung

༄7/dpal ldan rgyud bzhi'i dka' gnad dogs sel gyi zin bris/ 171ba'i phyir/ des na tsa ra ka las/ sman pa blo ldan shes rab can// rang gi yon tan phun sum tshogs// snying rje'i sems kyis brlan pa gang // sman pa kun gyi spyi rgyan yin// zhes gsungs pa'i don te gang la'ang blo gros chags thogs mi mnga' ba'i shes rab ni mkhas pa'i stegs te de dang ldan pa ni 'dzegs pa'o//le'u so gcig par/ rig pa'i gnas mchog bco brgyad thugs su chud//ces pa la/ rig pa'i gnas mchog ni/ rnying ma'i rgyud bdud rtsi bam po brgyad pa dang / 'dul ba lung gi rnam 'byed dang / bye brag rtogs byed dang /skyes rabs kyi 'grel ba rnams su yang gsungs kyang / mdzod rang 'grel du/rol mo 'khrig thabs 'tsho tshis grangs dang sgra// gso dpyad chos lugs bzo 'pho ('phongs3 gtan tshigs dang // rnal 'byor thos pa dran pa skar ma'i dpyad// rtsis mig 'phrul 'khor sngon rabs sngon byung rig/ 'di dag rig pa'i gnas chen bco brgyad do// zhes gsungs pa nyid mdor bsdus pa yin no// gzhan gyi bya ba la brtson nad pa de// de don phyi bshol bar du ma chod par// zhes pa la/ mes po'i zhal lung du/ 'di skabs kyi gzhan gyi bya ba ni nad pa ste de'i don lan gcig brtsams nas shi gson thag ma chod kyi bar du phyi bshol dang bya ba gzhan gyis bar ma chod par rtse gcig tu sgrims par bya dgos te/ zhes dang / 'phags pa sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa zhes bya ba'i mdo las/ rtsi dang sman gyi sbyin pa yis// sems can thams cad tshe dpag med// thams cad mkhyen pa'i bdud rtsi yang // myur ba nyid du thob 'gyur cig/ rtsi dang sman gyi sbyin pa yis// zla ba nya ltar nad med cing // gnod chung skyid cing bde bar gnas// mi rnams tshe ni ring bar 'gyur// zhes dang /spyod 'jug las/ 'gro ba nad pa ji snyed pa// nad gsos 'gyur gyi bar dag tu// sman dang sman pa dag dang ni// de yi nad g.yog byed par shog/ ces

172 ༄7khabri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/dang / dkon mchog brtsegs pa'i sdom gsum bstan pa'i le'ur/ sman min sbyin par mi bya zhing // sbyin par byed pa dag kyang spangs// lha rnams de la 'phya bar byed// sems can sdug bsngal myong bar 'gyur// phyogs dang phyogs mtshams 'gro byed cing // mya ngan zug rngus gnod par 'gyur// mya ngan rnam pa mang po yis// de ni yun ring mnar bar 'gyur// mya ngan gyur nas 'chi dus byed// de lta bas ni de mi bya// zhes dang / gzhan dag la sman ma yin pa sbyin par mi bya zhing gang dag de lta bu byed pa de dag la'ang brten par mi bya'o//zhes sogs rgyas par gsungs pa dang / 'di nyid du/ sman pa'i 'bras bu gnas skabs mthar thug gnyis// gnas skabs 'bras bu tshe 'dir skyid pa dang // dbang dang longs spyod dga' bde ldan par 'gyur// zhes dang /mthar thug 'bras bu g.yo sgyu 'dod pa rnams// spang nas nad pa gso ba la 'jus/ pa// bla med sangs rgyas sa la bgrod 'gyur zhes// mtsho mdzad sman pa'i rgyal pos bshad pa yin// zhes gsungs pa na/ 'di lta bu yon tan dang nyes dmigs gnyis ka la dgongs nas gso ba rig pa thugs nyams su bzhes pa rnams la sman par grags pa ni phan par byed pa po ste/ bdag po'i sgra yin pas mtshan don dang mtshungs par sems can rnams la phan pa sgrub pa dang gnod pa spang pa'i spang blang go ma ldog pa'i brtson 'grus la brtson par mdzad pa cis nas kyang zhu'o zhes bdag dkon mchog 'gro phan dbang pos smra zhing /nges tshig nad gso lus la phan phyir sman// nad steng dpyad dpa' 'gro la pha ltar skyob// ces gsungs pa'i don la yang bsam par bya'o zhes so//gsum pa/ man ngag rgyud kyi dka' gnad dogs sel/le'u gnyis par/ brla rengs ma zhu bad chil skyes pa 'i phyir// de la

༄7/dpal ldan rgyud bzhi'i dka' gnad dogs sel gyi zin bris/ 173snum 'chos spang la rtsub bcos bya// zhes tsub bcos ni bshad rgyud kyi nyams dmad snyung ba dang phyi rgyud kyi bkres skom dugs bya skyug tu gzhug sran ma so ba dar snyigs dwangs chang bsten pa sogs yin zhes bka' mchan du gsung la/dwangs chang ni so ba dang yos chang rnying pa bsing pa'i dwangs ma ste/ so ba sred skyosre3da yos chang yang ba yin/ zhes dang gsar pa lci zhing rnying pa yang ba yin/zhes dang / chang ni dwangs ma sga chu bskol ba btung / zhes sogs kyi shugs las dpag pa'o// zhes phyi ma rgyud kyi rnam bshad lag len du bshad/ chil zhugs brla rengs phyug po'i rlung ltar gso// zhes phyug po ni rtag tu kha zas snum pa bza' bar goms pa'i phyir snum 'chos kyis rlung mi sel bas gong gi brla rengs kyi skabs ltar tsub bcos bya'o zhes bka' mchan las so// 'di ni yan lag gi rma gso bar/ spyir na bsil gyis ma thub log gnon drod// drod kyis ma thub de yi log gnod bsil// log gnod dus tshod sbyor shes man ngag gnad// dus min log gnon 'khrul sbyor rmongs pa yin// zhes gsungs pa'i dgongs pa dang mthun pa yin pas sngon du tsub chos byas te bad tshil zad nas slar snum 'chos bya dgos pa yang 'byung bas na rig pas dpyad dgos so//sorakhur dur (zhugs dugs3dang me btsa' bcud bzhi'i thang // zhes bya ba'i bcud bzhi'i thang ni gong du sha mar bur rnying chang du gdus pa'i thang //rlung nad kun sel mchog tu so la phan// zhes pa de yin la bka' mchan du rtsa 'bru tshil rkang zhes 'byung ba yig nor te ngo bo ni rtsi'i bcud mar/ 'bru'i bcud chang / shing gi bcud bu ram/ sha bcud bzhi la dgongs pa yin zhing /sha mar bu ram gsum po lo lon pa rnying pa dang chang ni gsar pa yin no//le'u gsum par/ sku mdos sngo mdos gser mdos la sogs mngags(bsngags1/ / zhes pa bka' mchan gyis go bder bkrol ba dpal ldan lha mo'i sku mdos/ mtsho sman gyi sngo mdos/ byang sman gyi gser mdos/ gzhan

174 ༄7/khabri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/gang 'grub dang gzungs sgrub gtor ma gsung sgrog dbang bskur zhu gesogs mngags/ zhes 'byung ba ltar bya'o// le'u bzhi par/ sgyid pa skyur pa ni las la 'jug mi spro ba ste lus nyobs pa dang don gcig par zla zer las bshad/ sna la sna rgyungs dud pa rjon pos bdug/ ces pa sna la zhugs pa phyi rgyud ltar sna sbyong dang / yan lag brgyad par/ skyer ba yung ba ldong ros ba bla tsan dan dkar po a bar skyur gsum rnams kyi dud pa rnon pos bdug ces bka' mchan gyis bkrol ba'o//le'u lnga par/ se 'dru bse yab star bu 'u su dang // ma nu utpal tha bra ling dang bdun// zhes pa 'di mjug don gyi le'u smug po'i nad la gnyen po bdun sbyor mchog ces gsungs pa de 'di yin no//le'u bdun par/ 'gyur tshul kha zas gyong chil sbang ma sogs// zhes pa la 'di ni de dag 'dres pa'i don te sbrags ma yin no zhes skyems pa tshe dbang rgyal po'i 'grel pa 'dod 'jor bshad pas yi ge pas ga sa la kyog nga ru 'khrul ba'i shugs las ba'i ra btags kyang dor ba yin no// zug che skyug cingazungs gsum shor na spang // zhes pa phyi lus kyi zungs sha shor bas mur gong sogs rdib/ srog rlung gi zungs shor bas rtsa la shed med/ nang me drod kyi zungs shor bas zas la dang ga med cing zos kyang mi 'ju ba'o// zhes bka' mchan las so// 'di ni bshad pa'i rgyud las/ phyi nang srog zungs sha zas rtsa dang gsum// shor ba'i nad pa gang yin 'chi bar 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa'i dgongs don yin zhes so//le'u dgu skyobacu3par/ tsha chu rgyas thebs mi skye che ring ste// phug na srog yin myur du 'chi bar 'gyur// zhes pa dzi na mi tra'i gzhung las/ dmu chu rgya yis thebs pa ni// bshal gyis mi 'drong chu rgyas thebs// btsag (gtsagakatu mi btub lus zungs yin// chu rgyas thebs pa'i skye thag chod// tshe ring gso

176 sa༅/khabri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/phyug khros pa drag po byas pa'i dpral ba'i mig ces sbyar bas gsum ga mthun par 'gyur ba yin no zhes bshad/ mchod sbyin brlag pa dang drag po gnyis ka dbang phyug chen po'i ming gi rnam grangs su mngon brjod kyi gzhung chen mo rnams las bshad pas gong ltar yin dgos so// ma mo mkha' 'gro zad 'khrug rgyu las byung / zhes pa la/ bka' mchan du/ gsung rab rnams su ma mo dang mkha' 'gro rnams la rims nad gtong ba'i rigs sngags yod pas na de'i mthus nad yams gtong bar gsungs pas lo rgyus mang ngo zhes gsungs/ de ltar yang rbad pa las rims nad 'byung ba ni 'dod khams dbying tudabyings3phyug ma'i bskul las/ g.yon pa nad kyi rkyal pa ni// nad kyi rkyal pa 'phyar zhing g.yab// dam nyams dgra la nad yams 'bebs// zhes pa lta bu dang /'khrug pa las byung ba ni bal nad gso ba'i le'ur/ rims zhes bya ba'i nad 'byung rgyu rkyen ni// lnga brgya dus kyi tha mar 'gyur tsa na// mi rnams 'dod pa'i dbang gis log par spyod// sngags pa rnams ni rdo rje'i nang dme dar// dge 'dun btsun pa rnams ni sde 'khrug byed// mu stegs ban bon rnams ni zor kha 'phen// skye bo rnams ni mna' 'thab bshan dmar byed// de dus ma mo mkha' 'gro kun 'khrugs te// nad kyi mkha' rlangs sprin du chags pa las//bal nad rgyu gzer gag lhog 'brum nag 'byung ka zhes dang / bdud rtsi bum chen las/ snyigs ma'i dus kyi sems can rnams// log pa'i spyod pa sna tshogs spyod// sngags pa rtsa ba'i dam tshig nyams// btsun pa'i rtsa ba'i 'dul khrims nyams// skya bo ngo tsha khrel las bud// dge bshes 'khrug pa'i yo langs byed// ston pa'i dam chos zong du 'tshong // rnal 'byor tho cos nya ma bslu//sgom chen rdzun gyis bud med gso// bla ma dkon mchog rgyab tu skyur// 'jig rten lha 'dre srog bzhin mchod// log pa'i spyod pa sna tshogs ni// rang gis spyad pas rang nyid 'phung // zhes dang / a (pha3bdud rgyal po gza' mchog

178 ༄7/'bri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/rang grub kyi gsangs stong skya khyil le ba'am sngo khyil le ba/ 'bur nyams dang kong nyams dang srab pa'i nyams kyi rdol la khad yod pa der 'dzug dgos pa sogs lag len gyi gnad 'gag mthong rgyud (brgyud1ltar bya dgos so// zhes so//le'u so lnga par/ lud pa dmar na rgya skyegs 'bri mog btsod// ces pa 'og tu dmar po gsum zhes 'byung ba 'di yin no//le'u zhe brgyad par/ go chen go chung ske stong thur mas gseng // zhes par go chen go chung ni rgyud phyi ma'i thur gsang du/ bya rog mig nas phyir mtshon gang bcal ba'i// rtsib bar gong 'og go che go chung gsang // zhes pa de yin la bya rog mig ni rgyud 'di'i le'u gya lnga par/ dkar nag mtshams nas gyen du mtshon gang bcal// de nas g.yas g.yon gnyis su mtshon re dang //phun re bcal ba dpal khab gsang sa yin// de steng mtshon gang bcal ba thug khab gsang // de steng mtshon gang bcal ba bya rog mig/ ces so//dkar nag gi mtshams ni phyi rgyud me gsang du nu ma'i dkyil thad brang gzhung dkar nag mtshams/ zhes gsungs pas ske stong nas lhon sna'i bar gyi gzhung thig dang nu ma brang dkyil gyi 'phred thig 'dzoms pa'i rgya gram de yin la mthe bong gi tshigs pa dang po yan la mtshon re dang de phyed phyed la sor re dang phun re zhes 'byung / 'di tsho byang khog yul thig dang bcas te blo la nges dgos pa yin no zhes so//le'u drug cu re bzhi par/ mtshal ma ('dra3bcad de sha ma li yi shun//zhes pa la/ 'grel ba 'dod 'jor/ tsa ri rong skor nas shing gi tsha tsa tutsha3yin zer khyer yong ba de yin/ ma rnyed na mon cha ra'i shing shun gyis tshab rung zhes bshad pa 'bri gung bka' mchan du yang drangs kyang sha ma li zhes pa mon cha ra dang de'i shing gnyis ka'i dngos ming du sgra sbyor nges par gsungs la/

༄7/dpal ldan rgyud bzhi'i dka' gnad dogs sel gyi zin bris/ 179ngos 'dzin pa'i tshe na lo chen rin bzang gi dngos slob spu hreng gi mkhas pa mi bzhi'i 'chad srol bsten pa stod lugs su grags pa rnams ni deng sang gi ge sar gsum ldan yin zer ba 'di la bzhed de ngo bo ming don brda sprod dag pa rnams su/ mon char khrag rkyal skam po 'dra/ zhes 'byung ba dang yang mthun pa yin zer yang chos kyi rje zur mkhar ba brgyud bcas ni rje g.yu thog zhabs kyi shing be nag gi thang chu la ngos bzung nas mon cha ra ni khrag skam 'dra/ zhes dang / rje rang byung rdo rjes sman ming rgya mtshor/ be nag 'bras bu mon cha ra//'khru ba gcod pa'i gdams pa yin// zhes gsung pas shing be nag gi thang chu dang 'bras bu gnyis ka la zer ro// zhes so// 'di la sogs pa deng sang stod lugs dang smad lugs su grags pa'i sman gyi ngos 'dzin mi 'dra ba mang du snang ba la ro nus kyi khyad par shin tu che bar 'byung bas blo dang ldan pa rnams kyis legs par dpyad de ngos bzung gzhi ma dag rgan po'i cal sgrog gi rjes zlos la yid rton par mi bya'o//le'u don bzhi par/ mo nad gtso bo sum cu rtsa bzhi dang // zhes pa 'dir dpe rnying dag pa gnyis dang / 'grel ba 'dod 'jo dang / mes po'i zhal lung mthun par rtsa gnyis zhes pa khungs bzung zhing grangs 'grig pa yin zhes bka' mchan las so//le'u gya gsum par/ ngan pa sdud sgo bzhir phogs 'chi ba'i gnas//zhes pa la/ bka' mchan du/ so ma rwa (rā1dzar/ khru phyed pa ste spyi gtsug nas// de 'then pa ni thod pa'o// de lteb pa ni 'dus so gsum// rna ba'i ltag tu sleb pa ni// lha rtsa dag ni khyi nyal lo// de nas me thur gang bskor ba//(me long gang ste mtheb mtshon sgor// mtheb long dag tu shes par bya//) de ni sdud sgo bzhi dag ste// zhes gsungs pas don rang rang so sor sor nyer bzhi khru gang yin pas phyed de sor bcu gnyis re spyi gtsug nas rgyab mdun du gzhal

180 ༄༅khabri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/ba thod pa'i tshad dang de lteb pa sor drug re mdun rgyab dang rna ltag g.yas g.yon du 'then pa 'dus so gnyis dang lha rtsa khyi nyal gnyis te 'phrad nyal gnyis so// de ltar 'dus so gnyis dang khyi nyal gnyis te bzhi po'i sar mtshon bskor ba'i rgya tshad ni sdud sgo zhes bya'o// zhes gsungs pa 'di yang gal che ba zhig yin no// sha 'u rnam gsum zam thog ldog mi srid// ces klad pa'i nye'u bye tshe mig nas khubyi ba'i nu ma 'dra/ rus pa'i se'u lha mig nas 3yungs dkar gtor ba lta bu dang sha'i sha'u kha sha'i dbus sam steng nas dmar zal sran bzod chung ba gsum po zam thog pa ste 'brel ba'o// zhes bka' mchan las so// dom pa la zhes par 'grel ba 'dod 'jor do ba dang lang rtse'i zhes bshad kyang / brda sprod lnga par dom pa la'i mchan bur tsher sngon zhes 'byung ba dang legs bshad rgya mtshor dom pa la dang snyad 'tshol ral ba ni tsher sngon zhes bshad pas mgo rma'i skabs 'dir tsher sngon 'thad par snang ngo //le'u gya lnga par/ bcu gsum pa nas rtsa gnyis mchin par zug/ ces par 'dir gnyis ces pa ma dag ste gong du tshigs pa gsum pa'i thad nas srog rtsa las rtsa gsum mdun du byung ba snying dang glo bur zug pa gsum dang 'dir mchin par zug pa gcig de bzhin du mcher pa dang mkhal ma gnyis bsam se la'ang re re ste brgyad ni bshad rgyud du/ don snod nang 'brel sbas pa'i rtsa chen brgyad gsung pa de yin pa'i phyir/ 'dir gnyis byas na de bzhin zhes pa'i tshig gi nus pas mcher mkhal bsam ser yang gnyis gnyis zug par 'dod dgos pas sbas pa'i rtsa bcu gcig tu 'gyur ro// zhes bshad rgyud mes po'i zhal lung du gsungs pa bka' mchan du yang drangs so// da chu dug phral zho gcig ces pa la/ bka' mchan du/ dngul chu btso bkru sbyangs gsum byas pa/ zhes gsungs pa ltar yin dgos te da chu zhes pa dngul chu dang rgya mtshal gnyis ka'i ming du brda sprod lnga par bshad pas so// yang 'dod 'jor
