182 ༄7//'bri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/su yang sgog pa la lha'i bdud rtsi zhes btags pa med pas nor ro zhes gsungs/'di dag la sogs pa sman ming shes dgos gal che ba mang du yod pa ni 'grel ba 'dod 'jo dang bka' mchan du gsal bas de gnyis su blta bar bya zhing le'u lnga bcu pa'i bye rug brgyad pa'i shel rna la khungs mi snang bas don gnyer dag gis slar btsal dgos pa yod ces so// le'u gya brgyad par/ be log bshan pa'i khrag gis 'phog pa'i rkyen//zhes pa'i be log ni be'u khong du yod pa'i ma shi nas ro'i khong par be'u'i ro zhag lnga drug lus pa'i sha yin/ be'u khong shor gyi sha yin zer yang ma yin te shor ma thag gi sha la dug mi 'byung bas so// zhes dang / bshan pa'i khrag gis 'phog pa ni dgun gyi nyi ldog gi dus bshan pa'i lag pa la rma byung ba'i khrag sha la song ba zhag bdun nas dug tu 'gyur zhes bka' mchan las so// 'di dag kyang srog 'tsho'i slob dpon gyi bya ba yin pas shes dgos te/ bshad rgyud du/ rgyal po'i pho brang srog 'tsho'i slob dpon bzhag/ de ni zas skom dug las thar bar 'gyur// zhes gsungs pas so//le'u dgu bcu par/ rigs lnga yab yum byang sems 'phro 'du bya// zhes par thod pa'i sman gyi steng du rigs lnga yab yum gsal ba snyoms par zhugs pa'i sbyor mtshams nas byang sems dkar dmar babs pa sman la thim zhing mthar rigs lnga yab yum 'od du zhu nas sman la thim pas 'chi med kyi bdud rtsir gyur ba ha yighā bas bsrung bar bsam pa sogs bya/ zhes dang / spro bsdus phyogs bcu'i tshe bkug/ bum par bstim/ zhes par tshe dpag med kyi 'od zer phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad la 'phog de rnams kyi tshe bsod dbang thang dang 'gro ba rigs drug snod bcud thams cad kyi bcud dang phun tshogs thams cad bsdus te tshe dpag med kyi bum nang du thim par bsam zhes bka' mchan las te spro bsdu'i dmigs pa gong 'og 'di

༄7/dpal ldan rgyud bzhi'i dka' gnad dogs sel gyi zin bris/ 183gnyis ma shes na tshig tsam klags pas sman gyi byin rlabs mtshan nyid dang ldan pa mi 'byung bas nges dgos so// le'u go gcig par/ khri'u (khye'u3sus dus na khyem bu re re bsten//zhesakhya ba la sa dbang mchog zhabs nas khyi'u (khye'ukasus zhes bya ba gang gi ming yin gsungs pa la 'grel ba rnams su khyi'u skyokhye'u3gso ltar chung chung nyung nyung nas je cher btang ba'i don yin par bshad kyang man ngag rgyud du/ khyi'u (khye'u1sus na khyem bu re re bsten/ zhes khyi'u (khye'u3sus ni dus kho nar nges sbyar gsungs pa dang / yan lag brgyad pa dang 'bri gung bka' mchan du tho rengs kyi dus yin pa gsal bar gsungs/ 'dul ba la yang de dang 'dra ba zhig 'byung zhus slar bka' shog rin po che bstsal bar snga sor khyod kyis khyi'u (khye'u3sus zhes pa 'dul ba'i dus nas khyi'u (khye'u3sus mang du 'byung / de dag zas yang yang khyi'u skyikhye'u3gso ba ltar ster ba dang zas kyi dka' ba myong ba las tho rengs sogs dus nges sbyar du sbyar ba yan lag brgyad pa las ma gtogs 'dul ba las ma rnyed pas 'dul ba'i dus la sbyar ba gang na yod tshig gang yod gsal bar bskur zhes phebs pa la/ 'dul ba rnam 'byed du nang snga mo zas thog ma za ba la khyi'u (khye'u1sus su gsungs pa 'dra zhig yid la yod snyam byed kyang brjed ngad tungs1kyis tshig/ gsal 'bul ma thub par dbyings khrel mi 'khrungs pa mkhyen cing / mo nad bye brag bcos par nang par khyi'u tukhye'u1sus tshon re bsros kyin btang / zhes dang / yan lag brgyad pa'i rang 'grel las/ de la nang par khyi'u tukhye'ukasus su kha zas ma zos par sman za ba ni nad par pho ba'i drod che la be'u snabs kyang med de pho ba'i rtsa sgo rnams kyang ma 'gags la nad pa nyams dang ldan/ bad kan shes che ba'i mi de lta bu la sman khyi'u (khye'u3sus la btang na sman gyi mthu rab tu che bar 'gyur ro//zhes dang / brang ti 'jam dpal bzang po'i sde tshan lnga 'grel du/ khyi'u

184 ༄༅ltarabri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/(khye'u3sus zhes pa ni lto stong la bya'o zhes dang / sman pa kun mthun par sman mar dang lde gu sogs tho rengs lto stong la zo zhig ces pa yongs grags yin pas/ 'dul ba'i dus kyi khyi'u (khye'u1sus kyang 'di dag dang mi 'gal ba zhig yin nam snyam zhing chung chung nas je cher gtong ba'i don kho na 'chad pa 'di mi legs pa 'dra zhig lags zhus so//bzhi pa/ phyi rgyud kyi dka' gnad dogs sel/le'u dang por/ gso yul nad la bzhi brgya rtsa bzhir gsungs// rgyas par phye na stong dang nyis brgya yod// mdo ru bsdus pas bcos dgros brgya rtsa gcig/ ces pa la zur mkhar ba chos rje blo gros rgyal pos dri lan blo ldan rol mtshor/ bshad rgyud ces pa ni bshad pa'i rgyud yin pas/ gso yul gyi nad yin min rnam par ma phye ba'i sgo nas spyi tsam gyi nad bzhi brgya rtsa bzhir smos pa yin ste/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni de rnams kyi re re la slar yang kun btags sogs kyis rnam par phye nas bshad pa la nad kyi rnam dbye stong dang drug brgya bcu drug 'byung ba'i phyir/ phyi ma rgyud kyi skabs 'dir 'dren lugs de ltar byas na mi 'ong ste/ 'dir ni nad dang gnyen po gnyis ka mdo don du dril te nyams su blang dgos pa'i phyir/ des na dpyod ldan rnams kyis gso yul zhes pa dang / bcos dgos zhes pa'i tshig zur tsam gyis rtogs par nus pa dang /sman pas gso bar bya ba'i yul yin pa zhig nges par dgos rgyu yin te/ srog gcod nad dgu'am gzhan dbang sngon las kyi nad rnams ni sman pas gso bar bya ba'i yul ma yin pa'i phyir ro// des na skabs 'dir 'thad pa'i 'dren tshul ni/ bshad rgyud nas bshad pa'i nyes pa gtso bo rigs gnas kyi sgo nas phye ba bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi la kun brtag pa yongs grub ltar snang gi nad

༄7/dpal ldan rgyud bzhi'i dka' gnad dogs sel gyi zin bris/ 185gsum sbyar bas gso yul rgyas pa stong dang nyis brgya bcu gnyis 'byung zhing /gzhung tshig tu bcu gnyis zhes pa dngos su ma gsal yang shugs las rtogs dgos te/ gzhung du tshigs bcad ldum bde ba'i dbang du byas pas so//'bring du bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi ni de'i nang nas yongs grub kyi nad bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi po de yin la bcos dgos brgya rtsa gcig po ni de'i yang nang nas gang rung gcig la 'dod dgos te/ bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi po de yang ming 'dogs phyogs tsam ma gtogs don la brgya rtsa gcig kho nar 'dus pa'i phyir ro//des na phyi ma rgyud kyi skabs 'dir gnas kyi dbye ba'i brgya rtsa gcig la yongs grub kyi nad sbyar ba 'di nyid legs pa yin no// zhes dang / mes po'i zhal lung du/ gzhan snga ma 'dra ba la khyad par ni de ltar rnam pa du ma'i sgo nas ji tsam du phye yang nyes pa gsum du ma 'dus pa'i nad med pas na nyes pa phye ba brgya rtsa gcig po la yongs grub kyi nad sbyar ba'i brgya dang rtsa gcig po ni 'di skabs kyi bcos dgos brgya dang rtsa gcig yin par shes par bya'o// zhes gsungs shing / gso yul gyi dbye ba rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum ga phyi rgyud kho na'i dgongs don du bshad pa 'dra zhig byung / skyems pa tshe dbang rgyal pos rnam bshad lag len gsal byed du/ rang lugs bzhag pa ni bshad rgyud du/nyes pa'i dbye ba brgya rtsa gcig gtso bo'i dbye ba brgya rtsa gcig rigs kyi dbye ba brgya rtsa gcig gnas kyi dbye ba brgya rtsa gcig ste bzhi brgya rtsa bzhir gsungs pa 'di nyid nad kyi tshul gcig tu gyur pa'i phyir bcos dgos pa brgya rtsa gcig ste/ dper na lus dang sems skyon dang yon tan gyi dbye ba thams cad 'dus pa gang zag gcig yin pa bzhin no// de nyid rgyu nyes gsum 'dus pa rang rgyud can 'phel zad/ gzhan rgyud can ldan 'dus bla gnyan sogs su gyur nas gnas lugs kyi cha shas rnams su lhan gcig pa'i tshul gyis gnod byar gyur pa'i ngo bo la nad 'di dang 'di'o zhes ming gis btags shing

186 ༄7khibri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/rigs su dbye ba brgya rtsa gcig po la ltar snang kun brtags gzhan dbang yongs grub bzhi sbyar bas 'bring du gsungs pa'i bzhi brgya rtsa bzhir yang 'gyur te de ltar nyes pa gtso bo rigs kyi sgo nas bzhi'i zhes pa nas gcig la'ang bzhi sbyar bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi gyur/ zhes pa'i bar du gsungs pas so//zhes dang bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi la rnam grangs ltar snang kun brtags yongs grub gzhan dbang ste de dag mnyam pa'i phyir bzhi brgya rtsa bzhir gsungs zhes grags tshod tsam ni man ngag rgyud du rgyas par phye ba ste/ thog mar rlung gi nad la rigs kyi dbye ba nyi shu/ zhes pa nas/ bud med tsam btsal ba la lnga ste dril bas stong dang nyis brgya'o// zhes pa'i bar dang bcos dgos brgya rtsa gcig la rang lugs gnyis su bzhag par dang po lag len rin chen spungs pa la skyes pa'i nad gsum bud med nad gnyis dang / byis pa'i nad lnga rgas pa'i nad rigs gnyis/ kun khyab thun mong nad rigs brgyad cu dgu/ zhes 'byung ba ltar bshad pas rigs kyi dbye ba brgya rtsa gcig la 'dod par snang ngo // 'ju mi pham chos kyi bla mas bcos dgos brgya rtsa gcig man ngag rgyud kyi skabs bco lnga dang sbyar nas bshad/ de ltar smad lugs su grags pa'i bshad srol gyi gzhung shing 'dzin pa rnam gsum bzhed pa cung zad mi mthun pa ni 'ju mi pham chos kyi bla ma dang skyems pa tshe dbang rgyal po gnyis man ngag rgyud du/ spyi bo'i gtsug nas rkang mthil yan chad kyi// nad kyi rigs su gyur pa'i bcos thabs kun// lag len man ngag rgyud chen 'di'i nang du// brtse ba'i sems kyis drang srong khyod la bshad// ces gsungs pa la dgongs shing / chos rje blo gros rgyal pos ni/ gso tshul dgu bshad rgyud dang brtag thabs dang gso thabs kyi 'khrul gzhi gal 'gag bzhi po man rgyud la kha 'phangs pa tsam ma gtogs gso yul gyi nad gso byed kyi gnyen po dang gso thabs kyi lag len gsum ga la rgyas 'bring bsdus kyi sgo nas dbye bsdu mdzad pa phyi ma rgyud kho na'i dgongs don

༄7/dpal ldan rgyud bzhi'i dka' gnad dogs sel gyi zin bris/ 187du 'chad par mdzad do// 'di dag phyi ma rgyud kyi sdom tshig yin/ zhes gsungs pa la dgongs pa 'dra'o// 'dir dgos pa'i gnad ni/ de ltar sman pa'i gso yul du gyur pa'i nad kyi rnam dbye rgyas par phye ba la stong dang nyis brgya bcu gnyis las med pa las man ngag rgyud du/ a ru 'bri mar rlung nad stong la phan/ zhes dang me drod nyams dang grangarkend stong la phan/ zhes dang rgyud 'di nyid du mkhal rked chu sri grang nad stong la phan/ zhes grang rlung gnyis ka gso yul du gyur pa stong phrag gnyis 'byung ba mang ches so snyam na skyon med de bshad rgyud las rnam pa'i sgo nas dpag tu med par dbye/ nyes pa gnod bya nyi shu rtsa lnga la// rkyang pa ldan 'dus du ma'i rigs 'byung bas//grangs dang ming gi nges bstan yod ma yin// zhes gsungs pa la mes po'i zhal lung du/ rnam grangs grangs med trem du bgrangs pas so// de dag la gso ba'i las mi 'jug pa yang ma yin te/ zla zer las/ nad gang rnam par gyur pa thams cad kyi ming rwa nas bzung ba'i tshul du bsdus te bstan mod kyi ming med pa'i nad dag kyang snang bas de dag kyang gso bar bya ste/ gang gi phyir na/ nad gzhi med par nad kyi rnam pa yod pa ni mi srid do// de bas na 'dir smras pa ni/ nad la rnam par mi mkhas zhes// ngo tsha nam yang ma byed cig/ nad kyi 'gyur ba thams cad kyi// ming gi nges bstan yod ma yin//zhes bya ba ste/ zhes gsungs pas so// deng sang gi sman pa la la grang nad stong la phan zer rgyu yin pa zhes smra ba la ni shes byed med cing / don tsha snod la grang ba 'byung srid de// snod tsha don la grang ba byung mi srid// stod smad gnyis kyang de bzhin shes par bya// zhes gsungs pa dang 'gal bar 'gyur ro// lta dus mkha' la nyi shar klungs ma phebs// zhes pa ni/ so ma rwa (rā3dzar/dus ni snang ba 'ong ba dang // mun pa dag ste ri rtse la// nyi ma shar ba dag la ni// sribs kyi ngad pa gyes pa dang // gdags kyi ngad pa ma g.yos pas//

188 ༄7khibri gung sman rtsisaphyogs bsgrigs/dus kyi dbang thang de ru rgyu// zhes gsungs la de'i don bshad pa snyan brgyud rdo rje'i tshig rkang du/ yar mthar skya rengs shar ba nas// mar mthar ri rtse nyi shar ba// de yi dus na 'tshams par rgyu// zhes so// bcu gnyis ma 'dres pha tse'ige so 'dra// zhes pa'i don rtsa drug snod rtsa drug ste bcu gnyis so sor ma 'dres pa phyir rgyu don rtsa dang nang rgyu snod rtsa yin pa'i nges pa gsal por ston nus pa'i don te dper na pha tse'i re so ni rgyu khog dag grangs dang mnyam pa thags su btags pa na skas 'dzing pa'i dbang gis dkar po steng du don tshe nag po 'og tu song bas dkar nag spel ba 'byung ba bzhin du 'dir yang mtshon (tshon3gyi yar zur snying gi rtsa gdags te kha dog dkar ba'i rnam pa/mar zur rgyu ma'i rtsa sribs te nag pa'i rnam pa yid yul du byas pa ste gzhan rnams la'ang 'gre'o// dpangs grangs skugs gsum ngos 'dzin ni rje zur mkhar bas/ dpangs dang grangs dang snyugs gsum ni// mtho dman mang nyung ring thung yin// zhes gsungs te rtsa ba'i dpangs mtho dman grabs mang nyung snyug ste gting ring thung gi don yin no// zhes pa'o// de yang tsha ba'i rtsa grangs mang ba dang grang ba'i rtsa grangs nyung ba gzhir bzhag la dpangs gzhug thun mong du sbyar te dpangs dang grangs kyi tsha ba 'khrugs rims gsar//snyugasatpa tsha ba rnyings pa'i tsha ba yin// zhes dang / skugs grangs gsar la grangs dpangs rnying par 'dod ces gsungs so// de ltar yang tsha ba me'i rang bzhin can gsar pa'i dus bad rlung dang bsdongs pas rlung tshad ga nyis las rtsa dpangs mtho zhing grangs mang la/ rnyings na rlung zhi ste bad kan dang tsha ba bsdongs pas rtsa snyugs te gting na grims mgyogs su 'phar ba dang grang ba chu'i rang bzhin can yin pas gsar pa'i dus rtsa snyugs te gting du grangs nyung par 'phar la/ rnyings nas sa chu'i nus pa chung du song ste dpangs mtho bar 'gyur ba mngon sum du snang bas grub pa yin no// zug chu'i rtsa ni zhar

290༄tsho//gso ba'i gdams pa kun gyi yang snying gces bsdus las mgo gsang mig gsang gi zin bris bzhugs so//dang po/ mgo ga—sang mig gsang gi zin bris/mgo yi sdud sgo bzhi zhes pa// gtsug nas mdun rgyab g.yas g.yon du//rang mtho re re thod pa'i tshad// de btab pa ni 'dus so gsum// de nyid rna rtags tultag3g.yas g.yon du// 'then pa 'phrad khu'aphred3nyal steng yin te//de bzhir mtshon re bskor ba la// me thur gsang zhes bshad pa 'di// sdud sgo rnam pa bzhi yin no// de nyid so ma ra turā3dza'i lugs// lag len dmar khrid yig chung las// 'khor lo ching tuchings1ni ltag par bsnol// de nas dpral zur g.yas su 'then// de bzhin rna rgyab g.yon dang g.yas// dpral zur g.yon dang ltag par 'then// rtsib lnga 'byung ngo ltag pa nas// smin dbrag 'then la ltag zur g.yas// rna mdun g.yon dang g.yas su 'then//de nas ltag zur g.yon 'then nas// smin dbrag 'then pas rtsib bcu 'byung // mig gi 'grib rgyun gcod byed ni// man ngag dbang po sbed byed las// ltag pa'i sdud sgo g.yas g.yon gnyis// mur 'gram ltag ral 'khyug rtsa gnyis// smin ma'i dbus gnyis de gong du// sor drug bcal dang sog mthil gnyis// 'grib byed rlung lam rtsa sgo bcu// nad kyi dbang las ji ltar dgag/ slob dpon mkhas pa'i phyag len dang // man ngag 'dod na gser

484༄khya// rgyud kyi 'gyur byang dang slob rgyun sor khru'i 'jal tshad/ dang po/ rgyud kyi 'argyur byang /swa sti bra dzā bhya/ srid pa'i rgyu 'bras duḥkha drung 'byin pa'i// zla med thugs rje chen po'i rang gzugs gang // bee ḍūrya snang zhing du rnam rol pa'i//sman pa'i rgyal pos 'gro 'di dge legs mdzod// de la 'dir shes bya rig pa'iganas lnga'i nang tshan las gzhan rjes su 'dzin pa la phyi'i rig gnas kyi gtso bor gyur pa gso ba rig pa 'di la 'phags bod rgya nag la sogs pa'i yul du drang srong dang paṇḍi ta la sogs pas brtsams pa'i bstan bcos mang du byung ba las/ rang cag kha ba can pa nyid dang nye bar 'tsham pa'i gso rig gzhung khyad par can du 'phags pa/ dpal ldan rgyud bzhi zhes yongs su grags pa 'di nyid/ chos rje rang byung ba dang / bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa dang / stag tshang lo tstsha shes rab rin chen/ dus phyis zur mkhar blo gros rgyal po sogs/ g.yu thog pa nyid kyis yan lag brgyad pa sogs 'phags yul gyi gzhung dang / so ma ra dzā sogs rgya nas bsgyur ba'i gzhung dang / 'khor lo rgyal po'i be bum sogs zhang zhung nas bsgyur ba'i gzhung rnams kyi dgongs pa blangs nas brtsams par bzhed pa dang / 'ga' zhig gis bdag cag gi ston pa sman rgyal gyi skur bzhengs nas/ rjes su gnang ba'i bka' dngos su bzhed pa dang / 'ga' zhig gis bka' dngos yin kyang / sngon slob dpon padmas

༄7// rgyud kyi 'gyur byang dang slob rgyun sor khru'i 'jal tshad/ 485bsam yas dbu rtser gter du sbas la/ grwa mngon dbang phyug 'bar gyis phyung ba'i gter mar bzhed pa sogs sna tshogs yod pa don la ji ltar yang snyigs ma'i dus kyi mi zad pa'i zug rngu drag po dus min du rnam par ldang ba'i gnyen por gyur pas/ skye dgu'i lus sems la sman bde'i bcud len ster bar byed pa'i tshig don gyi cha ches phun sum tshogs par/ mkhas pa rnams bzhed pa mthun pa ltar/ gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir gso ba rig pa'i khur 'dzin thams cad kyis bsten bya gcig pur gyur pa yin mod/ 'on kyang bar skabs dus dbang gis sman pa rnams kho nar ma zad/ rig gnas gang la'ang tshul bzhin slob pa mi 'byung zhing / bslab kyang shes pa nyung bas/ gzhung 'di'i 'chad nyan gyi srol ji lta ba nub pa la phyogs pa'i tshe/ zur mkhar ba mnyam nyid rdo rje'i rigs chos kyi dbon po mkhas dbang blo gros rgyal pos 'grel bshad dang / zhu chen gyis gtan la phab pa bzhin/ nang so yar rgyas pas par du brkos pa dang / de la'ang dpyad pas ma khyab pa'i nor lus kyi rnyog ma phran bu byung ba rnams/ mi dbang sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i rnam dpyod ke ta kas bgrungs pa'i lha ldan po ṭa la'i par ma 'di nyid kun gyis yid rton pa'i gnas su rung bar 'dug pa ltar/ de nyid las 'bru len gyi phyi mo zhus te/ sde dge bstan pa tshe ring gi lhag bsam rnam par dkar bas skye dgu rnams kyi phan bde dang / gso ba rig pa'i bstan pa gong nas gong du rgya cher spel ba'i slad du/rab nyi'i chu glang lor lhun grub steng gi chos grwa chen por par du bsgrubs pa 'di'i dge bas/ lus can kun gyi 'khor ba'i rgyu dug gsum gyis kun nas bslangs pa'i mi dge ba dang / 'bras bu tshor ba sdug bsngal skyed pa'i rnam 'gyur 'phel zad 'khrugs pa'i rang bzhin gyi gdung ba mtha' dag myur du zhi nas/ sman pa'i rgyal po'i gong shāriphang la gnas par gyur cig dpal ldan rgyud bzhi'i 'gyur byang yin pa dge'o//

486 ༄7//'bri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/gnyis pa/ dpal ldan rgyud bzhi'i slob rgyun/dpal ldan rgyud bzhi'i slob rgyun ni/ bcom ldan 'das sman gyi bla/drang srong rig pa'i ye shes/ yid las skyes/ 'tsho byed gzhon nu'i gsos/klu sgrub/ dpa' bo/ zla ba mngon par dga'/ lo tsā ba bee ro tsa na/ bla sman mkhas pa mi dgu/ mnga' bdag chos rgyal chen po/ gter ston grwa ba mngon shes/ dbus pa dar ma grags pa/ stod ston dkon mchog skyabs/ g.yu thog yon tan mgon po/ sum ston ye shes gzungs/ gzhon nu ye shes/ mkhas pa 'bum seng / sangs rgyas rin chen/ rin chen rdo rje/ don rgyal ba/ brang ti dkon mchog skyabs/ sgra tshad dbang phyug grags/ rig 'dzin phun tshogs/rgyal mtshan dpal bzang / zur phud dpal ldan gdong gru seṅge bzang / lhun grub rgyal mtshan/ zur mkhar a bo chos rje/ mnyam nyid rdo rje/ paṇa chen don rgyal/ 'di 'tshams (mtshams3rgyud rims (rim1'ga' yi mtshan ma rtogs/ de nas 'brug kun mkhyen padma dkar po/ de'i sku tsha kong sman dkon mchog sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ 'bri gung rje chos kyi grags pa/ dkon mchog 'gro phan dbang po zhes sam tshe dbang bstan pa/ dpon tshangs (tshang3ye shes dang / zhwa dmar sgar 'og karma bstan 'phel dang / drung 'tsho tshe ring dbang /de gsum nas sku zhabs si tu chos kyi 'byung gnas sku mched kyis gsan/ de'i slob rgyud stong na gsang karma rin chen dbang rgyal lam bstan 'dzin dbang rgyas/ lha mo skyabs/ 'brong pa phun tshe de rnams la rim bzhin brgyud pa'o//'tsho byed kyi gzugs brnyan pa bdag padma dbang drag (grags3la rgyud bzhi'i lung gi brgyud tshul ni/ si tu kun mkhyen dharma kā ra nas rim par brgyud pa'i mgon po blo bzang bstan 'dzin grags pa'i zhal nas 'phrin las

༄khya// rgyud kyi 'gyur byang dang slob rgyun sor khru'i 'jal tshad/ 487phyi ma rgyud kyi 'bru lung rang cag na tshod chung ngu'i dus su thon pa/ phyis su grwa mngon gter ma bdud rtsi bum pa dang / bdud rtse bum pa'i rgyun 'khyer 'don bya'i 'bru lung dang / g.yu thog snying thig gi zab dbang rgyas pa thob/ kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho blo gros mtha' yas pa'i sde nas brgyud pa'i man ngag yon tan rgyud kyi 'bru lung stong nags bla ma karma 'phrin las rnam rol nas thob pa dang / rtsa rgyud bshad rgyud gnyis kyi 'bru lung stong nags bla ma karma thub bstan bstan pa'i snying po nas thob/ 'bri gung skyabs mgon thugs rje nyi ma dang / nang chen dhīng hu dkon mchog lha rgyal/ byams me sprul sku lha mchog la brgyud pa'i dkon mchog 'gro phan dbang po'am tshe dbang bstan pas mdzad pa'i gces bsdus phan bde snying po'i 'bru lung lha mchog mdun nas thob pa dang / rin chen sprul sku chos 'dzin dbang po'i 'chi med nor phreng gi 'bru lung gnang ba dang / g.yu thog gegs sel bla sgrubs (sgrub3dang / snying thig sdug bsngal mun sel bla sgrubs (sgrubaka gsol 'debs/ sman bla'i gzungs ring / gangs sku gsang ma de rnams kyi lung mgon po bla ma bstan 'dzin grags pa'i zhal nas thob/ g.yu thog bla sgrubs lung dge slong kun bzang nas thob/ yang bla sgrubs (sgrub1dang gegs sel bla sgrubs (sgrub1lung mkhan po rin chen 'jam dbyangs zhal nas thob/ zur mang sde ro kun khyabs (khyab1lugs bad kan srung ba sbrul 'khyud mdzad/ 'khor lo g.yon tu bskor rgyu/ za yig bcas kyi lung dpal me lho kun bzang sprul sku nas thob pa dang / mdzod du dus 'khor sogs nas sor khru sogs kyi rtsi tshul man ngag du ma gsungs pa dang / der brten mkhas dbang rnams bzhed pa mi 'dra ba sogs mtha' klas pa/ bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gzugs kyi skabs beeḍūrya dkar po ma bur gsal/

488 ༄7khibri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/gsum pa/ sor khru'i 'jal tshad/ skabs 'dir gso ba rig par yang / sman dpyad zla ba'i rgyal po las/sor bzhi la thur gang sogs du mar bshad cing / da lta phal cher ni/ phun sor du byed/ chag gang zhes pa khu tshur la mtheb mo'i ni le rigs (reg1pa'i sor lnga'am phyed lngar bzhed/ mdzub mtheb mdzub brkyang ba'i bar lhag kheng khukhengs3pa gang mdzub du byed pa mkhyid/ de las kyang ring bar bzhed pa sogs 'grul ('khrul1pa du ma mchis pa rnams dor ba'i snying por dril ba/rang nyid kyi lag pa'i mthe bong gi tshig (tshigs3bar nas sen mo'i dreg pa yod med kyi mtshams der mtshon yin la/ de phyed la rang sor/ de'i phyed la phun du go la sor de nyid bzhi la chag gang / drug la mdzub gang / dkyus de la mtho gang / mtho do la khru gang / khru de yi mi lus tshad dang ldan par khru bzhi dang mi'u thung la phyed bzhir 'gas su bzhed pa/ zhing (zheng3du rang khru bzhi med pa cher mi yong zhing / de dag la tshad ldan dang ma longs pa gang du 'ang 'du ba sogs shas che chung gi dbang gis/ la la stod che/ la la smad che/ la la skad turked3pa ring ba sogs mtha' gcig tu ma nges pa 'byung yang / spyi khyab kyi tshad khong du chud/ rjes shugs sam zhor du rtogs pa rnams ma yin par/ gang la dgos na'ang rgyud kyi 'grel bshad chen mo mtha' klas pa dang /rgyud che la goms 'dris/ slob dpon mkhas pa'i zhal rgyun dang khrid lung sogs brtson 'grus ma zhan par lhag par byang khog yul thig gi phyogs tsam la ma ltos par bag med kyis dor nas/ phyi ma rgyud kyi rtsa chu thang phye'i tshig don re'i zung / thor bu'i sde tshan pu ti khu tshur tsam 'chang nas rmongs pa'i khrod du mkhas gtam gyi yid ches pa'i gnas su gyur nas rang sems mkhas pa yin

par rlom nas gya nom pa/ don du gtar ka/ me btsa' mkho byed kyi zhib rtsis mkho gal che ba'i ched du rgyud kyi dgongs don ma 'chug par mthong thos chung ba rnams kyi don du 'tsho byed las mang du thos pa padma dbang drag skyogragasakyepas bris pa dge bar gyur cig/ sarba maṅgā lam/

490༄//dngul chu grang 'dul 'bring po'am dkar 'dul du grags pa/thog mar g.ya' phyi ba ni/ dngul chu srang twogi tshe/ sga skya/ pi ling / pho ril gsum so so nas thur mgo zhogang re 'bring tshad re zhib tu btags pa rlan cung zad phab la/ ra thug gam lcags bzang gla shun bug rdol med pa/ skyi nang du bstan khur (khud1du btum la dal bus nyi ma phyed tsam mnyes pas tsha ba gsum gyi phye ma ljang nag lta bur gyur cing dngul chu la gzugs brnyan 'char ba g.ya' thon pa'i rtags yin pas shug thal gyis sman ro zur du phye star bu'i khu bar bzhag de nas g.ya' khu 'don pa la cung zad rgyas par byed na dang po byis pa lo brgyad dri chu la dngul chu nub tsam kyi nang du khol nges su btsos nas dri chu bzhur/ dngul chu chu tsha grang gis dag par bshal/ des 'gres te gnyis pa rta gseb gcin/ gsum pa ba dmar zal gyi gcin/ bzhi pa star bu/ lnga pa mtshur nag bgrung chu/ drug pa chang skyur nges bcas kyis rim par btso zhing dag par chu tsha grang gnyis bshal/ btso ba'i tshe lcags thur gyis dkrug me shad (shed1che na 'tshig nas 'thor dog (dogs1yod cing / chung na mi tshos pas me 'jam nang du sil bur khol la ma ni 10rkya—150ran par bya/ btso lugs drug po'i yun snga ma las phyi ma je ring du bya dgos pas/ yig drug gam/ spos thur gyi tshod bzung rta sreg (gseb1dang ba dmar zal/ ma 'dzoms na rta gcin ba chu gang 'dzoms tsam gyis kyang rung / lag len bsdus na sga pi pho gsum gyis g.ya' phral rjes/ ba chu'i nang du btso zhing bkru bshal byed pa kho nas kyang

༄/dngul chu grang 'dul 'bring po'amadakar duladugragasapa/ da thu1 warung mthun chog par byed/ gang ltar phyi rdzas sman phye dang btso bkru chu rnams sems can gyi khar mi 'gro ba'i dong du sba/ btso snod rdza ma'am lcags snod dgos/ 'di dus legs par grub na shing bu phra mo 'dzin ma tshos par mi 'dzin par 'byung tshe tshos tshad mchog tu 'gyur ba'o// de nas lcags skyogs nang du snum nag gam mar rnying khu ba phor chung gang tsam khol bar byas la gsha' dkar dngul chu'i phyedahūm̐/ gsha' nag de'i yang phyed ṣṭṛbacas kyi sbrang gshog btab cing bskol ba/ gsha' khu nang du dngul chu btab lcags thur gyis dkrug ma ni lnga bcu tsam gyi yun nas phog la kha'i snum 'pho/ gsha' dngul 'dres ma rdo grang steng du blugs pas dngul chu skam por 'gyur ro// de nas mu zi dug phral dang / dngul skam ljid mnyam pa haṃrdo btun drod ldan du bsros pa'i nang du blugs pas zhu ba dang lhan cig rdo gtun gyis bsgyur nas nag mthing dngul 'od med par gyur tshe/ star bu'i chus 'dam 'thag rang skam ma song bar du byas/mu zi dug 'don ni bod kyi dur ba zhes ram rtsa btsos pa'i khu ba'i nang du mu zi slad med khrom tsam brdung ba'i ras lteb tu gtum la yun cig btsos pa'i khu bar zhag cig bsnyal/ nangs par khu ba dor la chu grang gis yang yang bshal/ grib skam byas la de la mu zi'i dri ma cher med par dug thon pa yin no//ces pa 'di ni/ sprul sku 'jam dbyangs mkhyen rtse'i (brtse'i3phyag bzhes yin pa snying nor du pad ma dbang grags kyis bris pa'o//yang lugs gcig la/ dngul chutram̐/ gsha' dkaratram̐/ dadha rdog po nyulhan du dngul 'od med par rdo gtun du 'dul na khyad par 'phags so//sarba marga lam̐// //

492༄7//dpal ldan zur mkhar ba'i khrad chos rkang 'bam gyi chig rgyud gsang ba'i man ngag bzhugs so//oṃ āḥthā/ kha cig g.yu ldum sngon po zer// kha cig zi ra sngon po zer//kha cig sngon po chab 'dren zer// lo ma gla ba'i rna mchog 'dra// sdong po lcags kyi sag tuseg3brdar 'dra// me tog g.yu yi phreng ba 'dra// 'bras bu rin chen 'thor ba 'dra// ming ni khu byug sran ma zer// 'bam gyi zab sman de la bya//kha cig gnyan thub nag po zer// kha cig gdon 'joms nag po zer// lo ma rgod pyi thul phran 'dra// sdong po mtshal gyi ka ba 'dra// rtsa ba dung rgyus bshad pa 'a dra// me tog stag phrug mig dang 'dra// mnam pas sdig sbrul dri ma bro//ming ni gyad mi sngon po zer// 'bam gyi byug sman de la bya// dngos gzhi sbyor sde'i lag len ni// gtso bo bya khyung rnam lnga la// spos dkar gu gul rwa cig btags// de mnyam khu byug sran ma sbyar// sman ni nyin gung mtshan gung btang // sman rta bskol grang chu yis bya//chig dril gnad las byung ba'i bkru sman ni/ sngon mo chab 'dren dus brkos 'khyor (khyoraka ba gang // tsha grangs (grang1sbyar ba'i mar gyi nang du btsos// tsha la 'bu skyog gtso bo dang // sbyar la thang dang phye ma gang 'os la//yang na gong gi steng du 'di bsnan te// sbyong bya ba sga tig 'khrul bshal lo//thang du btang bas nges med rgyun du 'khru// sha ru btsa' ma bsdus pa'i khu bas phul// 'gogs dka' dur byid zar bu'i khaṇḍa dang // chu ser sman gsum gong dang sbyar la btang // 'di ni kun la ma spel cig/ / /

493༄7//na ma dgu skor nad gang la kha bsgyur chog pa'i gdams pa zab mo bzhugs so//sha ma dgu skor zhes bya ba 'di la skor thabs kha sgyur sngags kyi steng na gdab/ rten 'brel snying pos rab gnas byas shing sngags gang mang bzlas la gdab/ gdam ngag na ma dgu skor zhes kyang bya/ a tsā ra yi gdams ngag 'di/ rma ni skrangs sam logs (log3 na mtshal lam rgya snag gis bris/gnad kyi yi ge 'bru nyi shu rtsa lnga pa/ 'di rgya gar shar nub la yang med/ rma ni tsha na dbang phyug chen por bsgoms/ rma ni skam na āḥ las zla ba bsgoms/khrag ma chod na zla ba shar ba bsgoms/ 'di yi phan yon shin tu mang / mu stegs nag po'i sngags rgod 'di/ 'bri lugs nyi shu rtsa lnga mngon pa la/ nad kyi gtso bo nyi sha rtsa lnga 'joms// bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad rnams sel// 'di yis mi thub gang yang med// dmig (dmigs1pa la sngags 'di btab pa'i dus/ rang nyid mu tig (stegs3nag po ral pa gyen la gzeng ba spyan gsum mche ba brtsegs (gtsigs3pa gcer bur bud pa/ phyag g.yas na mda'i mde'u la byis pa lo ni brgyad pa'i tshad bstan sprad/ phyag g.yon 'og ma'i gzhu ni bsnams par bhe/ rma ni 'bras srin shu ba ling tog gam/ lus la mi bde gang yang yod pa la/ bu mo bcu gsum lon pa'i mtshan mar bhe/ gdam ngag na ma dgu skor zhes kyang bya/ sha ma dgu skor zhes bya ba 'di mu tig tustegs1thog rgod nag pos mdzad pa'o//gsang chen dpa' bo 'bras bu lnga/ thocatamachige'irwanegasang chen bla

516 ༄7/khabri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/su longs la ltos: de nas man ngag kha bsgyur ni: ngar 'dod a ru ra mang btang : sbom 'dod sug sme tusmel1mang na 'byung : phra bar 'dod na sro lo 'o: ring bar 'dod na ju tucu3gang mang : snyan par 'dod na spang rgyan no: 'khong bar 'dod na shing mngar ro: de ni man ngag kha bsgyur te: shin tu zab phyir gter du sbas: las can gcig dang phrad par shog: sa ma ya/ rgya rgya rgya: sprul sku ratna gling pas gnam skas brag nas gdan drangs pa'o//skad sman bzang po'i sbyor ba ni/ cu gang se 'bru sug smel ru rta dang :spang rgyan dkar po shing mngar a ru ra: star zhun sro lo dkar po sha chen bcu: mnyam sbyar tsha shas che ba chu grang phul: rlung shas che na chang gis phul: snyan la ring 'dod se 'bru bskyed: skad gdang (gdangs1che 'dod sug sme (smel1bskyed: 'gro mgon sa skya paṇa chen lugs/rang nyid mu stegs dbang phyug nag po ni/ gcer bu rgyan med ling ga gyen la bsgreng // phyag gnyis rwa yi mda' gzhu 'geng bar bsgom// srung skud nag po mdud pa dgu rgyab (brgyab3sngags(bsngags1// mdud pa re rer gnam lcags sdig pa re// mgo dgu kha gdang sa me yi tsha tsha 'phro// dri ma mi zhim dpag tshad khyab par bsgoms// oṃ ma hā de wa hūṃ/ oṃ ha ba de ba hūṃ/ oṃ da be de ba hūṃ/ zhes pa brgya sogs mang nyung ci nus bsngags// nor 'phag 'o ma mi gtong skam 'gong dang // zho lad 'o rul chang lad dang // nad par grib sna byis pa mtshan ngus byid// lam 'dres btab dang srog rlung chang smyon byed// rta nor gdon btab rlung dang 'phra mi zin pa// de dag kun la shin tu phan pa ni// de la lan grangs stong tsam myong ba yin// gdon tshabs chung ba'i snyon jismyon1pa 'ga' zhig la// 'di nyid kho nas phan pa lan grangs mang //yang ni tun3dbang phyug lugs kyi srung ba la// rang nyid dbang phyug sngon po

༄7/dbang chen gsang ba 'dus pa las skad bcos tshangs pa'i 'brug sgrogs/ 517zhal gcig pa// phyag g.yas lcags kyu g.yon pas sdig mdzub zhags// rgyan med ral pa khams nag rab tu 'bar// rlung gi dkyil 'khor steng bzhugs me phung 'bar// de ltar bsgom la sngags 'di ci nus bzla// oṃ chum ti nan si swā hā: rang gis bzlas pas 'gos nad srung ba'i mchog/ sngags chu sngags mar byed dam phus btab na// 'di yis mi phan nad rigs gcig kyang med//smi/rang nyid mu stegs dbang phyug chen po ni: mdog nag ling ga dmar po gyen la bsgrongs: khrag gi ral pa bar snang khyab par bsgom: srin lag ral gri mthe bong spu gri yis: gnod byed ma yi mgo lus hrug hrug bcad:'og gzhi lcags bsreg sa gzhi'i steng du song : gzhob thul song nas thal ba bun song bsam: mtheb srin phreng ba phyir 'dren brgya tshad mi mang : ki ya ki sa: rjes nas thal mo lan gsum brdab bya zhing : byad ma rang mthu rang log 'chi byed 'gyur: nyer dgu la sogs rgyun bzlas sngags stong gsum:brlag byed rgyun du bzlas sogs mi rung gsungs: lbi/bdud kyi srog sngags kho rang bsgom mi dgos/ tsog kye tata la/ tsog kye lo ha le/ ma hā lo ha le/ a tre le/ ta la swāhā: 'dod pa'i dbang phyug sdig to can gyis bdag che ge mo las skyobs shig: stobs thong (thongs1shig: me chu gcan gzan dgra nad gdon 'jigs pa sogs bdud kyis bsrung zhing bdud kyi stobs sbyin pas bar chad gang gis mi tshugs mdo las gsungs/ de ni bdud kyi sgo nas srung ba rma chog /mkhris pa rlung gyur nad la/ sman zas gnyis/ se 'bru pi ling a ru ra//gur gum chos sman thun re dang // sha chen shing kun dzā ti dang // gla ba ril ma tsam cig btang // bu ram la sbyar chang gis phul// zas bcos chang 'jam bsros pa la// lug sha btsos pa'i khu ba btang // 'bras thug dag kyang gtang

518 ༄7//'bri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/bar bya// de yis sos par the tshom med// mgi lam̐/'bam sman la (lab3bcos skabs kyi gsang sman ngos 'dzin mi 'dra ba rigs gsum ni/ 'bri gung gi bla sman karmas lhog dug sha la yu ring la mdzad/mnga' ris 'tsho byed pa rnam rgyal 'phrin las kyis lhog dug lcags kyu ba la mdzad/ em chi 'brang rgyal shang pas klu bdud rdo rje la mdzad/ 'di gsum ka 'bam sman zab shos re yin pa gang ltar byas kyang nus mthu mtshungs par snang bas de gsum ga 'dril ba cha gnyis re btang ba myong grub yin pa rang gang mos ltar bya/chu'i mkhar brgyad ni rkang pa'i bol/ ngar gdong gi nang logatulogs3/chu so mtshan dbrag tshigs pa bcu drug mdo/ pho ba'i steng / brang zhol te brang smad/ kha sna'i skor/ mig gi smin dbrag (lcibs3so/rnor pas rang dang gzhan srung ba'i rten 'brel ni/ lug dar ma'i sog bal g.yas pa blangs la bu mo mgo gtsang gis skud pa gsum sgril du byas par mdud pa btab la/ ha he kā wā rtswa a sarba baghanān rakṣa rakṣa: bzlas pa btags pas gdon bgegs rkyen ngan thams cad thub bo// sa ma yā/ rnor pa tshangs pa'i dbyangs thob pa'i rten 'brel ni spang rgyan dkar po dang 'bri mog a ru ra rnams chang gtsang mar sbangs pa'i khu ba la/ ha ri ni sa hi ri mi ri swā hā: zhes stong phrag btab ste tho rangs btang bas dbyangs snyan po rtsa gsum lha'i thugs rgyud bskul ba dang / 'gro ba thams cad yid 'phrog par 'gyur ro// sa ma yā/ rnor pa'i sgrub rgyags kyi yun du thub par 'dod na tsan dan gyi byang bu la ha ri ni sa pa shu tsi tra swā hā/ sris rkun rakṣa rakṣaḥn na ṣi rda sdus sdus 'phel 'phel pukhyim ku ru hoḥbris shing btab ste ghi wang gi thum po dang bcas thab kyi nang ngam 'tsho ba'i snod la bzhag na zas khos nyung ngus kyang yun ring thub cing sri sme bar 'gyur ro// sa ma yā// / /

519༄cu//chu sman sbyor sde'i zin bris bzhugs so//zhabs pad rin po cher zhu 'bras/ rgyun brten shas cher mchod dus skya rbab dang grang 'or gyi skabs su/ dwangs ma gnas 'jog ni/ dong gra bsnan pa dang / gur gum bsnan pa gnyis las/ gur gum bsnan pa de rang legs shing / de'i sbyor sde tshad ldan la/ se 'bru zho brgyad shing tshwa (tsha3dang suklel gnyis zho gsum re/ pi ling zho bzhir bshad kyang gsung glo'i lding che ba byung dus pi legs (ling3zho do byas pas tshad ldan lags/ yang skya rbab rang gi skabasasu/ da lis bcu drug sbyor ba ni/ se 'bru shing tshwa tutsha3pi pi ling /sug smel gur gum bsnan pa lngas// lus spyi'i 'du ba snyoms par byed// sha pho ru rta li shi dang // ar nag dzwa ti snying zho sha/ thor bu'i rlung rnams sel bar byed// rgun 'brum cu gang shing mngar dang // ga dur glo ba'i nad rnams sel//dā li (da lis3sdig srin sbyar ba yis// chu ser skya rbab nad rigs 'joms//zhes nus pa rgyas pa gces bsdus rang du gsal ba ltar/ sbyar tshad dmigs bsal ma gsungs kyang / lag len du dā (da3lis me tog zho gsum/ se 'bru zho do gzhan rnams zho lnga re lags/ sbrang rtsi shad pa lhad med kham bu skam pa tsam sbyar bas dā li (da lis3bcu drug pa lags/ skya rbab 'or la nye dus/ lcags phye bco lnga ni/ lcags zhib btags phye 'bras bu gsum a bar skyur dang tsha ba gsum sgapipho ril// dā li (da lis3shing tshwa skyitsha3 se 'bru sug smel dang // gser bye sdig srin gze ma lcam pa rnams//gtso bo lcags phye thun gnyis sbyar// tsha chu shas che 'bras gsum a bar skyur gzem

520 ༄7|'bri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/lcam pa bskyed// chu sman gzhir bzhag bzhi cha mnyam par gces// zhes pa gser bye sdig srin gze ma lcam pa rnams thun che tsam dang / gzhan tsha grang skya rbab 'or la nye ba'i sogs kyis thun che chung bsnon phri byed pa lags/ yang grang chu tsha grang ldan chu me drod nyams pa las byung ba'i zag chu sogs la gces bsdus dwangs ma chu 'dren gyi sbyor sde ni/ se 'bru bzhi steng gur gum gser bye dang // sdig srin 'u su lcam pa'i 'bras bu bsnan// skyu ru ra ni kun dang mgo mnyam sbyar// chu rigs bco lnga 'dren zhing skem par byed// ces pa rgyud kyi se 'bru bzhi pa/ se 'bru zho do/ shing tsha/ pi ling / sug smel/ sdig srin/ 'u su/ lcam pa'i 'bras bu bcas pa cha gcig de kun dang mnyam pa'i skyu ru ra rul bsung med pa ni dwangs ma chu 'dren gyi sbyor sde bkrol ba lags/ dmu chu tsha shas che ba la/ 'bol span bdun pa ni/ gur gum dang ni 'jib rtsi dang //utpalagaser me bong nga dkar// ba shā ka dang skyu ru bdun// ljang na rlung gzer gze ma mgo ar li shi bsnan// ser na mkhris pa lce kyi lce la g.ya' kyi dug mo nyung / / dkar na bad kan sha ru bal gyis dril// 'u'am 'u su lcam pa thun mong kha tshar su la lha mos mkhyen// zhes pa'i 'bol sman bdun pa kha tshar can gyi sbyor sde gnang lugs tsha chu shas che ba'i skabs su gong gi bdun rkyang rang legs shing /'or dang tsha grang ldan chu sogs rlung mkhris bad kan gsum po gang shas che ba'i so so'i kha tshar rnams gtso bo bdun po zho re'i tshe na kha tshar skar lnga re bsnon lags/ yang chu babs shin tu chung ba'i tshe tsha chu rgyas smin la gong gi bdun steng du/ gsang sman 'bri gung lugs rang gi skabs su byi srad che chung zhes pa mdangs yod srad nag bya ma slebs gong btus pa dang de kho ring thung la de las rkang shin tu phra ba'i byi srad chung ba bya ma slebs gong mi dgos pas nam yin dus btus pa gnyis kyi rab khaṇḍa'am de min sngo sman kho rang gnyis gtso bo'i sman re gsum cha re snon pa la/ yang de las rgyas par bye ba ring bsrel

༄7/chu sman sbyor sde'i zin bris bzhugs so/ 521dang ra mo she'i lugs byi srad che chung gnyis kyi khar/ sngon mo chab 'dren g.ya' spang mtshams su skye ba'i me tog rgya tshan shar ba dang / sngon po shar ba gnyis rigs gcig pa gang rung / sga tig nag po/ byi'u shing mngar ram bye ru'i phreng ldan zhing gi mu la skye ba'i gang bu sran ma 'dra ba de dang / tshu sman de ba rdzospyi shur (bzhur3chu ma rtsi bcas cha mnyam gyi khaṇḍa tshul ldan gyi steng du gser bye/ sdig srin/ spos dkar/ lcam pa'i 'bras ga 'u su/ bya so bya zhes pa nya za ba'i pho rog 'dra ba de'i sgro nus ldan du bsregs pa khaṇḍa chu chod khar logs su zhib par btags pas de btab la legs par ma 'tshig par grod pur bcangs pa'i khaṇḍa tshul ldan de chu 'bab chung ba'i rigs tha dag la grang chur gur gum bsnan pa'i dwangs ma gnas 'jog dwangs ma chu 'dren/tsha chu la 'bol man bdun pa/ phyi ma rgyud kyi ghi wang dgu pa/ gces bsdus kyi bong dkar bcu pa bcas tsha grang babs btsūn gyi gsang sman khaṇḍa de bsnan nas btang srol shin tu zab nges lags/ chu'i gsungs (gsang sman3glo la nor bu bdun pa'am rgyud kyi tsan dan bco lnga dang / gces bsdus phye ma'i sde tshan du yod pa'i nor bu rbadun pa kha tshar can/ sku mtshal skyotshad3mtho dus 'khrugs glo kun sel bcas de gsum gyi sbyor sde sku la 'phrod bzhes yongs (yong3'dra bsam zhing / sku'i babs dang bstun pa'i chu sman tsha grang ldan 'dus sbyor sde gtso cher 'tsho byed tshe dbang brtan pa'i gces bsdus dang / chu sman gsang ba sbubs 'dren nang bzhin la phran rmongs pa rang gis kha gsal bar zhus pa/ gsang ba sbubs 'dren gyi gsang sman gnyis la/ che ba ni sa thams cad du skye ba'i srad nag la 'di ka yin/ 'di la lo ma skya zhing / me tog rgya kha yod pa gcig dang / lo ma sngo zhing me tog lcags kha yod pa gnyis las bzang ba dgos/ don po ni lo ma sngo la —me tog lcags kha yod pa de yin/ de yang rtsa

522 ༄7khabri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/ba'i rtsa brgyad stong sogs mang zhing skam pa che ba 'dug pas/ rtsa brgyad sgang du skyed pa de legs zer che ba bdag gis chu sman la gtong rgyu ni lo ma rgyas pa khu byug ma grags gong la btus nas rma phabs (phab3'jog pa gal che/ chung ba la yang lo ma skya zhing me tog rgya kha yod pa gcig dang / lo ma sngo zhing me tog lcags kha yod pa gnyis las dgos don bzang shos me tog lcags kha lo ma sngo ba de yin/ 'di yang skam sa che sar skyes/ rang dgos pa'i kha ru la'i 'og chu gsher che bas mi legs/ gad la 'or ba'i kanigadong rtsa turtswa3ra'am lha spyol3kha'i gzhogs kyi rtsa (rtswa1ra skam sa che ba'i sa sgang zhig tu mang po skyes yod pa bzang zer/ chung ba 'diphro khu byug ma grags gong la 'thu mi dgos pas lo ma dang me tog thams cad rgyas pa'i dus btus la gong ltar rma phab 'jog pa yin zer ba sogs 'tsho byed grags po che ba'i ngag rgyun no// 'di'i sman sbyor ba sogs kyi zhib cha legs (logs3su'ang yod/bshal sman spyi 'gro lag len bsdus pa byed skabs gtso bo thar nu/ dur byid/ danda gsum las/ thar nu bungs bskyed dgos pas phyi'i shun pa dang /nang gi rtsa rgyus dor la skam rlon gang yin ba chu nyung tsam dang / ra sha cung zad 'phang la chu phran bu bsnan nas khu ba rang thim ma song bar du bskol la skam/dur byid rkang shun phral la yos tshan nang du bcug la skam/ danda lce shun phral la lcags leb steng rtsam pa'i nang bcug la me thog bzhag nas rtsam pa 'tshig tsam bsregs/ a ru'i mchu mang tsam dang lcum rtsa/ bye lcam sdig gsum/ rgya/gla rtsi/ gur gum/ ghi wang bcas phran bu re bsnan nas zhib par btags la nad so so'i gnyen po gang 'os cung zad dang sbyar te gtong ba'i lag len 'dug go/ chu bskol gyis 'phul lo// zur mkhar ba'i gzer bcos 'chi ba gshol 'debs kyi gsod dbyung sbrags ma ni/ gzer 'joms/ thar nu/ chu rtsa/ sha chen/ 'dzin pa lnga/ 'phul byed/ gla rtsi gu gul thang gis phul/ thang

༄7/chu sman sbyor sde'i zin bris bzhugs so/ 523ma byas na gla gul gnyis sman byings nang sdebs la/ zhib par btags te chu khol gyis gtong / 'di gnyan rims gzer thung gi rigs la phan che ba yin zhing / don snod so so'i babs sgo dang / brtags thabs/ kha sgyur rigs gtar ga gdab lugs sogs zhal gdams pra khrid bu yig gnyis su gsal ba bstan pa ltar bya'o// 'di thar nu cha mtho tsam byas te/ thun chung bzhi lnga tsam zhig nyin gcig 'gro ba byas nas/ 'khru che chung brtag mi dgos par byed 'dug gnyan glang sogs snod tshad spyi dang / rgyu rims sogs la shin tu zab pa'i phur nag bzhi thang ni/ thur tuphur1nag khaṇḍa/ gu gul nag po/ gla rtsi/shu dag nag po bcas kyi thang dro 'jam 'di thog mar thengs re zung gtong na gnyan rims spyi la shin tu zab/ gnyan srin dang gzer thung la'ang mtshams mtshams su re gtong ba gsungs so// //

580༄7//rtsis kyi bstan bcos nya rgyas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor blo gsar kun da'i 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba bzhugs so//mchod brjod dang rtsom par dam bca' ba/'jig rten gsum na rgyal bstan kun gsal khyenatumakhyen1/ / de 'dzin rgyu skar dbus na mngon mtho'i mgon// phyag na padma'i sgyu 'phrul nyin byed dbang // phyogs las rnam rgyal mtshan snyan spyi bos bsten// mkhyen dang brtse ba nus pa'i mnga' bdag rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi nam mkha' la// de'i gsung snying po zhi ba chags bral dam chos rlung gi rgyal mtshan can// phan dang bde ba'i 'od mdangs yongs 'tsher rig grol gnyis ldan dge 'dun sogs// mi bslu gtan gyi skyabs gnas bla med dkon mchog rin chen gtsug na rgyal//gdod nas 'gyur bral kun tu bzang po'i mkha' klong las// sprul pa'i zlos gar mngon par bsgyur ba rta bdun dbang // 'gro kun phan dang bde ba'i 'dab stong rgyas mdzad pa// rtsa gsum kun 'dus padma 'byung gnas bdag sogs skyongs// bde chen lang tsho rgyas pa'i gzugs sku'i mkha'// stong gsal sna tshogs lha mo'i dbang gzhus 'khyud// gnyis med gnyis su 'char ba sgyu ma mkhan// zung 'jug dus kyi 'khor lo phyag gi gnas// tshogs gnyis chu gter che las 'khrungs pa'i sku// 'jam dpal rdo rje rnon po bsil sbyin mkhan// rmad byung mkhyen dang brtse ba'i 'od zer gyis// blo yi kun da'i rgyas

༄7/rtsis kyi bstan bcos nya rgyas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor blo gsar kun da'i 'dod 'jo/ 581mdzad dad pa'i yul// mdzes mdzes lta bas mi ngom 'jo sgeg nyams// snyan snyan tasbra ra yi sgra dpal sbyin// yang yang gsol ba 'debs na shes bya'i don//mang mang thogs med stsol cig sgra dbyangs lha// ngo mtshar rgya mtsho'i grong khyer shambha lar// gsang chen theg mchog bdud rtsi'i za ma tog/ skal ldan kun la ster ba mi yi rje// chos rgyal ri bo'i grangs kyis dge legs stsol// ya mtshan rkang 'thung 'phreng ba 'khrigs pa'i dbus// 'gro kun yid sim ha ri'i dra'i sdong po// phul byung rgyud don dri bsung rab 'phro ba// rigs ldan nyi shu rtsa lngas bdag skyongs shig/ byang phyogs rgyal khab rin chen gling mchog tu// rdzu 'phrul snying stobs kyis bgrod rgyud 'grel kun// thugs 'dzin nor bu'i zong mang 'phags yul du// drangs mkhas paṇa chen rnam gnyis phyag gi gnas// phyi nang gzhan gsum gser gyi shing rta che// ring lugs bod yul ra bar 'dren mdzad pa// rwa 'bro shong dpang lo paṇa mdzad bzang kun// bsam tshe lag pa'i padma snying khar zum// rnam dag phug lugs gzhung bzang chu gter las//li dbang sā ra'i mkhyen pa'i bum bzang du// yongs gtams rin chen yol gor beeḍūr dkar// mngon par 'gengs pa'i legs bshad 'di nyid kyang //'dor byed grangs mang brtsegs pa'i bla mkhyen kun// mdzub mo ngal ba'i nyams len chos dkon pas// des na bee ḍūr dkar po'i 'o ma'i mtsho/bsrubs pa'i skar rtsis snying por grub pa'i bcud// rtsis kyi bstan bcos shar ri'i phrag gong nas// lhag bsam nya rgyas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyis// blo gsar kun da'i tshogs rnams ma lus pa// 'dod pa 'jo byed dpal 'di kho bos sbyin// bstan bcos rgya mtsho che las ri mo yi// lag len chu thig (thigs3khol byung bris pa la// ma dag rnyog (rnyogs3pa'i rdzing bur zla ba'i gzugs//'char 'dod 'khrul pa ci mchis mkhas la bshags// tshul 'di rtsis gzhung zla ba'i ma ma cher// blo dman gsar bur phan sems gru rdzing gis// legs

582 ༄7khabri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/bskyod lag len bsam 'phel dbang gi rgyal// rgyal mtshan rtser bkod 'dod 'byung 'di longs shig/sa bcad dang po/ skar rtsis kyi sngon 'gro bshad pa/sngon 'gro bya ba'i rim pa ni// rgyas pa beeḍūr dkar po sogs// sngon byon mkhas pas gsal bas na// 'dir ni sa bcad tsam zhig 'bri// de nas lo 'go 'dzin tshul ni// bzhes tshul mi 'dra mang mchis kyang // gnyis med dpal ldan dus 'khor lo// dpal ldan 'bras spungs mchod rten cher//gsungs pa'i dus zla yin pa sogs// lo yi thog ma rab byung dang // nag zla dkar po'i tshes gcig gi/ res gza' nyi ma rgyu skar dbyug/ lug khyim la sogs dus gcig tu// 'dzom phyir nag po'i zla ba nyid// lo 'gor 'dzin pa 'khrul med lugs// rgya nag 'phrul gyi rtsis gzhung las// hor gyi zla ba bcu gnyis pa// dpyid ra stag la bzhed pa 'dir// rang lugs mdzad cing phug lugs kyi// yongs grags hor zla bcu gcig pa// dpyid ra stag gi tshes gcig stag/ nam langs yos nas lo 'go 'dzin// zhes bshad mgo zla stag thog ma// yin phyir stag yos 'brug sbrul dang // rta lug spre'u dang bya khyi phag/byi ba glang bcas rim pa bzhin// pho lo mo lo'i rnam bzhag ste// de la shing med pa lcags chus// gnyis gnyis 'byung bas zin pa de// lo rgan drug cur grags pa yin// de yi spros pa 'phags yul du// me yos rab byung don gcig pa'i// rab byung rnam byung dkar po dang // rab myos skyes bdag aṅgi ra//dpal gdong dngos po na tshod ldan// 'dzin byed dbang phyug 'bru mang po//myos ldan rnam gnon khyu mchog dang // sna tshogs nyi ma nyi sgrol byed// sa skyong mi zad thams cad 'dul// kun 'dzin 'gal ba rnam 'gyur dang // bong bu

༄7dzees kyi bstan bcos nya rgyas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor blo gsar kun da'i 'dod 'jo/ 583dga' ba rnam rgyal nyid// rgyal ba myos byed gdong ngan pa// gser 'phyang rnam 'phyang sgyur byed dang // kun ldan 'phar ba dge byed dang // mdzes byed khro mo sna tshogs dbyig/ zil gnon spre'u phur bu dang // zhi ba thun mong 'gal byed dang // yongs 'dzin bag med kun dga' dang // srin po me dang dmar ser can// dus kyi pho nya don grub drag/ blo ngan rnga chen khrag skyug pa// mig dmar khro bo zad pa'o// de rnams bsags pas bskal pa ste// rdzogs ldan gsum ldan gnyis ldan dang // rtsod ldan zhes su grags pa yin//lo re la yang dbye dus drug/ dpyid sos dbyar ston dgun stod smad//dri zhim ldan dang drod phebs dang // me tog ldan rnams dpyid du grags//nges sreg tsha gdung can dang ni// tshad can drod 'ong sos gar 'dod// chu bo gzhung rgyas sprin gyi dus// bsgyur byed char dus dbyar zhes grags// dga' skyed 'bras gdan mda' sbyin dang // dus kyi snga ba ston ka'o// kha dus dgun grang dus smad// de yang zla ba'i 'phel 'grib gnyis// tshes zhag sum cur 'khor ba ste// lo yi yan lag lo'i cha shas/ dbugs skyes lo yi mdzod ces dang // zhag gi phung po zla ba ste// so so'i dbye ba hor lugs kyi// dang po nas bzung 'di bzhin te// mchu zla mā gha rta pa zla// dka' thub zla ba 'du byed dang // cho 'phrul kam pa dang po'o// khra zla dbo zla 'bras ldan zla// ro hi ta dang phalgu ṇa// sbo zla rnam shes gnyis pa'i ming // nag zla sbrang zla myos par byed// dri zhim ldan dang yid srubs zla// 'dod dus zla dang ming gzugs zla//tsi tra mo ha ti gsum pa// sa ga zla ba me tog ldan// sgrub byed me tog sbrang rtsis bskyed// be sha kha dang bha dra dang // skye mched zla ba bzhi par 'dod// snron zla nges sreg 'dod 'phel ba// reg pa ri ṣa bha dag byed// byo'u gtsang ma lnga par brjod// chu stod can dang gtsang ma'i zla// ā ṣā dhā ste tshor ba dang // kurma zla ba drug pa'o// gro bzhin zla ba ma ka ra// nam mkha'i thod ldan myos zla dang //

584 ༄7/khabri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/ sred pa shra ba ṇa bdun pa// khrums zla nor ldan khyu mchog can// bzang zla reg pa ba glang rkang // bha dra pa dang sprin bzang can// len pa daṇḍa brgyad pa'o//tha skar ltad sbyor rtsi tog zla// a shi ni ste mi ki ri// klu dbyangs srid pa rgod ma can// ltad mo'i zla ba dgu par 'dod// smin drug zla ba mang po 'dzin//karti ka dang mgo las skyes// skye ba binyi sa ga skyes// bcu pa'i ming du brjod pa dang // mgo zla mṛ ga shirsha dang // ri dwags mgo dang smal po'i zla// tshim byed rga shi bya ku li// bkod ldan nus ldan bcu gcig pa// rgyal zla tshim byed so so ṣa// mṛg swasna me tog ldan// nus zla bcu gnyis pa yi ming // bden don yan lag bcu gnyis so// mtshon phyir zla ba bcu gnyis zhes// khyim ni nag zla nas bzung ste// lug glang 'khrigs pa karka ṭa// seng ge bu mo srang sdig gzhu// chu srin bum pa nya rnams so// 'dul mngon mar ngo sngon 'gro dang //tshes ni dbyangs 'char ma gtogs par// gcig nas bco lnga'i bar dag tu//dkar phyogs zhes grags zla tshes dang // zhi dang rgyas pa'i phyogs yar ngo //phyogs kyi dang po zla mthong lo'o// bcu drug nas bzung nag phyogs te//dmar phyogs 'byung 'du dam can 'du// phyogs kyi phyi ma zhes pa dang //dbang dang drag po'i phyogs mar ngos// zla rer phyogs gnyis grub pa yi// lo gcig sum brgya drug cu ste// de la khyab bdag dus 'khor nas// dbyangs gsal 'dod yon la sogs pa// rab byung lo dang zhag chu tshod// la sogs spros pa ji snyed cing // tshes lha 'char ba'i tshul tsam du// lugs 'byung lugs ldog bcas pa yi// sde pa re yis zla ba gnyis// mtshon pa'i nag pa zla ba yi//tshes gcig lha mo nya rdo rje// karha'i tshes gcig pa rdo rje// la sogs sgrub thabs le'ur bshad// 'jig rten khams kyi le'u nas// dbyangs gsal 'char tshul lugs gcig la// zla ba bcu gnyis kun gyi tshes// gcig pa a i ṛ u bla//drug nas a e ar o al// ha ya ra ba la rim bzhin// dkar phyogs 'char

༄7/rtsis kyi bstan bcos nya rgyas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor blo gsar kun da'i 'dod 'jo/ 585la nag phyogs kyi// bcu drug nas bzung lā wā rā// yā hā al au ār i dang //ā lī u rī yī ā rnams// rim min sdud pas 'char ba la// srog gi dbyangs zhes bshad pa dang // gsal byed chu srin khyim zla la// ka kha ga gha nga lnga la|gong gi dkar phyogs nag phyogs kyi// dbyangs rnams ma nyams bzhin bzhugs pa 'i// ka khi gro ghu rlo zhes dang // ka khe gar sgo nga la kta/ yi gyu grwa dang // rla tpā khā ste// tpā dzrī dhā kā la// kho gār ghi dā kṣ-i khru// hṝ mbi dā sogs zla kun gyi// dbyangs rnams gsal byed la zhugs tshul// khyad med de la yi ge dbyangs// gsal byed bum par chu srin gyi// de dag ldog ste nga gha ga/ kha ka lnga po drug skor du// dbyangs ldan chu srin ji bzhin 'char// nya la tsa sde'i gsal byed drug/ chu srin ji bzhin lug la ldog/ de bzhin ṭa sde glang khyim la//chu srin bzhin 'char 'khrig par ldog/ sa sde karhar chu srin bzhin// seng ge ldog ste 'char ba dang // ta sde bu mo chu srin ltar/ srang la ldog ste 'char ba dang // sa tha ṣa sha ska lnga po// sdig par chu srin bzhin 'char ba// gzhu la ldog ste 'char ba dang // yang na dbyangs gsal gong bshad la// dkar cha'i zla ba thig les brgyan// dmar cha sgrib pas rnam par bcad// ldan pa gsal byed zhugs tshul sogs// sngon ma ji ltar mtshungs pa yin// gzhan yang khyim zhag la sbyar ba'i// tshes lha sum brgya drug cu yi// sa bon ji bzhin 'char yang yod// nam mkha' rlung me chu dang sa// sgra reg ro gzugs dri sna lnga// dkar po'i phyogs la lan gsum 'khor// nag phyogs sa chu me rlung dang // nam mkha' dri gzugs ro reg sgra// gsum skor rim bzhin 'char bar bzhed//gtsug na zla ba'i legs bshad las// dzadma ha ni la sogs pa'i// tshes la 'char ba'i tshul mang yang // grags che dkar nag phyogs ldog pa'i// ā nti u i au lnga// 'byung ba sa chu me rlung mkha'// dri ro ru pa reg sgra rnams// dkar po'i phyogs la lan gsum 'khor// gsal byed nga nya ṇa gsum po// spangs

586 ༄7rṣabri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/pa'i ka nas da'i bar 'char// nag phyogs a i u e o// gsal byed rda nas ha'i bar du// rim par tshes rer 'char 'gyur zhing // 'byung ba 'dod yon dkar phyogs ltar// gsum skor rim 'char dga' ba dang // bzang po rgyal stong rdzogs pa lnga// phyogs rer gsum skor mtshungs par 'char// nam langs skyes bu'i lag pa'i ris// mngon pa nas bzung ri rtse yi// nyi nub lag ris nub pa'i bar// nyin mo'i rnam bzhag yin pa ste// mdangs gsar gsal snang padma bzhad// mun sel snang ba ldan rnams so// nyi nub nas bzung tho rengs bar// mtshan mo yin no de yi ming // nges nyal mun bcas nyal ba'i dus// thun gsum ku mud bzhad rnams so// nyin mtshan dus tshod drug drug la// nyi ma gang yod rags pa la// nam langs nas drangs dus sbyor ro//gzhan yang gtsug lag nag rtsis nas// nam langs yos la nyi shar 'brug/ nyi dros sbrul la nyi phyed rta// phyed yol lug la nyi myur sprel// de bzhin nyi nub sa sros dang //srod 'khor nam phyed phyed yol ba// tho rengs bar la rig pas 'gre//res bza' bdun dang gzhan yang ni// sgra gcan dus me mjug ring bcas// spyir btang gza' ni bcu ru 'dod// me sbyin skyes dang tsha zer can//padma'i gnyen dang ku mud dgra// rta bdun rgyal po 'od stong ldan// nam mkha'i nor bu rta ljang can// nyin byed nyin mo'i dbang phyug rnams// nyi ma'i ming gi rnam grangs so// mtshan mo'i mgon po rgyu skar bdag/ bsil zer can dang ku mud gnyen// rgya mtsho skyes dang 'od dkar can// padma'i dgra dang ri bong 'dzin// zla ba'i ming gi rnam grangs so// bkra shis sa skyes dmar po 'khyog/ gzhon nu lus dmar sa lha'i bu// yan lag dmar dang dmag dpon rnams// mig dmar ming gi rnam grangs so// zla skyes zla sras zla ba'i bu//lha mtshams skyes sogs lhag pa'i ming // phur bu bla ma lha'i bla ma// blo ldan sgra mkhan slob dpon no// pa sangs khu ba nab so skyes// sbyin byed dkar po lha

༄7/rtsis kyi bstan bcos nya rgyas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor blo gsar kun da'i 'dod 'jo/ 587min byon// spen pa gnyis skyes nyi ma'i bu// zhi 'gro dal bar 'gro zhes zer//sgra gcan skabs gsum 'jigs byed dang // srid gsum rnam rgyal nyi zla za//drag po'i gzugs can mig sman mdog/ mjug mar me dang dus me zer//mjug ring du ba ke tu dbal// gza' rnams 'dren pa zhes brjod do// sgrol byed 'phur byed skar ma ste// rgyu ba'i skar ma nyi shu brgyad// 'on kyang byi bzhin gro bzhin gnyis// longs spyod gcig pas bsdu ba na// rtsa bdun yin no rgyu skar rer// skar chung re yi rjes 'brangs yod// phal ba'i skar ma du phyur gnyis// bye ba brgyad dang sa ya lnga// yod pa 'khrul med gzhung las bshad//rgyu ba'i skar ma'i tha snyad ni// tha skar bra nye smin drug dang // snar ma mgo lag nab so rgyal// skag mchu gro pho me zhi nag/ sa ri sa ga lha mtshams snron//snubs (snrubs3dang chu stod chu smad dang // gro bzhin mon dre mon gru dang //khrums stod khrums smad nam gru ste// rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa bdun yin// byi bzhin zhes pa gro bzhin mthar// sbyar na nyi shu rtsa brgyad 'byung // yul phyogs la la'i tha snyad la// tha skar la ni dbyug pa dang // smin drug la ni spun drug dang //snar mar beel dzi mgor smal po// nab sor rgyal stod rgyal rgyal smad// skag mchulpu rta chen dang // gre la rta chung dbo la khra// bya ma me bzhi byi'i nag pa//sa gnyis nam gong nam 'og zer// lha mtshams lag sor snron gdu bu//snrubs la sogs pa'i ming du 'bod// chu stod gre la chu smad phul// gro bzhin la ni bya pho dang // byi bzhin bya gzhug mon dre la// sgrog stod mon grur sgrog smad de// nam gru la ni she par 'bod// 'phrod ni nyer brgyad 'di lta ste// kun dga' dus kyi dbyig pa dang // dul ba skye rgu gzhon bya rog/ rgyal mtshan dpal be'u rdo rje tho// gdugs grogs yid 'ong 'gal me dang // rtsa bton 'chi bdag mda' grub pa// mdung dang bdud rtsi gtun shing dang // glang po stag myos zad g.yo brtan// 'phel bas 'phrod do sbyor ba ni// sel ba mdza'

588 ༄7/khibri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/bo tshe ldan dang // skal bzang bzang po shin tu skrangs// las bzang 'dzin pa gzer 'bras 'phel// nges pa kun 'joms dga' ba dang // rdo rje dngos grub kun tu brdung // dpa' smo yongs bsnun zhi grub pa// bsgrub bya dge ba dkar po dang // tshangs pa dbang po 'khon 'dzin no// byed pa bcu gcig 'di bzhin te// gdab pa byis pa rig pa can// til rdung khyim skyes tshong bikhyi//tshes gcig phyi cha nas bzung ste// nyer dgu'i snga char 'khor bar byed// shadku ni dang rkang bzhi klu// mi sdug bzhi ste nyer dgu yi// phyi cha nas bzung tshes gcig bar// tshes grangs phyed la bdag pa yin// rten 'brel bcu gnyis zla ba yi// sgang 'ded che chung bya lugs rnams// shog khra bzhin byas 'grub pa ste//ma rig 'du byed rnam par shes// ming gzugs skye mched reg pa dang // tshor bsred pa len pa dang // srid pa skyes pa rga shi'o// gcig nas bcu gnyis bar nga ga gi/ 'khor 'das ma lus shes pa yin//grangs kyi mngon brjod mtha' klas kyang // rtsis la nyer mkho ri bong dang // zla ba gzugs dang 'od dkar can// bse ru rnams ni gcig gi ming // 'khrig bgrod mtshe ma thabs shes dang // lag mig zung rnams gnyis kyi ming // 'jig rten tsha ba rtse mo me// yon tan srid pa gsum gyi ming // rgya mtsho chu bo rig byed dang // bdud dang sde pa chu gter bzhi// 'dod yon nyer spyod dbang po dang // mda' dang 'byung ba lnga yi ming // ro dus mtshams dang bro ba dang // rgyan dang bzang po drug tu grags// rin chen sa 'dzin thub pa dang // ri bo drang srong gza' rta bdun// bkra shis lha klu nor gdengs can//srid pa lto 'gro brgyad kyi ming // rtsa dang srin po bu ga dang // gter rnams dgu yi ming yin la// khro bo 'byor pa phyogs 'jug pa// stobs dang sor mo bcu ru 'dod// bde byed bde 'byung dbang phyug drag/ byed pa bcu gcig ming yin la// nyi ma rten 'brel khyim bcu gnyis// 'dod pa lus med myos

—dgo/rtsi ༄—bstanabacosanyargyar baposngiX'akhorablosaṣaḍi—phrinag 'kho'ajo/ 589 0byed ngang // gdugs rim sna tshogs bcu gsum grags// srid yid ma nu shed bu rmams// bcu bzhi'i ming du mkhas rnam sa smra// tshes dang nyin 'ag bco lngar grags// mi bdag rgyal po bcu drug la// nyes skyon khamanu/ rnams bco brgyad ming // rgyal ba yul ni nyer bzhir brjod// de nyid nyi shu rtsa lnga ste//'khor lo skar ma nyer bdun ming /// so dang gnyis skyes sum/ cu gnyis// stong pa nam mala' rnams ni thig/ grangs kyi ming gi mngon brjod 'di// rdo rje'i tshig don sbas tshul du// brjod par rjes grub btags pa'i phyir// tshad du bzung bar mi nus kyang // grags che nyer mkho de tsam mo//'o 'go'i 'dzin tshul lugs mang gi/ bshad tshul rnam grangs ji snyed dang // gza' skar lo zla'i ming gi grangs// ha cang mang zhing brjod mi langs//'on kyang mngon brjod khungs thub nas// ma bldabs skabs 'dir mkho rnams bsdus// gahṝg brnyi brnyi stoji khre 'baṃm dang // shā ya bye ba duñdza phyur rnams// rkyang pa'i gras su shes par bya// theri 'bum khrargo khrig rab bahūṃm dang // gtarmis dkrines mi 'khrugis khyadi 'byin dang // spaci rten delda 'dren maz-i' snang dang // rgyu rirgi 'od mast+waṃs datpa' bo dang // leshaṃs 'byin rtorgos 'gro 'amy-ing rdul dang // rgya stargo sto skres 'khor bsdi shes dang // rnarmi 'byung stobam̐s mig khyadi 'byin dang // byarmes pa snyikhri rje dashaṃ' ba dang //brteng snyoms rnams ni chen por bcas// gnyis gnyis grangs med tha ma ste//bcu 'gyur rig pas bsgro ba yin// gong rnams rtogs par bya ba la// thog mar dgu mtha'i nges pa nas// bsgyur bgod ri mo'i lag len rnams// byang chub shes par bya dgos pas// dgu gcig gcig dgu dgu rang la// dgu

590 ༄7//'bri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/gnyis gnyis dgu bco brgyad yin// dgu gsum gsum dgu nyi shu bdun//dgu bzhi bzhi dgu sum cu drug/ dgu lnga lnga dgu bzhi bcu lnga// dgu drug drug dgu lnga bcu bzhi// dgu bdun bdun dgu drug cu gsum// dgu brgyad brgyad dgu bdun cu gnyis// dgu dgu brgyad cu gya gcig go/ brgyad gcig gcig brgyad brgyad rang yin// brgyad gnyis gnyis brgyad bcu drug la//brgyad gsum gsum brgyad nyi shu bzhi// brgyad bzhi bzhi brgyad sum cu gnyirsā // brgyad lnga lnga brgyad bzhi cu tham// brgyad drug drug brgyad bzhi bcu brgyad//brgyad bdun bdun brgyad lnga bcu drug/ brgyad brgyad drug cu rtsa bzhi'o//bdun gcig gcig bdun bdun rang yin// bdun gnyis gnyis bdun bcu bzhi la// bdun gsum gsum bdun nyi shu gcig/ bdun bzhi bzhi bdun nyi shu brgyad// bdun lnga lnga bdun sum cu lnga// bdun drug drug bdun bzhi cu gnyis// bdun bdun bzhi bcu zhe dgu'o// drug gcig gcig drug drug rang yin// drug gnyis gnyis drug bcu gnyis te// drug gsum gsum drug bco brgyad do// drug bzhi bzhi drug nyi shu bzhi// drug lnga lnga drug sum cu tham// drug drug sum cu so drug go/ lnga gcig gcig lnga lnga nyid de// lnga gnyis gnyis lnga bcu tham pa// lnga gsum gsum lnga bco lnga la// lnga bzhi bzhi lnga nyi shu tham// lnga lnga nyi shu rtsa lnga'o// bzhi gcig gcig bzhi bzhi rang yin//bzhi gnyis gnyis bzhi brgyad rang yin// bzhi gsum gsum bzhi bcu gnyis so// bzhi bzhi bcu drug dag tu 'dod// gsum gcig gcig gsum gsum nyid do// gsum gnyis gnyis gsum drug yin la// gsum gsum dgu ru grags pa nyid// gnyis gcig gcig gnyis gnyis yin la// gnyis gnyis dag la bzhi zhes grags// gcig gcig gcig ni gcig nyid do// 'bri dang bgrang ba g.yas nas brtsams// bsgyur dang bgod pa g.yon phyogs nas//sgyur byed mtha' yi thig le rnams// bsgyur bya de yi gral mthar dgod//

༄7/rtsis kyi bstan bcos nya rgyas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor blo gsar kun da'i 'dod 'jo/ 591bsgyur bya stong par bsgyur du med// sgyur byed stongs na bsgyur gzhi dbyi//bsgyur ba'i don ni gang yin pa// gang bsgyur grangs su spel ba'o// gcig bsgyur ba la mang nyung med// gnyis sogs kyis bsgyur gong du 'phel//bgod byed mtha' dbus thig le ni// rang gnas 'dzin las bgod nus med//ma thob nor skal thig le byin// bgod la rkyang pa sbrags ma gnyis// rkyang bgod ji tsam thob thob 'khyer// sbrags bgod la ni 'og ma gtso// bgod pa'i don ni 'god byed kyi// grangs su sdud pa'i cho ga yin// gong du gcig 'phar bcur 'gyur te// brgya sogs rigs pas shes par nus// gsil dus bcu sogs rim par phab// lhag de rang rang gnas su bzhag/ thig le gral 'gor 'byung mi srid// rab 'byams shes bya kun ci yang // bsgyur bgod thams cad de ltar yin//gza' dang byed pa'i 'khor lo bdun// skar sbyor gnyis ni nyer bdun te// chu tshod chu srang drug cu la// dbugs drug cha shas mang nyung dang //gnas la nges pa med pa yin// rang rang 'khor lo gang longs pa// phud pa'i nor de gong mar bsres// gnas gong thob nor shas cher dor// bsre ba ster ba phul ba dang // sbyin pa 'bul dang khan pa dang // bsnan pa bsnon pa nor du 'gyur// ldan pa 'di bcu don gcig yin// 'phri dang sbyang dang 'phrog pa dang // zhu dang 'phral dang dor ba dang // 'brid pa dman pa bu lon 'gyur//dben pa 'di bcu don gcig yin// bsgyur dang bsnun dang spel ba dang //bsgres dang gsil lnga don gcig la// bgo dang phye dang bsal ba dang //bcad pa 'di bzhi don gcig yin// phyis pa dbyi ba bsubs pa dang // dor ba rnams ni don gcig ste// nor de dor bas go shugs kyis// bgod la dor ba'ang 'jug pa yod// rnyed pa thob pa nor dang gsum// don gcig tu ni shes par bya//

592 ༄7//'bri gung sman rtsis phyopa /sa bsgrigs/zhes rtsis kyi bstan bcos nya rgyas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor blo gsar kun da'i 'dod 'jo las beeḍūr dkar po'i sngon 'gro nas bsdu ba byas pa'i sarga dang po'o// sa bcad gnyis pa/ bstan rtsis bshad pa/lung rig mkhyen pa lha yi lam yangs por// dkar nag rtsis rig rgyu skar bdag po'i 'od// gtsug lag bstan pa'i kun da rgyas mdzad mgon// dpal ldan phug pa yab sras phyag gi gnas// rtsis rig smra 'dod blo gsar ye mkhyen rnams// lo yi nges pa yan lag brgyad ldan mtshor// rnam dpyod yol gos bcus pa'i bstan rtsis rgyun// rnam dag 'di ko nye reg cis mi bya// de yang ston pa'i 'khrungs lo dang // shambha la ru rigs ldan bcas// 'phags bod paṇa grub phebs lo sogs// bstan bcos beeḍūr dkar po las// cung zad dbri bsnan byas te bkod// me klung ri zung27ṭwāṃ2lo tshogs la// rab byung ma nu'i nang tshan gyi// sna tshogs chu rta'i 'das lo byin// stod 'grel don grub sa lug gi/ sprin dus chu stod nya tshes la// kun mkhyen mnyam med nyi ma'i gnyen//dga' ldan gnas nas gzigs pa lngas// ser skyar zas gtsang sgyu 'phrul ma'i//lhums su zhugs pa 27/2phyin gyi lo// de la bse rus dman pa yi// lcags sprel sa ga'i tshes bdun la// lumbi'i tshal du sku27rdo2 bltams lo// de la klu lag 2ṭwāṃ'aphral ba yi// sa byir grags 'dzin btsun mo la// rdor sems thugs kyi rang gzugs shig/ sras kyi tshul du byin brlabs shing // rol mo'i sgras bskum sgo bzhir phebs// rga na 'chi dang dge slong dag/ gzigs pas srid spangs rab byung lo27ra4/ / de la mtshamarngage 6sbyangs shing pho rta'i// sa ga zla ba'i bco lnga la// byang chub shing drung du gshegs nas// rdo rje'i skyil krung thun

༄7/rtsis kyi bstan bcos nya rgyas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor blo gsar kun da'i 'dod 'jo/ 593gcig gis// bdud dmag srod la tshar bcad de// nam gyi cha stod bsam gtan bzhi// dgung la mngon shes lnga bskyed do// rdo rje'i rnal 'byor bzhes pa nas// tho rengs rgyal rnga brdung ba'i tshe// mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas shing // sgra gcan 'dzin dang kun dga' bo// bltams shing bdun phrag bdun gyi mthar// chu stod tshes bzhir tshangs pa dang // brgya byin gsol ngor lnga sde la// bden bzhi'i chos 'khor thog ma'i lo274rdo// gzugs mig21'phri pa'i shing yos la// mu stegs ston pa drug po sogs// cho 'phrul du mas btul phyin lo27rdo7// de la mda' mig25'phri ba yi// lcags 'brug nag nyar// 'bras spungs su// dus 'khor gsungs shing sa ga zla'i// bco lngar rtswa grong thub pa'i dbang dang // gzugs sku'i rnam pa bsdus nas lo2702// de la zlas1 dman lcags sbrul la// chus rgyal zla bzang rtsa rgyud bsdus27rkya1//de la zung 2'phri chu lug la// zla bzang longs spyod rdzogs skur bzhengs26//de la gzugs 1sbyangs shing sprel lo'i// sprel zla'i tshes bcu'i nyi shar dus//snang mtha'i gsang gsum 'od lnga bcas// dha na ko sha'i mtsho gling gi/ sad sdong ze'u 'brur 'phogs sa las// zhing 'dir 'bras bu'i theg pa yi//gsang sngags nye lam zab mo nyid// snyon mdzad rgyal dbang padma 'byung //brdzus te bltams pa phyin gyi lo269/// de la mkha' mtsho gri ba yi// shing phyi mgo zla'i tshes bco lngar// rgya nag kun rdzob bden rtsis kyi// 'dul phyir 'jam dbyangs byis pa'i tshul// ngo mtshar ri bo rtse lnga'i gnas// trikṣa'i shing go lba ba las// brdzus te gser ltar bltams pa'i lo265ṭwāṃ// de la dus bug mig296gis 'phrog/ drag po zhes pa lcags sprel lor// grub chen ba ra na pa bltams2262// de la thig ros6rkyasbyangs pa na// lcags sprel bai dha'i yul gru cher// kyu sgrub rje rigs 'khrungs nas lo22rkya2// de la mtsho mkha' lag pas 204zhu// shing sprel rigs ldan 'jam dbyangs grags// rgyal par byon nas

594 ༄7khorabri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/bsdus rgyud2rkya47bstan// de la mkha' me mdas52rkya dor bas// dngos po zhes pa shing khyi lor// gangs ljongs chos rgyal thog ma rjed// tho ri gnyan btsan yum bur 'khrungs156rdo// de la bug ris79'phri ba yi// chu sgrul med sde za ma tog/ babs pa bstan pa snga dar14rdo9 'go/ de la mkha' chus40 'phral ba na// chu byar tho ri gnyan btsan bshegs1449// de la ri mtsho lag pas245 phri// lcags 'brug 'bras bstan dus gsum rdzogs// sgrub pa'i bstan pa'i thog mar1202 slebs// de la mtsho4yis dbri ba yi// nyi sgrol shing sprel bde 'byung khrir// rgya mtsho rnam rgyal phebs pa dang // ma gar mu stegs byed pa zhugs// me mkha' rgya mtsho thog ma119/'dren// de la 'byung bas dman pa yi// sa glang gangs can mgon gcig pu// chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po1142bltams// de la nyi mas12'phri ba yi// lcags glang spor thang nag rtsis kyi// snga 'gyur thog ma skyes dang bcas/ 'phags ma'i rang gzugs kong jo yang // pur rgyal mi rje'i mgron du khugs11〈1// de la nyis 12sbyangs chu glang lor// lha ldan 'phrul snang gtsug lag btab1169// de la thug ris77'phrog pa na// lcags rtar 'jam mgon khri srong bltams1rkya92// rtsa zlas19dman pa'i sa glang la// dus gsum mkhyen pa padma 'byung // bsil ldan 'gro ba'i mgon du phebs1༷72// de la lag2zhus lcags yos lor// zan g.yang mi 'gyur lhun grub btab1༷71// de la ri mos27 phri ba yis// sa 'brug 'jam dbyangs khri srong gshegs1༷42// rgyal pos dman pa'i shing sprel la// pad 'byung lho nub srin 'dum gshegs1rkya1ra// zung dman me khyir rtsis 'go zug1༷16// de la ri mdas57sbyangs pa yi// chu lug gnod sbyin mog smon 'bras/ me tog mda' can glang dar btsas959// de la me2phri mo khyi lor// khri ral 'khrungs 956shing de nyid la//'byung mes25phri ba'i lcags bya lor// glang dar srid bzung zla drug nas//

༄7/rtsis kyi bstan bcos nya rgyas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor blo gsar kun da'i 'dod 'jo/ 595smon lam dbang gi dam chos bsnubs921// de la gzugs phri rnga chen lor//zla ba phyed bdun lon pa'i tshe// lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje yis// nyag phran 'phrul gyis glang dar bsgril 920// de nas yum brtan 'od srungs sogs// khol bu rang btsan bsgyur ba las// bod spyir dbang ba'i rgyal po med// de la dus mig 26phri ba yi// sa byir ti lli shes bzang 'khrungasaṭwāṃ94// de la klu lag2ra gis sbyangs pas// me 'brug na ro paṇa chen 'khrungasardo66// de la drag sbyangs 11me yos de// rtsis 'go zug nas gsum pa'i thog/ 'di khongs lho phyogs 'phags yul du// gsang chen khyab bdag dus 'khor lo// tsi lu paṇa chen dus zhabs pas// thugs 'dzin mdzad nas spyan drangs loshrī55// dus6 dman chu byar phyi dar 'go/ bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa bzhed rdo49// de la mdas5dbrog pa stag la// phyi dar thog mar 'brom ston bzhedaṭwāṃ44// de la mtshos4phri chu rta la// mnyam med dri sam kū ra 'khrungs〈4༷// de la lag mig22 phri ba yi// shing 'brug 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs// mi yi srid bzung 'brom ston 'khrungasar1ra// klu yis sbyangs pa'i chu khyi la// sgra bsgyur mar pa lo tsā 'khrungs1rkya// de la ma nus14dman pa yi// me stag me mkha' rgya mtsho rjogs796// de la gzugs1phri me yos la// rab byung thog mar rtsis pa dang // gnyis med dus 'khor bod du phebs795// de la 'dod phri12 lcags 'brug la// rnal 'byor dbang phyug mi la dang // ba ri lo tsā 'khrungs phyin lo7ra2// de la yid14sbyangs shing rta la// mnyam med jo bo dag zhing gshegs76ra// srid2dman me byar rwa bsgrong btab765// de la mig2 zhus pa phag la// rngog lo blon ldan shes rab 'khrungs62// de la ma nus14 'phri ba yi// chu glang gsang phu sa skya btab749// de la dus6dman pa lug la// bka' brgyud yongs kyi gtsug rgyan che// sgam po 'dzam gling grags pa me'akhrungs742// de la 'byung5sbyangs shing byi lor// ras chung rdo rje grags pa
