—dgye/rtsisakru stant+raziwi nyayokho'idakyila'akhoratshitshond+rakunada'i'adod1spya/ 597phri chu mo lug gi lor// jo bsnub ye shes rdo rje 'khrungs59kha/ / rtse mos2 phrog pa'i me khyi la// thogo kha rin chen seng ge bltams596/ / bug9sbyangs shing rngo/ lus/ gi lor// 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags nga 'khrungs5shrī7/ / de la mes2 phri pa khyi lor// mtshams bcad grags pa bsod nams 'khrungs5〈ji/ / bug lag 2lasbyangs pa'i me yos la// rab byung lnga pa'i thog555ma yin// drag11 pos sbyangs pa'i sa stag la// bcu gnyis rdo rje rin chen bltams544/ /mtshams6 kyi phrog pa'i shing sprel la// pad 'byung gnyis pa nyer brgyad 'khrungs52ṭwāṃ/ / dus 6dbrog lcags stag bu ston bltams522/ / rimes27 sbyangs pa'i me yos la// rab byung drug pa'i thog mar 'bod495/ / klusar dman shing mo phag gi lor// nyer gnyis chos kyi rgyal po bltams4〈7/ / rgyal16sbyangs lcags yos rtses thang btab471/ / dus6 phri gser 'phyang me bya lor// kun mkhyen blo bzang grags pa 'khrungs465/ / de la mtshos 6sbyangs lcags glang lor// glab chen thang stong rgyal po 'khrungs461/ noraṭwāṃ gyis sbyangs pa'i sa bya la// bshes gnyen don grub rgyal po bltams452/ / skyon1ra sbyangs me mo yos kyi lor// rab byung bdun pa'i thog ma 425yin// mtshos4 dman lcags lug pad dkar 'dzin// dge 'dun grub pa 'khrungs pa'i lo421/ / de la bsu 4phrog shing phag lor// 'gro mgon bdag po wang 'khrungs lo427/ / yid14sbyangs sa glang btsong kha rjes// dga' ldan btab cing lha ldan du// cho 'phrul smon lam chen mo btsug412/ / de la ris2 sbyangs me sprel la// 'dul 'dzin bkra shis dpal ldan gyis// 'bras dkar spungs pa'i chos sde btab456/ / rtses2 phri sa phag byams chen rjes// se ra theg chen chos sde btab4rkya2/ / lag2 zhus lcags mo glang gi lor// chos rgyal rin chen dpal bzang 'khrungs4rkya1/ / zung2 dman chu yos thams cad mkhyen// dus zhabs nor bzang rgya mtsho bltams299/ / de la skyon phri lcags bya la// lo chen chos

598 ༄7/'bri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/skyong bzang po 'khrungs2rdo1// mtshams6sbyangs me yos rab brgyad kyi// thog mar dpal ldan phug pa bas// padma dkar po'i zhal lung brtsams// chag lo 'khrungs shing bkras lhun btab275// de la lag2dor pa sbrul la// rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan 'khrungs272// tshes15 phri shing sprel gong dkar du//rdo rje gdan gyi chos sde btab25ra// drag pos11sbyangs shing lug la// rgyal dbang skyob pa gnyis pa che// kun dga' rin chen dpal bzang bltams247// gzugs1phri me sprel gru 'dzin bdag paṇa chen dge 'dun rgya mtsho 'khrungs246// zla mes25phrog pa'i me yos la// rab byung dgu pa'i thog ma 215 'dren/ mig2sbyangs sa mo sbrul gyi lor// bstan gnyis srol 'dzin zab gter bdag/ rgyal dbang rin chen phun tshogs 'khrungs212// de la phyogs sbyangs pa yos la// rin chen rnam par rgyal ba bltams2rkya2// klus sbyangs me mo phag gi lor// paṇa chen dpal gyi rgya mtsho 'khrungs295// de la mtshams dor chu sbrul lor/ nges don bstan pa'i rgyan gcig pu//spre lung cog sgar che chung btsugs2ra9// phyogs 10sbyangs chu mos snying rje'i gter// kun mkhyen bsod nams rgya mtsho 'khrungs279// de la chus 4sbyangs me lug lor// rgyal sras lha rje'i sgyu 'phrul gar// mnyam med chos rgyal phun tshogs 'khrungs275// mkha' mig 2༷'phral ba'i me yos la// rab byung bcu pa'i thog mar slebs255// srid pas 2phri ba'i lcags rta la// phyogs las rnam rgyal gdan sar phebs252// mtsho 4yis sbyangs pa'i shing khyi la//nā ro bkra shis phun tshogs 'khrungs24ra// de la tshes 15sbyangs sa glang la//rgyal ba yon tan rgya mtsho 'khrungs222// gzugs 1kyis phri ba'i lcags stag la// rje btsun dkon mchog rin chen 'khrungs222// mdas 5'brid shing khams lug gi lor// rig 'dzin yongs kyi gtsug rgyan che// khyab bdag dharma kirti bltams227// de la lag mig 22dben pa yis// me sbrul rgyal dbang

༄7/rtsis kyi bstan bcos nya rgyas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor blo gsar kun da'i 'dod 'jo/ 599thams cad mkhyen// ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'khrungs2rkya5// de la mes 2phri lcags sprel la// lnga pa ting 'dzin bsgoms rdzogs shing // phrag drug tshul khrims gnas 'go tshugs2rkya2// de la ris 7phri me mo yos// rab byung bcu gcig thog ma dang // rigs ldan seng ge khrir phebs 195lo// ma nus zhus pa'i lcags sbrul lor// bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal po yi(yis3// bod khams yongs la mnga' dbang bsgyur1ṭwāṃ1 // de la gzugs 1sbyangs chu rta la// go shrī'i bod ljongs mnga' 'bangs kun// gong ma kun gzigs lnga pa la// 'bul zhing mchod yon dbu tshugs 1rarkyalo// de la mes 2phri shing mo byar// rgyal khab pho brang po ta la// sa btul rmang bting mdzad pa'i lo177// ris 7dor chu 'brug rgyal ba'i dbang // gong ma shun rtsis spyan drangs shing // rgya bod bstan pa yug gcig gi/ bdag por lung las bsngags gzos 'bul17༷// bse rus 1sbyangs pa'i chu sbrul lor// mi dbang sangs rgyas rgya mtsho 'khrungs169//srid 2dman me pho spre'u lor// 'phags mchog gru 'dzin dgyes dngos mchog/dkon mchog 'phrin las bzang po 'khrungs166// me mig 22zhus pa'i sa lug la// 'jam mgon mi yi srid bzung ba// chos rgyal sā ra rgyal sar phebs142// de la mtshos 4dman chu phag la// rgyal dbang blo bzang rin chen 'khrungs129// rgya mtshos 4dor ba'i me yos la// rab byung bcu gnyis thog ma dang // bstan bcos bee ḍūr dkar po yi// rtsis 'go 'dzin pa phyin gyi lo125// ri zlas 17zhus pa'i shing sprel la// don grub chos kyi rgyal po 'khrungs11rdo// sde pas 4dor ba'i sa byi la// rgyal ba bskal bzang rgya mtsho 'khrungs114// srin pos 9sbyangs pa'i me bya la// 'bri rdzong bkra shis tshugs bskrun 105no// de la ris 7dman shing 'brug la// snying rje'i gter dngos 'gro 'dul bltams9ṭwāṃ// tshes 15sbyangs sa mo lug gi lor/ gzhu smad theg mchog rdo rje'i spo'i// gtsug lag rmang gting mdzad pa'i lo82// lto 'gros ra

da 600 ༄khya//'bri gungasmanartsisaphyogasabasgrigs/ — ——dor ba'i me yos la// rab byung bcu gsum thog ma 'dzin75// de la bkra shis ṭwāṃzhus pa yi// shing phag dharma surya 'khrungs67// me 2yis 'phral ba'i sa stag la// rgyal ba 'jam dpal rgya mtsho 'khrungs64// nyi mas 12dbri ba'i lcags stag la// rigs kun khyab bdag pad dkar 'chang // bstan 'dzin padma'i rgyal mtshan bltams52// me mig 22dor ba'i chu glang la// 'di brtsams byed po snyoms las pa// dharma dhwa dza'i ming can brtsam/skurdo 2kha/ / de la drag 11sbyangs shing byi la// rje btsun padma'i rgyal mtshan nyid// byang phyogs 'gro rnams sgrol slad du// gnam mtsho phyug mo'i bskor ba la// zhabs zung bskyed cing 'gom dgon du// tshogs chen 'dus pa'i smin grol dang //'brong dgon bka' brgyad sgrub chen sogs// bstan 'gror sman yon chen po mdzad1ṭwāṃ// de la mig 2sbyangs me stag la// rgyal ba lung rtogs rgya mtsho bltams16// de la gzugs 1sbyang me yos 'di// rgyal bstan lnga brgya phrag bcu ru// gsungs pa'i lnga brgya phrag drug pa'i// steng nas lag thig mig 'das shing // sgrub pa'i dus kyi smad yin la// rab byung bcu bzhi'i thog ma 15yin// 'od dkar dman pa'i sa 'brug la// rje btsun padma'i mtshan can gyi// rin chen gsum gyi rgyur grub cing // nor sna'i phra rgyan dpag med bcas//tshe mtha' yas kyi snang brnyan che// byin rlabs char 'bebs grags pa bzhengs14// de la klus radaben me byi la// lung bstan dus babs ji bzhin du//bsam yas dbu rtse mes 'jig cing // rgyal ba tshul khrims rgya mtsho 'khrungs6//bse rus 1sbyangs pa'i me glang la// gzhung sa mchog nas thugs brtson gyis//bsam yas dbu rtse bzhengs 'go tshugs// mtshos zhedaman lcags mo sbrul gyi lor// zan g.yang dbu rtse rigs gsum sogs// legs grub rab gnas mdzad pa'i lo1// de la gzugs1sbyang chu rta lor// legs bshad bai ḍūr dkar po las// rtsis kyi bstan bcos khol phyung ba'i// nya rgyas zla ba'i dkyil

༄7/rtsis kyi bstan bcos nya rgyas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor blo gsar kun da'i 'dod 'jo/ 601'khor mchog/ blo gsar kun da'i 'dod 'jo yi// rtsis 'go'i 'das lo bzung ba'i mtshams//zhes rtsis kyi bstan bcos nya rgyas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor blo gsar kun da'i 'dod 'jo las bstan rtsis skor bai dkar la cung zad dbri bsnan bgyis te bkod pa'i sarga gnyis pa'o//sa bcad gsum pa/ grub rtsis kyi sgru wa khyad 'phags ma dang byed grub lnga bsdus bshad pa/'gru rgyal kai la sha yi sa 'dzin spor// gnam sbyin dkar po'i rigs las gdong lnga'i dbang // mdo sngags chos sgras log smra'i wa skyes tshogs//'joms mdzad rig 'dzin dharma kirtis skyongs// rnam dag dgongs don nor 'dzin gtsang ma'i ngogs// ngo mtshar rtsis gzhi sa brtol ljon pa'i dbang //lag len gsar bskrun kun —dga'i 'bras bzang 'di// blo ldan nor 'dzin longs spyod dpal du sbyin// de ltar grub rtsis sgru wa ni// khyad 'phags ma dang byed grub kyi// tsis 'phro ma gtogs lnga bsdus sogs// bee dkar gzhung bzhin khol phyung bkod// de yang rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i// sna tshogs la sogs 'das pa'i lo//nyi mas 12bsgyur la nag pa sogs// 'das zla bsres la gnas gnyis bzhag/'og ma mig 2bsgyur 'dod yon brgyan// dbang mtshams 65kyis thob stong du 'phang // zla ba rnam par dag pa'o// zla dag me klu srin nor rdo9rdo2brgyan//ri dbang dus klus ṭwāṃ657bsgyur ba la// mig bug mda' rtsa mes 29592thob pa// der la lhag ma ri 7yis bsgyur la// mig bug mda' rtsa mes 29592thob pa// gza' yin lhag ma mkha' ros 6༷bsgyur// bgod byed kyis thob dbyu gu

602 ༄7khorabri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/ste// slar yang mkha' ros 6༷bsgyur ba la// bgod byed thob pa srang yin la//dus 6bsgyur bgod byed thob pa dbugs// ri mkha' ris 7rkya7bsgyur bgod byed kyis// thob pa cha ste gza' sgru dag/ ril char zla ba dag pa la// drag po 'khor los 2711brgyan par bya// me dbang lag pas 252bsgyur ba la// klu lag 'byung mes 252rathob pa dor// slar yang nor lag 2ṭwāṃgis bsgyur la//klu lag 'byung mes 252rathob pa de// ril po'o lhag ma dus nyis 126bsgyur//klu lag 'byung mes 252rdothob pa de// cha shas yin no lhag med 'char// nyi sgru'i don du zla dag la// zla ba ri mo 271byin pa de// mda' ros 65bsgyur la chu mkha' klusaṭwāṃrkya4// dor lhag 'khor lo 27bsgyur ba la// chu mkha' klus rdorkya4thob skar gnas te// lhag ma mkha' ros 6༷bsgyur ba la// chu mkha' klus rdoX4thob dbyu gu ste// yang lhag mkha' ros 6rkyabasgyur ba la// bgod byed kyis thob chu srang ste// lhag ma dus 6bsgyur bgod byed thob// dbugs so slar lhag ri ro 67yis// bsgyur la bgod byed kyis thob pa// cha de lhag med rnam dag 'byung // de ni sgrub tshul khyad 'phags shing // ngo mtshar skye ba'i sgru wa yin//spyi 'gro bsgrub na zla dag de// gnas lnga steng nas gzugs 1dang ni//zla yon 21mkha' dbang 5༷stong pa dang // mkha' nor chu bos 4rdoXrim bsgyur la// gzugs 1tshes 15dus mtsho 46lag pa 2dang // mtsho dbang 'dod yon 554brgyan pa la// ri mkha' ri 7༷7dang dus 6mkha' ro6༷// thig mtshams 6rkyathub pas dor ba'i lhag/ gza' yi byu wa rnam par dag/ zla dag gnas gnyis steng ma lag2/ 'og ma gzugs 1kyis bsgyur ba la// ril por khang 11phyug char mda' ro65// byin la dus khyim 126nor lag 2ragis// bsgril bas ril cha'i sgru wa 'grub// zla dag gnas lnga steng rim bzhin// mig 2phyogs 1rkyaklu dbang 5ragazugs 1dang ni// gza' 7zlas bsgyur la dus mig

༄7/rtsis kyi bstan bcos nya rgyas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor blo gsar kun da'i 'dod 'jo/ 605rgyal ba 24yin// drang srong 7de nyid 25stong rkyal stong 0/ / rkang bzung gdong mas cha shas bsgyur// ma zin rkang pa dang pos bsgyur// dus khyim 124thobapa yang dug sgru/ / lhag ma mkha' ros 6rkyabasgyur thob srang // mang lhag ros 6bsgyur dbugs yin te// slar lhag ri mkha' ris 707bsgyur bar// dus khyim 126thob pas rnam par dag/ yang dag sgru ba'i chu tshod de// snga rkang bsnan la phyi rkang phri// de ni gza' bar longs spyod du// nor mnyam bsnan la mi mnyam phri// de yang nyi dang shed mnyam ched// cha shas ri ros 67bsgyur ba la// ris mkha' ris 7rkya7thob nor lnga pa// lhag ste cha shas drug pa yin// nyi bar gnas gnyis gcig la ni// skar mtshams chu tshod 'byung chus 465sbyangs//ma ldang 'khor lo 27bsnan la sbyangs// sbyangs shul 'dod pa 12mkha' me 2rkyade// longs na dor la lhag ma ni// mkha' ros 6rkyabasgyur la chu tshod bcug/'byung me zlas 125thob nyi rkang bzung dang // ro 6mtsho 4bse ru 1snga rkang ste//ldo ga pa dang bcas dus 6kyi gnas// snga phyi zos dang ma zos sdom// g.yon bgrangs gzugs 1mda' 5dag la dus6/ / mig 2chu 4phyogs 1rkyal me 2drag 11sdom// stong la stong pa rnam par dag/ rkang bzung gdong mas lhag rnams bsgyur// ma zin tshe na dang pos bsgyur// 'byung me zlas 125thob yang sgru chu srang sogs kyi rang cha 'jug pa go ba'i shugs kyis rigs 'gre'o yin// lhag ma mkha' ros 60bsgyur thob srang // dus 6bsgyur dbugs su shes pa ste// ri ros 67bsgyur thob cha shas yin// snga rkang bsnan la phyi rkang phri// gza' dang nyi ma'i longs spyod du// 'dod pa mkha' me dor ba na// bsnan la ma dor dbri ba ste//gza' dang nyi ma dag pa yin// zla skar ched la nyi dag gcig/ chu tshod mtsho dbang 54tshes bsgyur byin// tshes 'khyud zla ba'i skar ma dag/ de la gza' longs man gyis sbyangs// res 'grogs zla skar 'grub pa yin// nyi zla bsres pas sbyor ba 'grub// byed pa tshes grangs 'khrig pas 2bsgyur// gzugres 1

606 ༄7ltarabri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/dman ri 7yis bgos pa'i lhag/ phyi cha'i byed pa yin pa ste// gza' tshes skar sbyor byed pa lnga// yan lag lnga ru bzhed pa yin//bsdus pa'i rgyud kyi rjes 'brangs pa'i// byed pa'i rtsis ni bstan pa la//rab byung bcu bzhi'i nang tshan gyis// chu rta la sogs 'das pa'i lo// nyi mas 12bsgyur la nag pa sogs// 'das zla bsres la gnas gnyis bzhag/ 'og ma mig 2bsgyur srin po 9bsnan// mda' ros 65thob pa zla dag go/ de nyid 'phar na lugs 'dir bshol// 'dir yang bsgrub lugs mi 'dra ba// yod kyang da las dkyus ltar du// zla dag gnas gsum steng rim bzhin// bse ru 1zla me 21mkha' 'byung 50bsgyur// steng nas ro 6dang chu tshod thigaX/ mkha' mes 2༷phri la mkha' ro 6rkyaganyis// thub 7pas dor lhag gza' sgru'o// zla dag gnas gnyis steng ma mig2/ 'og ma gzugs kyis 1bsgyur ba la// ril por mi bdag 16char ri mtsho47// phri la dus khyim 126klu lag 2ṭwāṃgis// dor lhag ril cha'i sgruba'o// zla dag gnas lnga steng rim bzhin/ mig 2phyogs 1rkyaklu dbang 5/lag 2phyogs 1༷bsgyur// skar gnas dus mig 26chu tshod du//ri lag 27'dod pa 12chu srang yin// dbugs 'byung 5cha shas gzugs 1kyis phrispyo 'dod 12ro 6mkha' ro 67thig ro 6༷dang // 'khor los 27der lhag nyi sgru'o// kun la sbyang bar ma ldang na// so so'i 'khor lo bsnan par bya// snga sgrur rang rang bsgyur byed byin// rim bzhin phyi ma'i sgru ba 'char// de nas nyin rtsis bya ba la// gza' sgrur chu tshod rtse dbang 59dang // srang yon 2dbugs chu ji9cha thig ༷dang // nyi sgrur dbyug mtsho 4zla mig 21srang // dbugs dbang 5cha shas bu ga 9rnams//byed rtsis kyi rtag longs re'u mig

༄7/rtsis kyi bstan bcos nya rgyas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor blo gsar kun da'i 'dod 'jo/ 609'khor lo 27bsnan la 'khor ༈:phyed dor// lhag ma'i skar ma thig 60ros bsgyur// chu tshod bcu drug la 'byung 125me zlas// bgos thob nor gyi nyi rkang bzung // ro 6mtsho 4bse ru 1snga rkang ste// ldog pa dang bcas dus 6kyi gnas//snga phyi zos dang ma zos sdom// rkang bzung gdong mas lhag rnams bsgyur// ma zin rkang pa dang pos bsgyur// 'byung me zlas 125thob yang dag rgyu// lhag ma thig ro 6rkya dus 6'dod pa12/ / lhag med 'dod na mkha' ri mig270/bsgyur rang rang gi cha go ba'i shugs kyis 'jug thob snga rkang bsnan pa dang // phyi rkang phri ba'i longs spyod de// gza' nyi bar pa gnyis ka la// 'khor phyed dor bsnan ma dor phri// de yis gza' dang nyi ma dag/ nyi dag gnas gnyis gcig la ni//chu tshod mtsho dbang 54tshes bsgyur byin// gza' yi longs spyod man gyis sbyangs// re grogs zla ba'i skar ma yin// nyi zla gnyis bsres sbyor ba 'grub//byed pa tshes grangs mig 2 bsgyur la// gzugs 1phri thub 7pas dor ba de//bsdus rgyud yan lag lnga ga tshang // de yang byed pa'i skyon bton pa'i// zhal lung lugs bzhin rnam dag tu// 'dod na gza' nyi gnyis po yi// sgru wa'i bsgyur gzhi so so la// ma nor bsgyur bar dbri byed de// gza' la dbang po 5chu tshod du// zla chu 41srang la ri 'byung ba57/ / dbugs khrig 2nyi gnas stong pa dang // chu tshod klu rdodang srang dus me26/ / dbugs la rtse mo 2'dod char gzugs1/ / phri la gzhan ma spyi ltar byas// rab yid chu rta'i byed pa yi//rtsis 'phro skyon 'don yin na'ang // rim bzhin skyon cher 'gro ba sogs//zhal lung ma bur gsungs pa'i phyir// dkyus bzhin bya las ha cang gi//dgos don che ba'i gnad ma mchis//zhes rtsis kyi bstan bcos nya rgyas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor blo gsar kun da'i 'dod 'jo las grub rtsis kyi sgru wa khyad 'phags ma dang byed grub lnga bsdus skor rtsis 'phro ma gtogs bee dkar sor gzhag bgyis pa'i san gsum pa'o//

610 〉〉ltarabri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/sa bcad bzhi pa/ sgra gcan skor dang zhar byung byed grub lo gza' cung zad gsal zhing༄la blon kar myang dpang phyug yab yum khrim gza' sgrub lugs bshad pa/mdo rgyud rig byed dka' gnad chu gter che// mkhyen rab gru gzings kyis bskyod rang rang blor// 'tshams pa'i legs bshad nor bu sbyin mkhas pa//dkon mchog lhun grub mtshan snyan dad pa'i yul// rgyud rgyal dgongs don longs spyod 'khor lo nas// sgra gcan rtsis gzhung g.yas 'khyil dung dkar po//ma rig gnyis tuganyid3slong lag len zab mo'i dbyangs// 'khrul med skye ba lnga pa 'di na snang // de ltar dpal ldan sgra gcan dang // lo gza' rgyal blon kar myang rtsis// khyim bza' bcu gnyis la sogs pa// bee dkar khol phyung 'dir 'god bya// rab byung bcu bzhi'i sna tshogs kyi// zla ba rnam par dag pa la// bu ga 29yon tan brgyan pa de// mkha' me 20bsgyur la gang brtsi yi//tshes grangs bsres la gnas lnga bzhag/ steng nas rim bzhin nam mkha' 0dang // rkyastong pa 0ma nu 14dbugs thig leX/ / cha shas nyi mas 12bsgyur byas la// py-i~Xṭwāṃme mig 22ro 6dang srang mkha' ro6༷/ / thig mtshams 6rkya'akhor los 27dor ba'i lhag/ bsod nams ldan pa'i bul ba dag/ de yi 'khor lor 27phri ba yi// gdong gnas skar dang longs spyod shar// de la 'khor phyed ༈:ster ram dman// mjug gam dus me rnam par dag/yang na zla ba dag pa la// bu ga 269bzang po lag ldan pa// mig 2bsgyur nya gzugs 1stong mig 2byin// mkha' dus chu bos 46༷thob pa dor//

༄7/rtsis kyi bstan bcos nya rgyas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor blo gsar kun da'i 'dod 'jo/ 611lhag ma skar mas 27bsgyur ba la// mkha' dus chu bos 46rkyathob pa dor//lhag ma skar mas 27bsgyur ba la// mkha' dus chu bos 46༷'god pa sogs//byas kyang bul ba gong bzhin 'char// khyim gnas ji ltar blta ba'i phyir//skar gnas mkha' ros 6rkyabasgyur ba la// chu tshod bsres la 'byung me zlas125// thob pa 'das pa'i khyim yin cing // lhag rnams dbang ri 575mda' yis bsgyur// 'byung me zlas 125thob 'das pa'i zhag/ gdong mjug gnyis ni ya 'ongs zhag/ thob pa'i lhag de mkha' ros 6rkyabasgyur// 'byung me zlas 125thob chu tshod la// yang lhag mkha' ros 6༷bsgyur thob srang // slar lhag dus 6bsgyur thob pa dbugs// de lhag me mig 22gis bsgyur bar// 'byung me zlas 125thob cha shas te// gdong mjug dbang ri 'byung bar 575sbyangs//lhag de khyim der 'das zhag yin//gzhan yang gro bzhin byi bzhin gnyis// longs spyod phyed pa'i bdag nyid de// phral ba'i rgyu skar nyi shu brgyad// phyogs re ri bo'i grangs gnas la//rgyu skar phyed ni lus kyis khyab// smin drug nas bzung g.yon la 'khor//gdong mjug skar ma gang gnas bzhag/ lo 'gros nag rtsis ltar gnas pa'i//nyi skar dus tshod dag dang bstun// gdong pa g.yon dang mjug ma g.yas//rang nyid ltor gnas blta phyogs la// g.yul 'jug gshags 'gyed rtsal sprod dang // rgyan dang cho lo mdos gtor sogs// las kun rang nyid rgyal zhing dge/ zhib par bshad na 'di bzhin te// rang nyid gdong nas skar ma yi//chu tshod phyed nas g.yas 'khor ba'i// skar bzhi'i khyon bar mthong phyi dang //g.yon du 'khor ba'i skar bzhi'i bar// dus me'i mthong snga spang pa yin//mjug ma de ltar g.yas g.yon brtsi// lto ba'i phyed drug rang gnas pa// lta ba'i phyed drug 'thab skar la// yin pa mkhas pa'i srol la bshad// drag gza' lte ba'i char gnas shing // zla ba blta ba'i phyogs gnas na// khyad par

612 ༄7rṣabri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/can gyi stobs nyid che//yang na sgra gcan nyi mas sbyangs// ma ldangs skar ma 27bsnan la sbyangs//sbyangs lhag mkha' ros 6rkyabasgyur ba la// 'byung me zla bas 125thob pa bgo/phyed lhag nor la gcig byin bya// nor nas g.yon skor rtsis pa'i sar//gdong pa gnas po des shes 'gyur// 'di yang thun mong lugs gcig yin//gzhan yang sgra gcan gdong sogs la// nyi dag skar mas sbyang bar bya//ma ldangs 'khor lo 27bsnan la phri// lhag ma'i skar ma mkha' nyis 12rkyabasgyur//chu tshod zung 2bsgyur bsres pa la// 'byung mkha' mtsho 4rkya5yis bgos thob pa//shar nas rim bzhin phyogs bzhi dang // mtshams bzhir skya rengs shar nas bzung // nyin tshad mtshos 4bgos dus bzhi dang // mtshan tshad chus 4bgos dus bzhi ru// phye sar nyi ma yod par bzhed// de nas bgrangs pa'i thob nor sar// khams gsum snang byed bdag po gnas// thob nor stongs na gza' nyi 'grogs// gcig thob snga dro phyed nas 'char// gnyis la nyin phyed gsum dgongs phyed// bzhi thob mun mtshams lnga srod phyed// drug la nam gung bdun tho rengs// shar ri'i rtse nas sgra gcan 'char// de ltar rtsa ba'i sgra gcan gyi// tsis gzhi rnam par dag pa dang // mdos gtor la sogs thebs phyogs kyi// brtsi tshul rags tsam yi ger spel// zhib na rā hu gzhan bdun dang // gang rtsi'i lo zla tshes gza' skar// gang zag nyid dang bstun pa sogs//rgyas par dbyangs 'char rgyud nyid du// bstan la mkhas rnams zhib gzigs mdzod//grub pa'i lo yi bdag po'i sa/za'// nyi ma nya rdzogs lug khyim du// sleb pa'i zhag de'i grub gza' yi// res gza' lo yi bdag po dang // lug tu slebs pa'i nyin zhag der// lha yi bla ma longs spyod pa'i// skar ma gang yin lo skar ro//

༄7/rtsis kyi bstan bcos nya rgyas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor blo gsar kun da'i 'dod 'jo/ 613byed pa lo yi bdag po ni// rab byung ma nu'i chu rta nas// gang rtsi'i 'das lo gnas lngar bzhag/ gzugs 1tshes 15gzugs me 21ri bong 1can//gzugs nyis 121bsgyur la steng rim bzhin// me 2dang lag mig 22bug mda' 59mtsho4/ / rig byed skar 274byin mas nas yar// ri zla yon tan 217dus 6mkha' ro6rkya/ / thig ro 6rkyathub pas 7dor ba yis// byed pa lo 'pho 'grub pa yin//zhal lung lo 'pho rnam zin rkang pa thog mas bsgyur// mda' yon 125zlas thob yang dag rgyu// lhag ma thig ros 60bsgyur ba la// srang bcug thob pa chu srang ste// dus 6bsgyur thob pa dbugs yin lhag/ rang rang cha shas kyis bsgyur bar// cha bcug thob pa cha shas te// lhag med rnam dag ri mo 'char// snga rkang bsnan la phyi rkang phri// rang rang dal bar gcig shos la//'khor phyed 12dor bsnan ma dor phri// de yis dal ba dag par 'gyur// de nas myur ba dag pa'i don// dal dag rkang 'dzin cha shas rnams// shed snyoms phyir la gang nyung gis// bsgyur ba mang bas bgos thob pa// nor de nyung cha lhag rang cha// yin no gnas drug spel la// so so'i dal ba dag pa yis// drag gsum rkang 'dzin nyi bar dang // zhi gnyis so so'i rkang 'dzin dman// ma ldangs 'khor lo 27bsnan la sbyangs// 'khor phyed ༈nyulhag na dor bar bya// lhag ma'i skar mas myur rkang bzung // 'khor phyed dor na rim min dang // ma dor rim pa bzung byas la// rim min rkang 'dzin thig le la//chu tshod mkha' mer 2༷longs mtshams nas// rim min kun la mkha' me 20bsre rim pa'i rkang 'dzin bcu gsum 12pa dang / rim min rkang 'dzin thig le rkyashar ba'i tshe/ chu tshod gcig gnyis sogs nas nyer dgu'i bar mang nyung gang byung yang / rkang long mkha' mes 2rkyabago dgos/ rkang 'dzin thig 0la chu tshod sum cu yan byung mtshams nas bzung ste/ rim min rkang 'dzin bcu gsum 12dang chu tshod nyer dgu'i 29bar/ lhakṣ-ici tsam byung ba de bar gyi rim pa

614 ༄7|'bri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/yin/ 'bab cing // la lar mi 'bab 'bru tshogs nyams// me shar kun 'jug ces zer te// yul kun khyab par sbrang char 'bab// thig le zhod che chu bo rgyas// dbang phyug mjal phrad ces bgyi ba// byed pa lo bdag gza' dbyug gnyis// gnas ni bcu gnyis bkod byas te// gza' la zla ba 1ri dbang 57phyug/ lug khyim don du byin par bya// chu 4dang me dbang 52glang la byin//ri bong 1ri gzugs 17'khrig pa ste// rgya mtsho 4me mda' 52kaṅka ṭa// zla ba 1mig bgrod 22seng ge la// chu gter 4rgyal ba bu mo 24ste// dus 6dang gzugs dbang 51srang gi don// zla ba 1ri mtsho 47sdig pa la// me 2dang rgyal po gzhu 16la ste// mtsho 4dang gza' yon 27chu srin yin// dus 6dang rgya mtsho 4bum pa la// nam mkha' rkyamig 'byung 52nya la bsre// so sor ma nor bsnan pa la// mkha' ro 6rkyathub pas 7bsgril ba'i lhag/ gang shar khyim gza' bcu gnyis yin//ces rtsis kyi bstan bcos nya rgyas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor blo gsar kun da'i 'dod 'jo las sgra gcan bskor rtsis 'phro ma gtogs bee dkar dkyus bzhin dang // zhar byung byed grub lo gza' cung zad gsal zhing rgyal blon kar myang dbang phyug yab yum khyim gza' sgrub lugs bcas khol phyung bkod pa'i sa bcad bzhi pa'o//sa bcad lnga pa/ gza' lnga nyin zhag dang ches spyod bai dkar sor ba nag dang gza' lnga khrim zhag gsar bsnan gyi sgrub lugs bshad pa/dkon mchog gsum gyi gsang gsum mtha' bral ngogs// cha rdzogs

༄7/rtsis kyi bstan bcos nya rgyas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor blo gsar kun da'i 'dod 'jo/ 615'phrin las 'od dkar skye dgu yi// nyon mongs mun 'joms bzang po'i bsil zer can// khyab bdag mtshan mo'i mgon la snying nas dad// 'khrul bral rtsis kyi gzhung bzang dbyar gyi rngas// nyer bskul sngon med legs bshad gtsug phud can// tshul bzhin rtogs pa'i cha kun bsags pa'i sgro// gza' lnga gsum gyi rnam bkra'i kha dog 'bar// de yang legs ldan gza' lnga po//nyin zhag khyon la spyod pa dang // tshes la spyod dang khyim zhag bcas// lag len snying por phyung ste bkod// dang po/ nyin zhag khron la spyod tshul/rab byung bcu bzhi'i nang tshan gyi// sna tshogs la sogs 'das pa'i lo//mig gzugs 12bsgyur la nag pa sogs// 'das zla bsres la gnas gnyis bzhag/ 'og ma zung 2bsgyur dbang pos 5brgyan// 'byung ros 65thob pa steng du 'phang // zla ba rnam par dag pa'o// zla dag thig yon 4rkyagyis bsgyur la// gang brtsi'i tshes bsre gnas gsum bzhag/ bar du ri mtsho 47'og ma la//me dang nyi ma 122byin byas te// ri mkha' ri 7༷7dang chu ro 64yis// brnyed nor steng sbyangs nyin zhag gam/ spyi zhag ces su grags pa yin// nyin zhag sgru ba'i don ched du// tshes grangs ma bsres spyi zhag de// gnas lngar bzhag la nam mkha' 0mtsho4// dus mig 26/zeg rkyadang cha shas la// dus tshes mig bug 92156gis bsgyur bar// 922phyi56steng nas dus mig 26me dbang 52dang // bde 'byung 11yon tan 2cha shas la// bug me dbang klu yid 14ra529byin nam// yang na steng nas thig ༷dngarkya ro6// klu mtsho 4rdolag pa 2cha shas la//nam mkha' 27ri ros 670sbyang ba la//6stirkya mas rim bug mkha' mig bug yid

616 ༄7/khabri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/14kha2rkya9// mtshams 6dang mkha' ro 6rkyathig ro 60dang // 'khor los 27dor lhag nyi sgru'o// de nas drag gsum dal bar dang // zhi gnyis rkang 'dzin don ched du// gang brtsi'i tshes bsres spyi zhag de// gnas lnga rim pas tshar lnga bzhag/ dang po bkra shis dal bar don// thig ༷miX 2zla zung 21'khrig pa 2dang // klu mkha' mtshe mas 20rabasgyur byas la// 22〉〈steng nas dbang phyug 11'byung mtsho 45dang // rtse mo 2'dod yon 5cha shas la// 'jig rten rtse mo rdzu〈'od dkar 122byin//1/22 bug mig lag 229dang dus 6mkha' ro6༷//thig ro 6rkya'akhor los 20bsgril ba'i lhag bkra shis dal bar rnam par dag/gnyis pa zla bu'i don nyid la// stong pa rkyatram̐n 1rdodang rgyal ba 24mda'5/ ri klu dus mtshos 46〈7bsgyur byas la// 4ktosnye7 steng ri 7zla zung 21me dbang 52da/nga1 // drag po 11nyer spyod 5cha shas la// me dbang dus klu ṭwāṃ652byin pa la//rardo5spya2mas rim ri bug ri klu ṭwāṃ797dus6// mkha' ro 60thig mtshams 6rkya'akhor los 27dor// zla bu'i rkang 'dzin longs spyod 'grub// gsum pa bla ma'i don ched la// nam mkha' rkyastongarkya pa 0lag mig 22dang // dbugs zung 2dus mig mtshe mas 226bsgyur// 22ṭwāṃ26 steng nas bse ru 1klu mtsho 4ṭwāṃdang //du~X mig 26'byung ba 5cha shas la// srin po bug gzugs 199byin la yar//1/shārdzogazugs dus me 261dang dus 6mkha' ro6rkya// thig ro 6rkya'akhor los

620 ༄༅//'bri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/ba'i 6gnas// snga rkang zos zin sdom bya zhing // phyi rkang la ni za rgyu sdom//rkang bzung gdong mas lhag rnams bsgyur// ma ni/ gong gi lo 'pho gnas so sor// steng nas zung 2dang mkha' me 2rkyadang // klu dbang 5rdodabugs mig 2cha shas la// mtshe ma ri lag 272brgyan pa yis// lo grangs stong pa bzang po'i bar// skyon 'don rnam par dag pa yin//rgyal blon ched du 'das pa'i lo// mes bsgyur gnas gnyis steng ma la//zung 2dang 'og ma 'byung bas brgyan// ri 7yis bgos nor so sor dor//steng ma rgyal dang 'og blon po// chu 4yis phri'am mes 2brgyan na// phyi ma'i rgyal blon rim bzhin 'char//nee pa la yi mkhas rnams bzhed pa'i// kar myang rtsis la mtsho chu dang //ri zlas 1744lo la rab yid kyis// sna tshogs nas bzung gang brtsi'i bar//lo bamis shā ka'i 'das lor grags// de nyid mes 2bsgyur drang srong 7bgo/thob nor logs bzhag lhag ma de// char gyi don du mig 2 gis bsgyur//'byung ba 5byin pa char 'bras yin// sngon gyi thob nor me 2yis bsgyur// ris 7bgod la sogs lan brgyad bya// 'bru rtswa bsil drod rlung 'phel zad//'khrug rnams rim pa bzhin du shes// nyung mtha' 'byung ba 5mang mtha' la//ri zla 17'bring po nyi ma 12yin// so sor mang nyung 'bras bu byin// yang ni shā ka'i 'das lo de// dbang phyug 11sbyangs la lhag ma de// mtsho 4yis dor lhag gzugs 1shar na// rdzing bur 'jug ces than pa che// gnyis pa 2yan lag 'jug ces pa// yul gru la lar char bod la chu tshod du mkha' me bsres nas drug cu 6rkyalongs na skar gnas su phud/ des slar rkang pa bzung sbyor byas nas rkang bzung sngon mas bsgyur chu tshod bar du rang 'khor bsgril nas nam mkha' ros 6༷bgo bar bya'o// longs na rkang 'dzin phud de bzung // myur ba'i rkang ba 'di bzhin te// dpal ldan gza' lnga'i myur rkang sa skyes rgyal ba yon lag 22gsum// sgru/ zla mig gnyis

༄7/rtsis kyi bstan bcos nya rgyas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor blo gsar kun da'i 'dod 'jo/ 653spyi yi sgru ba mkha' mkha' ros6rkyarkya/ / thob nor gsum 2las mang mi srid//'di ni gtso bo don brtag ste// gcig byung re 'bras zhing bdag gza'//gnyis byung dogs pa'i 'bras 'byung ba// taṅgāl bgrangs pa'i lnga pa'i gza'//gsum gyis re dogs gang yang med// taṅgāl nas bgrangs dgu pa'i gza'//dus ni nam 'grub brtag pa la// thob nor mkha' mkha' dus 6༷0kyis bsgyur// de nyin res gza'i grangs kyang bsre// mkha' mes 20bgos thob zla grangs dang // lhag ma zhag gi grangs yin la// de yang myur 'grub las yin na// mkha' mes bgos thob zhag so ste// lhag ma chu tshod grangs su nges//dgu cha'i dus sbyor 'di lta ste// spyi sgru mkha' stong mig 20༷gis bgo/ thob nor taṅgāl gang yin nas// bzung la dgu cha brtag pa de// lug seng gzhu rnams lug nas bgrang // chu srin glang dang bu mo ni// chu srin nyid nas 'dren par bya// 'khrig pa bum pa srang nas 'dren// karū sdig nya karha 'dren// 'di nyid rkun ma la sogs pa// brtag thabs mngon shes mang yod kyang // yi ges 'jig dang gsal drag pas// cung zad gud du sbas pa dang // gzhon nu spro ba bskyed pa'i phyir// brkus sam sbas sam khyer ba yi// ngag tu ma brjod ma mthong ba'i// dngos po 'di zhes brjod 'dod na// lug seng sdig pa'i dus sbyor la// bdun par nyi mig 'dzom pa'am// re re shar kyang rdzas de ni//lcags gser dngul zangs la sogs pa// bzhu ru btub pa'i rdzas shig dang //g.yu dang byu ru mu men dang // mu tig la sogs mi btub yin// bu mo chu srin 'khrig bum pa// shar nas de grangs bdun pa la// lhag spen 'dzom mam re re shar// ras gos shing lo la sogs pa// rtsa dang rtsa bar grub ces grags//srang gzhu nya glang karū shar// bdun par zla phur sangs 'dzom mam// re re yod kyang sha rus khrag/ pags sam srog chags rigs yin brjod// kha dog rags pa gza' mdog ste// phur seng nyi ma dmar skya'i mdog/ mig dmar

654 ༄7khibri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/dmar nag sgra gcan sngo// zla ba dkar ser spen pa nag/ lhag pa ljang dang sngo bar gnas// pa sangs kha dog nges med yin// de nas dbyibs dang rku shor na// mi yi ming grangs gang nye sogs// yod kyang gud du sbas nas bzhag/bcu gnyis cha la spyi sgru de// mkha' dbang gzugs 15rkyakyis bgod par bya//thob nor taṅgāl nas bgrangs pa'i// khyim gyi bdag po'i 'bras bu'am// tshong dang dgos don nad pa'i phyir// gcig byung bdag po 1kṛṇi dang // gnyis 2shar bdag po 'jom pa ste// gsum 2sogs bzang po 2mdze can 4dang // ba glang sna 5ni dkar po dang // thog 6dang sdug bsngal 7rnam mdzes rdodang //skal can 9gangs bdag 10drag po 11dang // thig shar nye ba'i ri bo yin//de yis bdag po'i gza' brtag par// zhing bdag nas bgrangs nyin drug 'gor// mtshan mo lnga 'khor gang yin la// bcu gnyis cha yi thob nor de//nyin la lnga 5dang mtshan mtshos 4bsgyur// zhing bdag gza' grangs bsnan pa la// thub pas dor lhag bdag po'i gza'// tshong nad dgos don la sogs pa// 'bras bu bdag po'i ming yig la// brten nas zhib par shes na yang //ha cang mang dang gsal drag pas// tho long tsam las ma bkod do// sum cu cha la spyi sgru la// mkha' ros 60bgos la dmag dpon 2dang // nyi bu rkyabla ma 5zla ba'i bu4// dkar po 6rim par bzhag byas la// 'byung ba 5mda' 5klu ṭwāṃri 7dbang 5bkod// lug sogs mi mnyam rim pa g.yas// glang sogs mnyam ste rim min g.yon// grangs mthun thad ka'i gza' 'bras te// lug 'khrig seng ge srang gzhu bum// mi mnyam rnyed nor gzugs 1mda' 5bar// mig dmar dus nas phyogs 1rkyabar spen// drag po 11nyes pa'i 1rabar du phur// bug gzugs 19de nyid 25bar lhag pa// dus mig 26mkha' me'i 20bar pa sangs// de yis 'bras bu bzang ngan ston // glang dang karū bu mo sdig/chu srin nya bcas mnyam pa drug/ gzugs 1nas mda' 5bar pa wa sangs//

༄7dzees kyi bstan bcos nya rgyas zla b.ri dkyil 'khorawā gsar kun da'i 'dod 'jo/ 655ro 6nas khyim 12bar lhag pa ste// 'dod pa 12mkha' mig 20bar phur bu//zla zung 21de nyid 25bar spen pa// dus mig 26mkha' me'i 2༷bar mig dmar// 'di ni 'dri byed dar gud brtag/ de yi bshad pa mang pa dang //dgos don ha cang mi che bas// 'di la ma bkod rgyud nas long // mnyam na nyin zhag phrugs gcig la// dus kyi sbyor ba bcu gnyis 'char// nyis khri chig stong drug brgya'i 21600dbugs// khyim 12gyi thob pa'i nor de ni// dus sbyor gcig pa'i longs spyod yin// nor la mig 2 rtse 2bug 9nyi ma12/ /mkha' me 20rnams kyis rim pa ni// bgos pa'i thob nor so so yi longs spyod nyid du shes par bya// dus sbyor mdo tsam bstan na yang // 'di yi 'bras bu yon tan ni// 'bum gyi grangs su brjod pa dang // 'phral du gza' tshes skar sbyor kyang // tadkul dus sbyor 'di yis bsgyur//zhes rtsis kyi bstan bcos nya rgyas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor blo gsar kun da'i 'dod 'jo las gsar bu rnams la be bum rgyas pa 'byor dka' gshis dus sbyor bee dkar sor gzhag 'khol phyung bkod pa'i sarga drug pa'o//sa bcad bdun pa/ nyi zlar sgra gcan 'jug chul bshad pa/chos kun gsal ba thugs kyi me long du// mdo sngags rigs lam gzugs brnyan rab bkod cing // gang 'dul 'od kyis sa gsum 'gengs mdzad pa// lo chen dharma shrī phyag gi gnas// 'jam dgon sā ra'i mkhyen rab lha lam du// myong byang zin tig chu 'dzin 'khrigs pa las// skog gyur dngos ston sngon med gru char rgyun// blo gsal kun rtog zhing sa brlan par bya// nya stong nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor la// srid gsum rnam rgyal 'jug pa'i tshul//

656 ༄7/khabri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/legs bshad baiḍūr dkar po las// lag len bde phyir khol phyung bkod//'on kyang sgrib 'di'i rgyu rkyen gyi// lo rgyus drang nges rnam bcu rnams// yi ges ngal bas 'dir ma bkod// dgos pa skabs don be bum gzigs// de yang byed pa la sogs par// bltos min rnam dag grub rtsis kyi// gtan du mi bslu nges pa la// ri mo sgo bstun mi dgos pa'i// zab pa'i man ngag mchis na'ang // 'dir ni cung zad gsal tsam las// bsdus rgyud dang bstun spyi 'gre la// bshad do de yang so so yi// 'dzin tshul sa bcad bcu ru bshad//thog mar spyi ru gces pa la// rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi rjes 'brangs pa'i// rnam dag grub rtsis lugs gsum 'di nyi ma byang bgrod dus ltar drug zhe lnga 465dang lho bgrod ltar mda'ame mig 252dang nyin mtshan mnyam dus ltar mda' dus kyis sbyangs dgos/dang// sgra gcan bsdus pa'i rgyud bcas pa// rtsa grub skyon med nges pa gces// rnam dag grub rtsis chad lhag dang // dum drug dus sbyor gzhung ltar gyi// nyin mtshan chu tshod zhib cha dang // sgra gcan dang ni zla ba dag/ khyim gcig 'dzom dang mi 'dzom dang // stong la nyi zla lhan cig tu// gnas sam bar khyad zhugs ma zhugs// lung ston bya ba'i yul de yi// shar nub ri bo'i mtho dma' dang //ri dang sa khad nye 'gyangs dang // nya yi 'od dkar zlaba'i ming bdag po dang //nam mkha'i nor bu nyima'iming 'char nub dus// nyin mtshan chu tshod tsam ji ltar zer yod dang khyim slebs sogs// zhib tu brtags nas ma smras na// mkhas rloms byed pa'i rtsis mkhan 'ga'// 'dzin tshul kha dmar log pa mang /dang po zla ba sngar bzung nas// zla drug 'dzin ces spyir btang las// mthong ba'i nges pa che ba med// zla ba phyed drug phyed bdun dang // lnga las nye bar 'byung mi srid// khyim ni sngar bzung drug nas 'dzin// nya la zla ba bzung rjes su// stong la nyi ma 'dzin pa'ang srid// stong la nyi ma bzung rjes su// nya la zla

༄7/rtsis kyi bstan bcos nya rgyas blo ba'i dkyil 'khor blo gsar kun da'i 'dod 'jo/ 657ba 'dzin pa srid// nyi 'dzin snga phyi gang rung la// zla 'dzin med tshe gnam stong la// nyi 'dzin 'byung ba mi srid do gsung yang myong byang sogs las dpyad na ma nges pas zhibadagos so/ / lo skor bar du nyi ma yang // mi 'dzin srid phyir nyi 'dzin dkon// 'dzin tshad mthong ba ma yin te// snga phyi'i chu tshod mang nyung dag la ragabacing / / spyirago la'i lam du na nyi zla gnyis g.yon skor dang // sgra gcan g.yas skor 'gro ba ste// gdong 'dzin dus sunyim dang zla ba'i longs spyod mang // mjug 'dzin dmaral sgra gcan mang ba la// go ma ldog goces grags ga rigs 'dzol med// tshe bar 'dzin par spyir btang bzhed// dang po/ zla bar sgra gcan 'jug tshul/dang por bsil zer zla ba'i ming 'dzin tshul ni// zla rer 'gros myur dal 'khyog 'byung bzhi'i'agros kyi mtshan ma ston payin te/ / de phyir ril por tshes 15bsres la// ma nus 14bgos lhag zla rkang bzung // rnyed mnyam snga rkang myur 'gros shar// phyi rkang dal 'gros lho ru byed// mi mnyam snga rkang 'khyog 'gros nub// phyi rkang 'byung 'gros byed de byang // nya yi zla ba shar dus su// mtshan tshad thog ma 'dzin pa la// nam zla 'phyugs pa med sogs nas// bco lnga nam dang mnyam zer bar// sngon gyi mkhas pa phal cher ni// nges pa che bar mi mdzad pa// yul gyi sa khad 'gyangs dog dang // zla ba'i 'char nub snga phyi bcas// cung zad 'khrul ba bden srid kyang // nyin re'i rgyu skar rjes 'brangs phyir// snga phyi'i tshad la 'phyugs pa med// 'on kyang zlaba'achar nub byed pa'i tshul ni/ / zla ba lhobagrod kyi dus su 'chara'aphyi zhing nub pa snga ba dang / / zla ba byang bgrod kyidus 'charasngazhing nub pa 'phyi ba yong / /dang po 'dzin dang mi 'dzin ni// bsdus pa'i rgyud byed pa'i rtsis kyi nyi dag

658 ༄7/khabri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/la// 'dod pa mkha' me lhaglubyin pa la mkha' ro dang 'khor lo longs na phud glutsopa'i lhag de/ / tshes 'khyud zla skar zhes grags dang | 'dil sgra gcan gdong dang mjug gang nye gnyis// skar ma gcig gitshothos la gnas pa'am// gcig gi khyad par ci 'dug kyang brtag par byaba'i gnas yin te/ / nyungaskar gnas dang chu tshod gang gisamang bar sbyangs pa'i lhag ma de// sgra gcan dang zla ba'i bar gyi chu tshod sogs kyi khyad par yin cing / / zlatshes 'khyud bar gdong gisbyangs pa'i lhag ma ru// ri skar gnas thig dang chu tshod dbang 5rnyiman chad nges par 'dzin pa de// sgragacan gdong la zla bas sbyangs pa dang // dus me sgra gcan mjug ma la zla bas sbyangs pa la// mkha' lhag ma skar gnas thig dang chu tshod 'byung 50rkyaman chad shar ba 'dzin par nges shing/ / zla ba dus mes sgra gcan mjug masasbyangs pa'i tshe// lhag ma skar gnas thig dang chu tshod 'byung mtsho man chad 'dzin pa yin cing/ / spyir ni chu tshod nyung bzhed kyang // gnyis zla skar gdong mjugakastongasazla skar dang gdong mjug gang rung gi chu tshod dang po nas na 'dzin mi 'gyur// zla 'dzin chu tshod mang bzhed kyang // gdong sgra gcan 'dzin klu sar dbang yanalhag pa dang // mjug gi 'dzin dus la 'byung mda' 55bsgral ba na//mthong bar gyur ba ma yin no//gnyis pa dus tshod bstan pa ni// nya yi tshes rdzogs bcu drug mtshams su zla ba 'dzin dus 'khor las dkar nag tshig mtshams su zla ba la sgra gcan 'jug pa'i tshes grangs gsungs pa la ding sang tshes grangs 'khor mtshams mi shes pa'i phal pa rnams kyi tshes bcu drug la zla ba 'dzin byung zer mkhan mang yang nges don du tshes bco lnga de bar ma rdzogs pa'i phyir rogi/ thog mar sgra gcan 'jug na yang // gnam sa bar khyad khyams che ba'i// rnam dag grub rtsis lanyimabyang bgrod dus// skar drug chu tshod zhe lnga sa sbyangs pa'i skyes khyim gyi cho ga dgos 465dang // nyimalho bgrod dus su skar mda' me mig 252dor// zla ba'i bgrod pa 'bring shar gyi dkyil nas 'gro skabs po dang // gdong sgra gcan pas zla ba la sbyangs skabs su rilapor sgrib babs pa'i tshe yin na/ / tshes kyi longs spyod gang yod rdzogs

༄༄/rtsis kyi bstan bcos nya rgyas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor blo gsar kun da'i 'dod 'jo/ 659ma thag tu zla ba 'dzin pa yin pas grangs yod des bee dkar bu dpe'i dpyod khra la bltas pas dus nam 'dzin bslu ba med pade'o/ / zla ba lho dang byang mthar thug gi du bgrod dus tshes longs steng duzla ba bsnan// bar lho byang mthar thug dang shar dbus ma yin pa'i du rnams la tshes longs kyi skabs chu srang steng mkha' me 2:rkyabyin pas/ / de nyid zad ma thag tu 'dzin zla ba cha bsngo yod pa'i cha shas 'dzin dus/ / cha rer chu srang mkha' mig 2:rkyagis//'dzin pa 'gor bas rig 'gros kyi// phyed zla ba 'dzin dus tshes longs steng du chu tshod lag pa dang // chu srang mkha' me 2rnyirkyabasnan pa yi// longs spyod zad tshe 'dzin pa yin// de yi rig pas cha gzhan zla ba'i cha gcig nas bcu'i bar gyi 'dzin pa'i cha grangs 'di rnams kyi chu tshod chu srang bsgyur tshe sa steng byin 'khor lo phud pas shes// zla bas la sbyangs gdong ngam dus mes zlab la/ / zla ba sbyangs tshe ril polasgrib dus bgrod pa gzhung shar dbus sam nyin mtshan cha mnyam dus/ / chutshodatshes longs spyod kyi lame lhabyin pasardzogs tshe 'dzin// lho zla ba'i bgrod pas byang mthar thug mtsho byin la// bar lho byang mthar thug shar dbus ma yin pa'i tshes longs du chu srang lamakha' me 2:0steng // cha shas 'dzin pa'i dus yin na// cha rer chu srang mtsho mig 2:4gis// 'dzin pa 'gor bas ca 'gros brtsi// dus mjug la mer zla bas sbyangs pa'i tshe// zlaril sgrib skabs dang zla ba'ibagrod pa sharadabus yin na// 'byung tshes longs steng durshab bsnan pa 'di nyid rdzogs mtshams nas zla ba 'dzin no/ / lho zla babyang mthar thug 'bab tshe longs steng nas dus 6dman zhing // zla ba'i bgrod pa lho mtha' dang byang mthar dang shar dbus ma yin pa'i bar du rnams la tshes longs chu tshod 'byung ba 25rkyadang // mkha' me 250chu srang byin pa de// cha 'dzin skabs yin na tshes sogs kyi chu srang steng du mig me byin pa yis2:2/ / cha rer 'dzin pa bul phye ba yin cing gza' tshes kyi longs spyod de rnams

660 〉〉ltarabri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/la nyin tshad kyis sbyangs pa'i lhag ma mun rub nas bzung 'dzin dus bar gyi dbyug grangs yin la sbyang ba'i tshe ma ldangs na nyin mor 'dzin pa yin pas de'i tshe 'dzin yun bsnan nas sbyangs shing / de yang ma ldangs na mi mthong ba'o// yang na zla rkang zhib btsal gyis bsgrub pa'i tshes longs grangs kyi spyod khra la bltas pas dus tshod shes shing tshes longs ster sbyin sogs lag len ngag las nyan/ / de yang rnam dag grub pa'i tshes 'khyud zla skar la| dus sbyor gzhung bzhin bsgrubs pa yis zla ba khyim bcu gnyis po gang la gnas bltas pa'i gang gnas ngos 'dzin nas de dang dus sbyor re'u mig dmar nag 'khor ma'i khyim dang ra sprad nas chu tshod dang thur grib sogs 'das mtshams nas mngon sum rtogs par 'gyur ro/ / zla grib thur ma'i grib ma yi// snga phyi mi bslu'i tshad rnams ston//gsum pa 'dzin phyogs bstan pa ni// gdong 'dzin tshes 'khyud zla skar la// gdong sgragacan gis sbyangs shing mjug 'dzin dus// tshes 'khyud dus mes mjug mas sbyangs byas la// ma ldangs byung na 'khor lo 27bsnan// sbyangs lhag 'dod pa 12las mang na// nam stod yin na byang smad namaphyed dbang byang sharaldan// tho rengs yin na sharastod phyogs nas nas 'dzin cing / sbyangs rjes me zla 12las nyung na// nam stod yin na shar smad dang nam phyed dus// me shar lho lha tho rengs lalho stod nas 'dzin cing/ / nub dang byang stod lho smad nas// 'dzin par srid par 'gyur ba min//bzhi pa cha yi che chung ni// cung zad dka' zhing mi rtogs pas// bsdus byedastsas rgyud sbyangs lhag chu tshod man// mkha' nor mig klus ṭwāṃ2raXbasgyur ba yis// gnas kun gcig 'gril de nyid la// zab pa'i cho ga du yod kyang bzhag/ / lag len snying po snga 'phros chu srang yan chad kyi// phal cher zhib par rtogs pas na// sbyangs lhag chu tshod mkha' ros 6༷ bsgyur// srang bcug 'byung zlas 15thob pa'i nor// gdong sgra gcan gis zla bar sbyangs shing dal 'gros dus// me klu ra2tshun la ril por sgrib// 'khyog 'gros gzugs klu ra1

༄7/rtsis kyi bstan bcos nya rgyas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor blo gsar kun da'i 'dod 'jo/ 661'byung 'gros la// bug ri 79myur 'gros gza' drang srong 77/ / ril por sgrib pa'i tshad yin la// mtsho zla ba'i lus cha ni nor nas bzung mig bug 92bar//bco zla ba cha lnga'i cha gcig lus pa ste// me bug 92nas gzugs phyogs 101bar du ni// cha bco lnga cha'i gnyis lus la mig phyogs 102nas// phyogs gzugs 11rkyabaradubaco lnga pa'i cha gsum lus// zla ba'i lnga cha lus pa ste// gzugs dang bse ru zla ba 111nas// bug drag 119bar du bco lnga'i cha bzhi lus// mkha' nyi 120nas bzung bug khyim 129bar// bco lnga'i cha lnga lus shing gsum gnyis cha bcu'adzin// mkha' me zla ba 120nas bzung ste// klu 'dod 12ṭwāṃbarabaco lnga cha'i du cha drug lus// bug me zla 129nas ri yid 147bar// bco lnga cha'i cha bdun lus shing nor yid 14ṭwāṃnas// bug tshes 15rdzobar du dal 'gros dus//phyedazla ba bco lnga cha'i 'dzin 'khyogs 'gros ri dbang 157dang // bse ru tshun la phyed ka ste// 'byung 'gros dbang tshes 155phyed myur 'gros la// me mda' gzugs 152tshun phyed 'dzin yin// cha grangs 'dzin cha ni mkha' ro 'od dkar 16rkyaklu nas rgyal po'i16ra/ / bar du bdun cha bco lnga cha'i 'dzin pa ste// bug pa mi bdag nas bzung 1ṭwāṃ9klu ri zla'i17ṭwāṃ/ / bar du bco lnga'i cha drug 'dzin pa ste//bug ri bse ru 179nas bzung ste// ri skyon 1ṭwāṃ7bar du bco lnga'i cha lnga'adzin pa yin no/ / zla ba'i dum gcig 'dzin pa yin no/ / nor dang nyes pa 1rdoranas brtsis te// dus bug gzugs 1rdzo6bar bzhi cha bco lnga cha'i 'dzin// ri rtsa zla 197nas bzung 'byung ba dang // mkha' mig 2rkya5bar du cha bco lnga cha'i gsum 'dzin// mtshams thig lag pa 2rkya6nas bzung ste// yid zung 214bar du cha bco lnga'i cha'i gnyis 'dzin// tshes bgrod 215nas bzung me mig lag pa'i 222bar// cha bco lnga cha'i gcig 'dzin kyang gsal ba dka'//zla bas sgragacan gdong pa la sbyangs pa'i dus// dal 'gros thub ri 77man ril sorasgrib// 'khyog 'gros mda' ri 75'byung 'gros la// me dang

662 ༄7ltarabri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/ thub pa 72myur 'gros dus// gzugs ri'i 71bar du ril sgrib ste// klu ri 7ranas bzung dus klu'i bar// cha gcig lus shing ri nor nas// dbang srin 95bar du cha gnyis lus// dus bug 96mtsho phyogs 1༷4bar gsum lus//mda' phyogs 1rkya5'dod zla'i 112bar bzhi ste// yid gzugs 114mig dang nyi ma'i 122bar// lnga lus zla ba'i sum gnyis 'dzin// me nyi 122gzugs 'dod 121bar drug cha// lus shing so zla 122mkha' yid 14rkyabar// bdun lus ri bong ma nu 141nas// gzugs tshes 151bar du dal 'gros phyed//'khyog 'gros bug yid 149'byung 'gros la// ri yid 147myur 'gros mda' mtsho gzugs145// phyed 'dzin tshad yin mig tshes 152nas// klu tshes 15rabar du cha bdun 'dzin// bug dbang zla ba 159nas brtsams te// dus mtshamasagazugs 166bar cha drug 'dzin// ri bo mi bdag 167me ri zla'i172// bar du cha lnga sgrib pa ste// zla ba'i sum gnyis lus pa yin// mtsho thub gzugs 174nas zla skyon 1ṭwāṃ1bar// cha bzhi 'dzin cing mig skyon nas//bug klu zla bar 1rdo9cha gsum 'dzin// mkha' bug bse ru 190nas bzung ste//dus rtsa gzugs 196bar cha gnyis 'dzin// ri srin zla 1kha7nas me stong dang //lag par 2rkya2cha gcig 'dzin gyur kyang // cha shas chung bas mthong ba dka'//mjug sgra gcan mas zla ba sbyangs pa'i dus// dal 'gros mig ri 72yan la ril// 'khyog 'gros mkha' ri 7rkya'abyung 'gros la// klu ro 6ṭwāṃmyur 'gros dus mtshams 66te// ril por sgrib pa'i tshad yin la// me dang drang srong 72nas brtsams te// gzugs klu'i ṭwāṃ1bar du cha gcig lus// mig nor rdo2mkha' bug 9rkyabar du gnyis// lus la bse ru srin po 91nas// bug rtsa'i 99bar du gsum lus yin// mkha' stong zla 1rkyarkyanas klu phyogs 10rdobar// bzhi lus bug phyogs 1rkya9ri drag 117bar// cha lnga lus te zla ba yi// sum gnyis 'dzin par bzhed pa yin// skyon gzugs 11ṭwāṃnas brtsams dus nyi'i 126

〉〉/rtsis kyi bstan bcos nya rgyas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor blo gsar kun da'i 'dod 'jo/663bar// cha drug lus shing ri khyim 127nas// mda' 'dod 125bar du cha bdun lus// dus me zla ba 126nas bzung ste// ri yid 147bar du dal 'gros dus// phyed 'dzin 'khyog 'gros 'byung ma nu145// 'byung 'gros me chu bse ru 142dang // myur 'gros gzugs yid 141tshun phyed 'dzin// klu dang ma nu 14ranas bzung ste// 'byung tshes 155bar du cha bdun 'dzin// ro tshes 156nas bzung me dus zla'i162// bar du drug 'dzin chu mi bdag164/gzugs ri zla bar 171lnga 'dzin te// zla ba'i sum gcig yin par bzhed//mig thub gzugs 172nas bug ri zla'i17rdzo// bar du bzhi 'dzin thig 1ṭwāṃ0skyon nas// ri klu gzugs 1ṭwāṃ7bar cha gsum 'dzin// klu nor zla 1shrīranas 'byung ba dang // bu ga bse ru'i 195bar du cha// gnyis 'dzin dus bug zla ba 196nas// me mkha' mig 2kya2bar gcig 'dzin kyang // cha chung mthong bar dka' ba yin//zla bas sgragacan mjug ma la sbyangs pa'i dus// dal 'gros dus su ri ro'i 67bar// ril 'dzin 'khyog 'gros mda' ro 65dang // 'byung ros me ro 62myur 'gros dus// gzugs mtshams 61bar du ril por sgrib// klu dus 6rdonas bzung dus ri'i 76bar// cha gcig lus shing thub ri 7trenas//mda' klu'i ṭwāṃ5bar du cha gnyis lus// mtshams klu /6'byung bug 95cha gsum lus// ro rtsa 96dbang phyogs 1༷5cha bzhi lus// dus phyogs 1༷6tshes zla 115lnga lus shing // zla ba'i sum gnyis 'dzin pa dang // ro drag 116mtsho khyim 124cha drug lus// dbang nyi 125me 'dod 122bar bdun las// mtsho 'dod 124nas brtsams dal 'gros dus// dbang yid 145bar phyed 'khyog 'gros la// me mtsho zla 142dang 'byung 'gros dus/ gzugs yid 141myur 'gros bug 'dod pa129// phyed 'dzin bya ba'i tshad yin la// dus yid 146stong tshes 15rkyabar du cha// bdun 'dzin gzugs tshes 151'byung dbang zla

664 ༄7/khabri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/155/ / bar du drug 'dzin dus tshes 156nas/ bse ru mi bdag 161bar du lnga// 'dzin pa zla ba'i sum gcig yin// mig ro zla 162nas ri mtshams gzugs167/ / bar du bzhi 'dzin nor mtshams dang // 'od dkar 16rdonas bzung me ri zla'i172/ / bar du gsum lus rgya mtsho dang // thub zla 174klu ri gzugs 17ṭwāṃbar du// gnyis 'dzin bu ga ri gzugs 179nas// me skyon 1ra2bar du cha gcig 'dzin// 'on kyang cha shas chung bas na// kun gyis mthong bar dka' ba yin// cha 'dzin kun la 'gros bzhi yi// khyad par ril phyed gnyis dang mtshungs// nyin mtshan mnyam dus ri mo yi// tshad las thob nor lag pa 2yis// ril 'dzin nas bzung cha shas bar// 'dzin pa sla bar bzhed pa yin// kun la cha gnyis tshun chad la// mthong bar dka' bas zhib cha brtagayang na sbyangs lhag chu tshod la 'byung bas bogs pa'i thob nor thigs (thig3rkyagazugs 1mig 2me 2mtsho 4shar na ril por sgril cing / lnga 5shar na cha dgu 'dzin pa dang ro 6la cha bcu/ri 7la phyed klu rdol lnga cha/ srin por 9drug cha/ khro bor 10brgyad cha/ drag por 11bco lnga cha'i cha gcig 'dzin pa sogs gsung ba ri mo bya slar bkod/ lnga pa sgrib yun bshad pa ni// zla ba bco lnga cha ldan zhing // ril sgrib chu tshod bco lnga 15la// phyed 'dzin chu tshod drang srong 7dang // chu srang mkha' me'i 2rkyabar sdod de// de yi rig pas gong gi sa bcad bzhi pa'i skabs kyi cha nas//brtsis pa'i chu tshod grangs lung ston// ji tsam 'dzin pa'icha grangs de me yis bgos pa'i/ / chu thob nor tshod dang lhag ma mkha' ros 60bsgyur// me 2thob pachu srang yin pa ste// sgrib yunadang mnan yunadang grol yun yin// de yang myur 'gros byed pa'i dus// chu srang mkha' mes 2rkya'adzin yun ring // de rtsis sum cu gtong ba'i yun tshad thung // 'khyog 'gros la yod 'dzin yun gtong yun gnyis// chu srang mkha' mig 2rkya'agor ba dang // mnan yun chu srang thig mtshos 4rkyathung // dal 'gros dang 'byunga'agros dang gnyis la bsnon 'brid med//

༄7/rtsis kyi bstan bcos nya rgyas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor blo gsar kun da'i 'dod 'jo/ 665drug pa lus pa'i phyogs bstan pa// gang bzung phyogs nas g.yon skor du// rim pa bzhin du sgrib par byed// thog mar byang shar nas bzung na//lho nub phyogs lus byang nye nas// bzung tshe lho nye'i phyogs su lus// shar nye nas bzung nub nyer lus// shar lho nas bzung nub byang lus// lho nye nas bzung byang nyer lus//bdun pa kha dog bshad pa ni// gdong mjug sbyangs lugs khyad med pa'i// ril por 'dzinadus la thogam dang mtha' la dud kha 'dzin// grub tsharanas gdong 'dzin dmar nag dang lta mjug 'dzin zangs kyi mdog ltar 'byung //kun la dum bu'adzin pa'i dus nag pa ste// phyed 'dzin sngo la sum gnyis 'dzin//de bas che na gdong 'dzin la// lcags bsregs mdog mtshungs mjug 'dzin kham// rgyu skar mgo lag gnyisal bzung na// sngo sangs nam mkha'i mdog ltar 'byung //brgyad pa gtong ba'i phyogs bstan pa// ril por 'dzina'adus dang po gang bzung phyogs nas gso// cha shas 'dzinadus lus phyogs nas gso ba ste// g.yon bskor rim bzhin gtong bar 'gyur// gang bzung phyogs kyi nub ngos su//sgra gcan grib ma zad par snang //dgu pa dge ba'i 'gyur khyad ni// dus bzang dkyus rnams brgyad 'gyur la// zla 'dzin bye ba bdun 'gyur dang // nyi 'dzin bye ba 'bum 'gyur du// rgyal bas gsung rab mtha' klas par// rgyas par gsungs bzhin don mthun cing // khyad par nyi zla'i mdo la sogs// drang don gsung rab rnams nas gsungs// nges don bcom ldan dus 'khor lo// nyi 'dzin ro rkyang rlung gnyis la// zla 'dzin rkyang ma dhu tri ru// tshud dus bskyed rdzogs bdag 'jug sogs// rnam dkar 'phel 'gyur 'gyur khyad kyang // de dbang yin pa don dam gsungs// de mtshungs skabs 'dir sdig las kyang // de bzhin 'phel

666 ༄7khibri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/bar bka' bstan bcos// khungs ma rnams nas bshad pa yin//bcu pa 'bras bu bzang ngan ni// rgyas par brjod kyis mi lang zhing //'jam dpal rtsa ba'i rgyud sogs nas// gza' 'dzin phal cher ngan par gsungs// 'on kyang ltas kyi gtsug lag rnams// bstun pa'i 'bras bu cung zad brjod// nag pa'i zla la gza' 'dzin sogs// byung na bris mkhan glu la dga'// smad tshong bram ze rig byed shes// gser 'gyur mkhan po rnams nyams shing // char ni khol 'bab khol mi 'bab// sa zlar til sogs 'bru med 'gyur// snron zlar rgyal po btsun mo dang // bram ze dmag mi lo tog nyams// chu stod thag ring 'gro ba dang // kha che dgon 'dab chu bo nyams//gro bzhin kha che rgya nag dang // so len dbus pa nyams par 'gyur// khrums zlar ma ga dha pa dang // sau raṣādang kla klo dang // bru sha mtha' khob bod rnams nyams// sbrum ma 'jig cing 'bru yang 'gyur// dbyug zlar ta zig ya rtse ba//sman pa sirnyu ko bo nyams// smin drug mgar ba shar phyogs dbul// ka liṅka sogs yul rnams nyams// mgo zlar spyir ni rgyal por gnod// char chu 'bab cing 'bru 'phel lo// rgyal zlar bram ze rgyal po nyams// mchu zlar bram ze rta glang dang // chos byed pa la gus pa yin// zhing sar mi dge char 'bab bo// dbo zlar mgar ba lo tog rgyas// gzhu mkhan rgyal po dka' thub nyams//lug gi khyim dang taṅgāl la// pañtsa li dang ka liṅka dang // shu ra se dang ki po rtse//ond+ra ka bha ra pa dang // mtshon cha 'dzin rigs mgar ba dang // lho phyogs pa rnams nyams pa yin// glang la ba lang rta lug rdzi// phyugs bdag chos spyod pa rnams nyams// 'khrig par rgyal blon rgyal mo dang // dang po rtsis pa ri mo mkhan// klu yi nad thebs mu ges 'jig/ karsha nub phyogs dmangs rigs gnod// seng ge da sha'i rgyal po dang // snying stobs can dang ri brag pa//bsod nams rgyal po mnyam rnams gnod// bu mor kha lo thogs pa yi//

༄7/rtsis kyi bstan bcos nya rgyas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor blo gsar kun da'i 'dod 'jo/ 667sems can kun la gnod pa yin// srang du chos byed dpa' bo dang // sha ra na yul pañtsa li// khyad par a daspa'i rgyal po// tshong pa ma ra la sogs pa'i//sems can la gnod shing rnams nyams// sdig gzhu drang srong mi chen dang /rta dang sman pa tshong pa dang // si na'i yul dang 'dul dka'i ming // mtshon cha brtag shes mi rnams nyams// chu srin chu gnas sems can dang ku blon po tha mal sman pa dang // sngags mkhan rkun po mtshon cha yis// 'tshe ba rnams dang byang phyogs ngan// bum pa nya la nub phyogs pa// 'phags yul 'bru sha nyams par 'gyur//res gza' nyi mar gong mar ngan// zla ba bram ze mkhas pa dang // rgyal khams phyugs dang bcas la gnod// mig dmar a pa ra dang ni// ki bi ra da'i chu 'gram gnas// nga rgyal can dang rgyal por gnod// lhag par a dar wi pa dang // yul de'i chu 'gram mi dag dang // chu bo shwa na'i 'gram na gnas//rgyal po dpa' bo mkhas la gnod// phur bu mkhas pa rgyal blon dang // rta glang nyams shing chu bo ni// siskyi'i 'gram gnas sems can dang // byang phyogs pa la gnod pa yin// pa sangs ki ka ya rgya gar// ya ba ri sogs yul dbus kyi//bud med blon po nad kyis 'jig/ spen pa ma ru ri pa dang // spos ka ra sa a bhu ta// bod kyi rigs ngan rnams la gnod// rgyu skar so so'i sgos 'bras rnams// zhib cha ltas kyi gtsug lag gsal// me khams rgyu skar bdag po la//mu ge mtshan ma'i rim pa dang // bud med mngal nad char mi 'bebs ba dang ma he'i bzho skems shing // mdza' bo nye 'brel 'bral ba dang // rtsod pa 'khrug pa rims nad 'byung // rgyal po g.yul 'pham ljon shing sogs//nyams shing bya dang ri dgas kyang // skrag gis gzir bas mi dge 'gyur//rlung skar bdun la gong ma dang // cha 'dra mu ge rlung gis 'jig/ chu skam lo tog tshogs chung dang // rlung gis khang chen 'gyed zhig dang // char med shing

668 ༄7khibri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/tog nyams par 'gyuraka sgra mi snyan dang lus 'phags gling // ba li ka dang tsam pa dang // ki so rtse dang ba ra dang // spos 'dzin yul rnams 'khrugs pa sogs// mi dge'i 'bras bu 'byung bar 'gyur// sa khams bdun la thams cad bde// lo legs nad zhi rgyal po rgyal// me tog phun sum tshogs pa dang //chomarkun med cing bram ze sogs// rang gi rig pas 'tsho ba dang // rigs ngan chos 'jug char 'bab cing // rim bzhin gang bsam don de 'grub//chu skar bdun pa lo legs dang // ba dang ma he'i bzho 'phel zhing // sbrum ma nad med bde bar btsa'// sa bon gang btab 'bras bu smin// rgyal po chos ldan bde ba dang // rig 'dzi na kun kyang 'phel ba dngaka/ me tog 'bras bu rgyas pa dang // char yang smon pa bzhin du 'bab//gzhan yang nyin mtshan cha bdun te// dang por mgar ba chos spyod par//ngan zhing gnyis par zhing pa dang // mu stegs zhang blon nyams par byed//gsum par bzo bo kla klo dang // dmangs rigs blon po nyams mi dge// bzhi par rgya gar yul dbus nyams// lnga par rgyal blon phyugs rnams nyams// mu stegs sdug bsngal skyes par byed// drug par bud med rgyal rigs gnod//bdun par rkun po masmre' 'khob gnod// gzhan yang byang bgrod rgyal po dang // bram zer gnod cing lho bgrod la// rje rigs dmangs rigs rnams la gnod// kun la skyes skar can rnams 'dzer// ming skar la yang cung zad ngan// gang byung de nas zhag dang por// char babs rgyal po chos bzhin spyod//gnyis gsum 'bru 'phel zhag bzhi la// dgra dang 'thab rtsod 'khrug pa 'byung // lnga la phrag dog mu ges 'jig/ zhag bdun bar du char med na//nad 'khrug mu ge'i sdug bsngal 'gyur// bzhi lnga ma gtogs zhag bdun tshun//char babs bzang 'bras ches sbyin zhing // ngan 'bras yin kyang 'joms pa yin//

༄7/rtsis kyi bstan bcos nya rgyas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor blo gsar kun da'i 'dod 'jo/ 669gnyis pa/ nyi mar sgra gcan 'jug tshul/rta bdun dbang por nyimasgra gcan nyid// 'jug tshul ri mo rgyud la gsal cha med pa'i dbang gis cung zad dka' zhing // lus 'phags gling dang ba lang spyod//nyin mtshan mnyam tshe lho 'dzam bu'i gling la// mi snga dro dang dgong mo 'dzin na/ nyin phyed dusabaslu dgung la 'dzin na bslu// de yi rgyu mtshan nyi ma lho dang byang la bgrod pa gnyis// yod pas rta bdun nyi mastobasasgra gcan ldan zung // go la'i lam so phan tshun 'dzolab yin// lho 'dzam bu'i gling ston dpyid nyin mtshan mnyam// dgung nyin phyed dusashā 'dzin pa'i ri mo shar na 'dzin par/ / the tshom med mod snga drodagong mo gnyis la 'dzin pa'i dus su bslub yin/ / sharalus 'phags nubab lang sbyod gnyis la lho byang bgrod gnyis dngayod// mig sgra gcan sman mdog can rta nyi ma'i shing rta 'dren byed las kyi rta bdun yod pa'i ming ngo bdun gnyis// nyin mtshan mnyam dus gnyisal go la'ilam dulhan cig tu 'grig pa yin// suryar nyimamatho dma' sna tshogs rim bzhin bcu gnyis yod// sgra gcan rtag tu mtho dma' med// nyi ma lho bgrod karū'i khyim// 'khyog 'gros dang po'i nyin zhag ni// gnam stong 'grig na mi 'dzin bzhed// gzhan yang lhag pa pa sangs gnyis// gang rung gcig dang skar ma gcig/ chu 'di la gnam gang gi lhag sangs gnyis la gza' lnga tshes spyod ma'i ri mo legs par bsgrubs nas khyim gang gnas pa so so'i ched ma nor ba byas pa'i tshe so so'i bar du tshod 'byung me 25zla tshun du// lhan cig gnas tshe bzung mi srid// dang po 'dzin nam mi 'dzin la// 'di la grub rtsis lag len skyes khyim sbyangs lugs gsum dang // cung zad bstun tsam dgos pa'i phyir// grub rtsis byang bgrod skar dus 6dang //chu tshod zhe lngas 45sbyangs pa dang // lho bgrod 'byung ba 5 me mig 22 dor//zhal lung skyes khyim mda' dus sbyangs// gnyis grub rtsis kyi lho 'grod byang bgrod skyes

670 ༄7khabri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/khyim sbyangs lugs dang bsdus pa'i rgyud byedacing dang bcas// gsum ga'i nyi ma dag padang // sgra gcan gdong mjug gang nye gnyis// skar ma gcig gi steng la babs pa'am gnas pa sogs dang // / skar ma gcig gi khyad par 'dug kyang 'dzin nam mi 'dzin brtag par bya ba ni nyung gis mang // sbyangs pa'i lhag gang yod de nyid ma brtag parabyu ba'i gzhi yin ste// gdong gis nyi dag la sbyangs pa'i lhag skar gnas stongs na/ / go ma log pa'i ri mo ste// chu sbyangs lhag tshod mig dbang bar du 'dzin//nyi mas gdong lasbyangs bas gdong pa thung // go ldog ri mo ces grags skar gnas stongs kyang chu tshod mda'// lhag na 'dzin pa ma yin no byang chu tshod mda' man chad kyang phal cher mi 'dzin pa shas che ba nyams myong yin/ / dus mes mjug mas nyi dag la sbyangasapas mjug ma ring // de yang rimogo ldog ces grags pas// skar thig chu tshod gcig nas rishātshunadang byed rtsis la bcu man 'dzin//nyi mas dus mer mjug ma la sbyangs pa naka ma ri mo go ldog pas skar gnas stongs nas chu tshod mkha' chu'i 4༷0 nang tshun 'dzin// khyad par bsdus rgyud nyi 'dzin byed rtsis med// grub rtsis le tshan 'dzin 'gyur yang // kun la mi 'dzin nub skar spyod// brtag dpyad gzhan rnams kun mthun na// cha chung 'dzin par srid pa tsam// byed rtsis 'dzin la grub rtsis nas// skar ma stongs tsam mi 'dzin kyang // 'khrul med bsdus rgyud byed brtsis kyi dgongs don gtso// khyad par shar skar bdun ni smin drug snar ma mgo lag nabs so rgyal stag rnams kyi steng la// nyi ma gnas na grub rtsis kyi// skar gnas lus kyang byed pa gtso// byed pa'i chu srang man ma gtogs// stongs skar gnas dang chu tshod tsam na nyi 'dzin mi 'byung ngo //nyi rkang gzugs la spyod pa'i tshe// mi bslu 'dzin pa'i ri mo ste// mtsho 4la sna tshogs yong ba dang // dus 6nyirkang la 'dzin par dka' ba yin// khyad par byed pa go ldog na// 'dzin min ma ldog brtag dpyad kun// mthun na 'dzin par srid pa yin// go ldog 'dzin dang mi 'dzin sogs// gong gi so so'i

༄7/rtsis kyi bstan bcos nya rgyas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor blo gsar kun da'i 'dod 'jo/ 671sbyangs lhag gtso// byed grub khyad rnams gong smos kyi// khyad par trem las ma gtogs pa'i don la byedapa'i lugs rang gtso// dbyar dgun nyi ldog nyer dgu dang //gnam stong dang tshesarnams gcig la yod pa yi// stong der nyi 'dzin mi 'byung mod// nyi ma 'khrig gnyis ka'i rang bzhin gzhu'i khyim na gnas// g.yo khyim bcu gnyis so so la g.yo brtan gnyis ka bcas pa'i nang nas bsa'adzin dka' zhing 'dzin na'ang cha res chung // kaṅka ṭa g.yob dngachu srin g.yo ba la// cha phyed tsam gyis chung bar snang // taṅgāl 'dzin pa'i dus su kaṅka ṭa dang chu srin gang rung yin kyang cung zad chung //byed la gnam gang rtsis chad kyang tshes gcig 'dzin// grub pa'i gnam stong dus nye'i tshes// chad tshe 'dzin par srid pa min//gnyis pa dus tshod bstan pa ni// gnam stong rdzogs nas tshes gcig gi/dkar nag tshes 'pho'i mtshams su 'dzin// de yang rnam dag grub rtsis kyi//byang nyi mabagrod dus skaradrug 6zhe lnga 672 ༄7//'bri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/'dzin pa bul bas rig pas dpyod dgos te dper na 'dzin pa'i cha grangs kyis klu 1rdolag bsgyur mkha' ros bgos nor chu tshod kyi grangs dang lhag ma gang yod mjug gang rung sbyangs ba'i tshe/ / nyin phyed kyi dus yin na bden bral lho nub snga droyin na lho nye nas/ / phyi dro yin na lho nub nye bar 'dzin// sgra gcan gdong la nyi mas sbyangs pa na// nyin
