༄7lhas kyi bstan bcos nya rgyas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor blo gsar kun da'i 'dod 'jo/ 783de lhag res gza' dang gcig na// bsreg dang dbang phyug sgrub pa dang //bskrad pa'i las la mchog tu shis// de min zhi las 'dzem pa gnad// phan tshun bden rdzun 'gran pa la// zla ba'i snyegs ma brtsi ba ste// zla skar man ngag ltar btsal ba'i// rnam dag skar ma mkha' ros 60bsgyur// dbugs bcug 'byung me zlas 125thob pa'i// khyim nas bgrang lugs 'di lta ste// lug dang sra ba si sbyar nas// rim bzhin so so bzung ba ste// rags pa yin gyi zhib par na// gong gi khyim ltas lhag ma yi// chu tshod la sogs gnas rnams kun//nyi mas 12bsgyur la 'khor los bsgril// mda' yon zla bas 125thob nor la//lhag ma lus na gcig 1byin pa// rang rang khyim gyi bdag po nas// rim par brtsis pa'i 'bras bu byin// sra ba 1si yis mi shis ngan// bde legs 2kyis ni phun tshogs byed// 'chi bdag 2gis kyang bdag nyid 'chi// trikhyi 4zhes bya dgeb yin// skye bas 5nor ni thob par byed// 'bar bas 6bdag nyid gzhan gyis gsod// dga' bas 7dge ste spyod pa rdongan// nges pa'i 9dgra ni 'byung bar byed// rgyal bas 1༷bdag nyid rgyal ba ste// su pa ta 11yis bshāsheg nyid 'chi// legs so 12zhes bya dge ba yin//bcu pa/ nyer mkho'i dbyangs 'char rgyad kyi 'khor lo sogs/dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo nas// gsungs pa'i rnal 'byor lha mo brgyad// 'char tshul rim pa 'di yin te// zla ba bcu gnyis kun gyi ni//tshes gcig dgu dang bcu drug dang // nyer bzhi shar du tshangs ma gnas//gnyis bcu bcu bdun nyer lnga la// byang du drag mo sum cu gcig/ bco brgyad nyer drug shar lho la// gzhon nu ma dang bzhi bcu gnyis// bcu dgu nyer bdun lho nub la// khyab 'jug bcu gsum lnga nyi shu// nyer brgyad lho la

784 ༄7khabri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/ phag mo gnas// drug dang bcu gnyis nyer gcig dang // nyer dgu nub tu dbang mo ste// bdun dang nyer gnyis nya stong phyed// lnga la nub byang tsā muṇa ṭā// brgyad dang nyer gsum nya stong gi/ phyed phyi byang shar dpal mo gnas//de yang tshes longs phyed snga phyi// brgyad kyis phye ba'i chu tshod sogs// tshes de'i bcu drug cha ru 'gyur// rnal 'byor ma re'i thun tshad de// dang po dgu pa gnyis bcu pa// gsum dang bcu gcig bzhi bcu gnyis// lnga dang bcu gsum drug cu bzhi// bdun dang bco lnga brgyad cu drug/ rang rang tshes kyi bdag po yi// thog ma nas bzung tshangs ma'i tshes// dper mtshon tshangs ma drag mo dang // gzhon nu ma dang khyab 'jug ma// phag mo dpang mo tsa muṇḍa//dpal mo ltar du rim bzhin gyi// rang dang g.yas phyogs gnas pa nas///mdun dang g.yon phyogs thebs su bzhed//bikhyi'i gnas lugs tshes bzhi dang // bco brgyad brgyad dang nyi shu gnyis// bcu gcig nyer lnga bco lnga dang // nyer dgu rnams la rim pa ltar//shar nas shar lho lho lho nub// nub dang nub byang byang byang shar// gnas pa'i rang rang phyogs nas ni// gong bzhin brtsis pas las stobs rgyas//dbyangs 'char gzhung nas bshad pa yi// rnal 'byor ma yi 'khor lo ni//shar nas rim bzhin a ka tsa// ṭa ta pa ya sha rnams ni// phyogs mtshams brgyad du gnas par bzhed// de la tshangs ma gzhon nu ma// dbang phyug ma dang khyab 'jug la// phag mo dbang mo rgan byed ma// sgeg mo la sogs rim pa ltar// gnas par tshes grangs gcig dgu dang // bcu drug nyer bzhi tshangs ma'i bdag/ gnyis bcu bcu bdun nyer lnga rnams// gzhon nu ma ste gsum bcu gcig/ bco brgyad nyer drug dbang phyug ma// bzhi dang bcu gnyis bcu dgu dang // nyer bdun khyab 'jug lnga bcugasum// nyi shu nyer brgyad phag mo ste// drug dang bcu bzhi nyer gcig dang // nyer dgu dbang mo bdun bco lnga//

༄7/rtsis kyi bstan bcos nya rgyas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor blo gsar kun da'i 'dod 'jo/ 785nyer gnyis rgan byed nya stong gi/ phyed snga rgan byed phyi ma dang // brgyad dang nyer gsum sgeg mo ste// rang rang gnas pa'i phyogs nas ni// thebs pa'i tshul ni spyi dang mthun// bikhyi 'char tshul shar rim bzhin// phyogs mtshams brgyad dang tshes dang ming // bco brgyad bco lnga bcu gcig brgyad// bzhi dang nyer dgu nyer lnga dang // nyer gnyis rnams la rim pa ltar// ka ra la dang 'bar ba can//dusakyi lce dang ma hā ma ri// bi ta bā la ma hā dzi ka/ bkra shis ma hā sgo ra gnas// gzhan yang shar nas rim pa ltar// so sor thun brgyad phye ba las//nyer dgu sta dang thun dang po// a dang brgyad dzā thun gnyis par// ā dang nyer gnyis khyi dang // thun gsum i dang bco lnga ṇi// thun bzhi i ru shes par bya// bzhi dang glu dang thun lnga u// nyer lnga nye dang thun bdun e// bcu gcig ṭi dang thun brgyad i// bco brgyad ghu dang thun drug u// gsal byed tshes dang dbyangs thun thog/ rang rang phyogs nas thebs par bzhed//dus mtshan 'khor lo nub phyogs nas// rim par g.yon bskor phyogs mtshams la// stong gi bar gyi tshes grangs bkod// rang rang tshes grangs phyogs la gnas// gzhan yang tshes grangs mtsho bsres la// klus thob lhag mas g.yon bskor nas// rim par bya ra'i thog la gnas// nyin mtshan tshad ni brgyad kyis bgos// res gza' nas bzung g.yon skor la// 'khor ba'i dus 'khor thun phyed 'char//dbyangs 'char thun phyed 'khor lo ni// dkar phyogs nyin mo g.yas bskor dang // mtshan la g.yon bskor nag phyogs ldog/ nyin mtshan tshad ni klu yis bgos// rang rang phyogs nas bskor bas shes// shar nas rim par khyim bcu gnyis// bum pa bzhi la rim pa ru// bkod pas nyi ma gang gnas pa// bum stong gnas pa'i sa phyogs yin// tshes grangs so so'i aṅgi dag/

786 ༄7khabri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/bkod pa'i phyogs la sde brgyad thebs// sgra gcan nu ru dus rgyu gnyis//dpe'u chung ltar spang blangs bya//zhes rtsis kyi bstan bcos nya rgyas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor blo gsar kun da'i 'dod 'jo las le'u tho rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum sbyor tshul dang / de dag la nye bar mkho ba'i dbyangs 'char rgyud nas gsungs pa'i 'khor lo rnams dang // dus 'khor lugs kyi rnal 'byor ma brgyad dang bikhyi sogs 'jug che'i rigs khol 'don gyis bkod pa'i sargo bcu pa'o//sa bcad bcu gcig pa/ rtsis 'phro spo ba zhag gsum 'khor lo bshad pa/dang po/ zhag gsum gyi rnam dbye bstan pa/brgya phrag nyi ma'i dpal 'dzin zhal 'dzum las// 'dod dgu'i char 'bebs kun gyi re skong mgon// sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin byed ngal bsos bus//gtsug lag bstan pa spel la bka' 'di bsrung // phug lugs rtsis kyi gzhung bzang mtho ris chab// thugs brtson hub kyis 'thung la mi ngal bas//'jam mgon mi rje'i tshul bzung dza tnas// slar skyugs zhag gsum gaṅgā chang med spel// de ltar zhag gsum rnam dbye dang // rtsis 'phro spo dang zhag gsum gyis// 'khor lo phud pa'i grangs stong par// zhugs tshul rim pa phyogs gcig bshad// de yang grub mtha' tshul mthun pa'i// tshes zhag nyin zhag khyim zhag gi/ rnam dbye go ba bskyed pa'i phyir// cung zad brjod kyis rna ba blogs// thog mar so so'i ngos 'dzin ni// zla ba'i 'phel 'grib bco lnga cha'i//

༄7/rtsis kyi bsta na bcos nya rgyas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor blo gsar kun da'i 'dod 'jo 787cha re rdzogs tshe tshes zhag yin// nam langs lag ris mthong ba nas// rjes ma'i lag ris mthong ba'i bar// nyin gyi zhag po phrugs gcig yin// nyi mas khyim gcig spyod pa'i yun// sum cur phye ba khyim zhag brjod// gza' rnams rang rang so so la// lo zla zhag rnams dbye ba yod// 260sum brgya drug cu'i nyi ma yi// khyim lo gcig gam khyim zhag gi/ dkyil 'khor grangs su nges pa yin// de yi rigs 'gres gzhan kun shes// nyi ma'i khyim dkyil mkha' dus me// gnas gnyis bzhag pa'i 'og ma ni// mig 2bsgyur mda' ros 65thob pa'i nor// steng mar ldan pa zhag po yin// lhag ma mkha' mtshams 6rkyabasgyur ba la// mda' ros 65thob pa chu tshod de// mkha' ro 6rkyadus 6dang 'dod 2glu1pa'i 12bar// rim bzhin bsgyur thob tshes dkyil 'grub// ༈ tshes dkyil zhag gnas thig ros 6༷bsgyur// chu tshod bcug la slar rim bzhin//mkha' ro 6rkyadus 6dang lus med 12kyis// bsgyur la rang rang cha bcug pa'i//tshogs de ri mkha' ris 7༷7bsgyur7266ṭwāṃ26ṭwāṃrarkyakyal// gnas gsum bzhag pa'i 'og ma ni// thub mkha' ri bos 7rkya7bgos pa'i nor// bar byin chu ros 64thob pa yis// steng mar phri ba'i lhag ma gang 72515574༷rkyarkya//risakha' ris 7rkya7bgos lhag lus pa// bgod byed cha yin nor 'dod 12pas// khyer lhag 'dod cha rnyed pa de// dus 6bgos lhag dbugs thob nor la// mkha' ros 6rkyabagos lhag chu srang yin// mkha' mtshams 6rkyakyis thob lhag chu tshod// nor de zhag gi gnas yin la// de yis nyin zhag dkyil 'khor 226tsū5'grub// 11rdo21 dkyil 'khor so so'i zhag rnams kyi// dus kyi longs spyod 'tshol ba'i lugs// lugs 'byung lugs ldog rnam gnyis las// lugs ldog

༄7/rtsis kyi bstan bcos nya rgyas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor blo gsar kun da'i 'dod 'jo/ 799252rdodor// ril cha'i rtsis 'phro dag par 'gyur// nyi byu rgya mtsho mkha' klus ṭwāṃ04dor// lhag de nyi sgru'i rtsis 'phro de// rim bzhin bsgyur bgod la sogs pa// da lta ji bzhin byas pas 'grub// bsdus rgyud byed pa'i rtsis 'phro la//rigs brtag stong 'jug btsal ba dang // byed grub lhad 'don la sogs pa//sgrub tshul nges pa 'ga' mchis kyang // rim bzhin lhad du 'gyur ba'i phyir//sna tshogs nas bzung gang spo yi// nag zla'i zla dag mda' ro'i lhag/ gsar pa'i zla dag rtsis 'phro dang // nag zla'i gza' nyi cha ril gyi// sgru ba kaḥde gsar spo ba'i// rtsis 'phro'i nges par bzung bar bya// de la byed pa'i skyon 'don na// byed grub rnam par 'byed pa dang // sna tshogs gsar spos rtsis 'phror gsal// sgra gcan ched du zla dag de// mkha' dus 6༷chu 4dang mkha' me lag220/ gang rung bgos pa'i lhag ma de// zla rer zla phyed so so yi//rtsis 'phro'i nges pa 'phyugs med yin// de yang gnas bsgrigs bsgrub 'dod na// rtsis 'phro de yang gang spo yi// nag pa'i bul ba de ga yin// byed pa lo bdag spo ba na// gang spo'i lo yi byed lo de// spo ba'i rtsis 'phro rnam dag yin//rgyal blon spo yang de dang 'dra// kar myang rtsis la rig byed chu1744/ / ri gzugs lo la rab yid kyis// nang tshan sna tshogs chu rta nas// gang brtsi yan gyi lo tshogs de// sha ka'i lo ru lhag grags pa yin// legs ldan gza' lnga nyin zhag la// spyi mthun spo na stong 'jug gi/ gong bshad zla dag mkha' 21mes bsgyur// gnas gsum bzhag la mas rim bzhin// ri mkha' 707ri dang chu ros 64bsgril// so so'i lhag de so so'i 'phro// rnyed pas steng sbyangs spyi zhag der// rang rang dkyil 'khor dor ba'i lhag/ so so'i sgos zhag rtsis 'phro yin// spyi zhag mig klu me skyon bsgyur1ra2ra2/ / mda' mkha' mtsho yi ri mtshams dor6714405/ / lhag de nyin zhag sgru ba'i 'phro// sngon med sgrub tshul khyad 'phags pa'i// tsis 'phro rang rang dal bar te// de yang stong

800 ༄7/khabri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/'jug spyi zhag la// rtag longs kyis bsgyur rang rang gi/ 'khor los phud pa'i lhag de yin// de nas sngon chad mkhas kun gyis// ma rig chos spyod rnam dag gi/ rtsis gzhi spo bar bzhed pa na// gong gi stong chen zla dag de// lnga bsdus sgru ba ji bzhin par// rang rang tshes zhag sum cu yi// rtag pa'i longs spyod kyis bsgyur bar// so so'i 'khor lo phud pa de// spo ba'i lo yi rtsis 'phro yin// de yang mi 'drar sgrub 'dod na// tshes zhag rtag pa'i longs spyod dang // rtsis 'phro rim bzhin bsres pa yis// cho ga rtsa sgrub bzhin byas pas//ya mtshan sgrub lugs gong bzhin 'char// kun gyi rtsis 'phro ster byed kyis//rang rang 'khor lor sbyangs pa'i lhag/ dbri bas rtsis 'phro 'phyugs med 'char// gzhan yang stong chen lo tshogs la// gza' nyi cha ril lnga sgra bcas//lo mtshams drug cu skor la sogs// rang rang dag pa'i lo tshogs kyis//bgos lhag lo la gong ji bzhin// dgos kyang don la khyad med par// bya sla'i ri mo 'char bar bzhed// gzhan yang zhag khyad la sogs par// nyin tshes 'khor lo 'khor ba'i grangs// shin tu gces phyir rab yid kyi// nang tshan sna tshogs chu rta yan// lo mtshams dag pa'i bgos lhag gis// nyin zhag 'khor lo 'khor ba'i grangs// mig dmar dbang ri zla klu gzugs// mtsho thig bse ru 1༷41ṭwāṃ175lhag pa la// ri thub gza' phyogs dbang ro klu// tshes 15rdo651rkya777'char phur bur dbang phyug dang // dbang chu ri thub drang srong 7774511ste// pa sangs dbang mtshams bre dus me// mtshams phyogs 10626665nyi bur rig byed mtsho// nor rtsa mig ri klu lag 2〈729ra44'char// de yi rgyu mtshan nyin zhag las// tshes zhag sgrub lugs 'di bzhin te//gang brtsi'i stong chen lo tshogs la// lo mtshams dag pas bgos pa'i lhag/de la zla dag spyi zhag dang // sgos zhag sgrub nor 'khor lo'i grangs// rab yid mtshon na gong bzhin 'char// de la tshes zhag bsgrub pa'i phyir// de nyid rang

༄7/rtsis kyi bstan bcos nya rgyas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor blo gsar kun da'i 'dod 'jo/ 801rang dkyil 'khor bsgyur// de la sgos zhag byin pa yi// spyi zhag dang mthun ri mo 'char// de nas gcig phab chu ror gyur// de la spyi zhag chu ro yi// lhag sbyangs de las gcig phab pa// ri mkha' rir gyur rang lhag sbyangs// de ni gang brtsi phan chad du// lo mtshams 'khor ba'i nyin zhag grangs// de la nyin zhag tshes zhag la// glo bur sgrub tshul zhag gsum gyi// rnam dbyer bkod bzhin bsgrub pa de// gnas drug zhag la rang rang gi/ zhag gcig rtag pa'i longs kyis bsgyur// 'khor los bsgril bas tshes spyod kyi// sgru ba rnam par dag pa 'char// de las myur bar bsgrub pa'i lugs// yul dus ri mo'i rig pa yis// man ngag 'ga' zhig logs su bstan// de yis nyi zla sgra gcan sogs// rim gyis rtogs par 'gyur ba yin// rab byung ma nu'i chu rta nas//brtsis pa'i ma 'ongs lo tshogs mda'// dus klu mkha' gzugs rtsa dus dbang // tshes dang nor lag mig klu bug/ gdengs dbang chu 'dod 'khor lo'i 271245rdo9ra22ṭwāṃ155691rkyar65grangs// rdzogs te kun kyang stong par 'jug/ gzhan yang nges pa yar slog tshul// gang slog lo nas brtsi bya yi//bar gyi 'das pa'i lo gang yod// khyim 12gyis bsgyur la gnas gnyis bzhag/'og ma mig bsgyur dbang ros bgo/ lhag mas slog lo'i dbang ro'i 65lhag/sbyangs shing ma ldangs dbang ro bsnan// bsnan tshe nor du gzugs bsre zhing //steng mar lhag pa zla ba dag/ lhag des brtsi bya'i lo de yi// dbang ro'i 65lhag ma gsal bar 'gyur// de nas lnga bsdus sgru ba ni// sngon med gsar btsal slog pa'i tshul// gang slog lo nas brtsi bya'i lor// zla dag sngar bzhin bsgrub de yis// slog lo'i gza' nyi ril cha yi// so so zla mtshams 'khor 'phros la// phri lhag brtsi lo'i brtsi 'phro 'grub// de nas gzhung bzhin bsgrubs pa yis// sgru ba rnam par dag pa'o// dkyus bzhin bya ba'i rim pa la// zla dag gnas lnga gnas gnyis dang // nyi mar gnas lnga bcas pa bkod//

802 ༄7//'bri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/rang rang bsgyur byed so sos bsgyur// 'khor lo ma nor bsgril ba yi// rtsis 'phro bral ba'i sgru ba 'grub// de yis slog lo'i sgru bar sbyangs// gang brtsi'i lo yi sgru ba ston// de bzhin byed pa'i sgru bar yang // rtsis 'go zug pa tshun la mātshungs// de phan tshul bzhin mi rtog pa// byed grub rnam par 'byed pa yi//dgongs don logs kyi yi ger gsal// de nas dpal ldan sgra gcan yang //zla dag mkha' mes 2rkyabasgyur ba nyid// gnas lngar bzhag la rang nyid kyi//sgyur byed rnams kyis rim par bsgyur// 'khor los so sor steng du bsgril//de yis slog lo'i sgra gcan sbyangs// brtsi lo'i rtsa ba gsal bar 'gyur//gdong mjug rim gyis spyi ltar bsgrubs// yang na zla dag mig 2gis bsgyur//mkha' dus 6rkyachu bos thob pa dor// lhag ma skar mas 27bsgyur ba sogs//rtsa sgrub ji bzhin byas pa la// slog lo'i rtsa bar sbyangs pa yis// gong bzhin brtsi lo'i rtsa ba 'char// byed pa lo bdag blon po ni// gang brtsi'i bar gyi lo grangs de// rang gi sgyur byed kyis bsgyur la// 'khor los so sor bsgril ba yi//slog lo'i byed pa lo 'phor sbyangs// brtsi lo gsal bar ston pa yin// rgyal blon la yang slog lo nas// grang brtsi'i lo grangs me 2yis bsgyur// ris bgos lhag ma gnas gnyis bzhag/ de yis slog lo'i rgyal blon sbyangs// brtsi bya'i lo de 'khrul med 'byung // gang brtsi'i bar gyi 'das pa'i lo// slog lo'i sha ka'i lo la sbyangs// sbyang bar ma ldang gyur pa na// kar myang rtsis kyi stong 'jug lta'i// lo grangs gzugs thig klu mtsho dus// ri dbang 5764༷rkya1bsnan sbyang lhag ma la// dkyus ltar bsgrubs pas kar myang 'grub// de nas nyin zhag gza' lnga ni// zla dag mkha' mes 20bsgyur ba la// gnas gsum 'og ma ri mkha' ri7rkya7// thob nor bar dang bar chu ros64/ / thob pa dor ba'i nor de yis// steng mar sbyangs pas spyi zhag 'grub// de yang chu ro 64ri mkha' ri'i7༷7/ / lhag gis slog lo'i lhag la sbyangs// ma ldangs chu ro 64

༄khya/rtsis kyi bstan bcos nya rgyas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor blo gsar kun da'i 'dod 'jo/ 803bsnan pa ste// brtsi lo'i lhag rnams gsal bar 'gyur// bsnan par gyur na spyi zhag las// gcig ni dbri bar bya ba yin// spyi zhag de nyid zhi gnyis don//brgya cha 1rkya0bcu chas 1༷bsgyur ba dang // drag gsum bcas pa rang dkyil bgos// lhag mas slog lo'i sgos zhag sbyangs// ma ldangs 'khor lo 27bsnan la sbyangs// brtsi lo'i sgos zhag rim bzhin rtogs// de las bsgrub pa dkyus bzhin bya// sgrub tshul mi 'dra gsar rnyed pa'i// khyad 'phags gnas bsgrigs slog pa'i tshul// spyi sgos zhag rnams so so la// gnas lngar bzhag la rang rang gi/ rtsa sgrub bsgyur byed rnams kyis bsgyur// so so'i 'khor los ma nor bsgril// de yi slog lo'i so sor sbyangs// brtsi bya'i lo de'i nyin zhag sgru/ /drag gsum dal bar zhi gnyis kyi// rkang 'dzin longs spyod rnam par dag/kho bo'i bgo skal tshes zhag la// spyod tshul gza' lnga slog 'dod na// zla dag gnas drug tshar lnga bzhag/ so so'i zla ril longs spyod bsgyur// ri mkha' ri dang bla ma la// ma nu yid 1414sogs rang rang gi/ 'khor los steng du bsgril ba des// slog pa'i lo yi sgru bar sbyangs// brtsi bya'i lo de 'khrul med 'gyur// nyi sgru grub pa'i lnga bsdus bzhin// gzhan yang de dag la sogs pa//rnam dag grub pa'i lugs drangs rnams// ji srid bar du rig pa yis// slog pas 'grub bo shes ldan dag/ byed par rtogs so rtsis 'go zug/ tshun las rtogs min gong dang mtshungs// nag rtsis skor 'go sa bdag rgyu// spar me la sogs rdol btang dang // khyad med rtogs tshul lugs mang ba// sgra gcan thebs dang kun dga' dang // dus dbyig rten 'brel dbyangs gsal sogs//sa ris ri mos rtogs pa dang // lkog gyur grangs kyi don rtogs pa// daṇḍi sogs kyi dpangs tshad kyang // grib mar brten nas shes pa dang // rkyang pa'i grangs nas bsnan bsub pa// ma mthong rang gi mtha' tshun dang // gzhan la ri mo'i rig pa yis// 'khor 'das phran tshegs rtogs pa sogs// blun

804 ༄༅/'bri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/rmongs byis blo 'dzin pa rnams// ya mtshan dag tu mthong ba 'ga'// mchis kyang dpyod ldan tshogs rnams kyis// dpyad tshe bzhad gad khrel ba'i rgyur//'dug phyir bkod pa'i spob pa zhan//ces rtsis kyi bstan bcos nya rgyas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor blo gsar kun da'i 'dod 'jo las zhag gsum rnam par dbye ba dang rtsis 'phro spo ba zhag gsum gyi 'khor lo bud pa'i grangs stong par zhugs nas 'das ma 'ongs lo ji tsam 'jug bcas bee dkar khol 'don gong 'og bsgril nas bkod pa'i san bcu gcig pa'o// mjug bsdu ba/dpal ldan dge tshogs du mas legs bskrun mtshan dpe'i bkod pa mi mthun med pa'i sku// snyan 'jebs yan lag drug cu'i rang rang skad dang dbang por 'jug pa tshangs pa'i gsung // rmad byung yon tan du ma'i gter gyur shes bya ji lta ji snyed mkhyen pa'i thugs// srid bya'i gtsug rgyan rje btsun bla ma mchog de sgo gsum gus pas slar yang 'dud// mkhyen rab phul byung legs byas khyung sngon skyes kyis nyer drangs pa'i// mkha' la rab 'phags mtha' klas shes bya'i dkyil 'khor 'od stong can// mi shes mun pa drung phyungs blo ldan pad tshal rgyas mdzad pa// 'jam mgon sā ra'i mtshan de bsam bzhin lag pad snying gar 'dzum// gang de'i shes rab kha ba'i rdul brtsegs las 'ongs shing // gtsug lag 'jug sgor gting mtha' mi mngon zad mi shes//dpyod ldan klu dbang kun bsten gzhir gyur skar nag rtsis// bai ḍūr dkar po rin chen 'byung ba'i gnas gcig pu// lha sras mu ni'i ye shes sgyu 'phrul gyi//thugs kyi kumbha las 'thon (thon1bstan bcos mchog/ grwa phug lugs srol

༄7/rtsis kyi bstan bcos nya rgyas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor blo gsar kun da'i 'dod 'jo/ 805bdud rtsi'i rgyun bzang po// sngon med legs bshad mkhas pa'i gtsug tu sbrengs// 'di ni tshul bzhin sbyangs na sbos ci 'tshal// yud tsam klags kyang rig lam shes bya'i gnas// rtogs shing gnad tshang mthong byed tsha zer gyis//mkhas pa'i grags thob utpal 'dab brgya 'dzum// 'on kyang skar rtsis kun gsalalto ba ru// 'dor byed lo'iming chu 'dzin grangs kyi rab brtsegs pas//lag len rnam bkra rgyu skar rang 'od tshogs// 'grib 'di ma bzod lhag bsam dri bzhon gyis// rtsis kyi bstan bcos shar ri'i phrag gong nas// nya rgyas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di shar bas// dpyod ldan blo gsar yid kyi kun da'i 'tshal(tshal3/ / 'dod pa 'jo byed tshul 'di de ring sbyin// gang 'dir mos ldan ldan pa'i nyin byed dbang // dbang po sgra 'dzin 'dzin pa'i 'dab brgya bye(phye3/ / phye ba'i legs bshad bshad pa sbrang rtsi'i bcud// bcud ldan rkang drug drug ldan blo gsar dpal// legs byas dpyid kyi rgyal mo dar drag las//'thon (thon3pa'i bsod nams dbyar skyes gzhon nu'i mgron// mthu ldan sa brtol ljon shing ldem pa'i rtser// me tog 'bras bzang dpag med rab tu bkra// rgyal bstan rin chen chu gter cher 'phel bas// dar rgyas rlabs 'phrengasrid rtser 'phyur ba dang // de 'dzin skyes chen zhabs pad srid mtha'i bar// dam bca' bzhi ldan ngo bor rtag brtan gsol// 'jig rten bde ba'i chu khur dkar po las// smon tshig rlung zhen dal bus bskyod pa'i tshe//bde skyid rdzogs ldan gru char rtag 'babs pas// 'gro kun gtsug phud dga' ba'i zlos gar bsgyur// lhag bsam sgrib bral rtsis gzhung a darsha// lag len bde ba'i gzugs brnyan 'char blo yang // ma rtog log bshad g.ya' yis sbags srid na// mkha' pa'i spyan sngar bshags so byi dor 'tshal// bdag dang mar gyur 'gro ba mtha' dag kun// dus kyi 'khor lo'i go 'phang thob pa dang // rtsis gzhung nya rgyas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di// nam yang nub med

806 ༄7/khibri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/'gro phan 'char bar shog/ ces phug lugs rtsis kyi legs bshad mkhas pa'i mgul rgyan baiḍūr dkar po'i do shal dpyod ldan snying nor zhes bya ba mkhas pa rnams la yid bzhin gyi nor bu las kyang ches cher 'phags pa 'di nyid deng skabs 'das lo yang 'byung me zla ba'i grangs su son par kun gyi lo tshogs kyis ngal bar 'joms pa'i lag len byed mi dkon pa dang / rang nyid sngar rang lo bcu bdun pa'i steng slob dpon mkhas pa'i dbang po nyin rdzong bla ma dkon mchog don 'grub chos dbang gi drung nas skar rtsis skor las lnga bsdus sgra gcan gza' lnga/ rtsis phran sogs dang / sgra snyan bcas rig gnas phran tshegs slob khul byas kyang sbyangs stobs zhan pas ha cang go don lon pa zhig ma byung ba dang / gshis nang don bskyed rdzogs sogs kyi skabs su babs pa las tha snyad rigs don mi che yang / deng skabs phyogs 'dir phyi nang rigs gnas kyi rgyun phal cher nyams par brten/ slob 'bangs rjes 'jug rnams kyi mig ltos dang lag len sogs la phan par srid snyam/ rang lo sum cu par slob dpon de nyid kyi gdan tshab mdo sngags rigs lam rgya mtsho'i bdag nyid nyin rdzorngo khri pa karma chos dbyings lhun grub bam dkon mchog chos dbang blo gros la snyan ngag le'u gsuyoga'i dogs gcod dang sgra rtsis sdeb sbyor sogs gzhi slob bgyis shing / lhag tu 'das lo spel tshul sogs zhib tu mnos pa'i rang lugs rtsis kyi bstan bcos pad dkar bzhad pa'i nyin byed ces bya ba rje chos kyi grags pa'i dngos slob paṇa chen dkon mchog lhun༄ba kyis mdzad pa de nyid rab byung bcu bzhi'i sna tshogs chu rtar 'das lo spos pa'i tshe/ slob dpon dam pa nyid nas bee dkar rtsis skor rnams kyang sna tshogs lor 'das lo spos pa'i lag len nyer mkho rnams zur 'don zhig byung na legs tshul gsung ba ma zad/rje bla ma mchog gi sku'i rigs su son pa gzims mchod yon tan 'byung gnas kyis kyang nan tur chen pos bskul ma dang ri mo'i grogs bgyi4par/ bee

808 ༄7khibri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/ldan snang ba gsal byed rig pa'i dpa' bo zhes 'bod pas dpal 'bri gung gi phreng mi 'gyur rdo rje'i spo'i bkra shis tshugs kyi gzims chung phun tshogs 'khyil par gzhung ka tas 'gro ba rnams ma gtogs sug bris bgyis pa'i thog ma'i glegasartsibam du sor mo'i 'du byed bsgyur ba po mang yul sgang sngon gyi chos mdzad nee rna dkon mchog bstan pa 'di bgyis dge ba'i mthu la brten nas nam mkha'i khams dang mnyam pa'i 'gro ba mtha' dag dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i go 'phang dam pa thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ sarba maṅga lam//

809ro༅// rtsis kyi bstan bcos pad dkar bzhad pa'i nyin byed ces bya ba bzhugs so//mchod brjod dang rtsom par dam bca' ba/na mo gu ru kā ma de wa maṇḍa lā pa// rnam pa kun ldan sna tshogs yul gyi mtshams sprin gsar pas mgrin 'khyud pa'i// mi 'gyur mchog gi bde ba'i ros gang ind+ra tī la'i sa 'dzin gang // lha sngags ye shes dkyil 'khor kun gyi khyab bdag gcig pur yongs grub pa// dpal ldan bla ma dus kyi 'khor lo rgyud kun ston mdzad de la 'dud// rnam dag chos dbyings mkha' la rtag gzims kyang // ma lus 'gro la brtse ba'i gom stabs kyis// rab 'byams zhing kun ye shes sku gcig gis// cig car rol mdzad 'jam mgon dpa' bos skyongs// mchog tu mi 'gyur bde ba'i ro// skal bzang dga' ba'i dga' ston du// bstsol mdzad yongs 'du'i dbang po mchog/ chos rgyal rigs ldan rnams la 'dud// gsung rab nags lung stug por rgyu// legs bshad kun dha'i rgyun bzang sbreng // tshangs spyod e n+ya'i bla gos can// bshes gnyen drang srong tshogs rnams rgyal// rnam dag rgyud sde'i mtsho las 'ongs//rnam 'gyur legs bshad 'od brgyas mdzes// rnam dpyod rta bdun gyis drangs pa'i// rnam mang rtsis kyi nyin byed spro//

810 ༄7//'bri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/le'u dang po/ sngon 'gro'i rim pa dang tha snyad rnam grangs kyi skor/sngon 'gro bya ba'i rim pa ni// bri bgrang snon pa g.yas nas bya// bgod bsgyur 'brid pa g.yon nas bya// bsgyur byed thig le gral la 'god// bgod byed thig les mas mtha' dgag/ sgyur byed stongs na bsgyur bya dbyi// 'di ni grogs med thig le'i yin// dbus mtha' stongs na thig le bri// rkyang bgod ji trem thob pa 'khyer// sbrags bgod 'og ma'i tshod dang sbyar// phyed kyis bsgyur na phyed cha'i grangs// gcig bsgyur ba la mang nyung med// grangs kyi rnam par bzhag pa ni// gcig bcu brgya stong khri 'bum dang // sa ya bye ba dung phyur te// dgu po rkyang pa'i grangs su brjod// ther 'bum khrag khrig rab bkram dang // gtams dkrigs mi 'khrugs khyad 'byin dang // spang rten ded 'dren mtha' snang dang // rgyu rig 'dod mdzes dbang po dang // legs 'byin rtogs 'gro 'bying rdul dang // rgya rtags stobs 'khor brda shes dang //rnam byung stobs mig khyad byung dang // byams pa snying rje dga' ba dang //btang snyoms rnams ni chen por bcas// drug cu pa ni grangs med de// gong nas gong du bcu 'gyur bsgreng //grangs rnams ming gi rnam drangs ni// gzugs dang bse ru rang bzhin dang // zla ba ri bong can sogs gcig/ zung dang lag mig 'khrig bgrod phyogs// sbyor ba mtshe ma gnyis yin no// 'jig rten dus dang yon tan dang //me dang rtse mo can ni gsum// chu gter rgya mtsho chu bo dus// sde pa rig byed

814 sa༅ltarabri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/la ni sgrog stod smad// khrums gnyis se stod se smad dang // nam gru la ni she pa zer// de nas sbyor ba rnam sel ba 'ga' zhig gis gcig yig lasel bar byed pa snang bas gang 'thad brtag par bya'o dang // mdza' ba 1tshe ldan 2skal bzang 2dang // bzang po 4shin skrangs 5las bzang 6dadzo// 'dzin pa 7zug ju rdoskrangs pa 9dang //'phel ba 1༷nges pa 11kun 'joms 12dang // dga' ba 12rdo rje 14grub pa 15dang // shin tu tung 16dang mchog can 17dang // yongs 'joms 1rdozhi ba 19grub pa 2rkyadang // bsgrub bya 21dge ba 22dkar po 22 dang // tshangs pa 24dbangarkupo 25khon 'dzin 26te// sbyor ba nyi shu rtsa bdun no// ba 1 gdab pa ba 2 byis pa lab 2 rigs can kol ba// tai 4 til drung ti la dang ba 5 khyim skyes rdzo dang // ba 6ni dza tshong pa'am spun pa dngabikhyi ༷'jug phod ste// 'pho ba'i byed pa bdun yin te// bod skad gdab pa1byis pa 2dang // rigs can 2tel rung 4khyim skyes 5dang // tshong pa 6 spun pa yang zer 'jug phod can 7bya'o//tshes gcig phyi cha nas bzung ste// nyi shu dgu yi lnga cha'i bar// tshes zhag ro la byed pa gnyis// 'char bar 'gyur bar shes par bya// shadku ni 1dang rkang bzhi 2klu2/ / ki sdu 4 misdug pa gha na zhes bya ba// nyer dgu'i phyi cha nas bzung ste// tshes gcig snga cha'i bar dag la// 'char ba rtag byed bzhi zhes grags//sngon 'gro bya ba'i rim pa dang tha snyad dang rnam grangs bstan pa'i skabs te le'u dang po'o//

༄7rtes kyi bstan bcos pad dkar bzhad pa'i nyin byed/ 815le'u gnyis pa/ yan lag gsal bar byas pa'i skor/dang po/ bstan rtsis skor/ mkhyen pa'i gting mtha' mi mngon zhing // brtse ba'i rlabs 'phreng srid rtser 'phyo// 'phrin las phyogs kyi mthar 'gro ba/ 'jam dgon chu gter dbang pos skyongs// dpal ldan rgyud kyi skyes mos tshal// dri med ma la ya can gyi// dngos bstan yan lag lnga yi rtsis// legs bshad dri gzhon gsar pa spro//me mkha' rgya mtsho 'das lo 402ni// dag par bsgrub pa'i zhar byung du// ston pa'i 'khrungs lo la sogs dang // bstan pa'i gnas tshad shes 'dod na// me mtsho dus mig lo tshogs la2642// rab byung ma nu'i nang tshan gyi// sna tshogs chu rta yan chad la// ro dang srid pa zla ba 126bsres// nyis stong bdun brgya don dgu 2779yod// slar yang ji tsam 'das pa bsnan// mig dmar shing pho byi ba la// ston pa lhums su zhugs pa nas// da lta'i chu rta yan gyi lo2779/ / de la ri bong can gyi (gyis3sbyangs// khro mo zhes bya shing glang la//'gro ba'i nyi ma bltams pa'i lo277rdo/ / de la bu ga mig gis sbyangs// rnam rgyal zhes bya chu sbrul la// khab nas mngon par byung ba'i lo 2749/ / de la re yis sbyangs pa ni// sgyur byed sa mo phag lo la// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas brnyes pa'i lo 2742/ / de las mda' dang rig byed 'phri// nyi sgrol byed pa shing spre la// dus kyi 'khor lo gsungs pa dang // ston pa mya ngan 'das pa'i lo 269ra/ / de la mkha' mkha' ro yis sbyangs// slar yang nyi sgrol shing spre la//'jam mgon grags pa byon pa'i lo 2rkya9ṭwāṃ/ / de la mkha' mkha' zla bas sbyangs// khrag skyugs ces pa chu phag la// bsdus rgyud bsdus shing rigs ldan

816 ༄7/khabri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/199ṭwāṃgyur// de la klu yi (yis) lo brgya sbyangs// nyi sgrol byed pa shing spre la//rgya mtsho rnam rgyal byon pa dang // kla klo'i lor ni rab tu grub119ra/ / de la mkha' mkha' zla bas sbyangs// rgya mtsho rnam rgyal nyid kyi dus1rkya1ra/ / de la mig dang klu yis sbyangasa'adi gnyis la lag pa gdengs can zla ba yod/ / mi bzad ces bya mi khyi la// rgyud kyi dngos bstan ji bzhin du// rgyal kas rtsis gzhi mdzad pa'i lo1rkya16/ / del zla 'di dang lag pa gdengs cag zla ba bsdongs pa la me mkha' rgya mtsho 'byung ba yin / ba mig lag sbyangs// rab byung zhes bya me yos la// dus 'khor 'phags yul dar ba'i lo795/ / de la dus gzugs zla bas sbyangs// rab byung gnyis pa'i chu phag lor// klu sgrub slar yang gangs ljongs 'dir// mi yi srid bzung 'bri gung pa// 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po 'khrungs679/ / de la mig rtse yon tan 'phri// rab byung brgyad pa'i shing lug lor// rgyal dbang skyob pa gnyis pa che// kun dga' rin chen dpal bzang bltams247/ / de la chu mes dman pa yis// rab byung dgu pa'i sa sbrul lor// zab gter sgo 'byed bka' rnying bstan// zung 'jug srol btod ratna 212'khrungs/ / de la dus klus phrog pa na// rab bcu'i shing khams lug gi lor// khyab bdag dharma gīrti bltams297/ / de la zla bzang zhus pa yis// rab byung drag po'i me sprel lor// phyag na padmo'i sgyu 'phrule gar// da kon mchog 'phrin las bzang po 'khrungs166/ / de la yid gzugs dor ba na// rab byung myos byed lcags stag la// gru 'dzin dgyes dngos rigs kyi bdag/ rje btsun padma'i rgyal mtshan bltams52/ / de la me mig gis phral bas// bag med zhes pa chu glang lor// kho bo dharma'i ming can 29btsas// de la bug zung 'brid pa na// rab yid sna tshogs chu rta'i lor// rtsis kyi bstan bcos 'di nyid kyi// rtsis mgo 'dzin pa'i lo grangs 0yin// bstan pa ji tsam gnas pa'i tshad// mi mthun rnam grangs mang na yang // mdo lugs 'bum gyi ṭīkka ru// la (lnga) stong

༄7khyas kyi bstan bcos pad dkar bzhad pa'i nyin byed/ 817gnas par gsungs pa ni// don la gnas zhes mang rnams mthun// dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo las// seng ge'i gdan can sum cu gnyis// lo grangs brgya brgyar chos ston par// gsungs pa'i rigs pas sum stong dang // nyis brgya bstan pa'i tshad du 'dod// slar yang drag po 'khor lo tshe'i// dus bzhi'i 'go ni rtsom par byed// mi lo nyi khri chig stong dang // drug brgya de yi tshad yin te// bcu gnyis gling re'i thob skal la// stong phrag re dang brgyad thob pa las cha re// lho gling dbus ma'i rang skal gyi// stong dang brgyad cha 'byung ba dang // gong gi sum stong nyis brgya po// bsdoms pas stong phrag lngar 'gyur ba// mdo lugs dang yang shin tu 'grig/ 'di la snga ma spyir btang dang //phyi ma stobs ldan 'khor lo tshe'i// dus bzhir dmigs kyis bkar nas gsungs// 'on kyang gnyis ka bdag cag gi/ ston pa'i bstan pa'i nyid du gcig/ rgyal ba mya ngan 'das pa nas// da lta'i chu rta yan chad la// lo ni nyis stong drug brgya dang // go brgyad 'das pa rang lugs te// chos rgyal drug dang rigs ldan ni// stobs po che yan nyi shu thal// de la nyis stong drug brgya yod// da lta'i rigs ldan ma 'gags pa// tshes ston lo ni go brgyad 'das//de las gzhan du smra ba 'khrul// 'on kyang beeḍūr dkar po'i lugs// rnam gnon chos ston go lnga 'das// ma 'ongs ji tsam gnas pa ni// rigs pa 'di las dpag par byos// de ltar rnam bzhag shes byas nas//da lta rab byung bcu bzhi'i nang // sna tshogs la sogs 'das pa'i lo//nyi mas 12bsgyur la nag pa sogs// 'das zla bsres la gnas gnyis bzhag/'og ma chus 4bsgyur klu gzugs 1rabasre// mkha' me zla bas 120thob pa'i nor// steng du byin pa zla dag go/ zla dag de nyid gnas gsum bzhag/ bar ma sos 22bsgyur steng rim bzhin// zla ba 1nam mkha' rkyame 2rnams bsres//

818 ༄7|'bri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/rdo 'og ma ros 6thob bar mar sbyangs// de la mkha' ros 6༷thob pa'i nor//steng du bsres la ri bos 7bgo/ waṃ lhag ma gza' yi sgru wa yin// zla dag gnas gnyis steng ma mig 2// 'og ma gzugs 1kyis bsgyur ba la// rmi steng drag 11'og ma bug ri 79bsres// paṃṇḍaṃ 'og ma dus nyis 126bgos pa'i lhag/cha shas yin no rnyed pa'i nor// steng du sbyin la klu lag 2rdogis// 122ṭwāṃ6 bgos lhag ril po zhes bya'o// zla dag gnas gsum steng ma mig2/ dbus ma drag pos 11bsgyur ba la// 121 steng nas rim bzhin nam mkha' 0dang // me rtse 22gter 9rnams sbyin byas la// ṭwāṃ2 'og ma bu ga mes 29thob pa'i// nor gyi dbus ma sbyangs bya zhing // mkha' ros 6rkyabagos lhag chu tshod steng // rnyed pa steng sbyin 'khor los bgo/ /dzā lhag ma skar ma'i gnas su nges// de yis nyi ma'i sgru wa 'grub// gza' yi gnas su zla ba dang // chu tshod gnas su mig me 22sbyin// cha shas zla ba 1ril por mig 2/ skar mar mig 2dang chu tshod du//drag po11rab tu byin pa na// zla ba phyi ma'i rtsis gzhi 'char// gza' yi gnas su tshes grangs bsres// tshes des chu tshod gnas nas sbyangs// slar yang ril por sbyin par bya// de la rgya mtsho zla bas 14bgo/ rnyed pa mnyam 24dang mi mnyam 12las// snron 'brid mtshan nyid shes par bya// rnyed pa med rkyana'ang mnyam pa yin// lhag mas zla ba'i rkang pa bzung // 'byung 5dbang 5mda' 5chu 4me 2mig 2gzugs1// ldog pa dang bcas yid 14gnas//gzugs 1dang 'dod pa 12dag la mda' 5// mig 2dang nyi mar 12phyogs zhes bya// me 2dang drag por 11tshes 15yin te// rgya mtsho 4phyogs 1rkyal bu ga gzugs1//mda' 5dang gter 9la zung bgrod 22pa// dus 6dang klu 2ral rgyal ba 24ste// thub pa 7la ni de nyid do25// rkang pa snga ma phyi ma'i 'char//

༄7/rtsis kyi bstan bcos pad dkar bzhad pa'i nyin byed/ 819longs spyod longs ma spyad pa bzung // rkang bzung sdun mas cha shas bsgyur//dus nyis 126bgos pas thob pa ni// yang dag rgyu ba'i chu tshod yin// lhag ma mkha' ros 60bsgyur thob srang // yang lhag ros 6bsgyur thob pa dbugs//rkang pa'i mtshams ni ma 'das na// chu tshod gnyis po bsre bar bya// 'das na yang dag rgyu ba yis// rkang pa'i chu tshod dag la sbyang // de las gcig phab mkha' ros 60bsgyur// chu srang gis sbyangs de las slar// gcig phab ros 6bsgyur dbugs kyis sbyangs// lhag rnams gza' yi chu tshod man// snon gong gi skong pa mnyam na snon mi mnyam nas dbri dang dbri bar bya ba yin// tshes grangs gnas gnyisagong ma de// chus 4bsgyur 'og ma mes 2thob bsre// de la thob na mkha' ros 6rkyabago/ rnyed pa skar ma'i gnas su dang // lhag ma chu tshod gnas su sbyin// 'og gi lhag ma nyi shus 2rkyabasgyur// chu srang du byin nyi bar yin// de nyid gnas gnyis gcig la ni// skar drug 6chu tshod zhe lnga 45sbyangs// 465 ma ldang 'khor lo 27bsnan la sbyangs// bsnan pa yin nam min kyang rung // ༈nyu'akhor phyed lhag na dor bar bya// lhag ma'i skar gnas mkha' ros 60bsgyur//'og gi chu tshod dang ldan pa// 'byung ba me 125dang zla bas bgo/ rnyed pa nyi ma'i rkang pa bzung // dus 6dang rgya mtsho 4zla ba 1ste// ldog pa dang bcas ro yi gnas// gzugs 1mda' 5ro 6ste mig 2chur 4phyogs1rkya// me 2la drag po 11zhes bya'o// de ltar snga ma phyi ma'i char// longs spyad longs ma spyad pas bzung // rkang bzung sdun mas lhag rnams sgyur// mda' yon zlas 125thob yang dag dbyug/ lhag ma mkha' ros 6rkyabasgyur thob srang // yang lhag ros 6bsgyur thob pa dbugs// rkang pa'i mtshams ni ma 'das na// chu tshod gnyis po bsre bar bya// 'das na yang dag rgyu ba yis// rkang pa'i chu tshod dag la sbyangs// de las gcig phab mkha' ror spel// chu srang gis sbyangs lhag ma

820 ༄7khibri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/nas// gcig phab ros 6bsgyur dbugs kyis sbyangs// lhag ma gza' nyi'i longs spyod du// 'khor phyed dor bsnan ma dor sbyangs// de yi gza' nyi rnam par dag/ nyi ma dag pa gnas gnyis bzhag/ gcig gis skar mar tshes grangs sbyin// tshes grangs logs bris drug gis bsgyur// de la gza' yi chu tshod sre// thob na mkha' ros 6rkyabago bar bya// rnyed pa skar ma'i gnas nas sbyangs// lhag mas chu tshod sbyang bar bya// gza' yi chu srang dbugs dag gis//skar ma'i srang dbugs sbyang bar bya// gza' dang zla nyi skar ma'i gnas// ri 7dang 'khor los 27bgo bar bya// lhag ma gza' dang rgyu skar gyi// rnam par dag pa mngon sum 'char// nyi zla bsres pa sbyor ba ste// tshes grangs mig 2sgyur zla bas 1sbyangs// thub pas 7bgos lhag byed pa'o// gza' tshes skar sbyor byed pa ste// rgyud kyi dngos bstan ji bzhin du// yan lag lnga ni bshad zin to//gnyis pa/ yan lag lnga rtsis kyi skor/ye shes lnga ldan bla ma la// yan lag lnga yis gus btud nas// byed pa'i dbang byas yan lag lnga'i// zhib rtsis gnas lnga gsal bar bya// rab byung bcu bzhi'i nang tshan gyi// sna tshogs la sogs 'das pa'i lo// nyis bsgyur 12nag sogs 'das zla bsres// gnas gnyis 'og ma mig 2gis bsgyur//bu gas 9spras la mda' ros 65bgos// rnyed pa steng sbyin zla dag go/ zla dag gnas gsum steng rim bzhin// gzugs 1dang zla me 21mkha' dbang 5rkyabasgyur///1paṃ steng mar nam mkha' ༷bar gter 'byung 59// 'og tu stong pa rtse mo 20bsres//lhaXṛ mkha' ro 6rkyamakha' ro 6rkyari bos 7bgo/slolhag ma tshes gza'i sgru wa kaḥ zla dag gnas gnyis steng mig 2dang // 'og ma gzugs 1

༄7/rtsis kyi bstan bcos pad dkar bzhad pa'i nyin byed/ 821kyis bsgyur ba la//glu steng drag 11'og mar bug ri 79brgyan//lhakṣ-i'og ma dus nyis 126bgos pa'i lhag/ cha shas yin no thob pa'i nor// steng du sbyin la klu lag 2ragis//122/6 bgos lhag ril bu'i sgru wa kaḥ zla dag gnas ༵ steng rim bzhin// mig 2phyogs 1rkyaklu dbang 5ṭwāṃzung 2phyogs 1rkyabasgyure//lto2/༷steng nas thirkyag 0so 22dus mtsho 46dang // nam mkha' 0khyim 12bsres 'og nas yar///rkyalto 'dod pa 1/༵sa 6dang mkha' ro 6rkyadang // thig ro 6rkya'akhor los 27bgos pa'i lhag/lto6rdo nyi ma'i sgru wa rnam par dag/ rang rang sgyur byed byin pa na// zla ba phyi ma'i rtsis gzhi 'char// bug mdwa' 59chu tshod yon tan 2srang //rig byed 4dbugs rnams tshes kyi bsgyur/5(/ gza' yi sgru war gnas mtshungs sbyin// ril por tshes gzhug ma nus 14bgo/ rnyed pa mnyam 240dang mi mnyam 12las// snon 'brid mtshan nyid shes par bya// rnyed pa med na'ang mnyam pa yin// lhag ma zla ba'i rkang pa bzung // 'byung 5dbang 5mda' 5chu 4me 2mig 2gzugs1//ldog pa dang bcas yid kyi gnas// rkang pa snga ma phyi ma'i char// longs spyod longs ma spyad pa sdom// gzugs 1dang 'dod pa 12dag la mda'5//mig 2nyir phyogs 1rkyate me 2drag 11tshes15//rgya mtsho 4phyogs 1rkyal bu ga 19gzugs// mda' 5dang gter 9la mig lag 22dang // dus 6dang klu rdol rgyal ba 24ste// thub par 7de nyid 25ma zin thigarkya/ rkang pa snga mas cha shas bsgyur// ma zin rkang pa dang pos bsgyur//dus nyis 1 26thob pa yang dag dbyug/ lhag ma mkha' ros 6rkyabasgyur thob

822 〉〉khabri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/srang // de lhag ros 6bsgyur thob pa dbugs// yang lhag yid 14bsgrur thob pa cha// rkang pa'i mtshams ni ma 'das na// chu tshod gnyis po bsre bar bya//'das na yang dag rgyu ba yis// rkang pa'i chu tshod dag la sbyangs// de las gcig phab drug cur 6rkyabasgyur// chu srang gis sbyangs lhag ma nas// gcig phab drug 6bsgyur dbugs kyis sbyangs// de las gcig phab ma nur 14bsgyur//cha shas kyis sbyangs lhag ma rnams// gza' yi longs spyod dag la ni// mnyam byin mi mnyam phrog pa yis// res gza' bar pa legs par grub// rig bye1 4chu tshod zla mig 21srang // dbugs mda' 5'dod cha bu ga 9rnams// tt+waṃ1tshes kyis bsgyur la nyi sgrur sbyin// de yis nyi ma bar pa 'grub// nyi bar gnas gnyis gcig la ni// skar drug 6chu tshod zhe lngas 45sbyangs///5 ma ldang 'khor lobasnan la sbyangs// 'khor lo bsnan nam ma bsnan yang //lhanyu 'khor phyed lhag na dor bar bya// lhag ma'i skar gnas mkha' ros 60sgyur// 'og gi chu tshod dang ldan pa// mda' yon 12zlas thob nyi rkang bzung // dus 6dang chu gter 4ri bong 1'dzin// ldog pa dang bcas ro yi gnas// rkang pa snga ma phyi ma'i char// longs spyod longs ma spyad pa sdom// gzugs 1mdar 5ro 6ste mig 2chur 4phyogs1rkya// me 2la drag po 11ma zin thigaX/ rkang pa sngun mas lhag rnams bsgyur// ma zin dang pos bsgyur ba la// rang rang 'khor lo steng du dril// de la mda' yon zlas 125thob pa// yang dag rgyu ba'i chu tshod yin//lhag ma mkha' ros 6rkyabasgyur ba la// 'og gi srang bcug thob pa srang // lhag ma ros 6bsgyur dbugs bsres nas// bgos thob dbugs yin yang lhag de//'dod 12bsgyur cha bsres thob 'dod cha/ rkang mtshams ma 'das chu tshod bsre// 'das nas yang dag rgyu ba yis// rkang pa'i chu tshod sbyang ba sogs//

༄7lhas kyi bstan bcos pad dkar bzhad pa'i nyin byed/ 823zla ba'i myur rkang bzhin du bya// de ltar 'phri bsnan gang byas kyang // gza' nyi bar pa'i longs spyod du// 'khor phyed dor bsnan ma dor dbrog/ de yi gza' nyi rnam par dag/ nyi dag gnyis bkod gcig gi ni// dbyug gur mtsho dbang tshes bsgyur byin// tshes 'khrud zla ba'o de nyid la// res gza'i chu tshod man chad kyis// sbyangs pas res 'grogs zla ba dag/ nyi zla bsres pa sbyor ba dang // tshes grangs mig bsgyur zla bas 1dman// thub pas 7bgos lhag 'phyi byed de// de las gcig 'phri snga byed do// gsum pa/ yan lag lnga rtsis kyi skor/grub mtha'i dbang du byas pa yis// zhib pa'i yan lag lnga rtsis ni/ /phyogs 'dir grags pa gtsor byas nas// zhal lung mkhan po'i lugs bzhin brjod// rab byung yid kyi nang tshan las// sna tshogs 'das lo nyi mas 12bsgyur// 'das zla bsres la gnas gnyis bzhag/ 'og ma mig 2bsgyur 'dod yon 5bsre// dbang ros 65bgos rnyed steng mar brgyan// tshes zla rnam par dag pa'o// zla dag gnas lnga steng nas gzugs1// zla me 21mkhaḍi mda' 50thig 'byung mtsho45// dbang po chu gter srid pa 245yis// 24zloshā5bsgyur la steng nas gzugs 1tshes 15dang // dus 46mtsho 'khrigs pa 2mig rdzurdoshā52'dod yon// rgya mtsho mda' me 245'bul ba'am//25༵25 yang na 'byung ba 5rig byed chu 44// 'dod pa 12'jig rten 2ma nu 14dang // rtse mo 'byung me trī~Xrnyi252'phri ba yi//21ṅge42 ma ldang rang rang 'khor lo 27bsnan// ri mkha' ri 707

༄7/rtsis kyi bstan bcos pad dkar bzhad pa'i nyin byed/ 825lhag ma mkha' ro 6rkyabro ba 6dang // ri mkha' ris 7rkya7sgyur dus 126nyis bgo/srang dbugs cha shas gnas su brtsegs// rkang pa'i mtshams ni ma 'das na//chu tshod gnyis po bsre bar bya// 'das pa yang dag rgyu ba yis// rkang pa'i chu tshod dag la sbyangs// de las rim bzhin phab sbyangs rdis// gza' yi chu tshod man chad la// rnyed pa mnyam sbyin mi mnyam dbrog///rdo de yis gza' phyed dag pa yin// rig byed chu tshod zla mig srang // dbugs mda' me mtsho'i cha shas rnams// tshes bsgyur nyi ma'i sgru war sbyin// de yis nyi ma phyed dag 'gyur//nyi ma bar pa gnas gnyis kyi// gcig la skar drug 6 dang chu tshod nas zhelngas45sbyangs//465 yang na skar ma mda' 5dang nishā/ / chu tshod dus 6kyi sbyang ba ni//zhal lung mkhan po'i khyad chos yin// 'o na dpal ldan rgyud rgyal las// dus kyi rgyu skar rkang pa gsum rechutshod zhe lnga/ / bcas pas sbyang bar gsungs pa la//dngos su 'gongs par mi 'gyur grangs// de ltar sbyang lugs gang byed kyang //sbyang du ma ldang 'khor lo 27bsnan// sbyangs kyang 'khor phyed lhag na dor//lhanyum dor lho bgrod dor na byang // lhag ma skar gnas mkha' ros 6rkya spel//'og gi chu tshod dang ldan pa// mda' yon zlas 125thob nyi rkang bzung // dus dang chu gter 4ri bong 1can// ldog bcas bro ba'i gnas su 'gyur// rkang pa snga ma phyi ma'i char// longs spyod longs ma spyad pa sdoms// rkang bzung sngun mas lhag rnams bsgyur// rang 'khor dril la mda' yon zlas125/ / thob pa yang dag rgyu ba yin// lhag ma mkha' ros 6༷bsgyur ba la/ srang bcug thob pa chu srang ngo // de lhag ros 6bsgyur dbugs bsres la// thob pa dbugs yin lhag ma de// ri‘ros 67bsgyur thob cha shas so// rkang pa'i mtshams ni ma 'das na// chu tshod gnyis po bsre bar bya// 'das na yang dag rgyu ba yis//

830 ༄7khibri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/rnams// snga ma'i khyim drug spyi nor la// gza' la bsnan cing skar ma la//'phri bas phyi ma phyi ma yis// spyi nor bskal pa'i bar du 'char// tshes mtshams 'tshol ba nas bzung ste// mgyogs ster byed tshul sngar dang mtshungs// gzhan yang snga lo'i li thu la// phyi lo'i nges pa 'char ba dang // tshes zhag snga ma'i gza' skar la// phyi ma'i gza' skar bsgrub tshul sogs// dgos pa chung phyir 'dir ma bkod// rgyud kyi dngos bstan byed rtsis gnas gsum ma dang de las cung zad zhib pa gnas lnga ma dang shin tu zhib pa grub dbang du byas pa dang de dag gi mgyogs ster la sogs pa yan lag lnga gsal bar byas pa ste le'u gnyis pa'o//le'u gsum pa/ sgra gcan rtsis 'phros skor/chos dbyings legs bris lam la gnas// stong nyid snying rje'i 'bar 'dzag gis// srid zhi mthar gyur nyi zla za// don gyi sgra gcan la btud nas//kun rdzob sgra gcan gsal bar bya// zla ba phyed pa'i sgra gcan ni// zla ba dag pa bug mes 29brgyan// mig 2 bsgyur nya stong gzugs 1mig 2 bsres//mkha' dus 46rkyachus rnyed dor ba'i lhag/ 'khor los 27bsgyur la mkha' dus chus460// bgos thob skar ma'i gnas su bzhag/ lhag ma mkha' ro 60mkha' dus 60dang // dus 6dang me mig 22gis bsgyur ba// sngar 46༷bzhin bgos pa'i rnyed nor rnams// chu tshod srang dbugs me mig cha// dgra gcan 'das pa'i longs spyod de// rtsa ba'i bul ba zhes kyang bya// de yis 'att+waṃr lo 27la sbyangs gdong // hūṃ:gdong la 'khor lo'i phyed bsres mjug/ /ṭwāṃ chu tshod sa/nas su rtse mo dang // srang la gzugs me dbugs su gcig/ me mig cha

༄7/rtsis kyi bstan bcos pad dkar bzhad pa'i nyin byed/ 831ru bu ga gzugs// zla ba phyed kyi rtags turtaX1longs te// snga ma'i rtsa bar byin pa na// phyi ma'i rtsa ba dag par 'char//haṃ5 chu tshod bdun dang chu srang gnyis// dbugs gsum cha shas bco lnga rnams// zla ba re re'i rtag longs te//mkha' me 22rkyalag pa bgo byed yin// dgra gcan rtsa ba mi dgos par//gdong mjug ri mo 'char 'dod na// mkha' dus 46rkyachu bo nyid la sbyangs//lhag ma 'khor los 27bsgyur ba sogs// gong bzhin byas pas gdong 'grub cing //lhadṛ 'khor phyed bsres pas mjug ma dag/ tshes ri'i dgra gcan rtogs 'dod na// bug mes 29brgyan pa'i zla dag de// mkha' mes 2rkyabasgyur la tshes grangs bsre// mkha' mkha' 69rkyarkyabu ga ros rnyed dor// lhag ma skar 27mas bsgyur ba la// mkha' mkha' 69rkya0bu ga ros thob skar// de lhag mkha' ro 6rkyal sogs pas// risdu bzhin bsgyur thob rtsa ba steng // gdong mjug ri mo sngar dang mtshangs// 1dī4cha srang ma nu me mig 'char//— nyi ma tshes re'i rtag ra 12raXlongs yin// 'di yi rtsa ba mi dgos par// gdong mjug rtogs par 'dod pa na// mkha' mkha' 69rkyaXbu ga ros dor ba'i// lhag ma bgod byed 6900nyid la sbyang // 'khor lo 27la sogs rim bsgyur zhing // mkha' mkha' 69rkya0bu ga ros bgos pas// gdong dag mjug ma sngar bzhin no// 'di yi re mig 'dzin tshul ni// zla dag nam mkha' 4༷rgya mtshos spras// mkha' me 220lag pas rnyed pa dor// lhag mas rtsa ba'i re'u mig 'dzin// gong re'umig ma nya dang 'og ma stong // de bzhin rtsis gzhi gang la yang // zla dag legs sgrub sgra gcan gyi// rtsis 'phro gang yin bsres pa la// mkha' me 220lag pas dor lhag gis// rtsa ba'i re'u mig 'khrul med zin// tshegs chung don che'i man

832 ༄7//'bri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/ngag yin// mun can 'char dus rtogs 'dod na// gdong dang nyi ma dag pas sbyangs// sbyang du ma ldang 'khor lo 27bsnan// lhag ma nam mkha' khyim 120gyis bsgyur// de la chu tshod mig 2bsgyur bsre// mda' mkha' chu bos 45rkyabagos pa yis// rnyed pa med na ༷gza' nyi 'grogs// gzugs 1mig 2me cha mda' ro ri sngadrophyed dnganyinaphyed dang dgongaphyed2/ri gi rte/ga :de/ //2 lha sna ༷1/ rten pa//mun mtshams 4srod phyed 5dang // nam gung 6thor phyed 7rim pa bzhin//shar ri'i rtse nas dgra gcan 'char// byang du gdong dang lho dus me// nyi ma nub ka zla ba nya// 'char ba rnams ni dus mtshungs na/ srid gsum rnam rgyal dus sbyor te// gzhan du g.yas g.yon me dang gdong // yod pa'ang rtsod pa las rgyal ba'i// srid gsum 3ma rgyal dus sbyor yin// de phyir rgyu ba kun spangs nas// rgyal bar 'dod pa 'di kho na// bzung bar bya ba nges pa'o//'on kyang dbyangs 'char las 'byung rība'i// mdung dang mdung chen sbyor ba dang // sel dang 'khyud pa'i 'phrod la sogs// rgyud 'grel rtsis la sbyor med na'ang // mkhas pa snga mas legs par bkag/ sgra gcan gyi rtsis 'phros dang bcas pa bshad pa'i skabs te le'u gsum pa'o//le'u bzhi pa/ lo zla bdag po'i gza' dang dbugs sgang khyim slebs skor/ stong nyid mdzes ma'i 'khri shing gis// legs 'khyud bde chen pā ka ra//mkha' khyab thugs rje'i grib bsil can// srid zhi'i gdung skyob de la 'dud//lo bdag gza' yi sgrub tshul ni// sna tshogs la sogs 'das pa'i lo// gnas gnyis steng ma mkha' mkha' chus4༷rkya/ / bsgyur ba 'og mas 'phri ba'i lhag /

༄7/rtsis kyi bstan bcos pad dkar bzhad pa'i nyin byed/ 833ri zla me 217thob gza' yi gnas// lhag ma mkha' ro 6rkyamakha' ro 6rkyadang //ros 6bsgyur ri zla me 217yis bgo/ thob nor chu tshod chu srang dbugs//lhag ma ri zla me yi cha// stedī nas rtse mo 2lag mig 22dang // bug mda' 59chu 4dang mtsho ri mig274/ 2/shā4 sbyin la 'og nas ri zla me217// dus 6dang mkha' ro 6rkyamakha' ro 6rkyadang // sa 'dzin 7gyis dor lhag ma de// byed pa'i lo yi 'pho ba ste// rgyud kyi dngos bstan 'di yin no// yang na lo bdag gnas lngar bkod// gzugs 1tshes 15gzugs me 21ri bong 1can// /sa nyis 121bsgyur la gong bzhin du// rtse mo 2lag mig 22la sogs sbyin//2/snyi4 ri zla me 217sogs bgos pa'i lhag/ gong dang mtshungs pa'i ri mo yi// rnam grangs yin no shes ldan dag/ lo gza' snga ma dag pa la// gzugs 11tshes 15gzugs me 21ri bong can1// zla ba nyi ma 121gnas mtshungs su//1lhalhasnya1 byin pas phyi ma'i nges pa 'char// zla bdag gza' yi sgrub tshul ni// lo 'pho'i gza' dang chu tshod gnyis// khyim gyi grangs du bkod byas la// 5kā zla ba thub dbang lug la ste//542 sde pa me mda' glang la'o//1kyi 'khrigs par zla ba ri gzugs dang //542 rig byed me dbang karka ṭa//212 bse ru mig lag seng ge ste//264chu gter rgyal ba bu mo la//561 srang la bro ba gzugs dbang dang //4kyi ri bong ri mtsho sdig pa'i 'o//126 yon tan mi bdag gzhu la ste//2rnyi chu gter ri me chu srin la//tsū bum par dus dang rig byed dang // 5༷2nam mkha' mig dbang nya la'o// de dag go rim bzhin du bya// 'og ma mkha' ros 6rkyabagos pa'i nor// steng du byin la ri bos 7bgo/ lhag ma khyim gza'i rnam par dag/ snga

༄7lhas kyi bstan bcos pad dkar bzhad pa'i nyin byed/ 847tshun mtshungs de nyid mi mtshungs na// bzung bya'i re'u mig grangs nyung ba'okude ltar gang zin re'u mig la// grangs mtshungs des dag mimatshungs na/ ka tho bzhin du mang khyad kyis/ rkang longs chu tshod bsgyur byas la// rim dang rim min gnyis ka la// rkang mtshams ma 'das sbyin bya zhing // 'das na dbri ba shes par bya// de ltar bsgrub pa'i skar dbyug srang // rang rang dal ba dag pa la// rim snon rim min dbri bar bya// gal te dbri bar ma ldang na//'khor lo bsnan nam yang na ni// sbyang byas sbyong byed la sbyangs pas// drang srong lnga yi myur ba dag/rim pa'i snga rkang shar la phyi rkang lho// rim min snga rkang nub la phyi rkang byang // rim bzhin myur dal 'khyog dang 'byung 'gros te// gza' dbang bgrod pas 'gros bzhi ldan pa'i tshul//nam mkha' nyi zla gdong ma jug dang // gza' lnga gnas pa'i khyim shes ched// rang rang skar ma mkha' 6rkyaros bsgyur// 'og gi chu tshod steng du bsre//mda' yon 125zlas thob 'das pa'i khyim// lhag rnams so so'i char 'gyur phyir// nyi lhag sangs gsum me ris 72bsgyur// rang rang 'khor lo steng du dril// rgyal ba mes 22 4thob 'das pa'i zhag/ mig dmar bug mig 229lag pas bsgyur// mkha' mtsho 540mdas thob 'das pa'i zhag/ spen pa me klu 5282me mdas bsgyur// mkha' gzugs klus ra1rkyathob 'das pa'i zhag/zla ba phyogs mkha' 2rkya1rkyamig gis bsgyur// tshes me ri drag 117 215gis thob zhag/ phur bu gzugs dus me 261yis bsgyur// sgra gcan mda' ri 'byung bas 575bsgyur// mda' yon zlas 125thob 'das pa'i zhag/ gdong mjug gnyis ni ma 'ongs zhag/ bgos lhag so sor mkha' ros 6rkyabasgyur//so sos thob pa chu tshod yin// lhag ma mkha' ros 6༷bsgyur ba la// 'og gi srang bcug thob pa srang // yang lhag ros 6bsgyur dbugs bsres la// thob

848 ༄7//'bri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/pa dbugs yin de lhag rnams// so so'i bgos byed kyis bsgyur bar// 'og gi cha bsres thobawā cha// de rnams rang rang khyim der 'das// gdong mjug ma 'ongs pa yin phyir// 0mda' ri 75'byung bar sbyangs pa'i lhag/ khyim der 'das pa'ikag yin no// nyi lhag sangs gsum mkha' me'i 2༷zhag/lharsha dbyug gur nyer lngar 25sbyang bar bya// mig dmar ri mda' 57dbyug tshes 15sbyangs//snyalha spen pa ri bug rdokha7klu zhag dang // rdoyam̐7 dbyug gu phyogs 10la sbyang bar bya// phur bu snazugs 261dus me zhag sbya ngas//261 zla ba zhag mig 2dbyug skyon 1rdodang //rdzuthe chu srang dus chu 46dbyug mtshor 4sbyangs// lhag rnams khyim dor ma 'ongs tshad// de yang zhag ni nyi zla dang // dgra gcan tshes zhag dang sbyar zhing // gza' gzhan lnga po nyin zhag dang sbyar ba// byed pa sla ba'i ched du'o// de ltar gza' rnams khyim dag tu// gnas tshul brtags nas gza' 'grems bya// blo gros sprin tshogs thob pa'i glog 'phreng can// legs bshad dbyar gyi rnga sgra cher sgrogs pa'i// gza' dbang bgrod pa gsal byed char gyi rgyun// blo gsal zhing pa dga' ba'i dga' ston lags// drang srong lnga'i dal myur gyi cho ga byed pa'i dbang du byas pa'i rgyud kyi dngos bstan dang grub mtha'i zhib brtsis re'u mig gi mgyogs ster bcas pa gsal bar byas pa ste le'u lnga pa'o//le'u drug pa/ dus spyor nges pa'i skor/dus dang dus can spros pa'i tshogs// dus gsum dus med phyogs rgya cher// mchog tu sdom mdzad dus 'khor lor// dus kun tu ni phyag bgyis nas// nang gi dus sbyor rtogs bya'i phyir// phyi yi dus sbyor bshad par bya//

༄7/rtsis kyi bstan bcos pad dkar bzhad pa'i nyin byed/ 849thog mar nyi ma khyim rnams su// 'pho ba'i nges pa rtogs sla ba// skar mig dbyug tshes lug gi tshad//115 rig byed mkha' me glang du brjod//24rkyaro dang zhe lnga 'khrig pa yin///5 dgu dang nam mkha' karka ṭa/ṭā drag po bco lnga seng ge'ony-i4// bcu gsum sum cu bu mor dran//lha: tshes dang zhe lnga srang yin zer//〈ninor zla stong pa sdig pa go/1rkyar nyi shu bco lnga gzhu yin snyam// glurshazung mig mkha' me chu srin mthong //snyinyu rgyal ba mda' chu bum par grags//rduni 'khor lo nya ru shes par bya//ཿ khyim gyi 'khor lo rdzogs pa yi// mtshan nyid dag ni bstan pa yin//dus sbyor so so'i nyin tshad ni// nya dang bu mo sum cur mnyam//2rkya lug dang seng ge sum cu gnyis//22 glang dang sbal pa sum cu bzhi// 24'khrig pa'i nyin tshad so drug go/26 srang dang bum pa nyer brgyad dang //2ra chu srin sdig pa nyi shu drug/26 gzhu yi nyin tshad rgyal ba'o//ṭwāṃ4 de rnams mkha' 6rkyaror 'phri ba'i lhag/ rang rang mtshan mo'i tshad du 'gyur//dus sbyor so so'i srang tshad ni// nam mkha' 2rkyarkyamakha' zung nya yi tshad//nam mkha' rig byed 240mtshe ma lug/ stong pa nor lag 2ṭwāṃXglang yin te//nam mkha' 22༷gnyis skyes 'khrig pa yin// mkha' dang dus me 26rkyakarka ṭa//nam mkha' mkha' mtsho 4rkyarkyaseng ge ste// bu mo la sogs zlog par bya// rang rang nas brtsams khyim drug gi// chu srang bsdoms pas nyin tshad dang // phyi ma'i khyim drug bsdoms pa yis// mtshan mo'i chu tshod nges par 'char//da ni 'das pa'i khyim zla dang // nyin mtshan 'phel 'grib zhib brtag phyir// nyi ma'i dal ba bar pa gang // mkha' ros 60bsgyur la chu tshod bsre//mda' yon 125zlas thob khyim zla'i grangs// lhag ma mkha' mes 2rkyabasgyur ba la// chu srang lag pas 2bgos thob gzhug/ thob pa 'das pa'i zhag yin te//

850 〉〉//'bri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/chu tshod sogs kyang sbyar bar bya// de ni don gyi khyim 'pho dang // don gyi 'das zhag nyid du brjod// 'das zhag steng nas klu 'di grub rtsis kyi dbang du byas kyis byed rtsis dang / bco lnga sbyang sha 'grig/ yis sbyang // ma ldang khyim nas phab la sbyangs// khyim yang 'khor lo 12rdzogs na bsnan// lhag ma'i khyim grangs gang yin pa// 'das pa'i khyim zla'i grangs yin zhing // zhag ni ngo thog rang gi khyim// de ni byed pa sla phyir yin// klu yis 'phri ba'i bco lnga 'phri ba'i zhag lhag gang // chus 4bsgyur mkha' ros 6rkyathob pa'i nor// chu tshod yin no lhag chu srang // byed pa sla ba'i khyim de yi// gzhu sogs byang bgrod nyin mor sbyin//'khrig sogs lho 'grod nyin mor der// des ni nyin mo'i tshad 'char zhing //mkha' ror 6༷'phri lag mtshan mo'i tshad// nyin mtshan 'phel 'grib de yis rtogs// 'das pa'i zhag grangs gang yin pa// rang rang chu srang gis bsgyur la// mkha' mes 2rkyathob pa 'das pa'i srang // de yis rang gis srang tshad la//'phri lhag khyim de'i ma 'ongs pa'i// chu srang yin no shes ldan dag/ da lta'i nyi khyim dang por byas/ nam langs thur grib nyer gcig bar// dang po'i khyim shar bdun pa nub// bcu gnyis tshe na gnyis pa shar// nyin gung tshe na gsum pa shar// bcu la bzhi pa nyi shur lnga// nyi nub tshe na drug pa shar// mtshan mo'ang cha shas 'di yis shes// cung zad rag (rags3pa'o zhib par na// rgya mtsho chu dang zla ba 144la// nya dang bu mor dus 6sbyin zhing // lug dang seng ge rang sar bzhag/ glang dang sbal ba dbyig ṭwāṃgis dman// 'khrig pa la ni nyes pa 1〈sbyangs// srang dang bum par bcu 10yang sbyin// sdig gzhu chu srin khyim 12gyis sbyangs// thub shing grib bcas kyis thob pa// chu tshod yin la de'i lhag ma drug cus 6rkyabasgyur// bgos thob srang yin dbugs kyang bya// snga dro 'das zin phyi dro lus// de yi nyin mo'i tshad la sbyangs// lhag ma snga dro 'char rgyu dang // phyi dro shar zin 'das pa yin// 'das pa'i chu tshod mkha' ros 60

— ༄༅/rtsisakyi bstan bcos pad dkar bzhad pa'i nyin byed/ 851bsgyur// rang gi ma 'ongs chu srang gis// thog ma byas nas sbyangs pa las//gang du ma ldang tadku la// de nas bgrangs pa'i bdun pa ni// nub pa'i dus sbyor yin shes bya// lug lug ga'i srang tshad snga nur byed pa'i dgongs pa'o//sogs drug la rim pa dang // srang sogs drug la bzlog pas dbri// 'dir 'das zhag steng nas klus sbyang ba ni zhag de sum cur ma longs kyi bar du da lta'i zhag tu sgro btags nas rang khyim dang mtshungs par 'dzin pa ni nyi ma gzhu khyim du sleb nas grub rtsis ltar na zhag brgyad na dgun nyi ldog pas klus sbyangs pa yin la/ byed pa'i dbang du na zhag bco lnga rtsi na ldog pas de ltar na 'das zhag steng nas bco lngas dbri dgos par grub bo// de'i phyir lho byang bgrod pa'i mtshams ngos bzung nas sbyin dor gyi ngos bzung sla ba'i ched du klu'i tshes kyis sbyang ba yin no// nyin mtshan gyi tshad sogs dbyangs 'char ltar byas pa yin la/ de la'ang lug gi srang tshad nya'i srang tshad sogs su snga nur dgos pa dang /dbyar dgun gyi nyi ma karka ṭa dang chu srin gyi khyim du mi bzlog cing ston dpyid kyi nyin mtshan mnyam pa'ang / lug srang gi khyim du mi 'byung sogs mngon sum gyi grub pa'i khyim re lnga nur ba yin no//dus sbyor gcig dang phyed pa dang // sum cha dgu cha bcu gnyis cha//sum cu'i cha yi bye brag rnams// shes par gyis shig lha mdzes ma// 'phri ba'i lhag ma sum cus 2rkyabasgyur// de la taṅgāl chu srang gis// bgos pas thob pa cha shas yin// lhag ma drug cus 6rkyabasgyur ba la// chu srang gis thob dbyug gu yin// yang lhag drug cus 6༷bsgyur ba la// chu srang gis thob chu srang yin//de lhag drug 6bsgyur thob pa dbugs// taṅgāl cha shas dbyug srang dbugs//dus sbyor gyi ni gnas lngar bzhed// dus sbyor thog mar gzhag pa'i phyir// taṅgā la ni sum cus 20bsgyur// 'og gi cha shas steng du gzhug/ de yang drug cus 6rkyabasgyur byas te// 'og gi chu tshod steng du bsre// mkha' mkha' 1/00nor dang gzugs kyis bgo/ thob pa dus sbyor gcig pa ste// taṅgā la dang bye brag med//dus sbyor phyed pa lta ba'i phyir// cha shas drug cus 6༷bsgyur ba la// 'og gi chu tshod dang ldan pa// 'di ni kun gyi bgo gzhi'o//

852 ༄7//'bri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/mkha' mkha' 'aXbu gas bgos pa la// 'di nas sum cu'i cha shas bar// phyed pas lhag lhag ma byung na na gcig 1sbyin bya// 'dir rnyed gnyis las mang mi srid// gcig gis bdag po nyi ma 1ste// gnyis kyi bdag po zla ba 2yin//de nas sum cha brtags pa ni// spyi nor mkha' mkha' 6rkyarkyaro yis bgo/rnyed pa gsum las mang mi srid// gcig ni taṅgā la yin te// gnyis byung taṅgāl nas bgrangs lnga// gsum byung dgu pa'i dus sbyor bshad// gang yin bdag po'i 'bras bu 'byung // de nas dgu cha brtag par bya// spyi nor mkha' 2༷rkyastong mig gis bgo/ rnyed pa dgu las mang mi srid// taṅgāl nas bzung dgu cha brtag/ gang yin bdag po'i 'bras bu 'byung // lug seng gzhu rnams lug nas bgrang // chu srin bu mo glang rnams ni// chu srin nas ni bgrang bar bya// 'khrigs pa bum pa srang rnams ni// dang po srang nas grangs bzung ngo // karka ṭa dang sdig pa nya// karka ṭa nyid thog mar gzhag/ bcu gnyis cha la sngar bzhin du// spyi nor nam mkha' tshes 15༷kyis bgo/ rnyed pa khyim 12las lhag mi srid// taṅgāl nas bgrangs gang yin gyi// bdag po'i 'bras bu 'byung bar 'gyur// sum cu'i cha la spyi yi nor// mkha' ros 60bgos pa'i thob nor du// sum cu las ni mang mi srid// mig dmar spen pa phur bu dang //lhag sangs dbus su rim par bzhag/ lnga dang lnga dang brgyad bdun lnga//g.yas dang g.yon du bgod par bya// lug sogs mi mnyam rim pa g.yas//glang sogs mnyam g.yon rim min bgrang // dbus kyi bdag po'i 'bras bu 'byung // da ni de yi bgos byed bshad// nyi khri chig stong drug brgya'i 216rkyarkyadabugs// nyi mas 12phye nor 'pho chen gcig de la 'pho chen gcig po rim bzhin lag pa 2dang // me 2dang bu ga 9nyi ma 12dang // mkha' mes 2༷thob nor rim pa bzhin// dum bu so so'i dkyil 'khor 'gyur// 'di dag

854 sa༅khabri gung sman rtsisasnyogs bsgrigs/nyi ma byed pa'i nyi ma dag pa la/ /7 chu tshod ri me srang srin po dbugs dbang pos sbyangs na zhal lung rnam dag ma dang 'grig dag pa dang ka gdong dang dus me gang nye brtag/gdong gis 'dzin par 'gyur ba na// sgra gcan gdong gis nyi ma sbyang // skar gnas stongs shing chu tshod du// 5༷5 nga lnga'i bar du 'dzin pa yin// gal te nyi mas gdong sbyangs na/ skar gnas stongs shing chu tshod kyang //rsha gcig nas lnga bar phal cher 'dzin// dus 6ri 7klu 8dang srin po 9la// cung zad 'dzin srid lhag na min// nyi mas mjug ma sbyangs pa na// skar gnas stongs pa gzhir bzhag la//5༷5 chu tshod nga lnga'i bar du brtag/ gal te mjug mas nyi sbyangs na// skar gnas stongs shing chu tshod ni// rshamada' yi bar du phal cher 'dzin// dus 6ri 7klu ṭwāṃl sum cha dang // dgu 9nas bcu gsum 12bar dag tu// bzhi cha tsam zhig 'dzin par ni// 'dod pa yod de brtag par bya// de ltar 'dzin pa'i gnas rig nas// gsar bu nges pa skye ba'i phyir// gdong gis 'dzin tshe nyi dag la// sgra gcan rtsa ba bsre bar bya// rang rang 'khor los steng du dril// 'khor lo'i 27'khor phyed lhaglulongs pa der// de dang gong gi lhag ma gnyis// phan tshun gcig gis gcig sbyangs pas//nghru gnas bzhi'i gnas gsum stongs na 'dzin// mjug gis 'dzin tshe nyi dag dang // 'das pa bsres la lhag mar sbyin// rkyarang 'khor dril la 'khor lo'am27/ / 'khor phyed lha:lhag na dor bar bya//lci gnas kun stongs na 'dzin par 'dod// 'on kyang nyi bul bsre ba'i ngal ba 'di// rgyud dang 'grel par bshad pa med//mkhas rlom mgo bo rmongs pa'i phyir// mkhas pa sngon ma'i dpe mkhyud mdzad//gzhan de ladag dpyad pa med par ni// nyi 'dzin rtogs thabs zabe mor yin pa

〉〉rtes kyi bstan bcos pad dkar bzhad pa'i nyin byed/ 855'khrul// sbyang de'irgyu mtshan bya sbyong byed go log cing // lhag ma'ang shin tu mang gyur kyang // gnas bzhi'i gnas gsum nges par stongs// de tshe dela'adzin nam mi 'dzin pa'i// nges bzung ji ltar bya ba smos// gzhan yang nyi dag gnas gsum bzhag/ so so'i dbyug gur chu bo 4sbyinaku dang por mun can 'das pa bsre// gnyis par 'khor 27bsre gdong gis sbyangs/ gsum par phyed lha:bsres mjug gis dbri// skar ma'i gnas nas 'khor lo'am27//'dod pa 12dor bas thig gsum sharaX// the tshom med par 'dzin par 'dod// 'di yang sbyang tshul ma log dang // log kyang sbyang lhag nyung ngu yi//dbang du byas kyi gzhan du min// gdong gis 'dzin tshe nyi ma mang // mjug 'dzin de las ldog pa dgos/ phan tshun bzlog par gyur pa na// lhag ma mang tshe 'dzin mi 'gyur/ sbyang bya sbyong byed ma log na// lhag ma mang yang 'dzin pa mthong // nyi ma dang ni zhi gza' gnyis// khyim gcig tshogs sam tshogs su nye//nyi zla'i rna cha dag pa zhes// chung ngur 'dzin tshe mngon par dka'// sbyangs lhag chu tshod stongs ༷sam gcig1/ shar tshe 'dzin pa dka' zhes zer// chu tshod stongs ༷kyang bzung ba ni/ kho bo'i myong bas legs par grub// nyi rkang dus 6la spyod pa dang // gzhu srin 'khrig kar khyim bzhi la// nyi ma gnas par gyur pa na// cha ni chung bar 'dzin zhes zeraka che chung ji tsam 'dzin pa ni//sbyangs lhag chu tshod chu srang du//2shāX brgyad dang nyi shu'i bar du ni// ril por 'dzin ni chu tshod dgu//༵ chu srang mkha' mtshe'i bar dag tu// bcu gnyis cha gcig ma gtogs 'dzin//1༷rkya chu tshod bcu dang chu srang stongs// dgu cha ma gtogs 'dzin par 'gyur//lhaXglu dbyug srang bcu gsum nyi shu la// bzhi cha ma gtogs 'dzin pa yin// 〈༷'u mi bdag mkha' mtsho bar du ni// sum gnyis

856 ༄7ltarabri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/'dzin no chu tshod du//2༷rkya nyi shu lus na phyed lhag tsam|ghā0glu nyer gsum nyi shu 'i dbyug srang la// phyed 'dzin yin no chu tshod du//gluX9 nyer drug chu srang bzhi bcu la// phyed pas cung chung dbyug gu ni// 2༷2 so gnyis shar tshe sum cha 'dzin//lhaXrā dbyug srad so brgyad nyi shu la// bzhi cha gcig gi zhe drug dang //ciX9 bzhi bcur drug cha gcig 'dzin no//5:5 chu tshod nga lnga 'dus pa'i tshe// nyi ma'i bcu gnyis cha gcig 'dzin// gzhan yang ri mo'i rnam grangs ni// sbyang lhag chu tshod bdun phyin la//phyogs 1༷ster bdun las mang ba na// 'byung ba 5byin la mkha' ror 6rkya'aphri//lhag ma nyis 12bsgyur mkha' ros 60bgo/ nor la me 2bsres 'dzin pa'i cha//re ros bcu gnyis cha re sgrib// me 2dus 6bu ga 9nyicem 12rnams// bzhi cha phyed dang bzhi gsum ril// 'dzin par 'gyur ro som nyi spongs// yangan sbyangs lhag chu tshod de// mda' 5yis bgos pa'i rnyed pa la//gzugs 1sam mig 2byung ril por sgrib/ gsum —2thob drug cha ma gtogs 'dzin// bzhi 4la phyed 'dzin lnga thob na// phyed pas cung chung drug 6gsum cha// bdun 7thob drug cha brgyad rdobargyad cha// dgu 9nas 10bcu gcig 11bar dag tu// dgu cha bcu cha bcu gcig cha// re re sgrib par 'gyur ba yin//yang na lag len myong grub ni// gdong gis nyi sbyangs lhag ma des//mkha' ror 6rkya'aphri lhag mda' 5yis bgo/ thob pa'i nor la gang byung de//nyi ma'i cha ni 'dzin pa'i grangs// de yis nyi ma 12la 'phri ba'i// lhag ma mi 'dzin pa yi cha// nyi mas dus me sbyangs pa'i lhag/ mkha' ror 6rkya'aphri lhag mda' 5yis bgo/ thob pa'i grangs la gang byung de// nyi ma'i cha ni mi gong du 'dzin la snga ma rnams dang khyad med cing mjug 'dzin la 'di kho na nges pa 'dug pas lag tu long dang

〉〉/rtsis kyi bstan bcos pad dkar bzhad pa'i nyin byed/ 857bslu bar mi 'gyur ro// 'dzin te// de yis nyi ma 12sbyangs pa'i lhag/ 'dzin pa'i cha yin 'khrul pa med// nyi ma'i cha ni bcu gnyis so//yun ni sbyangs pa'i lhag ma des// zhag gi dbyug gu drug cur 6rkyasbyangs//lhag ma mda' 5yis thob pa'i nor// 'dzin pa'i yun yin ril 'dzin tshe//chu tshod bcu gnyis 12bar du ste// de bzhin cha re dbyug gu rer// mnyam pa'i rigs mda' kun la snun//mdor na dang po'i sbyangs lhag dang // bar du thig le bzhi shar dang //tha mar yun la brtag bya ste// sbyangs lhag shin tu nyung ba dang // thig le gnas bzhir shar ba dang // yun ni chu tshod bcu gnyis su// longs sam longs su nye ba na// som nyi spongs la lung bstan byos//dus ni tshes kyi longs spyod la// ston dpyid mnyam tshe 'dod pa 12dang //mthar thug gnyis la mi bdag 16sbyin// lhag ma zla ba brgyad po la// shed bu 14tshes 15dag snon pa ni// 'phel hor zla bcu gnyis pa la bco lnga/ dang po la bcu bzhi gsum pa la bcu bzhi bzhi pa la bco lnga/ de bzhin du hor zla drug pa ding bcu pa la bco lnga/ bdun pa dang dgu pa la bcu bzhi ster ba yin no// zhing 'grib pa'i rim pas shes// byed pa'i tshes la 'di rnams dgos// grub mthar nur ster ngal ba med// nor bcas tshes kyi dbyug gu dag/zad pa'i mtshams su 'dzin par 'gyur// tshes longs ji trem nyung bzhin du//gling 'dir mthong shas che ba yin// ha cang longs spyod mang ba na// 'jig rten grags pa'i tshes gcig gi/ snga dro nyi ma 'dzin pa mthong //phyogs ni gdong gis nyi sbyangs sam// nyi ma dus me sbyangs pa na// nyi phyed lho nub mtshams nas 'dzin// phyed gong lhor nye phyed 'og la// nub la nye ba'i phyogs nas so// dus mes nyi ma sbyangs pa'am// nyi mas gdong la sbyangs pa na// nyin phyed rlung lha'i phyogs nas te// phyed gong byang nye phyed 'og dus//nub la nye ba'i phyogs nas 'dzin// shar nas nam yang ma yin no// yang na nyi

858 ༄7khabri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/ma lhor bgrod tshe// rlung gi phyogs la nye ba dang // byang du bgrod tshe bden bral la// nye ba'i phyogs nas 'dzin no zhes// dus zhabs shākya dbang phyug gsung // gzhan dag de las ldog par smra//kha dog gdong la dmar nag dang // dus me la ni dmar ser ro// dum 'dzin nag cing phyed 'dzin sngo// gsum gnyis kham la ril 'dzin tshe//lcags bsregs pa yi mdog dang mtshungs// rgyu skar mgo lag steng bzung na//nam mkha'i mdangs la 'gran par 'gyur//de nas zla ba 'dzin tshul ni// zla ba rdzogs pa'i longs spyod la// tshes gza'i chu tshod man chad bsre// yang na tshes longs ma sbyangs pa'i// nya yi tshes 'khyud zla ba dang nas lnga sbyang ba man ngag go// / sgra gcan gdong mjug gang nye gnyis// mang la nyung gis sbyangs pa'i lhag/ skar gnas stongs shing chu tshod ni//505 nga lnga'i bar du brtag parwa bya// de bas mang na 'dzin mi 'gyur// byed pa'i tshes 'khyud dbang pos 5sbyangs//tt+waṃ2 grub mtha'i tshes 'khyud zla ba yi// chu tshod gnyis skyes srang bu ga9/ dbugs la dbang po 5bsnan pa na// zla 'dzin man ngag dam pa 'char// cha ni sbyangs lhag chu tshod la// 'byung bas 5'gos pa'i thob nor du// gzugs 1mig 2me 2mtsho 4ril por sgrib// mda' 5shar drug cha ma gtogs 'dzin//ro 6la sum gnyis ri trel phyed| klu ral sum cha bug 9drug cha// phyogs 1rkyal brgyad cha 11drag po la// bco lnga cha gcig 'dzin par 'gyur// yang na sbyangs lhag chu tshod de// klu lag 2ṭwāṃgis bsgyur mkha' ros 6༷bgo/ rnyed pas de nyid 25la sbyangs shing // de lhag des kyang tshes 15la sbyangs// sbyang du ma ldang ril por 'dzin// ldang na slar yang lhag ma des// tshes 15la sbyangs lhag gang byung ba// grangs snyed zla ba'i cha 'dzin te// zla ba tshes kyi char rtsi'o// 'di ni

༄7/rtsis kyi bstan bcos pad dkar bzhad pa'i nyin byed/ 859cung zad rags par mngon// yang na 'di myong grub ma'o lhag ma bdun 7phyin la|phyogs 10dang bdun 7las mang ba na// mda' 5bsres de yi mkha' ror 6rkyadabri/ lhag ma nyis bsgyur 12mkha' ros 6rkyabago/ nor la me 2bsres 'dzin pa'i cha// khyim 12dang dbang phyug 11ril por 'dzin// phyogs 10la dkar cha mngon tsam lus// srin po 9mtshams 6dang 'jig rten 2la// bzhi gsum phyed dang bzhi cha gcig/ de yi 'gros kyis shes par bya//yun ni ril por 'dzin pa'i tshe// chu tshod bcu gnyis 12 bco lnga 'dod pa yod sne mang ba'i skyon bar du ste// phyed la drug sogs rigs pas dpyad// dus kyang nyi ma ji bzhin du// nor byin bcas pa'i tshes longs la// dus de'i nyin mo'i dbyug gus dbri// lhag ma mun mtshams nas bzung ste// de snyed grangs 'das mtshams su 'dzin// phyogs ni zla bas gdong sbyangs sam// dus mes zla ba sbyangs pa na//nam phyed byang shar phyed gong byang // phyed 'og shar la nye ba 'dzin nas/ / gdong gis zla ba sbyangs pa'am// zla bas mjug sbyangs nam phyed nas// shar lho nas 'dzin phyed gong shar// phyed 'og lho la nye ba nas// rgyu skar bdag po sgrib par byed// phan tshun mnyam par gyur pa na// nam phyed shar gyi phyogs nas te//srod la dbang ldan nam smad me// nub nas nam yang 'dzin mi srid// gang bzung phyogs nas grib ma mdzad//kha dog nyi ma'i skabs dang mtshungs// de ltar bshad pa de dag kyang / /zhib mo'i dbang du byas mod kyi// da dung shes par bya ba yod// 'dzin pa'i nges pa rnyed na yang // rang gnas nyin srib gar gtogs dang // de yang ri la nye ring dang // ri yang shar nub mtho dma' dang // ri klung sa khad yangs dog dang // lung pa'i shar nub lho byang dang // lho byang nyi zla'i bgrod mtha' dang // skabs de'i nyi zla 'char nub pa// legs par brtag pa gnad du che//

860 ༄7/'bri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/tshes longs 'phel dang gdong 'dzin dang // cha cher 'dzin tshe myur rang 'dzin pa ba dang // tshes longs 'grib dang mjug 'dzin dang // dum 'dzin bul bar 'dzin pa ni//sngarabs bshad pa bzhin du myong bas grub// byed rtsis lhag chad yod kyang 'dzin// khyad par gnam gang chad pa'i tshe/ tshes gcig la ni 'dzin pa mthong // grub mtha'i rtsis la nya stong dag/ chad na nyi zla mi 'dzin pas// de phyir tshes kyi lhag chad sogs// zhib mor dpyad de mi 'khrul ba'i//nges pa rnyed nas smra bar byos// 'di dag re re'i don la yang // rnam pa du mar legs dpyad nas// phal cher ri mos gtan la phab// de phyir 'khrul pa med snyam sems// nyi zla gza' 'dzin gyi man ngag rab tu gsal bar byas pa ste le'u bdun pa'o//mjug gi don/rdo rje nyi ma bden donabacu gnyis ldan// rdo rje'i zla ba de nyid bcu drug rig/ rdo rje'i sgyu 'phrul rnam pa nyi shus chub// rdo rje'i slob dpon mchog dngos grub de rgyal// gang gi byin rlabs nyi ma'i khu ba ni// lan brgyar 'thungs pa'i blo gros 'dab brgya pa// rnam dpyod spobs pa'i 'dzum dkar bzhad pa las// legs bshad sbrang rtsi'i dga' ston tshar du dngar// grags 'byor lang tsho'i khur dman yang // mkhas la 'os pa'i legs bshad gtam//sngon rabs mdzangs pas ma myangs pa'i// dga' ston 'di 'dra yud kyis bskrun// de las byung dang des mtshon pa'i// kha ba dung dang kunda ltar//dkar ba'i bsod nams gang mchis pa// des ni srid gnas lus can kun//tshogs gnyis chu klung 'bum sdud cing // mkhyen gnyis rin chen kun gyi bdag/bden gnyis gdengs kas mdzes pa yi// rnam grol klu dbang de thob shog/

༄7/rtsis kyi bstan bcos pad dkar bzhad pa'i nyin byed/ 861ces rtsis kyi bstan bcos pad dkar bzhad pa'i nyin byed ces bya ba 'di yang lha sngags ye shes thams cad kyi khyab bdag dpal ldan 'bri gung pa chen po gsang ba sngags kyi rig pa 'dzin pa chos kyi grags pa 'phrin las rnam par rgyal ba'i sde zhes snyan par grags pa de'i zhabs rdul spyi bos blangs pa'ikhyin rlabs kyi mthu kho na dang rtsis gzhi rtsoms shig par rjes su gnang ba thob gal brten nas mnga' ris stod du skyes pa'i btsun pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyi 'du 'dzis dben pa'i bsam gtan dang rjes su mthun pa'i bsti gnas rin chen brag gi bla brang du sbyar ba dge legs su gyur cig/slad nas rab byung bcu gcig pa 'di nyid rang gi nang tshan me stag 'das lor bsgyur zhing / gzhan rnams dpal ldan bla ma dkon lhun nyid kyi ljags sgrigs sor bzhag pa yang 'bri ban bha dras so//gdod nas 'a gyur med thabs mchog bde chen sku// shes rab stong nyid zung 'jug ye shes che// dang po'i sangs rgyas khyab bdag dus 'khor dang //dbyer med rje btsun bla mar mgos phyag 'tshal// ji snyed shes bya'i chos kyi chu gter cher// rmad byung mkhyen rab rlabs 'phreng mi zad pa// spro mkhas gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇḍi ta// dkon mchog lhun grub mtshan snyan dad pas bsngags// gang gis mkhyen dpyod las mthon (thon3skar rtsis kyi// gzhung bzang pad ma dkar po bzhad pa'i phyir// zab don gsung gi nyin byed 'di shar tshe// blo ldan chu skyes 'dab brgya brtas par byed// 'dor byed grangs kyi ngal dub chu 'dzin gyis// lag len rgyu skar gtso bo sgrib pa'i tshe// lhag bsam dri bzhon shugs kyis slar bsal nas// rang lugs rtsis gzhung ri dwags rnam par bkra// 'dis mtshon rab dkar dge tshogs duddha bhiḥ brtson 'grus dbyug gus bskul ba'i legs bshad sgra// blo ldan thos 'dzin bdud rtsir 'gyur ba dang // 'gro kun duḥkha'i gnyid las grol gyur cig/ de ltar rtsis

862 ༄7//'bri gung sman rtsis phyogs bsgrigs/kyi bstan bcos pad dkar bzhad pa'i nyin byed ces bya ba gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇḍi ta paṇa chen dkon mchog lhun grub kyi ljags sgrigs tshig don phun sum tshogs shing lag len khyer bde ba 'di nyid rgyal dbang dkon mchog 'phris /'phrin las3bzang pos rab byung bcu gcig pa'i mtha' zad pa me stag la 'das lo spos pa gnang 'dug kyang / deng skabs 'das lo brgya dang so drug skor 'gro ba bcas 'dor byed grangs kyi ngal dub la brten pa'i tsis pa rnams kyis lag len cher byed kyin mi 'dug par/ des na rang lugs rtsis kyi bstan bcos 'di nyid nyams pa'i rgyur mthong nas 'bri gung pa bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis sngar rang lo bcu bdun pa sa sbrul lor slob dpon mkhas pa'i dbang po dkon mchog don grub chos dbang gi drung nas/ byed grub lnga bsdus sgra gcan/ rtsis phran myur rtsis bskal li skor dang / mtshur lugs kyi gza' lnga dus sbyor sogs bslab sbyangs bgyis kyang / na tshod phra stabs ha cang go don mtha' chod zhig ma byung ba/ slar yang chu lug lor slob dpon de nyid kyi gdan tshab nyin rdzong khri— pa karma chos dbyings lhun grub las bskyararugasos kyi 'das lo spo tshul sogs zhib tu dpyad de rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i sna tshogs chu rtar spos bstan rtsis cung zad bsnan/ dbugs sgang khyim slebs ri phag ldog gnyis bcas gsar du bcug cing / gzhung tshig dngos paṇa chen gyi gsung sor bzhag bgyis te dpal ldan 'bri gung pa'i pho brang bkra shis tshugs kyi gzims sbug tshe dbang 'khyil du bris pa'i shog thog tu 'bebs pa po ni dge slong gu ṇa kā ra'o// shu rghaṃ//
